gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshes dang tshes gnyis la ma rnyed kyang tshes gsum dang tshes bcu tshun cad kyis gos mang po dag cig rnyed na dge slong des zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du ①snga ma dag gtang rgyabar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am/gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin ③par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi rjogos spang bar gyur dun de ma spangs shing bral bar ma byas la ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig rnyed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi dugos spang bar gyur ⑦na de spangs shing bral bar ma byas la ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig rnyed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi lagos spang bar gyur na de spangs shing bral bar byas la ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig rnyed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi ⑨gos spang bar gyur na de spangs shing bral bar byas la ltung ba bshags nas gzhan zhig rnyed na de la ltung ba med do/ /de bzhin du dge slong gis ji srid du spang ba'i dngos po de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags par spre)lhung bzed dam/chos gos sam/ dra ba'am/ phor yibu'am/ ska rags sam/ dge sbyong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad gang yang rung ba gzhan nye bar 'jog par byed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang /sems 'khrugs ⑩pa dang / tshor ba dag gis 0nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /'chang ba'i spang ba ste dang po rdzogs stob// //6—101

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal ①mgon med zas sbyin gyi ②kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong rnams la chos gos mang ba nyid 'di lta bu 'di byung ste/ dge slong dbyar gnas par khas blangs pa gang yang rung bas chos gos rnyed nas des de bkrus shing dras te drubs nas kha bsgyur ①te gtur bu'i bam po bsgres nas dge slong gnas pa dang /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la rjes su gtad de/ dge slong dag chos gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs rgyur 'dong zhing de dag chos gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs 0rgyur 'dong ba na ma sbas pa dang sbed du ma bcug rjopar gyur to/ /dge slong gnas pa dang gzhug mar gnas pa dag kyang chos gos de dag skems 0pa dang / bsang ⑦ba dang /'ding ba dang / sprug ⑧pa dang / brtul ⑨ba dang / sbed pa dag byed pas bya ba mang ba dang / byed pa mang bar gyur cing lung mnod ⑩pa dang / bklag ⑩pa dang / kha ton tsodang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba dang / nang gi sems kyi zhi gnas gtong bar byed nas/ dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong rnams la chos gos mang ba nyid 'di lta bu 'di byung ste/ dge slong dbyar gnas par khas blangs pa gang yang rung bas chos gos rnyed nas des de bkrus shing dras te drubs nas kha bsgyur te gtur 'bu'i bam po bsgres nas dge slong gnas pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la rjes su gtad (stede/dge slong dag chos gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs rgyur 'dong zhing de dag chos gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs 6—102

rgyur 'dong ba na ma sbas ①pa dang sbed du ma bcug par gyur/ dge slong gnas pa dang gzhug mar gnas ②pa dag kyang chos gos de dag skems ③pa dang /bsang rjob dang / 'ding ba dang / sprug pa dang / brtul dub dang /sbed pa dag byed pas bya ba mang ba dang / byed pa mang bar gyur cing lung mnod ༷pa dang / bklag ⑦pa dang / kha ton dang / rnal 'byor dang /yid la bya ba dang / nang gi sems kyi zhi gnas gtong bar byed ces smod par byed / phyar ⑧ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi ⑨'di dang / skabs ⑩'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen yibazhin du rmed 8par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong mang po dag la mas 8pa/ dge slong dag khyed la chos gos mang ba nyid 'di lta bu tsobyung ste/ dge slong dbyar gnas par khas blangs pa gang yang rung bas chos gos rnyed nas des de 8bkrus shing dras te drubs nas kha bsgyur te gtur ⑫bu'i bam po bsgres nas dge slong gnas pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la rjes su gtad de/ dge slong dag 0chos gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs rgyur 'dong zhing khyed cag chos gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs rgyur 'dong ba na ma sbas pa dang / sbed du ma bcug par gyur la/ dge slong gnas pa dang gzhug mar gnas pa dag kyang chos gos de dag skems 8pa dang / bsang ⑩ba dang / 'ding ba dang / sprug pa dang /6—103

brtul ①ba dang / sbed pa dag byed pas bya ba mang ba dang / byed pa mang bar gyur cing lung mnod ②pa dang / bklag ①pa dang / kha ton dang /rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba dang / nang gi sems kyi zhi gnas gtong bar byed pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas 0bcom ldan 'das kyis gso dka' ༷ba dang / dgang dka' dub dang / 'dod pa che ba dang /chog mi shes pa rnam par smad pa ⑦mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gso sla ⑧ba dang / dgang sla ⑨ba dang / 'dod pa chung ba dang / chog shes pa dang / phri ba dang / yo byad bsnyungs pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang /mdzes pa nyid dang / tshod shes pa'i bsngags pa brjod nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par rjes su gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ⑩bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga (trem bzhin no/ /'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong chos gos zin pas sra brkyang phyung na gal te nub gcig 8kyang chos gos gsum las chos gos gang yang rung ba dang mtshams kyi phyi rol du bral tshubar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab 8pa'i gzhi bca' ba mdzad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po rgyal po'i khab na sde can ma'i phug na gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas dge 'dun dang mthun par 'dug go/ /byadage slong rab tu mang po dag de nyid kyi 6wa 104

gso sbyong bcwa ②lnga pa'i tshe gso sbyong gi gnas su 'dug cing mthun par gyur nas gtso cher tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po 'ong ba la sdod do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po gso sbyong gi gnas su 'phags pa na chu klung dbyar bzang ldan rgal ②ba dang chu rlabs chen po byung ba des de'i snam sbyar gsher ③bar gyur to / /de nas tshe rjodang ldan pa 'od srung chen po snam sbyar de 'tshir ba dang / 'ding ba dang / skems 0pa na yun ring du thogs par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos rjosnam sbyar de bcir cing bting ste bskams ⑦nas gso stong gi gnas ga la ba der song ste phyin nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du stan ⑧bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas dge slong rab tu mang po dag gis tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa 'od srung 0chen po mkhyen par mdzod cig /'di na bdag cag dge slong rab tu mang po dag gso sbyong gi gnas su 'dug cing mthun par gyur nas gtso cher tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po la sdod cing 'khod na/ 'on kyang tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po 'phyis ⑩par gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di na bdag ⑩gso sbyong gi gnas su 'phags pa na chu 0klung dbyar bzang ldan rgal ⑩ba dang chu rlabs chen po byung ba des bdag gi snam sbyar gsher bar gyur nas/ bdag snam sbyar 'tshir ba dang / 'ding ba dang / skoms 8pa na yun ring zhig thogs par gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag da ltar bdag dge slong 'od srung chen po rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa lags la bdag gi snam sbyar ni lci bas yongs su skyong bar rngo mi thog tson/ bdag gis ⑩ji ltar bgyi zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 6—105

kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis dge slong 'od srung chen po rgan po ①rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa dang / gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba byin cig /'di ltar sbyin par bya ste/gnas mal bshams ②pa byas nas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs ①te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo nas dkyil 'khor bar dge slong bzhi'i ④tshogs las mi nyung ba'i dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la dge slong 'od srung gis bla gos phrag pa gcig ⑤tu byas te rgan rims dubazhin du phyag 'tshal nas rgan pa'i mtha' logs su tsog pur 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas dge 'dun la snam ①sbyar nye bar bstan te 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong 'od srung rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa lags la bdag gi nisnam sbyar ni lci bas yongs su skyong bar rngo mi thog ⑨nas/ bdag dge slong 'od srung rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa dge 'dun las snam 0sbyar dang 'bral tsobar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba gsol na/thugs brtse 8ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse tsoba'i slad du bdag dge slong 'od sung rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang (sreb stsal du gsol/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o//dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong 'od sung 'di rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa lags la 'di'i snam sbyar ni lci bas yongs su skyong bar rngo mi thog tsonas/ dge slong 'od srung rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa 'di dge 'dun las snam 0sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba gsol na/ gal 6—106

te dge 'dun gyi ①dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis ②gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'od srung rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsol ②sto/ /'di ni gsol ba'o / /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/dge slong 'od srung 'di rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa lags la 'di'i snam rjosbyar ni lci bas yongs su skyong bar rngo mi thog ⑤nas/ dge slong 'od srung rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa 'di dge 'dun las snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang rjob gsol te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'od srung rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsol ⑦na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong 'od srung rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung ⑧shig /gang dag 0mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ⑩shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'od srung rgan po rgas pa dgog tu gyur pa la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun gyis dge slong gang yang rung ba la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba byin par gyur na des yichos gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs rgyur 'gro bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa shā 8ri'i bu 'khor de nyid du 'dug cing mthun par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā 0ri'i bus dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag da ④ltar bdag dge slong shā ri'i bu rlung nad can 6—107

lags la①/ bdag gi snam sbyar ni lci bas yongs su skyong bar rngo mi thog ②na bdag gis ji ltar bgyi zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis ③bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis dge slong ༷shā ri'i bu rlung nad can dang gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba byin cig /'di ltar sbyin par bya ste/ gnas mal bsham ⑤pa byas nas gaṇ+ḍi rjobardungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo nas dkyil 'khor bar dge slong bzhi'i tshogs las mi nyung ba'i dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la/dge slong shā ༅ri'i bus bla gos phrag pa gcig tu byas te rgan rims ⑧bzhin du phyag 'tshal nas rgan pa'i mtha' logs su tsog pur 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas dge 'dun la snam sbyar nye bar bstan te 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong shā ri'i bu 0rlung nad can lags la bdag gi snam sbyar ni lci bas yongs su skyong bar rngo mi thog ⑩nas/bdag dge slong shā ri'i bu rlud nad can dge 'dun ⑩las snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba gsol na thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag dge slong shā ri'i bu rlung nad can la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsal du gsol/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong shā ri'i bu 'di rlung nad can lags la 'di'i snam sbyar ni lci bas yongs su skyong bar rngo mi thog tsonas/ dge slong shā ri'i bu rlung nad can 'di dge 'dun las snam 6—108

sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ①dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong 'e ri'i bu rlung nad can la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsol to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong shā ri'i bu 'di rlung nad can lags la 'di'i snam sbyar cini lci bas yongs su skyong bar rngo mi thog ②nas/dge slong shā ri'i bu rlung nad can 'di dge 'dun las snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba gsol te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong shā ri'i bu rlung nad can la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsol na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong shā ri'i bu rlung nad can la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung ①shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ④shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong shā ⑤ri'i bu rlung nad can la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi ⑥gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun gyis dge slong gang yang rung ba la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba byin par gyur na/ des chos gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs rgyur 'gro bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa 'dod pa rnams kyi ⑦bsngags pa brjod cing bslab pa la gus pa rnams dang / bslab ⑧pa la yo byad bsnyungs ⑨pa rnams dang / phri ba rnams dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan rnams dang / mdzes pa rnams dang / tshod shes pa rnams kyi yon tan brjod nas dge 6—109

slong ①rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na snga ma ni bcas pa yin la 'di ni gnang ba yin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab ②pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong chos gos zin pas sra brkyang ③phyung na gal te nub gcig ④kyang chos gos gsum las chos gos gang yang rung ba dang mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'bral bar byed na dge 'dun gyis gnang ba ma gtogs te spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /dge slong zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa'o/ /chos gos zin pas sra brkyang phyung na zhes bya ba ni chos gos zin la sra brkyang ma phyung ba yang yod/ chos gos ma zin la sra brkyang phyung ba yang yod/ chos gos zin cing sra brkyang phyung ba yang yod/ chos gos ma zin cing sra brkyang ma phyung ba yang yod de/snga ma bzhin du mu bzhir rgyas par sbyar ro/ /gal te nub gcig kyang zhes bya ba ni nub gcig ⑤gi mthar yang ngo / /chos gos gsum las chos gos gang yang rung ba dang zhes bya ba ni snam sbyar dang bla gos dang mthang gos las gang yang rung ba dang ngo / /mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'bral bar byed na zhes bya ba ni gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na'o/ /dge 'dun gyis gnang ba ma gtogs te zhes bya ba ni dge 'dun gyis gnang ba bzhag ste'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi dultung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ⑦ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar ②ji ltar 'gyur zhe na bar sdom la/ khyim gcig pa dang khyim gnyis dang / /khyim gyi latshogs dang ldan pa dang / /rtsig pa rib ma 'obs bskor dang / /rnam bzhir bya ba grong dang khyim/ /sten ⑩'gro mu stegs tshong rdal dang / /tshong khang sgra khang yigayul dang ni/ /g.yul tshoms gru dang 6—110

shing rta dang / /shing ljon kun dga'i ra ba yin/ /lam du 'gro sdod 'dug nyal dang / /thad kur yang ni de bzhin te/ /mtshams gzhan nyal ba tha ma yi/ /sde tshan yang dag bsdus pa yin// khyim gcig dang ldan pa'i grong dang / khyim gnyis dang ldan pa'i grong dang /khyim gyi tshogs dang ldan pa'i grong dang / rtsig ①pas bskor ba'i grong dang / rib mas bskor ba'i grong dang / 'obs kyis bskor ba'i grong dang rnam pa bzhir bya ba grong nyen kor ②gcig pa dang / grong nyen kor tha dad pa dang / grong rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang / grong rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang /khyim nyen kor gcig pa dang/ khyim nyen kor tha dad pa dang / khyim rab tu mang po ②nyen kor gcig pa khyodang / khyim rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang /sten ⑤'gro'i khyim nyen kor gcig pa dang / sten 'gro'i khyim nyen kor tha dad pa dang / ⑥sten 'gro'i khyim rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang / sten 'gro'i khyim rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang / mu stegs can gyi khyim nyen kor gcig pa dang / mu stegs can gyi khyim nyen kor tha dad pa dang / mu stegs can gyi khyim rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang / mu stegs can gyi khyim rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang / tshong rdal nyen kor gcig pa dang / tshong rdal nyen kor tha dad pa dang / tshong rdal rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang /tshong rdal rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang / tshong khang nyen kor gcig pa dang / tshong khang nyen kor tha dad pa dang / tshong khang rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang / tshong khang rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang / sgra khang ⑦nyen kor gcig pa dang / sgra khang 2nyen kor tha dad pa dang / sgra khang ⑨rab 6—111

tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang / sgra khang ①rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang / g.yul nyen kor gcig pa dang / g.yul nyen kor tha dad pa dang / g.yul rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang / g.yul rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang / g.yul gyi tshoms nyen kor gcig pa dang / g.yul gyi tshoms nyen kor tha dad pa dang / g.yul gyi tshoms rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang / g.yul gyi tshoms rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang / gru nyen kor gcig pa dang / gru nyen kor tha dad pa dang / gru rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang / gru rab tu mang lapo nyen kor tha dad pa dang / shing rta nyen kor gcig pa dang / shing rta nyen kor tha dad pa dang / shing rta rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang /shing rta rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang / shing ljon pa nyen kor gcig pa dang / shing ljon pa nyen kor tha dad pa dang / shing ljon pa rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang / shing ljon pa rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang /kun dga'i char ba nyen kor gcig pa dang / kun dga'i ④ra ba nyen kor tha dad pa dang / kun dga'i ⑤ra ba rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa dang /kun dga'i ⑥ra ba rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa dang / lam du 'gro ba la ⑦sogs pa dang / thad kur 'gro ba la ⑧sogs pa dang / mtshams gzhan dag gi gnas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bye brag gis dge slong chos gos dang mi 'bral ba dang ⑨'bral ba'i ltung ba rnam par bzhag ⑩pa'i bye brag rgya cher ston to / /de la khyim gcig yidang ldan pa'i grong gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ri khrod pa rnams dang / bod rnams dang / kla klo rnams kyi grong ngo / /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na / nang thams cad dang / phyi rol 'dom gang ngamatshu/ gang du de dag rdung 6—112

bar byed pa dang / rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang / 'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang / 'thung bar byed pa dang / phyo sus byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis ①nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do②/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /khyim gnyis dang ldan pa'i grong gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ khyim gcig dang ldan pa'i grong ji lta ba bzhin du/ khyim gnyis dang ldan pa'i grong yang de bzhin no/ /khyim gyi tshogs dang ldan pa'i grong gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ grong sgo sna tshogs nas kun nas gnas pa gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ ci yang ma yin no/ /cig ③pas bskor ba'i grong gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste grong rtsig ④pas bskor ba gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom dugang ngam/ gang du ba lang drug dang ldan pa'i shing rta phyig ⑥ma can gyis khyab cing 'dug pa dang / bya gag spar nas 'dug pa'i bar de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar ⑦byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /rib mas bskor ba'i grong gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ grong rib mas bskor ba gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad 6—113

dang / phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du ra lug bton pa dag gi ①mig pas bslang ba'i rdul 'bab pa dang / mi rang bzhin gyis ngo tsha dang ldan pa bshang sar 'gro ba'i bar de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag ②bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ②ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'obs kyis bskor ba'i grong gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste grong 'obs kyis bskor ba gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/gang du skas gdang ④bu bcu gnyis pas khyab cing 'dug pa dang / phyag dar bor ba'i bong ba rags pa 'dril ba'i bar de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste/ nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do⑤/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /grong nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ grong gang na skyed mos tshal rjolam 'dun ⑦sa'am/ lha'i gnas gcig yod pa gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ lha'i gnas so/ /dge slong gis grong du chos gos dag bzhag ste lha'i gnas su skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /lha'i gnas su chos gos dag bzhag ste grong du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /grong ngam lha'i 6—114

gnas su chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /grong nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/grong gang na skyed mos tshal ①lam/ 'dun sa'am/ lha'i gnas rab tu mang po dag yod pa gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o//ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ ci yang ma yin no/ /grong rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig ②pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ grong gang dag na skyed ①mos tshal lam/'dun dusa'am/ lha'i gnas gcig yod pa gang yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ lha'i gnas so/ /dge slong gis grong du chos gos dag bzhag ste lha'i gnas su skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /lha'i gnas su chos gos dag bzhag ste grong du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /grong ngam lha'i gnas su chos gos dag ⑤bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /grong rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ grong gang dag na skyed ⑥mes tshal lam/ 'dun sa'am/ lha'i gnas rab tu mang po dag yod pa gang yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na / so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ ci yang ma yin no/ /khyim nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi gcig ⑦gi'am/spun sgo ma phye nib dag gi khyim gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/nang thams cad dang / phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du de dag rdung bar byed pa dang / rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang / 'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang / 'thung bar byed pa dang / phyo 6—115

sus byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor ①yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste ②nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /khyim nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi khyim gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ sgo'o/ /dge slong gis nang du ②chos gos dag bzhag ste sgor skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /sgor chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam sgor chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /khyim rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi rjogacig gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi khyim rab tu mang po dag gang yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/gang du de dag rdung bar byed pa dang / rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang / 'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang / 'thung bar byed pa dang / khye'u sus byed pa de ni de dag gi nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /khyim rab 6—116

tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa ①dag gi'am/spun sgo bye ba dag ni rgyakhyim rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ ci yang ma yin no/ /sten ②'gro'i khyim nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi sten du'agro'i khyim gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/gang du de dag gi gling bu 'jog par byed pa dang / rnga pa ṭa ༷ha dang / pi bang rjodang / rdza rnga kha gcig pa dang / khar ⑦nga dang / su sto ṣa ⑧ka 'jog par byed pa dang / mong phang dang phang lo 'jog par byed pa dang / gang du rdung bar byed pa dang / rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang /'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang / 'thung bar byed pa dang /khye'u sus byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ⑨sung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya tshurengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /sten 'gro'i khyim nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi sten 'gro'i khyim gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o / /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ rgyal mtshan gyi shing ngo / /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste rgyal mtshan gyi shing la skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /rgyal mtshan gyi shing la chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du 6—117

skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam rgyal mtshan gyi shing la chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /sten 'gro'i khyim rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/'di lta ste mi gcig ①gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi sten 'gro'i khyim rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngamal/ gang du de dag gi gling bu 'jog par byed pa dang / rnga pa ṭa ③ha dang / pi bang rjodang / rdza rnga kha gcig pa dang /khar ༷rnga dang / su sto ṣa rjoka 'jog par byed pa dang / mong phang dang /phang lo 'jog par byed pa dang / gang du rdung bar byed pa dang / rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang / 'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang / 'thung bar byed pa dang / khye'u sus byed pa de ni de dag gi nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis ⑦nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung nibyed du 'gyur ro/ /sten 'gro'i khyim rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi sten 'gro'i khyim rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ ci yang ma yin no/ /mu stegs can gyi khyim nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mu stegs can gyi khyim lta ba gcig pa dang / bzod pa gcig pa dang / 'dod pa gcig pa 6—118

dang / bsam pa gcig pa gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang / phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du de dag lci ba dag gding ba ①byed pa dang / yam sreg ②shing dag 'jog par byed pa dang /g.yang gzhi dag dang / shing shun dag dang / dbyig gu dag dang / ril ba dag dang / blugs chagazar dag dang / dgang gzar dag 'jog par byed pa ④dang / me sbar bar byed pa dang / yam sreg ⑧shing dag sreg par byed pa dang / gang du de dag rdung bar byed pa dang / rngo bar byed pa dang /'thag par byed pa dang / 'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang /'thung bar byed pa dang / khye'u sus byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /mu stegs can gyi khyim nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mu stegs can gyi khyim lta ba tha dad pa dang / bzod pa tha dad pa dang / 'dod pa tha dad pa dang / bsam pa tha dad pa gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ lha'i gnas so/ /dge slong gis mu stegs can gyi khyim du chos gos dag bzhag ste lha'i gnas su skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ —/lha'i gnas su chos gos dag bzhag ste mu stegs can gyi khyim du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /mu stegs can gyi khyim mam 0lha'i gnas su chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya 6—119

rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /mu stegs can gyi khyim rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa ①gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mu stegs can gyi khyim rab tu mang po lta ba gcig pa dang / bzod pa gcig pa dang /'dod pa gcig pa dang / bsam pa gcig pa gang dag ②yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngamadu/gang du de dag lci ba dag 'ding bar byed pa dang / yam sreg shing dag 'jog par byed pa dang / g.yang gzhi dag dang / shing shun dag dang / dbyig gu dag dang / ril ba dag dang / blugs gzar rjodag dang / dgang gzar dag 'jog par byed pa dang / me sbar bar byed pa dang / yam sreg shing sreg par byed pa dang / gang du de dag rdung bar byed pa dang / rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang / 'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang / 'thung bar byed pa dang / phyo sus byed pa de ni de dag gi nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /mu stegs can gyi khyim rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mu stegs can gyi khyim rab tu mang po lta ba tha dad pa dang / bzod pa tha dad pa dang / 'dod pa tha dad pa dang / bsam pa tha dad pa gang dag duyin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'ol/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ ci yang ma yin no/ /tshong rdal nyen 6—120

kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi tshong rdal gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang /phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du ①de dag zong 'jog par byed pa dang /nyo bar byed pa dang / 'tshong ②bar byed pa dang / bgrang ③bar byed pa dang /'jal bar byed pa dang / 'jog par byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis ④nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ⑧ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshong rdal nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/spun sgo bye ba dag gi tshong rdal gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ gzhag ⑥stegs so/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhag ⑨stegs su skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /gzhag stegs su chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam gzhag stegs su chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshong rdal rab tu mang po ④nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste / mi gcig gi ⑨ga'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi tshong rdal rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang /phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du de dag zong 'jog par byed pa dang / nyo bar byed pa dang / 'tshong ⑩bar byed pa dang / bgrang yibar byed pa dang /6—121

'jal bar byed pa dang / 'jog par byed pa de ni de dag gi nyen kor yin no//dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du ①'gyur ro//tshong rdal rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi tshong rdal rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na / ci yang ma yin no/ /tshong khang nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig ②gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi tshong khang gang ②yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/gang du de dag zong 'jog par byed pa dang / gro dag dang / nas dag dang /mon sran ④gri'u dag dang / sā ⑤yu dag dang / 'bras dag dang / til dag dang / 'bras thug po che dag yidang / bu ram dag dang / mar dag dang / ras bal dag dang / skud pa dag dang / gos dag 'jog par byed pa dang / 'bru spung bar ⑦byed pa dang / bre'u duchung dang / gle ba 'jog par byed pa dang / 'jal bar byed pa dang / rlung yor ⑨'dzugs par byed pa dang / nyo bar byed pa dang / 'tshong ⑩bar byed pa dang / bgrang ⑩bar byed pa dang / 'jal bar byed pa dang / 'jog par byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag 0bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste 6—122

nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ①lhung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshong khang nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi tshong khang gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/'dug stegs sol/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste 'dug stegs su skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /'dug stegs su chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam 'dug stegs su chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshong khang rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi tshong khang rab tu mang po gang sridag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du de dag zong 'jog par byed pa dang / gro dag dang / nas dag dang / mon sran gre'u dag dang / sā 0lu dag dang / 'bras dag dang / til dag dang / 'bras thug po che ⑤dag dang / bu ram dag dang / mar dag dang / ras bal dag dang / skud pa dag dang / gos dag 'jog par byed pa dang /'bru spung bar 0byed pa dang / bre'u chung dang / gle ba ⑦'jog par byed pa dang / 'jal bar byed pa dang / rlung yor ⑧'dzugs par byed pa dang /nyo bar byed pa dang / 'tshong ⑨bar byed pa dang / bgrang ⑩bar byed pa dang /'jal bar byed pa dang / 'jog par byed pa de ni de dag gi nyen kor yin no//6—123

dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ༅ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshong khang rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di rnye ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi tshong khang rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na / ci yang ma yin no/ /sgra ②khang nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig gi'am / spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi sgra ④khang gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang / phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/gang du de dag glang dag 'dogs par byed pa dang / rtswa dag 'jog par byed pa dang / mun dza dag rdung bar byed pa dang / thag pa dag 'khal bar byed pa dang / gang du rdung bar byed pa ⑤dang / rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang / 'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang /'thung bar byed pa dang / khye'u sus byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor ༷du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed ⑦du 'gyur ro//sgra ②khang nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/spun sgo bye ba dag gi sgra 0khang gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so 6—124

so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na ya gad do/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste ya gad la skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do//ya gad la chos gos dag bzhag ste/ sgra ①khang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /sgra ②khang ngam ya gad la chos gos dag ③bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /sgra ④khang rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi sgra ⑤khang rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang / phyi rol ⑥'dom gang ngamacha/ gang du de dag glang dag 'dogs par byed pa dang / rtswa dag 'jog par byed pa dang /mun dza dag rdung bar byed pa dang / thag pa dag 'khul bar byed pa dang /gang du rdung bar byed pa dang / rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang ⑤/'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang / 'thung bar byed pa dang /khye'u sus byed pa de ni de ⑨dag gi nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ / nyen kor du chos gos dag ⑩bzhag ste canang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /sgra ⑩khang rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/spun sgo bye ba dag gi sgra 8khang rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ ci yang ma yin no/ /g.yul nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na / 'di lta ste mi gcig 6wa 125

gi'am / spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi g.yul gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang / phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du de dag 'bru rdung bar byed pa dang / 'phyar bar byed pa dang / 'khyab par byed pa dang / spung bar ①byed pa dang / bre'u chung dang / gle ②ba 'jog par byed pa dang / 'jal bar byed pa dang / rlung yor ②'dzugs par byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang lhung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /g.yul nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi g.yul gang yin pa'o//de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/g.yul gyi dkyil lo/ /dge slong gis g.yul gyi dkyil du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste g.yul gyi dkyil du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /g.yul gyi dkyil du'am nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /g.yul rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi g.yul rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du de dag 'bru rdung bar byed pa dang / 'phyar bar byed pa dang / 'khyab par byed pa 6—126

dang / spung bar ①byed pa dang / bre'u chung dang ②/ gle ba 'jog par byed pa dang / 'jal bar byed pa dang / rlung yor ③'dzugs par byed pa de ni de dag gi nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /g.yul rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi g.yul rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ ci yang ma yin no// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po nyi shu ⑥drug pa/ g.yul gyi tshoms nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi g.yul gyi tshoms gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du de dag glang dag ⑤'dogs par byed pa dang / rtswa yidag 'jog par byed pa dang / mun dza dag ⑦rdung bar byed pa dang / thag pa dag 'khal bar byed pa dang / lci ba dag 'dor bar byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /g.yul gyi tshoms nyen kor 6—127

tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi g.yul gyi tshoms gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o / /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ sgo'o/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste sgor ①skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /sgor chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed ②byed na yang lhung ba med do/ /nang ngam sgor chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /g.yul gyi tshoms rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi g.yul gyi tshoms rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam gang du de dag glang dag 'dogs par byed pa dang / rtswa chadag 'jog par byed pa dang / mun dza dag rdung bar byed pa dang / thag pa dag 'khal bar byed pa dang / rtsi ba dag 'dor bar byed pa de ni de dag gi nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do//nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /g.yul gyi tshoms rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/spun sgo bye ba dag gi g.yul gyi tshoms rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na / ci yang ma yin no/ /gru nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi 6—128

gcig gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi gru gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ 'gro ba'i ni nang thams cad dang / phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/①'dug pa'i ②ni nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du de dag phur pa ②'debs par byed pa dang / gru rtod par byed pa dang / gdos pa dag 'jog par byed pa dang / gru skya dag 'jog par byed ༷pa dang / mun dza dag rdung bar byed pa dang / thag pa dag 'khal bar byed pa dang / gang du rdung bar byed pa dang / rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang /'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang / 'thung bar byed pa dang /khye'u sus byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor duyin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gru nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta steX/ mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi gru gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ gru gdong ngo / /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste gru gdong du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /gru gdong du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do//nang ngam gru gdong du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gru rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi gru rab tu mang po 6—129

gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ 'gro ba'i ni nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngo ①/ /'dug pa'i ni nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du de dag phur pa 'debs par byed pa dang /gru rtod ②par byed pa dang / gdos pa dag 'jog par byed pa dang / gru skya dag 'jog par byed pa dang / mun dza dag rdung bar byed pa dang / thag pa dag 'khal bar byed pa dang / gang du rdung bar byed pa dang / rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang / 'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang / 'thung bar byed pa dang / khye'u sus byed pa de ni de dag gi nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gru rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi gru rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ ci yang ma yin no/ /shing rta nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig ②gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi shing rta gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ 'gro ba'i ni dunang thams cad dang / phyi rol 'dom gang ngo / /'dug pa'i ni nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du de dag phur pa 'debs par byed pa dang / glang dag 'dogs par byed pa dang / rtswa rjodag 'jog par byed pa dang / mun dza 6—130

dag rdung bar byed pa dang / thag pa dag 'khul bar byed pa dang / gang du rdung bar byed pa dang / rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang /'cha' bar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang / 'thung bar byed pa dang /khye'u sus byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag ①bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shing rta nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi shing rta gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe ②na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ kha lo pa'i gnas so/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste kha lo pa'i gnas su skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do//kha lo pa'i gnas su chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam kha lo pa'i gnas su chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shing rta rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi gcig gi'am/spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi shing rta rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ 'gro ba'i ni gyenang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngamadu / 'dug pa'i ni nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam⑤/gang du de dag phur pa 'debs par byed pa dang / glang dag 'dogs par byed pa dang / rtswa rjodag 'jog par byed pa dang / mun dza dag rdung bar byed pa 6—131

dang / thag ①pa dag 'khal bar byed pa dang / gang du rdung bar byed pa dang /rngo bar byed pa dang / 'thag par byed pa dang / 'cha' bar byed pa dang /za bar byed pa dang / 'thung bar byed pa dang / phyo sus byed pa de ni de dag gi nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang lhung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed ②du 'gyur ro/ /shing rta rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi shing rta rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ ci yang ma yin no/ /shing ljon pa nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste shing ljon pa yal ga'i tshogs 'brel pa gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang ③zhe na/ nang thams cad dang phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du lo ma lhags pa rlung gis ma bdas pa dag 'bab pa dang / char chad pa'i thigs pa sbom ④po dag 'bab pa dang / gang du gung tshigs kyi tshe 0shing ljon pa'i grib mas khyab cing 'dug pa de ni de'i nyen kor yin no / /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang 0ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shing ljon pa nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste shing 6—132

ljon pa yal ga'i tshogs ma 'brel pa gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na rtsa ba'o/ /dge slong gis rtsa bar chos gos dag bzhag ste yal gar skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do//yal gar chos gos dag bzhag ste rtsa ①bar skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /rtsa ②ba'am yal gar chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shing ljon pa rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste shing ljon pa rab tu mang po ⑧yal ga'i tshogs 'brel pa gang ༷yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang / phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du lo ma lhags ༷pa rlung gis ma bdas pa dag 'bab pa dang / char chad pa'i thigs pa sbom po dag 'bab pa dang / gang du gung tshigs kyi tshe shing ljon pa'i grib mas khyab cing 'dug pa de ni de dag gi nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shing ljon pa rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ shing ljon pa rab tu mang po yal ga'i tshogs ma 'brel pa gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ ci yang ma yin no/ /kun dga'i ra ba nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi gcig gi'am/spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi kun dga'i ra ba gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe 6—133

na / nang thams cad dang / phyi rol 'dom gang ngam/ gang du de dag me tog dag thu ①bar byed pa dang / skon pa dag 'jog par byed pa dang ②/phreng ba dag rgyud par byed pa dang / 'jal bar byed pa dang / nyo bar byed pa dang / 'tshong ②bar byed pa dang / bre'u chung dang / phul 'jog par byed pa de ni de'i nyen kor yin no/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do//nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /kun dga'i ra ba'i ༷nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/ spun sgo bye ba dag gi kun dga'i ra ba gang yin pa'o/ /de'i nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o / /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ khron pa'o/ /dge slong gis nang du chos gos dag bzhag ste/ khron par skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do//khron par chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang lhung ba med do/ /nang ngam khron par chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /kun dga'i dur ba rab tu mang po nyen kor gcig pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi gcig gi'am/ spun sgo ma bye ba dag gi kun dga'i byar ba rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ nang thams cad dang / phyi rol 'dom gang ngamardzi/gang du de dag me tog dag thu ⑧bar byed pa dang / skon pa dag 'jog ⑨par byed pa dang / phreng ba dag rgyud par byed pa dang / 'jal bar byed pa dang /6—134

nyo bar byed pa dang / 'tshong ①bar byed pa dang / bre'u chung dang / phul ②'jog par byed pa de ni de dag gi nyen kor ①yin no/ /dge slong gis dunang du chos gos dag bzhag ste nyen kor du skya rengs 'char bar byed na ltung ba med do/ /nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste nang du skya rengs 'char bar byed na yang ltung ba med do/ /nang ngam nyen kor du chos gos dag bzhag ste gzhan du skya rengs 'char bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /kun dga'i ⑤ra ba rab tu mang po nyen kor tha dad pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi tha dad pa dag gi'am/spun sgo bye ba dag gi kun dga'i rjor ba rab tu mang po gang dag yin pa'o/ /de dag gi nyen kor gang zhe na/ so so tha dad pa'o/ /ci zhig thun mong yin zhe na/ci yang ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba 'khor gyis ⑦nus pa/ btsun pa dge slong gis chos gos dag dge slong la gtad de 'gron ⑧lam du mchi na/ btsun pa ⑨de'i nyen kor gang lags/ nye ba ⑩'khor ngas bram ze gro zhin ⑩skyes la a mra'i sdong po shin tu me tog phun sum tshogs pa/ 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa/ yal ga tho)phun sum tshogs pa/'dom bdun gyis bar du chod pa'i a mra'i sdong po bdun po gang dag yin pa de dag la 'dom bzhi bcu rtsa dgu yod par bstan pa de ni dge slong lam du zhugs pa'i chos gos dag gi nyen kor yin 8no/ /'greng ba dang / 'dug pa dang /nyal ba'i nyen kor ni 'dom gang kho ra khor yug go/ /thad kur 'gro ba'i nyen kor yang 'dom gang kho ra khor yug go/ /thad kur 'greng ba dang / 'dug pa dang 8nyal ba'i nyen kor yang 'dom gang kho ra khor yug go/ /btsun pa dge slong mtshams 8gzhan du mchis nasatso/ nyal bar bgyid na de'i chos gos 6—135

dag gi nyen kor gang lags/ nye ba ①'khor ji tsam du chos gos kyi ②grwa lus dang ma 'bral ②ba tshun cad rjodo/ /dge slong gis duchos gos spang bar gyur na de ma spangs shing bral bar ma byas la ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig rnyed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis 0chos gos spang bar gyur na/ de spangs shing bral bar ma byas la ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig rnyed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ / dge slong gis chos gos spang bar gyur na/ de spangs shing bral bar byas la ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig rnyed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /⑦dge slong gis chos gos spang bar gyur na/ de spangs shing bral bar byas la ltung ba bshags nas gzhan zhig rnyed na de la ltung ba med do/ /de bzhin du dge slong gis ji srid du spang ba'i dngos po des ⑧ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags par lhung bzed dam/ chos gos sam/ dra ba'am/ phor bu'am/ska rags sam/ dge sbyong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad gang yang rung ba gzhan nye bar 'jog par byed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med khyado/ /'bral ba'i spang ba ste gnyis pa rdzogs so//ci //⑩sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong rnams la gos mang ba 7nyid 'di lta bu 'di byung ste/ dge slong gang yang rung bas gos sngon po zhig rnyed na des de byed du mi 'jud 8par de gang gi tshe 'di dang 8'dra 6—136

ba rnyed par gyur pa de'i tshe gos byed du gzhug go snyam du re ①bas de 'jog par byed cing / ༅ sngon po ji lta ba bzhin du ser po dang / dmar po dang / stug po dang / srab mo yang de bzhin no/ /dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong rnams gos mang ba nyid 'di lta bu 'di byung ste/ dge slong gang yang rung bas gos sngon po zhig rnyed na des de byed du mi 'jud par de gang gi tshe 'di dang 'dra ba rnyed par gyur pa de'i tshe gos byed du gzhug ②go snyam du re bas de 'jog par byed cing sngon po ji lta ba bzhin du ser po dang / dmar po dang /stug po dang / srab mo yang de bzhin no/ /zhes smod par byed/ phyar ①ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang /gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad ④do zhes bya ba la ⑤sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes ⑥bya ba la ⑦sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rab tu mang po dag la rmas ⑧pa/ dge slong dag khyed la gos mang ba nyid 'di lta bu 'di byung ste/dge slong gang yang rung bas gos sngon po zhig rnyed na des de byed du mi 'jud par ⑨de gang gi tshe 'di 'dra ba 0rnyed par gyur pa de'i tshe gos ⑨byed du 'jug ⑫go snyam du re bas de 'jog par byed cing / sngon po ji lta ba bzhin du ser po dang / dmar po dang / stug po dang / srab mo yang de bzhin du bden nam/btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod pa che ba dang /chog mi shes pa dang / gso dka' ba dang / dgang dka' ba rnam par smad 6—137

par mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod pa chung ba'i bsngags pa brjod cing / chog shes pa dang / gso sla ①ba dang / dgang sla ②ba dang /phri ba dang / yo byad bsnyungs pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan rnams dang /mdzes pa nyid dang / drod rig ③pa'i bsngags pa brjod nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ④bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs ⑤pa yang snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong chos gos zin pas sra brkyang phyung na dus ma yin pa'i gos shig rnyed la 'dod na dge slong des gos de blang bar bya'o/ /blangs nas ⑥gal te langs ⑦na myur ba kho nar gos su bya ste ⑧bcang bar bya'o/ /gal te mi langs la kha ma langs ⑨pa kha skong ba'i gos la re ba yod na dge slong des gos de zla ba gcig gi mthar gzhag ⑩par bya'o/ /de las 'das par 'jog na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /dge slong zhes bya ba ni chos 'di 0pa'o/ /chos gos zin pas sra brkyang phyung na zhes bya ba ni chos gos zin la 8sra brkyang ma phyung ba yang yod/ chos gos ma zin la sra brkyang phyung ba yang yod/ chos gos zin cing sra brkyang phyung ba yang yod/ chos gos ma zin cing sra brkyang ma phyung ba yang yod de/ mu bzhir bcad pa snga ma bzhin no/ /dus ma yin pa'i gos shig ces bya ba la dge slong gis 'gos kyi dus ni gang yin/dus ma yin pa ni gang yin zhe na/ sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas na ni ston zla 'bring po 8nya nas dpyid zla ra ba 8nya'i bar gyi zla ba de dag ni gos kyi ⑩dus yin la / de phan cad ni dus ma yin no/ /sra brkyang ma bting ⑩ba'i gnas na ni 6—138

thams cad dus ma yin rnal/ /rnyed la zhes bya ba ni gzhan las so/ /'dod na zhes bya ba ni gal te don du gnyer na'o/ /dge slong des gos de blang ②bar bya'o zhes bya ba ni bdag gir bya'o/ /gal te langs lan zhes bya ba ni gal te chog na'o/ /myur ba kho nar gos su byas te bcang bar bya'o zhes bya ba ni mi rjobasgyang ba kho nar byin gyis brlab tu rung bar byas te'o/ /kha ma langs 0pa kha skong ba'o ⑥zhes bya ba ni snam sbyar ram/ bla gos sam/ mthang gos kha ma langs pa kha skong ba'i 'o⑦/ /gos la re ba yod na zhes bya ba ni dge slong la mas bdag la gos sbyin pa'i re ba'am/ pha'am/ phu nu'am/ sring mo'am/slob dpon nam/ mkhan pos bdag la gos sbyin pa'i re ba'am/ lo lnga'i dus ston gyi tshe'am/ lo drug gi dus ston gyi tshe'am/ gtsug phud 'dreg ⑧pa'i dus ston gyi tshe'am/ gnas khang gi dus ston gyi tshe'am/la dus ston chen po'i tshe 0rnyed du re ba yod na'o/ /dge slong des gos de zla ba gcig gi mthar gzhag 0par bya'o zhes bya ba ni zla ba gcig gi mtha' tshun chad du'o/ /de las ⑫'das par 'jog na zhes bya ba ni de las thal bar ro/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de ④spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ bar sdom la/ dogs bcas dogs pa med pa dang / /nyams gyur grub par ma gyur dang / /rgyun chad gos lnga gos gnyis dang / /sbyar ba dang ni tshad rnams so/ /dge slong gis tshes la gos sngon po zhig rnyed nas des de byed du mi 'jud par de gang gi tshe 'di dang 'dra ba rnyed par gyur byapa de'i tshe gos byed du gzhug go snyam du re bas 8de 'jog 6—139

par byed cing des tshes de nyid la gos sngon po dogs pa dang bcas pa gzhan zhig rnyed par gyur na/ dge slong des gos de nyi ma bcu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab ①par bya ba'am/ gtang bar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am/gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs ②shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshes la ma rnyed kyang tshes gnyis sam/ tshes gsum mamal/ tshes bcu tshun cad kyis gos sngon po zhig rnyed na/ dge slong des gos de 0zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab 0par bya ba'am/ gtang bar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am/gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ / gos de 0 bcu la ma rnyed kyang nyi ma bcu dgu tshun cad ⑦kyis rnyed na/ dge slong des gos de nyi ma nyi shu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am/ gtang bar bya ba'am / rung bar bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na/ nyi ma nyi shu pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma nyi shu pa la ma rnyed kyang nyi ma nyi shu rtsa dgu tshun cad kyis rnyed na dge slong des gos de zla ba de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am/ gtang bar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am/gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi 6—140

byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na/ nyi ma sum bcu ①gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gos sngon po rnyed pa ji lta ba bzhin du ser po dang / dmar po dang / stug po dang /srab mo yang de bzhin no/ /dge slong gis tshes la gos sngon po zhig rnyed nas des de byed du mi 'jud ②par de gang gi tshe 'di dang 'dra ba rnyed par gyur pa de'i tshe gos byed du ③gzhug go snyam du re ba med pas de 'jog par byed cing des tshes de nyid la gos sngon po dogs pa med pa gzhan zhig rnyed par gyur na/ dge slong des gos de nyi ma bcu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am/gtang bar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam / gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshes la ma rnyed kyang tshes gnyis sam/ tshes bcu tshun cad dam/ nyi ma bcu dgu tshun cad dam/ nyi ma nyi shu rtsa dgu tshun cad kyis gos sngon po zhig rnyed na/ dge slong des gos de zla ba de nyid kyi ④nang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am/ gtang ⑤bar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am / gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma sum bcu gcig gi 0skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gos sngon po rnyed pa ji lta ba bzhin du ser po dang / dmar po dang / stug po dang / srab mo yang de bzhin no/ /dge slong gis tshes la gos sngon po zhig rnyed nas des de byed du mi 'jud par de gos la re ba yod pa ⑦de 'jog par 6—141

byed cing de'i gos la re ba gang yin pa de nyams par gyur/ 'gyangs ①par gyur②/nyam ②chung bar gyur cing / des tshes de nyid la gos sngon po gzhan zhig rnyed par gyur na/ dge slong des gos de 0nyi ma bcu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab ⑤par bya ba'am/ gtang bar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am/gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshes la ma rnyed kyang tshes gnyis sam/ tshes bcu tshun cad rjodam/ tshes bcu la ma rnyed kyang nyi ma ④nyi shu rtsa dgu tshun cad kyi snogos sngon po zhig rnyed na dge slong des gos de zla ba de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis ⑨brlab par bya ba'am/ gtang bar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob ⑨ par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma sum bcu yigacig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gos sngon po rnyed pa ji lta ba bzhin du ser po dang /dmar po dang / stug po dang / srab mo yang de bzhin no/ /dge slong gis tshes la gos sngon po zhig rnyed nas des de byed du mi 'jug 8par de re bas de 'jog par byed cing de'i gos la re ba gang yin pa de 'grub par ma gyur/ rgyun chad par ma gyur par des tshes de nyid la gos sngon po gzhan zhig rnyed par gyur na/dge slong des gos de nyi ma bcu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am / gtang bar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o / /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung 6—142

bar mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshes la ma rnyed kyang tshes gnyis sam/nyi ma nyi shu rtsa ①dgu tshun chad kyis rnyed na dge slong des gos de zla ba de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am/ gtang bar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am / gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma sum bcu ②gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gos sngon po rnyed pa ji lta ba bzhin du ser po dang / dmar po dang / stug po dang / srab mo yang de bzhin no/ /dge slong gis tshes la gos sngon po zhig rnyed nas des de byed du mi 'jud par de re bas de 'jog par byed cing de'i gos la re ba gang yin pa de thams cad kyi thams cad du rgyun chad par gyur na dge slong des gos de nyi ma bcu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am / gtang ②bar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o / /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na/ nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshes la ma rnyed kyang tshes gnyis sam / nyi ma nyi shu rtsa dgu tshun chad kyis rnyed nas ④des de byed du mi 'jud rjopar de re bas de 'jog par ༅byed cing de'i gos la re ba gang yin pa de thams cad kyi thams cad du rgyun chad par gyur na dge slong des gos de nyi ma bcu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am/ gtang ⑦bar bya ba'am/ rung bar bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/6—143

gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gos sngon po ji lta ba bzhin du ser po dang / dmar po dang / stug po dang /srab mo yang de bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ①'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa gos dag du mchis/ nye ba ②'khor lnga ste/gos bdag po yod pa dang / gos bdag po med pa dang / gos bor blangs ⑧dang / gos dur khrod pa dang / gos phyag dar khrod pa nyid ni lnga pa'o/ /de la gos bdag po yod pa gang zhe na/ gang la bdag po skyes pa'am/ bud med dam / ma ning yod pa de ni gos bdag po yod pa zhes bya'o/ /gos bdag po med pa gang zhe na/ gang la bdag po skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ ma ning med pa de ni gos bdag po med pa zhes bya'o/ /gos bor blangs gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ nye du dag gis nye du nyams pa dang / shi ba dang / dus la bab par rig ④nas de'i rgyab nas gos kyis bkab ste dur khrod du khyer nas de dag gis gos de yang phyir khyer te 'ongs nas dge 'dun la 'bul ⑤ba de ni gos bor blangs zhes bya'o/ /gos dur khrod pa gang zhe na/ yongs su 'dzin pa med pa'i dur khrod nas blangs pa gang yin pa de ni gos dur khrod pa zhes bya'o/ /gos phyag dar khrod pa gang zhe na/ phyag dar khrod pa ⑨rnam pa lnga ste/ lam po che'i gos dang / dgon par bor ba dang / chu 'gram pa dang / sril zan dang / ral rul nyid ni lnga pa yin te/ ral rul zhes bya ba ni ha cang zegs pa gang yin pa'o/ /gzhan yang phyag dar khrod pa rnam pa ༅lnga ste/ mes tshig pa dang / chus khyer ba ⑤dang / byi bas zos pa dang / be'us zos pa dang /6—144

ma ma'i gos nyid ni lnga pa yin no/ /gzhan yang gos gnyis te sar ①pa dang dus tshigs su spyad pa'o/ /gos sar ②pa gang zhe na/ tha ga ③pas gsar du btags ༷pa dus tshigs gsum po dag las dus tshigs dugang yang rung ba'i dus tshigs su ma spyad pa gang yin pa de ni gos sar 0pa zhes bya'o/ /gos dus tshigs su spyad pa gang zhe na/ dus tshigs gsum po dag las dus tshigs gang yang rung ba'i dus tshigs su spyad pa gang yin pa ste/ dus tshigs zhes bya ba ni zla ba ⑦bzhi ste/ de ni gos dus tshigs su spyad pa zhes ⑧bya'o/ /dge slong gis gos sar ⑨pa rnyed na gal te dge slong des bcag pa dang / gding ba dang /dra ba dang / btsem ⑩pa dang / kha bsgyur ⑩bar nus na dge slong des gos de las snam sbyar ni nyi tsorim du bya/ gding ba yang nyi rim du bya/ bla gos ni cig 7rkyang du bya/ mthang gos kyang cig ④kyang du bya'o/ /dge slong gis snam sbyar nyi 0rim la rim pa gsum pa glon ⑩par byed na de glon par byed pa na nyes byas su 'gyur la/ zhag bcu 'das na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis snam sbyar nyi 0rim las gzhan du glan tsono snyam pas ⑥rim pa 'bogs par byed na de 'bogs pa na nyes byas su 'gyur la/ nyi ma bcu 'das na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis snam sbyar nyi ⑥rim las bkrus shing kha bsgyur te 'di (7nyid la glan no snyam pas rim pa 'bogs par byed na de 'bogs pa na ltung dub med la/ nyi ma bcu 'das na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur rol/ /snam sbyar la ji lta ba bzhin du gding ba la yang de bzhin no/ /dge slong gis bla gos cig brkyang dul rim pa glon par byed na de glon pa na nyes byas su 'gyur la/ nyi ma bcu 'das na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /bla gos 6—145

la ji lta ba bzhin du mthang gos la yang ①de bzhin no/ /dge slong gis gos dus tshigs su spyad pa zhig rnyed la gal te dge slong des bcag pa ②dang /gding ba dang / dra ③ba dang / btsem pa dang / kha bsgyur bar nus na dge slong des gos de las snam sbyar ni bzhi rim du bya/ gding ba yang bzhi rim du bya/bla gos ni nyi ④rim du bya/ mthang gos kyang nyi ⑤rim du bya'o/ /dge slong gis snam sbyar bzhi rim la rim pa 0lnga pa glon par byed na de glon pa na nyes byas su 'gyur la/ nyi ma bcu 'das na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis snam sbyar bzhi rim las gzhan du glan ⑦rna snyam pas rim pa 'bogs par byed na de ⑧'bogs pa na nyes byas su 'gyur la/ nyi ma bcu 'das na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis snam sbyar bzhi rim las bkrus 0shing kha bsgyur te 'di nyid du 0glan par bya'o snyam pas rim pa 'bogs par byed na de 'bogs pa na ltung ba med la/ nyi ma bcu 'das na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur rol/ /snam sbyar la ji lta ba de ⑩bzhin du gding ba la yang de bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ /dge slong gis bla gos nyi rim la tsorim pa gsum pa glon par byed na de glon pa na nyes byas su 'gyur la/ nyi ma bcu 'das na spang ba'i lhung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bla gos nyi tsorim las gzhan tsodu glan no snyam pas rim pa 'bogs par byed na de 'bogs pa na nyes byas su 'gyur la/ nyi ma bcu 'das na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bla gos nyi rim las 'di nyid bkrus shing kha bsgyur te 'di nyid du glan no snyam pas rim pa 'bogs par byed na de 'bogs pa na ltung ba med la/ nyi ma bcu 'das na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /bla gos la ⑩ji lta ba bzhin du mthang gos la yang de 6—146

bzhin no/ /phyag dar khrod la ni ji tsam 'dod pa glan par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ①'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa snam sbyar dag gi snam phran du lags/ nye ba ②'khor ②dgu ste/ snam phran dgu pa dang / snam phran bcu gcig pa dang / snam phran bcu gsum pa dang /snam phran bcwa 0lnga pa dang / snam phran bcu bdun pa dang / snam phran bcu dgu pa dang / snam phran nyi shu gcig pa dang / snam phran nyi shu gsum pa dang /snam phran nyi shu lnga pa'o/ /nye ba kya'akhor de la snam phran dgu pa ni gsum sbyar gsum mo/ /snam phran bcu gcig pa ni gsum sbyar gsum dang snam phran gnyis so / /snam phran bcu gsum pa ni gsum sbyar bzhi dang snam phran gcig go/ /snam phran bcwa 0lnga pa ni gsum sbyar lnga'o⑦/ /snam phran bcu bdun pa ni gsum sbyar lnga dang snam phran gnyis so/ /snam phran bcu dgu pa ni gsum sbyar drug dang snam phran gcig go/ /snam phran nyi shu gcig pa ni gsum sbyar bdun no/ /snam phran nyi shu gsum pa ni gsum sbyar bdun dang snam phran gnyis so/ /snam phran nyi shu lnga pa ni gsum sbyar brgyad dang snam phran gcig go/ /nye ba ⑧'khor de la snam sbyar snam phran dgu pa gang yin pa dang / snam phran bcu gcig pa gang yin pa dang / snam phran bcu gsum pa gang yin pa de gsum ni glegs bu phyed dang gsum par byas te bcang bar bya'o/ /snam sbyar snam phran bcwa ⑨lnga pa gang yin pa dang / snam phran bcu bdun pa gang yin pa dang / snam phran bcu dgu pa gang yin pa de gsum ni glegs bu phyed dang bzhi par byas te bcang bar bya'o/ /snam sbyar snam phran nyi shu gcig pa gang yin pa dang / snam phran nyi shu gsum pa gang yin pa dang / snam phran nyi shu lnga pa gang yin pa de gsum ni 6—147

glegs bu phyed dang lnga par byas te bcang bar bya'o/ /nye ba ①'khor de yan cad ②ni tshem bru'o③/ /btsun pa snam sbyar gyi tshad ji tsam lags/ nye ba du'akhor gsum ste/ snam sbyar chen po dang / 'bring dang / chung ngur rig par bya'o//de la chen po ni khru gsum dang lnga'o/ /chung ngu ni khru phyed dang gsum dang phyed dang lnga'o/ /'bring gi ni de gnyis kyi bar ma'o/ /snam sbyar ji lta ba bzhin du bla gos dang / mthang ⑤gis kyang de bzhin no/ /gzhan yang mthang gos rnam pa gnyis te/ khru do dang lnga pa dang / khru do dang bzhi pa'o/ /mthang gos tha ma ni 'khor gsum khebs pa gang yin pa'o/ /spang ba rnams kyi ༷gos tha ma ni khru gang kho ra khor yug go/ /dge slong gi ༅gos spang bar gyur na de ma ⑧spangs shing bral bar ma byas la ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig rnyed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar ⑨'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi ⑩gos spang bar gyur na de spangs shing bral bar ma byas la ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig rnyed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi ⑩gos spang bar gyur na de spangs shing bral bar tsobyas la ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig rnyed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi ⑩gos spang bar gyur na de spangs shing bral bar byas la ltung ba bshags nas skegazhan zhig rnyed na de la ltung ba med do/ /de bzhin du ji tsam du dge slong gi 8spang ba'i dngos po de nyid kyis ma bshags shing / so sor ⑩ma bshags par lhung bzed dam/ chos gos sam / dra ba'am/ phor bu'am/ ska rags sam/ dge sbyong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad gang yang rung ba gzhan nye bar 'jog par byed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa ⑩dang / smyos pa dang / sems 6—148

'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /'jog pa'i spang ba ste gsum pa rdzogs stol// //gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pas ②gzigs pa lnga po rigs dang / yul dang / dus dang /rus dang / bud med la gzigs pa dag gis 'jig rten la gzigs nas glang po cher snang bar bsgyur te yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa de'i tshe na sa chen po shin tu g.yos par gyur cing 'jig rten gyi 'jig rten gyi bar gang na nyi ma dang zla ba 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ 'di ltar mthu che ba 'di gnyis kyi ③'od dag nyams su mi myong ba'i mun pa mun gnag ⑤mun par byed pas gnag rjopar gyur pa gang dag yin pa de dag kyang de'i tshe na snang ba rgya chen pos khyab par gyur nas/sems can gang dag der skyes pa dag gis rang gi lag pa brkyang ba yang mi mthong ba de dag gis kyang 'od des sems can gcig gis gcig ⑥mthong nas shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so/ /shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so zhes shes par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' zla ba bcu 'das nas yum gyi lhums nas bltam ⑦pa de'i tshe yang sa chen po shin tu g.yos par gyur cing 'jig rten gyi 'jig rten gyi bar gang na nyi ma dang / zla ba 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba 'di ltar mthu che ba 'di gnyis kyi 'od dag nyams su mi myong ba'i mun pa mun gnag nimun par byed pas gnag ⑨par gyur pa gang dag yin pa de dag kyang de'i tshe na snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur nas sems can gang dag der skyes pa dag gis ⑩rang gi lag pa 6wa 149
