brkyang pa yang mi mthong ba de dag gis kyang / 'od des sems can gcig gis gcig ①mthong nas shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so/ /shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so zhes shes par gyur to/ /gang gi nyin mo bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' bltams ②par gyur pa de'i nyin mo rgyal po chen po bzhi dag gi bu yang btsas par gyur te/ mnyan yod na rgyal po chen po rtsibs kyis 'phur tshangs sbyin gyi bu btsas nas de 'di snyam du sems te/bdag gi bu btsas pa na 'jig rten gsal ba lagasal ba ltar snang bas ༷gzhon nu 'di'i ming gsal rgyal du gdags so snyam nas bu de'i ming gsal rgyal zhes bya bar btags so/ /rgyal po'i khab na rgyal po chen po pad ma chen po'i bu btsas nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi bu btsas pa na du'ajig rten nyi ma'i gzugs shar ba ltar snang zhing du'adi btsun mo gzugs can gyi bu yin pas gzhon nu 'di'i ming gzugs can snying por gdags so snyam nas bu de'i ming gzugs can snying po zhes bya bar btags so/ / kau shāsbyi na ⑦rgyal po chen po dmag brgya pa'i bu btsas nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi nibu btsas pa na 'jig rten nyi ma shar ba ltar snang bar gyur pas gzhon nu 'di'i ming shar bar ⑨gdags so snyam nas bu de'i ming shar ba zhes bya bar btags so/ /'phags ⑩rgyal na rgyal po chen po mu khyud mtha' yas kyi bu btsas nas de 'di snyam du sems te / bdag gi bu btsas pa na 'jig rten rab tu snang bas snang bar gyur pas gzhon nu 'di'i ming rab snang zhes bya bar gdags so snyam nas bu de'i ming rab snang zhes bya bar btags so/ /rgyal po re res bsams ⑩pa/ yang bdag gi bu'i mthu yin no/ /bdag gi bu'i mthu yin no snyam mod kyi/ de ni de lta ma 6—150

yin te/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni byang chub sems dpa'i mthu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gang gi nyin mo bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' bltams ①pa de nyid kyi nyin mo shākya gzhon nu bzang ldan la ②sogs pa lnga brgya yang btsas so//bsnyen bkur ba 'dun byed la ①sogs pa lnga brgya yang btsas so/ /rta rgod ma lnga brgya las durte'u bsngags ldan la sogs pa 0lnga brgya yang du'abrangs so lha rnams kyis kyang gter lnga brgya nye bar bstan ༅to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' de bram ze ltas pa dang mtshan mkhan dag gis lung bstan pa/gal te gzhon nu pho brang gyegi nang na bzhugs par gyur na 'khor los sgyur khyaba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir rgyal ba/ chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de'i rin po che sna bdun po de dag ni 'di lta bur 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ 'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / dmag dpon rin po che nyid ni bdun pa yin no/ /'di la bu dpa' ba/ rtul phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms ⑩pa stong tshang ba yod par 'gyur ro/ /de rgya mtsho la thug pa'i sa chen po ma lus pa gnod par sngo yib med cing 'tshe ba med pa 'di nyid chad pa med cing mtshon gyis bda' ba med la chos dang mthun zhing snyoms pas legs par phab ste gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te skra dang kha 8spu bregs te gos ngur smrig dag bgos nas yang dag pa kho nar dad pas khyim nas 0khyim med par rab tu byung na ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du rnam par grags 6—151

pa'i sgra dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten du byung ba de'i tshe na thams cad du gangs kyi ①ngos dang nye ba chu klung skal ldan shing rta'i ②'gram drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas dang / ha cang mi ring bar shākya ③rnams kyi gzhon nu byung ste/ de bram ze ltas pa dang / mtshan mkhan dag gis gal te gzhon nu de pho brang gi nang na bzhugs ①par gyur na 'khor los sgyur ⑤ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir ①rgyal ba / chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur te / de'i rin po che sna bdun po de dag ni 'di lta bur 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang /nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / dmag dpon rin po che nyid ni bdun pa yin no/ /'di la bu dpa' ba / rtul ༷phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms pa stong tshang ba yod par 'gyur ro/ /de rgya mtsho la thug pa'i sa chen po ma lus pa gnod par sngo ⑧ba med cing 'tshe ba med pa 'di nyid chad pa med cing mtshon gyis bda' ba med la chos dang mthun zhing snyoms pas 7legs par phab ste gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig tshudag bgos nas yang dag pa kho nar dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung na ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du rnam par grags pa'i sgra dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to zhes sgra bsgrags ⑩par gyur to/ /nyi 'og gi khams kyi rgyal po dag gis kyang gangs ri'i 8ngos dang nye ba chu klung skal ldan shing rta'i 0'gram drang srong 6—152

ser skya'i bste gnas dang / ha cang mi ring bar shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu byung ste/de bram ze ltas pa dang / mtshan mkhan dag gis gal te gzhon nu de pho brang gi ①nang na bzhugs par gyur ②na 'khor los sgyur ③ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir rgyal ba/chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur dute/de'i rin po che sna bdun po ⑤de dag ni 'di lta bur 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang /nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che rjodang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / dmag dpon rin po che nyid ni bdun pa yin no/ /'di la bu dpa' ba / rtul phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms pa stong tshang ba yod par 'gyur ro/ /de rgya mtsho la thug pa'i sa chen po ma lus pa gnod par sngo ⑦ba med cing 'tshe ba med pa 'di nyid chad pa med cing mtshon gyis bda' ba med la chos dang mthun zhing snyoms pas ②legs par 0phab ste gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig dag bgos nas yang dag pa kho nar dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung na ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du rnam par grags pa'i sgra dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan to zhes ⑩thos so/ /thos nas kyang nyi 'og gi khams kyi rgyal po de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ da skyegazhon nu bsten na dus su 'bras bu ster bar 'gyur bas gang bsten na gzhon nu chubasten par 'gyur snyam mo/ /de dag gis bsams 0pa/ rgyal po zas gtsang bsten par bya ste/ de bsten na gzhon nu bsten par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de dag gis ④rgyal po zas gtsang bsten par 6—153

brtsams te/ dus dang mthun pa'i dus su 'dud pas pho nya dang / dkor sgrom dag skur bar byed do/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/bdag gi bu btsas pa na don thams cad dang las kyi mtha' thams cad grub pas de'i phyir gzhon nu 'di'i ming don thams cad grub pa zhes bya bar gdags so snyam nas de'i ming don thams cad grub pa zhes bya bar btags so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen por 'khrungs shing des rgan po dang /nad pa dang / shi ba gzigs nas thugs phyung ①ste nags kyi nang du gshegs pa de'i tshe na ②rgyal po zas gtsang dang / shākya legs par rab rtogs kyis bka' mchid gsol ba'i mi nyis brgya lnga bcu nyis brgya lnga bcu bkye ste/ de dag gis nyi ma re ②re zhing deng ni gzhon nu til 'bru gcig gam/ 'bras thug ④po che 'bru gcig gam/ mon sran sde'u 'bru gcig gam/ mon sran gre'u 'bru gcig gam/rgya shug gi 'bru gcig gam/ rgya sran 'bru gcig gis 'tsho bar mdzad do zhes bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i bka' mchid khyer te 'ong ngo nyi 'og gi khams kyi rgyal po dag gis de ltar gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa rgan po dang / nad pa dang / shi ba gzigs nas thugs byung ༷ste rab tu byung ༷ngo zhes thos nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ gang gi phyir bdag cag rgyal po zas gtsang la sten ⑦par byed pa'i gzhon nu de rab tu byung ngo snyam nas/ de dag las ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal ma gtogs pa gzhan thams cad kyis 'dud pa dang / pho nya dang dkor sgrom 'bul ba rgyun bcad par gyur to/ /de'i tshe na ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la blon po'i mchog sbed pa zhes bya ba zhig yod la/ rgyal po zas gtsang la ni mdun na 'don gyi bu 'char ka zhes bya ba 6—154

yod de/ gang gi tshe ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal rgyal po zas gtsang gi gan du pho nya gtong bar byed pa de'i tshe na blon po'i mchog sbed pa gtong bar byed de/ des rgyal po'i bya ba dag dang / rgyal po'i byed pa dag ①byas nas 'char ku'i lakhyim du 'jug par byed do/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po zas gtsang ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi gan du pho nya gtong bar byed pa de'i tshe na ni mdun na 'don gyi bu 'char ka gtong ②bar byed de/ des kyang rgyal po'i bya ba dag dang / rgyal po'i byed pa dag byas nas blon po'i mchog sbed pa'i khyim du 'jug par byed do/ /sbed pa la chung ma sbed ma zhes bya ba gzugs bzang ba blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa/ skyes bu dga' ba zhig yod de/ 'char ka sbed ma dang lhan cig kha dum par gyur to/ /sbed pas ji ltar 'char ka 0sbed ma dang lhan cig kha dum par gyur par shes nas des bsams ⑤pa/ 'di gsad par bya'o snyam mo/ /yang bsams dupa/ gal te 'di bsad ⑦par gyur na yul 'khor gnyis 'khrug pa chen por 'gyur bas bdag gis bud med kyi lus kyi phyir co'i phyir bram ze gsad ⑧par bya snyam nas de btang ⑨stoms su bzhag go/ /de nas 'char ka 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag sbed pas 'phrigs so snyam du rig nas skrag ste khyim nas byung zhing gzhan na 'dug pa dang / sbed pas smras pa/'char ka khyod ci'i phyir rang gi khyim spangs te gzhan na 'dug tshur shog /'di khyod rang gi khyim yin gyis ⑩ci bder 'dug shig /de nas 'char ka 'di snyam du sems te/ don gyis na 'dis bdag la rjes su gnang yingo snyam du rig nas de nyid na 'dug go// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po nyi shu 8bdun pa/ de nas 6—155

dus gzhan zhig na blon po'i mchog sbed pa dus la bab nas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis de la bu med pa'i phyir nor thams cad rang gi mdzod dang bang ①bar bcug go/ /sbed mas 'char ka la gang gi tshe bdag gi khyim thab gson zhing 'dug ste 'tsho zhing sdod pa de'i tshe na khyod rtag pa kho nar byon na da de'i ②dus la bab ste/ ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis kyang bu ma mchis pa'i slad du nor thams cad rang gi mdzod dang bang bar stsal na/ da khyod kyis bka' mchid tsam yang mi spring ngam zhes yi ge spring ngo / /de nas 'char ka spring yig gi don thos nas 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te bdag der song bar gyur na gzhi ③de las 'char ka bud med la chags pa ④bud med kyi phyir der song ngo zhes gzhan dag kha zer bar 'gyur gyis bdag gis ⑤thabs kyi rnam pa zhig bya'o snyam nas des lan gnyis sam gsum du ⑥rgyal po'i bya ba dag dang /rgyal po'i byed pa dag byas nas rgyal po zas gtsang ga la ba der song ste phyin nas rgyal po zas gtsang la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha gang gi tshe gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa bltams ⑦pa de'i tshe na nyi du'og gi khams kyi rgyal po thams cad 'dud cing thams cad kyis pho nya dang / dkor sgrom dag gsol nas/gang gi tshe gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa rgan 0po dang / nad pa dang /gum pa gzigs nas thugs byung ste nags su gshegs pa de'i tshe na nyi ⑩thog gi khams kyi rgyal po de dag las ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal ma gtogs pa gzhan thams cad kyis pho nya dang / dkor sgrom 'bul ba rgyun bkum nas lhas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la pho nya dang / dkor sgrom dag bka' stsal cing bskur nas de lta de ltar rkyen par gyur pa las da ⑩yal bar bor 6—156

na slad kyis gnod pa chen por 'gyur ba de skol ①dang mtshams 'brel bar mchis pas de dang ②lhan cig rkyen par mdzad pa'i rigs so/ /'char ka gal te de lta na khyod nyid pho nyar song shig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes de nas 'char kus dkor sgrom dag khyer te ①mnyan yod ga la ba der 'phags nas mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin to/ /de nas 'char ka 'di snyam du sems te/ sten pa la bsten par mi bya bar bsten pa la bsten pa bsten par ④bya ba yin pas je ⑤dang por blon po rnams blta bar bya zhing de'i 'og tu rgyal po blta ste/ sbed ma'i phyir rgyal po la gsol ba bya'o snyam nas/ des blon po rnams la ⑥blta bar brtsams te smras ⑦pa/ shes ldan dag khyed kyis kho bo ji ltar sbed ma dang lhan cig bshes pa de mi shes sam/ de lakhyim thab dus la bab nas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bu med pa'i phyir de'i nor thams cad rang gi mdzod dang /bang bar bcug pas de'i phyir kho bo rgyal po la gsol ba byed kyis ⑨khyed kyis grogs gyis ⑩shig /de dag gis de bzhin du khas blangs so/ /de nas 'char ka ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la rgyal ba dang / tshe spel ba byas te mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas lan gnyis lan (spregasum du rgyal po'i bya ba dag dang /rgyal po'i byed pa dag byas te/ ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha bdag gi tsoganas stsol cig /'char ka khyod sngon gang du zhugs/ lha blon po'i mchog sbed pa'i sdum par mchis so/ /'char ka song la de nyid du zhugs shig /lha blon po'i mchog sbed pa dus la bab po/ /gal te de dus 0la bab na ci de'i khyim yang ④dus la bab bam/ lha de'i sdum pa ni — 6—157

dus la ma bab med kyi 'on kyang de na stan tsam yang ma mchis so/ /rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed kyis 'char ku'i gnas byin cig/'char ku'i ①phyir byung ba dang / blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha ci lags 'char ka la gnas ma mchis snyam mamacha/ 'di ltar 'char ka sbed ma dang lhan cig mchid mjal bas don gyis na 'char kus sbed ma'i slad du lha la gsol ba lags kyis0/ lha 'char ka ni bram ze mdun na 'don gyi ④bu lags pas bram ze ni mi 'dod bzhin du gzung bar bgyi ⑤ba lags te/ 'di legs par bzung na rgyal po zas gtsang legs par bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal pos 'char ka bos te smras pa/ 'char ka ngas khyod ji ltar sbed ma dang lhan cig bshes par sngar ma shes kyis yid song la sbed ma dang / de'i khyim dang / nor thams cad khyod khyer cig /lha bka' stsal pa bzhin 'tshal lo zhes smras nas/'char ka sbed ma'i khyim ga la ba der song ba dang / sbed mas 'char ka 'ongs so zhes thos nas sgo khang du 'dug ste ngu bar brtsams so/ /'char kus mthong nas smras pa/ sbed ma khyod ci'i phyir ngu / des smras pa/ bdag 'tshal ba'i khyim thab dus la bab na ci khyod kyis kyang yongs su btang ⑦ngam/ de nas 'char ka 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te bdag gis mthun par smras na 'di shin tu ngu bar 'gyur bas bdag gis ⑧'di tshar gcad ⑨par bya'o snyam du rig nas 'char gas sbed ma la smras pa/ sbed ma byang chub sems dpa' dka' ba byed pa gang gis btsun mo grags 'dzin dang / sa 'tsho ma dang / ri dgas skyes la 0sogs pa bud med drug khri spangs te rab tu byung ba de dag gi 0rkang pa'i rdul tsam du yang khyod kyis mi phod do/ /de nas de cang mi smra bar 'dug pa dang /6—158

'char gas smras pa/ kho ①bos khyod ma btang bas khyod nyid kyi phyir 'dir 'ongs pa yin no/ /kho bos rgyal po las khyod dang khyim dang / nor thams cad thob na ci khyod 'di nyid du 'dug gam/ ser skya'i gnas su 'gro/ /des bsams ②pa/ gal te ser skya'i gnas su song nas 0bram ze mo las srog kyang mi thob bo snyam du rig nas 'di nyid du mchis so zhes smras te de de nyid du 'dug go / /de'i tshe na 'char ka la khyim gnyis yod de/ gcig ni mnyan yod na'o//gcig ni ser skya'i gnas na'o/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas ༅lo drug tu dka' ba spyad de dka' ba byed pa ci yang med par rig nas/ci bder dbugs rngub par mdzad ci bder dbugs 'byin par mdzad cing /'bras chan dang / zan dron la ⑤sogs pa zhal zas rgya chen po dag kyang gsol bar mdzad/ zhun mar dang / 'bru mar dag gis sku dag kyang skud par mdzad⑥ / chu dron pos kyang sku bsil bar mdzad cing / grong sde 'dong du gshegs nas grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo ⑦dang / dga' stobs ma gnyis las lan bcu drug bzlas pa'i 'o ma sbrang rtsi dang bsres ⑤pa gsol te/ klu'i rgyal po nag pos mngon par bstod pa na rtswa ⑨bkra shis 'tshong spre) pa las rtswa gser gyi mdog lta bu dag bzhes nas/ byang chub kyi gzhi ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas/ nyid kyis rtswa ma 'khrugs pa'i gdan bshams nas skyil mo krung yibacas te sku drang por bsrang 8nas dran pa phyogs par bzhag 0ste bzhugs nas thugs bskyed cing gsung brjod pa/ ji srid zag med ma thob par de srid skyil krung cigazhig mi bya/ /de yis ji srid zag med pa/ /ma brnyes skyil krung 8'jig mi mdzad/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshan mo'i gung — 6—159

thun la bdud 'byung po dung phyur phrag gsum dang / bye ba phrag drug gi 'khor dang ldan pa byams pa'i stobs kyis mngon par btul te labla na med pa'i mkhyen pa thugs su chud nas tshangs pas gsol te/ bā rā ṇa sīr ②gshegs nas ⑧lan gsum du bzlas te rnam pa bcu gnyis su chos dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de'i tshe lnga pa dang / nye lnga dag dang / grong ba'i khye'u mtho ba mtho ba lnga bcu btul to/ / kur pa si'i tshal rjogaseb tu gshegs nas bzang sde'i tshogs drug bcu dubaden pa dag la bkod do/ /grong sde 'dong du gshegs nas grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma gnyis bden pa dag la bkod do / /steng ⑥rgyas su gshegs nas ral pa can stong rab tu phyung ①zhing rdzogs par bsnyen par mdzad do/ /ga yā ⑧mgo'i mchod rten du gshegs nas dge slong stong po de ⑨dag cho 'phrul gsum gyis gdams pa mdzad nas 'khor ba'i dgon pa las bsgral te shin 0tu mthar thug ⑩pa grub pa dang bde ba bla na med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bkod do/ /shar pa'i tshal tsogaseb tu gshegs nas ma ga ṅgār 'byung ba'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po lha brgyad khri dang /ma ga d+mar tsobyung ba'i bram ze dang / khyim bdag 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig bden pa dag la bzhag 'go/ /rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs nas 'od ma'i tshal bzhes te shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal 8gyi bu 'khor nyis ⑩brgya lnga bcu dang ldan pa rab tu phyung 8zhing rdzogs par bsnyen par mdzad do/ /mnyan yod du gshegs nas rgyal byed kyi tshal bzhes te ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gzhon nu'i dpe'i tsomados btul nas/ de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na 6—160

bzhugs so/ /de nas ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis rgyal po zas gtsang gi gan du pho nya btang ste/ lha dgyes pa skyed cig /khyod kyi sras kyis bdud rtsi thugs su chud de/ bdud rtsis 'gro ba tshim par mdzad cing /mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes spring ngo / /rgyal po zas gtsang gis thos nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar pho nya btang ste/ gzhon nu bdag gis ring du ma mthong ste/bdag gzhon nu mthong bas yongs su skom mo zhes gsol pa dnge / pho nya de ①de nyid du rab tu phyung ②ngo / /pho nya gnyis pa btang ba dang de yang de ③nyid du rab tu phyung dungo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis duchos du'adul ba ni legs par gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir gang dang gang ༅pho nyar btang ba de dang de de nyid du rab tu byung ngo / /de nas dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po zas gtsang gis de thos nas lag pa la 'gram pa gtad ⑧de sems khong du 0chud cing 'dug pa/'char gas mthong nas smras pa/ lha ci'i slad du phyag la zhal gtad de thugs khong du ⑨ chud cing bzhugs/ 'char ka gang gi tshe gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa dka' ba dag spyod pa'i 0tshe ngas gtam med pa'i mi dag btang tson de dag nyi ma re re zhing gtam khyer te 'ongs nas gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa gnas pa 'dis gnas so zhes gtam snyod 0par byed na/ da gzhon nu don thams cad grub pas bdud rtsi thugs su chud de bdud rtsis 'gro ba tshim par mdzad cing / mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs zhes thos nas ngas gtam med pa'i mi dag btang tson/'gas kyang gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa'i gtam khyer te mi 'ong bar gang — 6—161

dang gang pho nyunyar btang ②ba de dang de de nyid du 'dug par gyur rgyan nga ji ltar lag pa la 'gram pa gtad de sems khong du ༷chud cing mi 'dug tu rung /'char kus smras pa/ lha bdag la bka' stsal du gsol/ khyod kyang der 'dug par 'gyur ro/ /lha bdag gis lha'i spyan sngar bka' mchid 'tshal te mchi'ol/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis rang nyid kyis phrin ⑤yig 'di skad ces/ma ①rum bzhugs pa tshun chad nas/ /bdag gis legs par khyod bsrungs ⑦te//nyon mongs gdugs kyis rab gdungs pas/ /rgyal ba'i niljon shing sdod cing mchis / /slob ma'i yal ga rtsa lag gis/ /da 0ltar khyod ni rgyas gyur pas/ /gzhan dag bde bas dga' mdzad na/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal sten ⑩par gyur/ /gang tshe dang po khyod 'khrungs tshe/ /shin tu don chen mdzad nas ni/ /nye du rjes su gzung ⑩mdzad ces/ /de tshe khyod kyis thugs dam bcas/ /de slad go ⑫'phang zhi brnyes khyod/ /bdag dang nye du'i tshogs rnams la/ /rjes su thugs brtse nyer bzung ste/ /byon pa'i blo gros mdzad du gsol/ /zhes bris so/ /de nas 'char ka phrin tsoyig de blangs te mnyan yod du 'phags nas de mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin nas ciji ④tsam na 'char kus bcom ldan 'das la phrin ⑫ yig phul ba dang / bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis phrin yig bklag ⑩pa mdzad nasatso/'char kus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gnas su gshegs sam/'char ka 'ong ngo / /'char gas 7sngon gyi gcugs pa de nyid kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te bcom ldan 'das mi gshegs na bdag gis mthus bkri bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa bka' stsal pa/ gang la khrid byed sred pa yi/ /dra bkram gang na'ang yod min pa/ /6—162

spyod yas gzhi med sangs rgyas de/ /gang gi gzhis ①ni khrid par byed/ /gang la khrid byed sred pa yi/ /dra bkram gang na'ang yod min pa/ /rtsal yas gzhi med sangs rgyas de/ /gang gi gzhis ni khrid par byed/ /gang rgyal mi nyams gang la ni/ /'jig rten ma rgyal yod med pa/ /spyod yas gzhi med sangs rgyas de/ /gang gi gzhis ②ni khrid par byed/ /gang rgyal mi nyams gang la ni/ /'jig rten ma rgyal yod med pa/ /rtsal yas gzhi med sangs rgyas de/ /gang gi gzhis ni khrid par byed/ /'char kus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag rgyal po zas gtsang la brjod ①du mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'char ka rgyal ba'i pho nya dag ni de lta bu ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das 'o na rgyal ba'i pho nya dag ji lta bu lags/ skra bregs shing gos ngur smrig gon ④pa rab tu byung ba dag yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis rgyal po zas gtsang la slar mchis par ⑤mchid kyis 'tshal to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab tu byung ste song shig /'di ltar bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpar gyur pas sngon tshe rabs rjes ⑥pa de dang de dag tu yab dang /yum dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / bla ma dang / bla ma'i gnas lta bu dag gi chos dang ldan pa'i tshig 'ga' yang ma bcag ⑦pas bka' stsal ma thag tu 'char gas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag rab tu 'byung ⑧ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la ⑨bka' stsal pa / shā ri'i bu 'char ka rab tu phyung shig dang / de ni 'di la yun ring po'i ⑩don dang / phan pa dang / bde bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas 6—163

'char ka rab tu phyung bsnyen par rdzogs par byas te/ de la 'di ni khyod kyi ①bya ba yin no/ /'di ni khyod kyis ②bya ba ma yin no②/ /'char ka khyod kyis deng phyin cad bud med kyi yul dang lhan cig khyim gcig ⑦tu nyal bar mi bya'o zhes bya ba la ⑤sogs pa kun tu spyad pa'i chos thams cad brjod do/ /'char gas mkhan po ⑥bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te song nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ⑦der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gnas su mchi'o//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'char ka khyod kyis tsham tshom med par rgyal po'i pho brang du 'jug par mi bya bar sgor 'greng ste shākya'i dge slong 'ongs so zhes ⑨brjod par bya'o/ /gal te shākya'i dge slong gzhan dag kyang yod dam zhes 'dri na shākya'i dge slong gzhan dag kyang yod do zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te zhugs shig ces zer na 'jug par bya'o/ /gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa yang cha lugs 'di 'dra ba nyid yin nam zhes 'dri rkyen/ cha lugs 'di 'dra ba nyid yin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /khyod kyis rgyal po'i pho brang du gnas par mi bya'o/ /gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa yang rgyal po'i pho brang du gnas 'cha' bar mi byed dam zhes 'dri na/ gnas 'cha' bar mi byed do zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te gang du gnas 'cha' bar byed ces 'dri na/dgon pa'am/ gtsug lag khang du'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa 'ong ngam zhes 'dri na 'ong ngo zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te yun ji tsam na 'ong zhes 'dri na zhag bdun 'das nas so zhes brjod par 6wa 164

bya'o / /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bcom ldan 'das bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo /'char ka 'ong ba'i tshe mnyan yod du nyi ma mang po dag gis phyin na phyir 'gro ba'i tshe 'di lta ste / sangs rgyas rnams ①kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi lha'i ②mthus nyi ma gcig gis ser skya'i gnas su phyin to/ /de nas tshe rgyadang ldan pa 'char ka ①rgyal po zas gtsang gi pho brang ga la ba der song ste phyin nas mi sgo ba bos te smras pa/ kye nang rje khyod song la rgyal po la shākya'i dge slong 'ongs so zhes sgron cig /des smras pa/ shākya'i dge slong gzhan dag kyang mchis sam/'char kus smras pa/ shākya'i dge slong gzhan dag kyang yod do/ /sgo bas rgyal po la sbran pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ shākya ⑤'jug tu chug shig /su zhig byu shākya zlog ①par byed/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka sgo bas ngo shes nas rgyal po zas gtsang ga la ba der song ste phyin nas rgyal po zas gtsang la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po chen po khyod la bcom ldan 'das a rog gya ⑦zhes gsung ngo //rgyal po zas gtsang gis 'char ka skad las ngo shes nas smras pa/ khyod 'char ka yin nam/ lha bdag skye bos de ltar 'tshal to/ /⑧rgyal pos smras pa/gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa yang cha lugs 'di 'dra ba nyid yin nam/ lha cha lugs 'di 'dra ba nyid lags so/ /rgyal po seng ge'i khri las brgyal 0te sa la lhung nas chus dbang bskur bas srog phyir 'ongs nas dris pa/ gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa 'ong ngam/ lha mchi'o/ /yun ji tsam na 'ong (spre/dgung bdun 'das nas so/ /rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan 6—165

dag deng la ①rgyal po'i pho brang dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dag byi dor gyis shig/lha gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa de rgyal po'i pho brang ngam/ btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du gnas 'cha' bar mi bgyid do/ /'o na gang du gnas 'cha' bar byed/ dgon pa'am/ gtsug lag khang du'o/ /gtsug lag khang ci ②'dra bar/ 'char kus mnyan yod na gtsug lag khang ci ②'dra ba dag mthong ba de 'dra ba brjod do/ /de'i tshe ④na rgyal po zas gtsang la skyed mos tshal ⑤skye yod dang / n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba dang / tshangs pa'i gnas la ⑥sogs pa skyed ⑦mos tshal lnga brgya yod pas rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed deng la/ skyed ④mos tshal gsum po skye yod dang / n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ⑨ra ba dang / tshangs pa'i gnas dag tu skyed ⑨ mos tshal re rer ⑪yang rgyal byed kyi tshal /7)'dra ba'i gtsug lag khang ()khang chen bcu drug dang /khang pa'i gzhi drug bcu tsoyod pa dag myur du byed du chug la/ grong khyer ser skya'i gnas thams cad kyang rdo ba tsodang / gseg ma dang / gyo mo med par gnas par gyis shig /rgyal po rnams ni tshig gis 'grub pa yin la/ lha rnams ni sems kyis 'grub pa ⑨yin/ rnal 'byor pa rnams ni sems bskyed pa 0tsam gyis thams cad 'grub pa yin pas blon po rnams kyis lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes rgyal po zas gtsang las mnyan nas skyed tsomos tshal gsum po skye yod dang /n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba dang / tshangs pa'i gnas dag tu skyed yimos tshal re rer yang rgyal byed kyi tshal 'dra ba'i gtsug lag khang dukhung chen bcu drug dang /khang pa'i gzhi drug bcu 0yod pa dag byed du bcug cing grong khyer ser skya'i gnas thams cad kyang rdo ba dudang / gseg ma dang / gyo mo med par gnas 6—166

par byas so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gson zhing bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes ①pa rnams la ②chos nyid kyis gdon mi za bar bgyi ba bcu mnga' ste/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ji srid du sangs rgyas su lung ma bstan pa dang /ji srid du sems can gzhan gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu phyir mi ldog pa'i sems ma bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis gdul bar bya ba thams cad ma btul ba dang /① ji srid du sku tshe'i cha lnga pa ma lus pa dang / ji srid du mtshams bcad dupa ma mdzad pa dang / ji srid du nyan thos zung gcig ⑤mchog tu ma bstan pa dang / ji srid du grong khyer kun 'od du lha las babs rjopa ma bstan pa dang / ji srid du mnyan yod du cho 'phrul chen po rnam par ma bstan pa dang / ji srid du mtsho chen po ma dros par nyan thos rnams dang thabs cig 0sngon gyi las kyi rgyu ba lung ma bstan pa dang / ji srid du yab yum gnyis bden pa dag la ma bkod pa de srid du yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba yin no//de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ rgyal po chen po zas gtsang dang / shākya 'bum phrag du ma dag gdul ba'i dus nye bar gnas par gyur cing /'di lta ste/ yab yum gnyis bden pa dag la gzhag pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pas gdon mi za bar mdzad pa yin no snyam du dgongs nas/⑧ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal 0gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal 0gyi bu khyod song la dge slong rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa ser skya'i ⑪gnas su gshegs kyis0/ khyed cag las gang de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig tsoser skya'i gnas su 'gro ba dang / yab dang sras mjal 8ba lta bar spro ba des chos gos dag long ⑩shig ces bsgo ⑩shig /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ⑦gyi 6—167

bu chen pos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas/dge slong rnams la tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gnas su gshegs kyis ①khyed cag las gang de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig ②ser skya'i gnas su 'gro ba dang / yab dang sras mjal ⑧ba lta bar spro ba des chos gos dag long 0shig ces bsgo'o/ /dge slong phyedag gis tshe dang ldan pa de bzhin ⑥bgyi'o zhes tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ⑦gyi bu chen po las mnyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba dang ldan pa/ zhi ba 'khor zhi ba dang ldan pa/ grol ba 'khor grol ba dang ldan pa/⑧ dbugs phyin ⑨pa 'khor dbugs phyin ⑩pa dang ldan pa/ thul ba 'khor thul ba dang ldan pa/dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa dang ldan pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba dang ldan pa/ mdzes pa 'khor mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ khyu mchog ltar ba lang gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ glang po che ltar glang po che'i phru gu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ seng ge ltar mche ba can gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar ngang pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nam mkha' 0lding ltar bya'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ bram ze ltar slob ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ sman pa mkhas pa ltar nad pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ dpa' bo ltar ru pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ sa mkhan ltar lam du zhugs pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ded dpon ltar tshong pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/tshong dpon ltar 'khor gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mkhar gyi rgyal po ltar blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ 'khor los sgyur 8ba ltar bu 6—168

stong gi ①tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ zla ba ltar rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nyi ma ltar 'od zer stong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/yul 'khor srung ltar dri za'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ 'phags skyes po ltar grul bum gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mig mi ②bzang ltar klu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nor ②sbyin ltar gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ thags zangs ④ris ltar lha ma yin gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ brgya byin ltar sum bcu ⑤ma gsum pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ tshangs pa ltar tshangs ris kyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/dbang po rnams ⑥shin tu dul ba/ spyod lam dang / spyod pa ma 'khrugs pa/chu gter ltar ting nge ba/ sprin ltar chu dang bcas pa/ glang po che'i rgyal po ltar dregs pa dang bral ba/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu ⑦ma gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus ④sku rnam par mdzes pa/'od 'dom ⑨gang gis gzugs can brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun tu bzang btso/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ 'jig tho〉rten la phan par zhugs pa/ srung ba gcig pu pa/ nyag gcig tsodapa' ba/ gnyis pa ⑫med pa/ gnyis su mi gsung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gis bzhugs pa/rig pa gsum gsal bar mdzad pa/ bslab pa gsum la legs par bslabs pa/dul ④ba'i gnas gsum gyi gzhi la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi las rgal tsob/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis spyod pa'i gzhi la legs par gnas pa/ bsdu ba'i 6—169

dngos po bzhi ①la yun ring po nas yongs su sbyang ba mdzad pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis bsnyengs ②pa mi mnga' ba/ yan lag lnga spangs ③pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtag tu gnas pa drug gis gnas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi ④me tog gis phyug pa/ lam gyi yan lag brgyad ston pa/mthar gyis gnas pa'i ⑤stoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcur snyan pas ⑥yang dag par rgyas pa/ brgya phrag bcur dbang bsgyur ba las khyad par du 'phags pa/ 'khor nyan thos chen po tshe dang ldan pa lteng ⑦rgyas 'od srung dang / ga ya du'od srung dang / chu klung 'ong srung la 0sogs pa sngon gyi ral pa can stong dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu chen po tshul sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun mang pos mdun du bdar te ser skya'i gnas ga la ba der rgyu zhing gshegs so/ /de'i tshe na rgyal po zas gtsang gis nyi ma bdun pa la grong khyer ser skya'i gnas thams cad rdo ba yidang / gsog ma dang / gyo mo med par bzhag cing bdug pa dang /phye tsom 'khrigs pa dang / me tog sna tshogs bkram pa dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan bsgreng ba la 0sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad rgya chen po dag bshams shing /n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar sa phyogs go skabs yangs par gdan thabs zla gam lta bur skyobashams te/ n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba nas grong khyer ser skya'i gnas kyi bar gyi tsolam thams cad mdzes shing rdo ba dang / gsog ma dang /gyo mo med par bzhag ste/ spos chu'i chag chag btab cing bar bar du dar gyi chun po mang po dbyangs 4)shing / me tog gi tshoms 6)dag kyang bshams/6—170

bdug spos dri zhim po'i du ba 'khrigs pa dang / me tog sna tshogs bkram pa dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ba dag rnam par bzhag go/ /rgyal po zas gtsang nyid kyis ①rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang / rgyal po'i mthu chen pos n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das la sdod ②cing 'dug go / /de nas bcom ldan 'das mthar gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa na chu rlung ③ro ha ku'i 'gram du gshegs so/ /de na khyodage slong kha cig ni lag pa dang rkang pa dag 'khru bar byed/ kha cig ni ⑤so shing 'dor bar byed/ kha cig ni chu 'tshag par byed⑥/ kha cig ni khrus byed do/ /⑦grong khyer ser skya'i gnas na 'khod pa'i shākya rnams kyis gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa 'ongs shing /rgyal po zas gtsang gis n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar sa phyogs go skabs yangs par gnas mal bshams zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang shākya 'bum phrag du ma dag n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar 'dus par gyur cing / de na ⑤kha cig ni sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dag gis bskul zhing 0lhags so/ /kha cig ni ya mtshan skyes te je tho chedang por yab kyis sras kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal bar mdzad dam/'on te sras kyis yab kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal bar mdzad pa blta'o snyam pas lhags 7so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ gal te de bzhin tsogashegs pa zhabs kyis ser skya'i gnas su gshegs na shākya nga rgyal can dag gzhon nu don thams cad grub pas chen po ma rnyed de/ 'di ltar 'di sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur pa na grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas lha 'bum phrag du mas bsu ste 8steng gi nam mkha' las byung ste song na8/ da 'dis bla na med pa'i ye shes rtogs kyang rkang pas tso'ongs so zhes ma dad pa skye bar 'gyur bas 6—171

bdag rdzu 'phrul gyis ser skya'i gnas su 'jug par bya'o snyam du dgongs shing rig nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed ni rkang pa dag gis chu klung ro ha ka ⑤rgol cig /de bzhin gshegs pa ni rdzu 'phrul ②gyis gshegs so/ /dge slong rnams kyis btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas/ rkang pa dag gis chu klung ③ro ha ka rgal ④te n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba ga la ba der dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi dge 'dun song nas ring po ma lon par thugs su chud nas ting nge 'dzin 'di lta bu la snyoms par zhugs te/ ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag ⑤na rdzu 'phrul gyis chu klung ro ha ku'i pha rol gyi 'gram nas mi snang bar gyur cing steng gi nam mkha' la ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dab ma brkyang ⑥pa ltar mngon par 'phags nas/ ser skya'i gnas kyi steng nas ⑦rgya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba'i steng gi nam mkha' la skyil mo krung ⑧bcas te bzhugs so/ /de na ⑨bcom ldan 'das shar phyogs logs ⑨ su spyod lam bzhi po 'di lta ste/ 'chag pa dang / bzhengs pa dang /bzhugs pa dang / mnal ba dag mdzad do/ /me'i khams la yang snyoms par 'jug pa mdzad yide/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs pa'i sku las 'od zer sna tshogs 'di lta ste/ sngon po dag dang / ser po dag dang / dmar po dag dang / dkar po dag dang / btsod ka tshudag dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dag byung ngo / /cho 'phrul zung ⑫dag kyang rnam par ston pa ④mdzad de/ sku'i smad nas me 'bar zhing sku'i stod nas chu grang tsomo'i rgyun 'bab par mdzad do/ /sku'i stod nas me 'bar zhing 6—172

sku'i smad nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bab par mdzad do/ /shar phyogs su ji lta ba bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs su yang de bzhin du ①mdzad do / /②de ltar phyogs bzhir rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi bzhi ⑧ston par mdzad do/ /de nas ④bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/gal te de bzhin gshegs pas rgyal po zas gtsang gi rkang pa gnyis la gtugs par gyur na ni de'i spyi bo tshal pa bdun du 'gas par 'gyur la/ gal te rgyal po zas gtsang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs gnyis la gtugs par gyur na ni shākya nga rgyal can dag ci'i ⑤phyir yab tu gyur pas sras kyi rkang pa gnyis la gtugs ⑥par byed ces ma dad pa skye bar 'gyur bas bdag gis ci nas ④kyang rgyal po zas gtsang gis lus ma btud bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par du'adu bya'o snyam du dgongs shing rig nas ta la bdun srid tsam gyi steng gi nam mkha' la gzhes 0shing / ta la drug dang / lnga dang / bzhi dang / gsum dang /gnyis dang / gcig srid tsam na bzhugs so/ /de nas skyes bu bdun srid tsam na gzhes shing skyes bu drug dang /0 lnga dang / bzhi dang / gsum dang /gnyis dang / gcig srid tsam na gzhes so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis ⑪ma btud bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas shākya rnams la 6)go bar bya ba'i phyir de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/gang tshe khyod bltams 'dog sa rab g.yos dang / /'dzam bu'i grib mas khyod sku ma btang dang / /'di dang lan gsum kun gzigs mkhyen ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas khyod kyi zhabs la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis brdzu 6—173

'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa de slar ①bsdu ba mdzad nas n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar gshegs te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang dang / bre bo zas dang /zas dkar dang / bdud rtsi zas dang / shākya ②'bum phrag du ma dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'khod do/ /shākya kha cig ni bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de ②logs su thal mo sbyar te mtha' gcig ⑤tu 'khod do/ /shākya kha cig ni thag ring po kho na nas bcom ldan 'das mthong nas cang mi smra bar mtha' gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i skad kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ dpa' bo bcibs pa glang po dang / /chibs dang shing rtas khab gshegs na/ /tsher bcas dog sa'i gzhi dag la/ /ji ltar zhabs kyis gshegs pa ⑤mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bdag ni rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang / /yang dag stsol ⑥ba'i bzhon pa yis⑤/ /nyon mongs tsher mas ma smas ⑤par/ /sa gzhi kun tu rnam par rgyu/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/dpa' bo sngan ⑨chad ka shi ku'i/ /na bza' gsol bas rnam mdzes na/ /ngur smrig ⑩na bza' rtsub po dag /ji ltar khyod skus bzod par mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po bdag ni 0khril 'dzem pa'i/ /snam sbyar gos gyon mdzes pa yin/ /gang gis 'thub pa'i gos gyon pa/ /zhi ba'i nags na tsomadzes par 'gyur8/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ brtan pa sngon chad ⑫gser snod nas/ /zhal zas ro mang ldan gsol nasatso/ /da ltar bsod snyoms ngan pa dag /ji ltar khyod kyi mgur du byon/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 6—174

bka' stsal pa/ chos ldan dga' ba dag ①gi zas/ /nges 'byung ldan zhing mnyam bzhag yin/ /zas srid spangs kyang 'jig rten kun/ /rjes su gzung phyir bdag spyod byed/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ blo bzang khyod sngon yang thog gi//gzhal med khang steng dus mthun bzhugs/ /nyag gcig nags na khyod bzhugs na / /ji ltar bsnyengs ②dang bral bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gi ②tam 'jigs kun rtsa dang srid/ /de dag rjobag nyal bcas spangs pas/ /mya ngan 'jigs bral nags gnas te/ /de na bdag 'jigs ci yang med/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ thub dbang khyod sngon rab dgyes pa'i/ /khab na rtag tu khrus mchog mdzad/ /nags na nyag gcig khyod bzhugs na/ /de na 'byor khrus su dag bgyid/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gi ②tam chos rdzing ⑥bsod nams 'gram/ /rnyog med dam pas bsngags pa ste/ /mi lus mi gsher der bkrus pa/ /rig byed yon tan pha rol 'gro/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ dpa' bo rang gi pho brang na/ /gser dngul bum pas khrus mdzad na/ /chab tshan rnyog dang bcas pa yis/ /ji ltar khyod kyi ①sku khrus mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gau dutam dang klung tshul khrims 'gram/ /dang ba bsil ba mkhas pas bsngags/ /mi lus mi gsher der bkrus pa/ /rig byed yon tan pha rol 'gro/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ zil gnon gang nas skye 'gyur zhing / /'jigs skrag lagang nas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yid 'byung gang nas skye bar 'gyur⑩/ /zhus pa de ni bdag la gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/zil gnon gang nas skye 'gyur zhing / /'jigs skrag yigang nas 'byung 'gyur 6—175

dang / /yid 'byung gang nas skye 'gyur ba/ /gson cig bdag gis khyod la bshad / /rga dang na dang 'chi 'gyur ba/ /gal te de gsum yod min na/ /bdag kyang shin tu yid 'ong ba'i/ /yul rnams la ni dga' ①bar 'gyur/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ shākya'i rigs rnams dga' mdzad pa/ /dpa' bo 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis/ /khyod la gos pa mi mnga' ba/ /legs par 'khrungs pa legs pa lags/ /de nas rab dga' dang rgyas pas/ /drang srong dge 'dun bskor byas te/ /thub dbang zhabs la mgos gtugs nas/ /bde gshegs kun nas rtog cing sdod/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/bdag gi bus ②yon tan gyi tshogs 'di lta bu rtogs pa ni bdag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo phal po che'i tshogs de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ②dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'di ltar rgyal po zas gtsang dang / lhas sbyin sdig pa 'dod pa cing rgyal las kyang nga rgyal can ma gtogs pa zas dkar la ⑤sogs pa shākya bdun khri bdun stong gis bden pa dag mthong bar gyur pa de ltar chos bstan pa mdzad do/ /de nas ⑥srog chags stong phrag mang po kha cig gis ⑦ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas/ kha cig gis ni lan gcig ⑧phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni rab tu byung ste nyon mongs pa ⑨thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ 'khor de las phal cher sangs rgyas la gzhol ba dang /chos la 'bab pa dang / dge 'dun la bab par rnam por gzhag par ⑩mdzad do / /rgyal po zas gtsang ni bdag gi bu 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ 'di 6—176

ltar mthu che ba yin no snyam du ①ha cang dga' bas bden pa ma mthong ngo / /lhas byin ni sdig pa 'dod pa dang / nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal gyis bden pa ma mthong ngo / — /lhas byin bden pa ma mthong zhing khro bas ①zil gyis non pas smras pa/ gal te bdag gis kyang 'di ltar rjes su 'jug par byed pa'i sgyu ②ma shes par gyur na/ bdag gis kyang 'jig rten thams cad rjes su 'jug par bya ba la rag go/ /shākya gcugs par gyur pa dga' ba ston pa dag gis de la smras pa/ lhas byin thong shig bcom ldan 'das ni rdzu 'phrul che ba/ mthu che ba yin gyis rjode skad ma zer cig /de nas de cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /nyi ma gnyis pa la skyed dumos tshal skye yod du sa phyogs go skabs yangs par gdan thabs zla gam lta bu bshams pa byas nas/ der yang bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo phal po che'i tshogs de'i bsam ⑥pa dang bag la nyal dang / khams dang /rang bzhin thugs su chud nas 'di ltar rgyal po zas gtsang dang / lhas byin sdig pa 'dod pa nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal can ma gtogs pa⑦/ bre bo zas la ⑧sogs pa shākya bdun 0khri drug stong gis bden pa dag mthong bar gyur pa de ltar chos bstan ⑩pa mdzad do/ /de na srog chags stong phrag mang po kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas/ kha cig gis ni lan gcig ⑩phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig 8gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni rab tu byung ste nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ 'khor de las phal cher sangs rgyas la gzhol ba dang / chos la 'bab pa dang / dge 'dun la bab par rnam par gzhag par ⑫mdzad do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ni bdag gi bu 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/6—177

'di ltar mthu che ba yin no snyam du ha cang dga' bas bden pa ma mthong ngo / /lhas byin ni sdig pa 'dod pa dang / nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal gyis bden pa ma mthong ngo / /lhas byin bden pa ma mthong zhing khro ba'i ①zil gyis non pas smras pal/ gal te bdag gis 0kyang 'di ltar rjes su 'jug par byed pa'i sgyu ma shes par gyur na/ bdag gis kyang 'jig rten thams cad rjes su 'jug par bya ba ②la rag go/ /shākya gcugs par gyur pa dga' ④ba ston pa dag gis ⑤de la smras pa/ lhas byin thong ⑥shig /bcom ldan 'das ni rdzu 'phrul che ba/mthu che ba yin gyis de skad ma zer cig /de nas de ༅cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /nyi ma gsum pa la skyed ②mos tshal tshangs pa'i gnas su sa phyogs go skabs yangs par gdan thabs zla gam lta bu bshams pa byas nas/ der yang bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo phal po che'i tshogs de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang /khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas 'di ltar rgyal po zas gtsang dang /lhas byin sdig pa 'dod pa nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal can ma gtogs pa bdud rtsi zas la 0sogs pa shākya bdun khri lnga stong gis bden pa dag mthong bar gyur pa de ltar chos bstan pa mdzad do/ /de na ④srog chags stong phrag mang po kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs 0pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas/ kha cig gis ni lan gcig tsophyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/kha cig gis ni rab tu byung ste nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te 'khor de las phal cher sangs rgyas la gzhol ba dang /chos la 'bab pa dang / dge 'dun la bab tho)par rnam par gzhag par tugemadzad do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ni bdag gi bu 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/6—178

'di ltar mthu che ba yin no snyam du ha cang dga' bas bden pa ma mthong ngo / /lhas byin ni sdig pa 'dod pa dang / nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal gyis bden pa ma mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ci'i phyir rgyal po zas gtsang bden pa mthong bar mi byed snyam du ①dgongs na/ rgyu gnyis kyis bden pa mi mthong ②ste/ sems ha cang mtho ba dang / ha cang zhum pas so/ /de ltar rgyal po zas gtsang gi sems gzhon ②nu don thams cad grub pa sngon cad lha dang mis mchod par gyur na/ da ni mis ④mchod cing lhas mchod par ma gyur to snyam du ha cang zhum par gyur par thugs su chud do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bdag gis rgyal po zas gtsang gdul duba'i phyir lha'i 'khor 'ba' zhig ⑥la chos bstan par bya'o snyam du dgongs shing rig nas 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos nyid ni gal te 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed par ⑦mdzad na ni tha na srog chags grog sbur gyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs sems kyis shes la/ ji ste 'jig rten las 'das pa'i thugs bskyed par mdzad na ni rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs sems kyis mi shes na nyan thos la ⑧sogs pas lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas tshangs pa dang / brgya byin la sogs pa ⑦lha rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ ci'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad snyam ⑩pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rgyal po zas gtsang gdul ba'i slad du lha'i 'khor 'ba' zhig la chos ston pa bzhed ⑩par mthong ngo / /de nas 'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi 'thugs 6—179

sems kyis shes nas/ 'di lta ste/ dper na skyes bu'i lag pa ①bskums pa las rkyong bar byed pa'am/ brkyang ②ba las skum ③par byed pa de bzhin du/'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams lha'i 'jig rten nas mi snang bar gyur te skyed ④mos tshal tshangs pa'i gnas su bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑤spyan sngar lhags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i khang bzangs yisgo bzhi pa sprul pa mdzad ⑦de/ sgo bzhi po dag tu 'jig rten skyong ba ⑧bzhi po dag sgo srungs ⑨su rnam par gzhag par ⑩mdzad do/ /de nas gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 7zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas g.yas phyogs su nye bar brten ④te 'khod do/ /'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyis kyang yibacom ldan 'das la lan gsum ④bskor ba byas te/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas g.yon phyogs su nye bar brten ④te 'khod do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gi kun du spyod pa ni nyin mo lan gsum bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir 'gro'o//de nas rgyal po zas gtsang nang par sngar langs te khang bzangs kyi 8shar sgo ga la ba der song ba dang / yul 'khor srung gis smras pa/ rgyal po chen po tsom 'jug par sdod cig /ci'i phyir bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor 'ba' zhig la chos ston par mdzad pas 'dir mi tsam gyis tsotshod kyis mi chud do/ /bzhin bzangs ⑪khyod su zhig yin/ rgyal po chen po kho bo ni rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung yin no/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang khang bzangs kyi 0lho sgo ga la ba der song ba dang / 'phags skyes pos smras pa/ rgyal po chen po ma 'jug 0par 6—180

sdod cig /ci'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor 'ba' zhig la chos ston par ①mdzad pas 'dir mi tsam gyis ②chod kyis mi chud do/ /bzhin bzangs ③khyod su zhig yin/ rgyal po chen po kho bo ni rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po yin rnal/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang khang bzangs kyi ④nub sgo ga la ba der song ba dang / mig mi bzang gis smras pa/ rgyal po chen po ma 'jug par sdod cig /ci'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor 'ba' zhig la chos ston par mdzad pas 'dir mi tsam gyis phyetshod kyis mi chud do/ /bzhin bzangs khyod su zhig yin / rgyal po chen po kho bo ni rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang yin no/ /de nas rgyal po yizas gtsang khang bzangs kyi ༅byang sgo ga la ba der song ba dang /rnam thos kyi ③bus smras pa/ rgyal po chen po ma 'jug par sdod cig /ci'i phyir / bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor 'ba' zhig la chos ston par mdzad pas 'dir mi 0tsam gyis tshod kyis mi chud do/ /bzhin bzangs khyod su zhig yin/rgyal po chen po kho bo ni rgyal po chen po rnam ⑩thos kyi bu yin no/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang kye ma bdag gis bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor 'ba' zhig la chos ston par mdzad pa mthong na ci ma rung snyam du 'dod pa skyes so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po zas gtsang gi sems thugs kyis mkhyen nas khang bzangs shel gyi rang bzhin du sprul pa skemadzad pa dang / 'di ltar rgyal po zas gtsang gis bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor 'ba' zhig la chos ston pa me long gi gzugs kyi nang na 'dug pa ltar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/su la yang 'di lta ste/ da ltar bdag gi don thams cad grub pa lta bu'i bu med do snyam mo/ /de nas 8rgyal po zas gtsang gi sems kyi rgyud ha cang mtho bar 6—181

gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa de slar bsdu ba mdzad nas rgyal po zas gtsang la chos bstan par brtsam pa mdzad do//de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ci'i phyir rgyal po zas gtsang bden pa mthong bar mi byed snyam du dgongs pa dang ①/ da ltar rgyal po zas gtsang su la yang 'di lta ste/ da ltar bdag gi don thams cad grub pa lta bu'i bu med do snyam du ha cang dga' bas sems kyi rgyud ha cang ②mtho bar gyur par thugs su chud do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ②gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal ④gyi bu khyod kyis rgyal po zas gtsang la soms shig /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ⑤gyi bu chen pos btsun pa bka' ⑥bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas rgyal po zas gtsang ga la ba der song ngo / /rgyal po zas gtsang gis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ⑦gyi bu chen po thag ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di skad ces smras sol/ /btsun pa mod gal bgyi bu tshur gshegs/ btsun pa mod gal 0gyi bu byon pa legs so/ /btsun pa mod gal tho )gyi bu gden bshams pa nyid la bzhugs shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal 0gyi bu chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs dbye ba mdzad pas ting nge 'dzin 'di lta bu la snyoms par zhugs te/ ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag na rang gi stan tshulas mi snang bar gyur cing shar phyogs kyi steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags te/ spyod lam bzhi po 'di lta ste/ 'gro ba dang / 'greng ba dang / 'dug pa dang /nyal ba dag byed do/ /me'i khams la yang snyoms par 'jug ste/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal 0gyi bu chen po me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs pa'i lus las bya'od 6—182

zer sna tshogs 'di lta ste/ sngon po dag dang / ser ①po dag dang / dmar po dag dang / dkar po dag dang / btsod ②ka dag dang / shel dang /dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dag ①byung ngo / /cho 'phrul zung dag kyang rnam par ston te / lus kyi ༷smad nas me 'bar zhing lus kyi stod nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bab par byed do/ /lus kyi ⑤stod nas me 'bar zhing lus kyi smad nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bab par byed do/ /shar phyogs su ji lta ba ⑥bzhin du lho dang nub dang / byang phyogs su'ang de bzhin te/ phyogs bzhir rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi ⑦bzhi bstan nas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba de phyir bsdus te stan bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ⑤gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal 0gyi bu chen po bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ 'di ltar mthu che ba/ gzhan dag kyang mchis sam/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ⑩gyi bu chen pos de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ thub pa'i nyan thos mthu che ba//gsum rig sems kyi rnam grangs shes/ /zag pa zad par gyur pa dang / /dgra rnams bcom pa mang du yod/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das nyag gcig rdzu 'phrul che ba/ mthu che bar ma zad kyi/ 'di ltar nyan thos rnams la yang rdzu 'phrul che ba mthu che ba 7dag yod do snyam nas/ de na ⑩rgyal po zas gtsang gi sems kyi rgyud snyoms par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal 0gyi bu chen pos rgyal po zas gtsang khrid de bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom 6—183

ldan 'das kyis rgyal po zas gtsang gi sems thugs kyis mkhyen cing ①/ bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/'di ltar rgyal po zas gtsang gis stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa de ltar chos bstan pa mdzad do/ /des ②bden pa mthong nas gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcom ldan 'das la brten nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis / lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams ⑤pa dang / mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum④/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas dag dunas ni rkang pa phyung /lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchisaX/ bdag dge bsnyen du gzung ⑦du gsol / deng slan chad nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag pa nas rab tu 6—184

dang bas skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshigs su bcad pa yang gsol pa/ bu pho bzang pos pha la ni/ /lan du phan gdags gang bgyi ba/ /de ni khyod kyis bdag la bgyis / /sems ni mtho ris gzhol bar gyur/ /bu pho bzang pos pha la ni/ /lan du phan gdags gang bgyi ba/ /de ni khyod kyis bdag la bgyis/ /sems ni thar la gzhol bar gyur/ /ngan song dag las legs phyung zhing / /khyod kyis mtho ris thar pa la/ /rab tu 'bad pas bdag bzhag ste/ /khyod kyis dka' ①ba legs par mdzad/ /tshong pas khe spogs rnyed pa ltar/ /mtho ris rnyed pa bdag ②gis rnyed/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la ni/ /nye bar rten ②pa bzang ba lags/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis bden pa mthong nas zas dkar la smras pa/ gzhon nu khyod kyis rgyal srid byed du chug shig /nga ni rgyal po'i drang srong gis tshangs par spyad pa spyod do/ /lha ci'i slad du rgyal srid bgyid du mi stsol/ ngas bden pa dag mthong ngo / /lhas ④nam gzigs/deng nyid do/ /lhas deng nyid gzigs kyi ⑤bdag gis gang gi gdugs la bcom ldan 'das 'dir gshegs pa de yinyid kyi gdugs la bden pa dag mthong ⑦lags so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis bre bo zas dang bdud rtsi zas la smras pa/ gzhon nu gnyis khyed kyis rgyal srid byed du chug shig /nga ni rgyal po'i drang srong gis tshangs par ②spyad pa spyod do/ /ci'i slad du rgyal srid bgyid du mi stsol/ ngas bden pa mthong ngo / /lhas nam gzigs/ deng nyid do/ /lhas deng nyid gzigs kyi ⑨bdag cag gis ches ⑩sngar mthong lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu rnams kyi yibu thu bo gang yin/ gzhon nu bzang ldan lags so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gzhon nu bzang ldan shākya'i rgyal por 6—185

dbang bskur rol/ /de'i tshe na ②bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ nyin gcig mi ②chad par rgyal po'i pho brang du gdugs tshod gsol ba dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis ral pa can las rab tu byung ba dka' thub kyis lus mi sdug par snang ba dag ④mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dag sems ni bzang ba yin na lus mi bzang ste/ dka' thub drag po dag gis lus mi sdug par snang ba dag yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑤'khor ni bcom ldan 'das nyid ci 'dra bar ⑥'khor yang de 'dra ba nyid du gyur na de lta na bcom ldan 'das mdzes par 'gyur ro snyam mo//de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis shākya rnams bsdus te smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa rab tu ma byung bar gyur na cir 'gyur/lha 'khor los sgyur ⑦ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /khyed ②kyi bu dag cir 'gyur/lha zhabs 'bring ⑨bar 'gyur ro/ /'o na da ⑨ gzhon nu don thams cad grub pas bdud rtsi thugs su chud de/ bdud rtsis 'gro ba tshim par mdzad na khyed kyi bu dag ci'i phyir zhabs 'bring ⑩mi byed/ lha ci lags de dag rab tu dbyung ⑫ngam / rab tu phyung shig /lha shākya'i rigs rgyun chad par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos smras 8pa/ khyim re re nas re re rab tu phyung shig /lhas byabaka' stsal pa bzhin 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis shākya gzhon nu rnams kyis 'khyim re re nas re re rab tu dbyung skyabar bya'o zhes dril bsgrags pa byas so/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po zas gtsang gis dril bsgrags pa ⑩de'i tshe na bzang ldan dang ma 'gags 8pa dang / nam gru la yisogs pa shākya'i ⑥gzhon nu lnga brgya rab tu byung ngo / /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya rab tu phyung ⑥ba 6—186

de'i tshe na bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di lta ste/ rigs mthon po las rab tu byung ba ni rnyed pa'i phyir ①dang nye ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas de dag las rnyed pa dang bkur sti chen po byung bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/rigs kyi bu 'di dag gzhan gyi phyir kho nar ②rab tu byung ba yin na/ gzhan kho na la chags so snyam du dgongs nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de dag las ①rnyed pa dang bkur sti stibyung ba gcad par bzhed nas ser skya'i gnas su ci dgyes par bzhugs nas mnyan yod ga la ba der gshegs te/ mthar gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa na mnyan yod du byon nas/ mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal rjomagon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po nyi shu ⑥brgyad pa/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka snga dro sham thabs bgosatso/ lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs ⑧nas/ mthar gyis mnyan yod na bsod snyoms la rgyu ba na/ khyim bdag gi chung ma sbed ma'i khyim ga la ba der song ngo / /khyim bdag gi chung ma sbed mas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka thag ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang brang brdungs te smras pa/ 'char ka ci'i slad du khyod kyis bdag spangs te rab tu byung / 'char gas smras pa/byang chub sems dpas btsun mo grags 'dzin ma dang / sa 'tsho ma dang / ri dgas skyes la ①sogs pa bud med drug khri spangs te rab tu byung ba ni shin tu dka' ba yin gyi rdul gyi rdzab 'dra ba khyod la mi bra tho)ba ci yod/ 'char ka bdag kyang rab tu 'byung yingo / /de ltar gyis shig /khyim gyi bya ba legs par bsdu bar bgyi'o/ /'char ka de der dus chadang mthun pa'i dus su 'ong zhing 6—187

smras pa/ sbed ma rab tu mi 'byung ngam/ sbed mas smras pa/ da dung khyim gyi bya ba legs par ma bsdus so/ /sbed ma dus de tsam gyis ko sa lar byung ba'i khyim gyi bya ba yang legs par bsdus par 'gyur ro/ /'char ka deng legs par bsdus te sang rab tu 'byung ngo / /'char ka 'di snyam du sngon yang bdag ①lhung bzed nag po can rnams kyis zil gyis mnan ②par gyur pas gal te bdag gis dge slong ma rab tu phyung bar gyur na drug sde dag gis dge slong ma rab tu phyung ngo zhes rgya cher zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro snyam du 'gyod pa skyes nas/ de lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te rgyal po'i khab ga la ba der rgyu zhing song nas mthar gyis rgyu zhing 'gro ba na rgyal po'i khab tu phyin nas de rgyal po'i khab tu dbyar gnas par khas blangs te 'dug go/ /sbed ma yang phyi de nyin par khyim gyi bya ba legs par bsdus te rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'ongs nas de dge slong rnams kyi gan du song ste dris pa/ 'phags pa dag de gar mchis/ de su yin/ 'phags pa 'char ku'o/ /de rgyal po'i khab tu song ngo / /sbed mas ngu bar brtsams pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ sbed ma ci'i phyir ngu / 'phags pa 'char ku'i mchid nas khyim gyi bya ba legs par bsdus la mchi shig dang /bdag gis rab tu dbyung ngo zhes mchi nas bdag gis khyim gyi bya ba legs par bsdus te mchis lan de rgyal po'i khab tu mchis pas da ni bdag khyim na gnas pa yang ma lags la/ rab tu byung ba yang ma lags so/ /dge slong rnams kyis de la smras pa/ sbed ma 'char ka byaspu gri'i phyir rgyal po'i khab tu song bas spu gri sar ⑤pas khyod kyi skra 'dreg ⑥par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong ma gso sbyong 'bul ba dag rgyal byed kyi tshal du lhags nas de dag gis 0sbed ma ngu ba mthong nas smras pa/6—188

sbed ma ci'i phyir ngu / 'phags pa 'char ku'i mchid nas khyim gyi bya ba legs par bsdus ①la mchi shig dang / bdag gis rab tu dbyung ngo zhes mchi nas bdag gis khyim gyi bya ba legs par bsdus te mchis na/ de rgyal po'i khab tu mchis pas da ni bdag khyim na gnas pa yang ma lags la rab tu byung ba yang ma lags so/ /g.yengs ②ma dge slong dag su zhig gyidage slong ma rab tu 'byin par byed/ 'di ltar dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong ma rab tu 'byin par byed kyis tshur shog④ /'phags ma skye dgu'i ⑤bdag mo chen mo gi ta sbris ⑥khyod rab tu 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis de skye dgu'i ⑦bdag mo chen mo gi ta sbi'i ⑧gan du khrid nas smras pa/ 'phags ma khyim bdag gi mchis 'brang 0sbed ma 'di rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal lo/ /skye dgu'i ⑩bdag mo chen mo gi ta sbos ༅de rab tu phyung rdzogs par bsnyen par byas so/ /'char ka 'di snyam du bdag gis lhung bzed nag po can rnams rjes su srung 8bas khyim bdag gi chung ma sbed ma tsorab tu ma phyung bas rgya cang dang / lcag pod dang / shur bu dang / shur bu phre'u dag gi bar chad kyang byas la/ de yang lhung bzed nag po can 'ga' zhig gis rab tu phyung bar gyur na de dang phrad tsodu yang mi ster ro snyam du 'gyod 0pa skyes nas de mi dga' bzhin du dbyar gnas par khas blangs so/ /mnyan yod na rgan zhugs shig mi dga' bzhin du dbyar gnas par khas blangs pa des lhung bzed dang chos gos mchan khung du bcug ste dgag dbye byas pa na dgag dbye legs par byas so/ /dgag dbye shin tu byas so zhes de rgyal po'i khab ga la ba der song ste/ mthar gyis rgyu zhing 'gro ba na rgyal po'i khab tu phyin pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka gtsug lag khang gi sgo na lam la 6—189

rnam par lta zhing 'dug pa des thag ring po kho na nas rgan zhugs mgo spra ba'i me tog ltar skya ba/ smin ma 'phyang ba zhig 'ong ba de mthong nas 'char kus bsams pa/ dge slong 'ong ba 'di gnas brtan gang yin pa su'o ⑨snyam nas/des smras pa/ gnas brtan byon pa legs so/ /byon pa legs so phyag 'tshal lo / /des smras pa/ slob dpon phyag 'tshal lo/ /'char gas 'di ni rgan zhugs shig ste/ slob dpon yang mi shes/ mkhan po yang mi shes pa zhig go snyam du shes nas 'char gas de gtsug lag khang du 'jug tu ②bcug ste smras pa/rgan zhugs khyod ga las 'ongs/ des ②smras pa/ mnyan yod nas so/ /'char gas bsams pa/ gal te dang po kho nar sbed ma'i gtam dris na 'phya rjobar 'gyur bas 'di ltar snga phyir byas te dri bar bya'o snyam nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa ji lta ⑤bcom ldan 'das gnod pa ༅chung ba dang / nyam nga ba chung ba dang / bde ba dang / snyun mi mnga' ba dang / stobs dang ldan par mnyan yod du dbyar gnas par zhal gyis bzhes sam/ btsun pa 'char ka de bzhin te/bcom ldan 'das gnod pa chung ba dang / nyam nga ba chung ba dang / bde ba dang / snyun mi mnga' ba dang / stobs dang ldan par mnyan yod du dbyar gnas par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ji lta ⑦dge slong gi dge 'dun dang / dge slong ma'i dge 'dun dang / dge bsnyen gyi 'khor dang / dge bsnyen ma'i 'khor gnod pa chung ba dang / nyam nga ba chung ba dang / bde ba dang / nad med pa dang / stobs dang ldan par ⑧mnyan yod na gnas sam/ston pa la lta ⑨bar 'dod dam/ dam pa'i chos nyan par 'dod dam/ btsun pa 'char ka de bzhin te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang / dge slong ma'i dge 6—190

'dun dang / dge bsnyen gyi 'khor dang / dge bsnyen ma'i 'khor gnod pa chung ba dang / nyam nga ba chung ba dang / bde ba dang / nad med pa dang /stobs dang ldan par mnyan yod na gnas shing / ston pa la blta ①bar 'dod pa dang / dam pa'i chos nyan par 'dod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa ji lta ②gnas brtan kun shes kau ṇ+ḍi n+ya chadang / gnas brtan 'od srung chen po dang / gnas brtan shā ri'i bu dang ④/ gnas brtan mod gal ⑤gyi bu chen po dang /gzhan yang dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan dag gnod pa chung ba dang /nyam nga ba chung ba dang / bde ba dang / nad med pa dang / stobs dang ldan par mnyan yod na gnas sam/ btsun pa 'char ka de ⑥bzhin te/ gnod pa chung ba dang / nyam nga ba chung ba dang / bde ba dang / nad med pa dang / stobs dang ldan par mnyan yod na gnas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ji lta ko ⑦sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / bla mkhyen drang srong byin dang / rnying pa dang / khyim bdag gi chung ma ri dgas 'dzin gyi dum sa ga dang / legs skyes dag shes sam/ btsun pa 'char ka de bzhin te shes so//tshe dang ldan pa 'o na khyod kyis khyim bdag gi chung ma sbed ma shes sam/ btsun pa 'char ka shes te de ni btsun pa 'char ku'i sngon gyi chung ma yin no/ /rgan zhugs gtam shes so/ /de da dung yang khyod kyi 0khyim bdag gi chung ma yin snyam mamatshul/ de ni rab tu byung ngo / /sus rab tu phyung / skye dgu'i yibadag mo chen mo gi ta sbos tsoso/ /'char gas bsams pa/ da dung spyod yul lhag ma dang bcas pa yin no snyam nas smras pa/ rgan zhugs tshur shog /rkang pa dag khrus shig ces des de la rkang pa bsku ⑩ba dang / lag pa bsku ba mang po byin 6—191

nas des de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos ya gad btsugs te ②zung mthon po la bzhag nas smras pa/ rgan zhugs gtsug lag khang 'di ni zas dang bcas pa/rnyed pa dang bcas pa yin gyis ②gtsug lag khang 'dir mngon par dga' bar gyis shig /des smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka bdag ni mchod rten la phyag 'tshal du 'ongs te 'gro ba yin pas bdag gnas 'di mi 'dod do/ /'char kus de'i mdun du sgo lcags dang lde mig kyog ①po dag bzhag ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis gtsug lag khang gnas pa dang bcas par bya'i mi gnas par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal to ④zhes smras nas mig lam du mi snang bar song ste/ de mthar gyis rgyu zhing 'gro ba na mnyan yod du phyin nas 'char gas rang gi gtsug lag khang chag chag btab/ legs par byugs / lci ba sar ⑤pa'i byug pas byugs te sgo bcad nas khri'i ⑥steng na phyi gan ⑦du nyal zhing skad kyi gdangs kyis kha ton byed cing 'dug go/ /dge slong ma 'dun pa 'bul ba dag lhags nas de dag gis de'i skad kyi gdangs thos ⑧nas de dag gis de la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ 'phags pa 'char ka khyod ⑨gar bzhud tsobazhud/ 'char kus smras pa/ rgyal po'i khab tu'o/ /de dag dbyar khang du dong nas sbed ma la smras pa/ sbed ma dga' ba skyed cig /khyod kyi slob dpon 'ongs so/ /kho mo'i slob dpon gang / 'char ku'o/ /de ji ltar kho mo'i slob dpon/ ci kho mos de'i gan nas bklags sam/ g.yengs ⑩ma khyod kyis mi shes kyis tsodage slong ma rnams ni dge slong la rag mang du las kyis ⑫khyod song la ltos shig /sbed mas nas kyi ngar phye dang khrus kyi chal dang /'bru mar thogs te 'char ku'i gtsug lag khang du song nas sbed mas 'char ma'i 6—192

gtsug lag khang gi sgo brdungs ①pa dang / 'char gas smras pa/ de su yin/sbed mas smras pa/ bdag sbed ②ma'o/ /khyim bdag gi chung ma sbed ma 'ongs pa legs so/ /bdag da dung yang khyod kyi rgyakhyim bdag gi chung ma lags sam/'o na ci yin/ bdag rab tu byung ngo / /khyod sus rab tu phyung / 'phags ma skye dgu'i ④bdag mo chen mo gau ta smis ⑤so/ /kho bo re zhig bya ba de lta bu zhig byung nas de'i phyir kho bo rgyal po'i khab tu song na khyod la brtad pa ci byung na de'i phyir khyod rab tu byung / khyod kyi zhal nas khyim gyi bya ba legs par bsdus rjol shog shig dang / kho bos khyod ⑦rab tu dbyung ngo zhes gsungs dunas/bdag gis khyim gyi bya ba legs par bsdus te mchis na khyod rgyal po'i khab tu bzhud de/ gal khyate bdag 'phags mas rab tu ma phyung ⑩du lags na bdag khyim na gnas pa 0yang ma lags la rab tu byung ba yang ma lags par 'gyur ro/ /'char kus smras pa/ sbed mas 4)ci kho bo bdag nyid kyi lag ngar la sos 'debs par 'byed dam/ skye dgu'i ④bdag mo chen mo gi ta sbos tsorab tu phyung yang rung / kho bos rab tu phyung yang rung ste legs kyis yinang du zhugs shig dang chos bstan par bya'o/ /sbed mas 'char ku'i rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te chos mnyan pa'i phyir mdun du 'dug go/ /des de la chos bstan par brtsams te/ des de la ji tsam pa de tsam du chos bstan nas sngon gyi bgad pa dang / dga' bar byas pa dang / rtses pa dang / dga' mgur spyad pa dran par bya bar brtsams te/ sbed ma bdag cag gnyis kyis skyed ༅mos tshal dang /'dun sa dang / lha'i gnas ga ge mo zhig tu zas 'di dang 'di lta bu zos pa dang / bca' ba 'di dang 'di lta bu 'chos pa dang / btung ba 'di dang 6—193

'di lta bu 'thungs pa gang yin pa de dran nam zhes smras pa dang 'char ka kun du chags par gyur to/ /ji lta ji ltar ②chags par gyur pa de lta de ltar dral to/ /bud med kyi yul mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can la la la ma 'dres pa'i chos lnga yod de/lnga gang zhe na/ skyes pa chags par gyur pa ⑤shes shing chags pa dang bral ba shes pa dang / dus shes shing zla mtshan shes pa dang / mngal na gnas pa zhugs ③pa shes pa dang / gang las mngal na gnas pa zhugs pa de shes pa dang /khye'u shes shing bu mo shes pa ste/ gal te khye'u yin na dku g.yas par brten ④cing 'dug la/ gal te bu mo yin na dku g.yon par brten cing ⑤'dug pa'o༅//sbed ma des 'char ka de ⑦chags so snyam du shes nas sbed mas smras pa/ slad rol du mchis te slar mchi'o/ /'char gas ⑧bsams pa/ 'di bshang ⑨ba byed 'dod dam/ gci ba byed 'dod gor ma chag ⑨ snyam nas des ⑨smras pa/song shig /sbed ma phyir byung nas shi nga tsodapung bcad tsobardzes te rgyug ④par brtsams pa dang / 'char ka de sgra la mkhas pa yin pas des 8de'i sgra thos nas des 4)de'i phyi bzhin du byung ste/ dge stong ma mgo reg mo gar 'bros zhes de de'i phyi bzhin rgyug ⑩par brtsams pa dang / de la brla'i reg 8pas khu ba byung nas de kun nas dkris ⑥pa dang bral te glang po che chags pa dang bral ba bzhin du gzhi de snodag nyid na 'dug go/ /sbed mas de kun nas dkris 0pa dang bral zhing 'phyir log pa mthong nas 'di kun nas dkris 0pa dang bral lo snyam du rig nas drung du song ste tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa gal te bdag gis dang du blangs par gyur na bdag kyang dge slong mar mi rung ba nyid du 'gyur la/ khyod kyang dge slong du mi rung ba nyid du 6—194

'gyur ro/ /sring mo bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang bdag nyid srung na gzhan sung bar byed la/ gzhan srung na bdag nyid srung bar byed do zhes ①legs par gsungs so/ /ji ltar bdag nyid srung na gzhan srung ②bar byed ce na/ sten par byed pa dang / goms par byed pa dang / lan mang du byed pa dang /rjes su srung bar byed pa dang / reg par byed pa dang / mngon sum du byed pa ste/ de ltar bdag nyid srung na gzhan srung bar byed do/ /ji ltar gzhan srung na bdag nyid srung bar byed ce na/ tho mi 'tshams ②pa dang / mi gshe ba dang / mi 'tshe ba dang / rjes su brtse ba dang / rjes su snying brtse ba dang /byams pa'i sems kyis te/ de ltar gzhan srung ④na bdag nyid sung bar byed do//'phags pa sham thabs 'di tshur stsol bkru bar bgyi'o/ /'char gas sham thabs de sbed ma la byin no/ /sbed mas khu ba de mthong nas 'gyod pa skyes te/bdag gi ④lus kyi phyogs btsun pa 'char kus sngon ma mthong ba'am sngon ma mnams ⑥pa'am/ sngon ma byugs pa ci zhig yod na bdag gis dang du ma blangs pa ni ma legs pa zhig byas so snyam du 'gyod pa skyes so/ /sbed ma ⑦de ltar rnam par rtog pa na de kun du chags shing dral bar gyur pa'i sems kyis khu ba de rang gi mngal gyi sgor ②blugs so/ /sems can rnams kyi ⑨las kyi rnam par smin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas de la sems can zhugs par gyur to/ /de dge slong ma rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ sbed ma kho mo cag go ⑩khyod chos bzang po'i chos kyis 'phags pa 'char ku'i gan du 'gro bar sems kyi kho mo cag gis des khyod gnas skabs 'di lta bur byas par mi sems so/ /sbed mas smras pa/ phu nu mo dag dge slong de ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin te/ gang 6—195

tshun chad rab tu byung nas des kho mo la sngan ②chad lan 'ga' yang lag gis kyang ma byugs so/ /de dag gis smras pa/ ma byugs na yang des khyod gnas skabs 'di 'dra bar byas na/ gal te byugs na des khyod gnas skabs ji lta bur ②byas par 'gyur zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams la brjod do/ /dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong ma de ni pham par ma gyur gyis ②'di ltar phyogs dben par bzhag ste bsod snyoms kyis brel ba med pa ④gyis shig dang / bu gzhon nu 'od srung zhes bya ba btsa' bar 'gyur zhing nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur te 'di lta ste/ dge slong gzhon nu 'od srung de ni nga'i gtam sna tshogs dang / gtam snyan pa dang / spobs pa dge ba can rnams kyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/dge slong rnams kyi 'anyes dmigs byung ba yigang yin pa de ni dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la gos rnying ⑦pa 'khrur 'jud pa las gyur pa yin no snyam du dgongs nas / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dubyung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang /skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la 0sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la gos rnying ⑩pa 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'chag tu 'jud na spang ⑪ba'i ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni ⑩'char ku'am gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /dge slong ma zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa'o/ /nye du ma 6—196

yin pa la zhes bya ba ni phyi mo dang / mes po dang ①/ phrugs las brten ②pa'i bdun pa tshun chad ni nye du yin la de phan cad ②ni nye du ma yin no/ /gos zhes bya ba ni bdun ④po bal gos dang / sha na'i ②gos dang / zar ma'i gos dang /du gu la'i gos dang / ras bal gyi gos dang / ko ⑥tam pa'i gos dang /nyi 'og gi gos dag las gang yang rung ba'o/ /rnying pa zhes bya ba ni dus tshigs gsum po dag las dus tshigs gang yang rung bar spyad pa gang yin pa'o/ /'khrur 'jud dam zhes bya ba ni tha na chur snyug pa ⑦byed du 'jud na'o/ /'tshed du 'jud dam zhes bya ba ni tha na tshon du snyug pa ⑤byed du 'jud na'o/ /'chag tu 'jud dam zhes bya ba ni tha na thal mos rdebs ⑨par byed du 'jud na'o / /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste des cin spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la nye du ma yin par 'du shes pas gos rnying pa 'khrur 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'tshed du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'chag tu 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang (7'chag tu 'jud dam/'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'chag tu 'jud dam / 'chag tu 'jud ⑩pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'chag tu 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud pa dang ⑫/'chag tu 'jud na ④spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la yid gnyis za bas gos rnying pa 'khrur 'jud tson spang ba'i 6—197

ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'tshed du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'chag tu 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'chag tu 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'chag tu 'jud dam/'chag tu 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'chag tu 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud pa dang / 'chag tu 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du la ①nye du ma yin par 'du shes pas gos rnying pa 'khrur 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro//'tshed du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'chag tu 'jud na yang ②nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'chag tu 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'chag tu 'jud dam/ 'chag tu 'jud pa dang ③'khrur 'jud dam/ 'chag tu 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud pa dang / 'chag tu 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur rol/ /dge slong gis ④dge slong ma nye du la yid gnyis za bas gos rnying pa 'khrur 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'tshed du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur rol/ /'chag tu 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'chag tu 'jud dam/ 'tshed ⑤du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'chag tu 'jud dam/'chag tu 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'chag tu 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ du'akhrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud pa dang / 'chag tu 6—198

'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang /sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan ①'das kyis dge slong dag 'di lta ste/ rigs mthon po las rab tu byung ba 'di ni rnyed pa rnams kyi phyed dang nye ba yin no/ /zhes bka' stsal pas ②de na yang shākya'i khyim nas rab tu byung ba de dag la rnyed pa dang bkur ste ②chen po byung nas de dag shin tu gos kyis ⑤chab la sbyor ba'i rjes su brtson par ⑤gnas shing / lhung bzed dang /chos gos dang / dra ba dang / phor bu dang / ska rags lhag pa dag kyang 'chang bar byed pas bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la dus dang dus su chos bstan kyang ⑥de dag gis bden pa dag ma ⑦mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das ⑧'di snyam du dgongs te/ ci'i phyir shākya rab tu byung ba dag bden pa dag mthong bar mi byed snyam du dgongs nas ⑨de dag shin tu gos kyis chab la sbyor ba'i rjes su brtson par gnas shing de dag lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang / dra ba dang / phor bu dang / ska rags lhag pa dag 'chang ba'i phyir te/gal te ngas shākya rab tu byung ba rnams la smad na dbral dka' bar 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gdul ba la ⑩mkhas pa bla na med pa yin pas de na ⑩bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da zla ba gsum po 'di la nang du yang dag 'jog bzhed kyis(spre / nga'i spyan sngar dge slong bsod snyoms stobs pa gcig (sredang /'di nyid kyi gso sbyong bcwa 8lnga pa'i tshe ma gtogs par dge slong gang gis kyang nye 6—199
