pa dang / kha ton dang / rnal ①'byor dang / yid ②la bya ba dang / nang gi sems kyi zhi gnas kyang gtong bar byed/ lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig 'dod pa dang / lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi don nyid ①du du'ongs pa dag bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams la yang dang yang rjodu rig par byed nas/ dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i nyaphyir/ dge slong dag lug gi bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi stan sar pa byed pa dang / byed du 'jud deX/ dge slong dag lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi stan sar pa byed pa dang / byed du 'jud pa na lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig dkon zhing rin che bas bya ba mang ba dang / byed pa mang bar gyur cing / lung mnod ⑧pa dang / bklag ⑨pa dang / kha ton dang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba dang / nang gi sems kyi zhi gnas kyang gtong bar byed/ lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig 'dod pa dang /lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi don nyid ⑩du 'ongs pa dag bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams la yang dang yang du rig par byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ⑪ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang /gleng gzhi tso'adi dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs 8pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs rdzipa yang snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la rmas 8pa/dge slong dag khyed tshulug bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi stan sar pa byed pa bden nam / btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod pa che 6—300

ba dang / chog mi shes pa dang / gso dka' ba dang / dgang dka' ①ba rnam par smad par lamadzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod pa chung ba dang / chog shes pa dang / gso sla ②ba dang / dgang sla ①ba dang /phri ba dang / yo byad bsnyungs pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / mdzes pa dang / drod rig pa nyid kyi bsngags pa brjod nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas/ 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi rjobaslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste/ zhes bya ba la sogs ༷pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi stan sar pa ⑦byed na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa'o/ /lug bal zhes bya ba ni lug gi bal lo/ /nag po 'ba' zhig gi zhes bya ba ni nag po bzhi ste/ rang bzhin gyis gnag ⑧pa dang / sngo bas gnag ⑨pa dang / 'dam kha dang / kham pa'o / /stan zhes bya ⑩ni stan gnyis te/ nang tshangs can dang / rlings pa steyi / don 'dir ni rlings ④pa yin par dgongs so/ /sar pa zhes bya ba ni sar pa gnyis te/ gsar pas sar pa dang / rnyed pas sar pa ⑩ste/ don 'dir ni gsar pas sar pa yin par dgongs so/ /byed na zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid kyis sam/ gzhan byed du 'jud na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /zhes gsungs (sreso/ /de la ltung bar 'ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ chun po dang / 'da' ba dang / phung po las te/ dge slong 6—301

gis ①lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig dag gi chun po 'byed par byed/ 'jig par byed/ rmel bar byed cing ji srid du stan mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ stan byas zin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig dag gi 'da' ba 'byed par byed/ 'jig par byed / rmel bar byed cing ji srid du stan mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ stan byas zin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig dag gi ②phung po 'byed par byed/ 'jig par byed/rmel bar byed cing ji srid du stan mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/stan byas zin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig dag ②gi chun po dang / 'da' ba dang / chun po dang /phung po dang / 'da' ba dang / chun po dang / 'da' ba dang / phung po dang / phung po dang / chun po dang / phung po dang / 'da' ba dang /chun po dang / 'da' ba dang / phung po 'byed par byed/ 'jig par byed rmel bar byed cing ji srid du stan mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/stan byas zin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /byas zin pa rnyed pa dang /byas zin pa la yongs su longs spyod pa dang / rnyed ④pa mngon par 'du byed pa la ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi spang ba ste bcu gnyis pa rdzogs sto༅// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan ⑥'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med 6—302

zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis lug gi ①bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi stan sar pa mi bya'o zhes gsungs pas/de dag bal dkar po dang / mkhob ②bal cung zhig bcug nas lug gi bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi stan sar pa byed pa dang / byed du 'jud de / des kyang de dag bya ba mang ba dang / byed pa mang bar gyur cing lung mnod ④pa dang / bklag ①pa dang / kha ton dang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba dang / nang gi dusems kyi zhi gnas kyang gtong bar byed doX/ /de 'dod pa dang / de'i don nyid ⑧du 'ongs pa dag bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams la yang dang yang du rig par byed nas/ dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag bal dkar po dang / mkhob bal cung zhig bcug nas lug gi ⑨bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi stan sar pa byed pa dang / byed du 'jud de/des kyang ⑩bya ba mang ba dang ⑩/ byed pa mang bar gyur cing / lung mnod ④pa dang / bklag 0pa dang / kha ton dang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba dang / nang gi sems kyi zhi gnas kyang gtong bar byed/ de 'dod pa dang /de'i don nyid du 'ongs pa dag bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams la yang dang yang du rig par byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka tsogatong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis 8bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang /skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do/ /zhes bya ba la 8sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste/ zhes bya ba la 0sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs 6—303

rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la rmas ①pa/ dge slong dag khyed cag ②ngas dge slong gis lug gi bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi stan sar pa mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas bal dkar po dang / mkhob bal cung zhig bcug nas lug gi bal nag po 'ba' zhig gi stan sar pa byed pa dang / byed du 'jud ①pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod pa che ba dang / chog mi shes pa dang / gso dka' ba dang / dgang dka' ba rnam par smad pa ④mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'dod pa chung ba dang / chog shes pa dang / gso sla ⑤ba dang / dgang sla ⑥ba dang /phreng ⑦ba dang / yo byad bsnyungs pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang /mdzes pa dang / drod rig pa nyid kyi bsngags pa brjod nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya 0ste/zhes bya ba la 0sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong gis stan sar pa byed na cha gnyis ni lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig las gzhug par bya/ gsum pa ni dkar po las/ bzhi pa ni mkhob bal las gzhug par bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gis cha gnyis lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig las ma bcug ⑩gam/ gsum pa ni yidakar po las/ bzhi pa ni 'amakhob bal las ma bcug tshupar stan sar pa byed na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /dge slong gis zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pas so/ /stan zhes bya ba ni stan gnyis te/ nang tshangs can dang / rlings 8pa ste/don 'dir ni rlings pa tsoyin par dgongs so/ /sar pa zhes bya ba ni sar pa 6—304

gnyis te①/ gsar pas sar pa dang / rnyed pas sar pa ste/ don 'dir ni gsar pas sar pa yin par ②dgongs so/ /byed na zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid kyis sam/ gzhan byed du 'jud na'o/ /cha gnyis ni ③lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig las gzhug par bya zhes bya ba la/ lug bal zhes bya ba ni lug gi ④bal lo/ /nag po 'ba' zhig ces bya ba ni nag po bzhi ste/ rang bzhin gyis gnag ༷pa dang / sngo bas gnag ⑥pa dang / 'dam kha ⑦dang / kham pa'o/ /gsum pa ni dkar po las zhes bya ba las dudakar po zhes bya ba ni glo'i bal dang /rgyab kyi bal dang / gnya' ba'i bal lo/ /bzhi pa ni mkhob bal las gzhug par bya'o zhes bya ba ⑨la/ mkhob bal zhes bya ba ni rkang pa'i bal dang /mgo'i bal dang / lto'i bal lo/ /ma bcug ces bya ba ni ma bsres par ro/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar ⑩ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis stan srang bcu pa byed na de 0lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig las spong lnga dang / dkar po las sung 'phyed dang gsum dang / mkhob bal las 8srang phyed dang gsum gzhug par bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gis cha gnyis lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig las ma bcug 8gam/ gsum pa dkar po las/ bzhi pa mkhob bal las ma bcug 8par stan sar pa byed na stan zin na spang ba'i lhung byed du 'gyur ro/ /srang bcu pa ji lta ba de bzhin du dge slong gis stan sung nyi shu pa dang / sung sum bcu pa dang / srang bzhi bcu pa tsodang / srang lnga bcu pa byed na des lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig las sung nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / dkar po las srang 6—305

phyed dang bcu gsum dang / mkhob bal las srang phyed dang bcu gsum gzhug par bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gis cha gnyis lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig las ma bcug gamanya/ gsum pa dkar po las bzhi pa mkhob ②bal las ma bcug par stan sar pa byed na/ stan zin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dkar po dang / mkhob bal las sung gcig gam/ sung phyed phri ste/ lug bal nag po 'ba' zhig las stan sar pa byed na thams cad du spang ②ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /nag po 'ba' zhig mod pa dang / rin mnyam pa dang / dkar po dang / mkhob ④bal dkon pa dang / rin che bar gyur na ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag ⑤gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /cha gnyis bsres pa'i spang ba ⑥ste bcu gsum pa rdzogs stol// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyam ②yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong rnams la stan mang ba nyid 'di lta bu 'di byung bar gyur te/ de dag stan 'di ni ha cang rings so0/ /'di ni ha cang thungs so yi zhes de bor nas gzhan byed du 'jud do0/ /stan 'di ni ⑩ha cang dog go/ /'di ni ha cang yangs so /'di ni thams cad kyi thams cad du bug rdol dang / sha zad pa dang / bcos dka' 6)ba nyid yin no zhes de bor nas gzhan byed du 'jud 0pas/ dge slong de dag stan byas shing byas shing 'dor ba na bya ba mang ba dang / byed pa mang bar gyur cing / lung mnod 8pa dang / bklag ⑩pa dang / kha ton 6—306

dang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba dang / nang gi sems kyi zhi gnas gtong bar byed nas/ dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir/ dge slong rnams la stan mang ba nyid 'di lta bu 'di ①byung bar gyur te/ 'di dag stan 'di ni ha cang rings sol/ /'di ni ha cang thungs sol/ /zhes de bor nas gzhan byed du 'jud/ stan 'di ni ha cang dog go/ /'di ni ha cang yangs so//'di ni thams cad kyi ༷thams cad du bug rdol dang / sha zad pa dang /bcos dka' ⑤ba nyid yin no/ /zhes de bor nas gzhan byed du 'jud pas/dge slong 'di dag stan byas shing stan 0byas shing 'dor ba na bya ba mang ba dang /byed pa mang bar gyur cing / lung mnod ⑦pa dang / bklag ⑧pa dang / kha ton dang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba dang / nang gi sems kyi zhi gnas gtong bar byed ces 0smod par byed/ kha zer bar byed/ phyar ka ⑩gtong bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang ⑪/skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs 8pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs 8pa yang snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la rmas 0pa/ dge slong dag khyed la stan mang ba nyid 'di lta bu 'di byung bar gyur te/ khyed cag stan 'di ni ha cang rings sobya/ /'di ni ha cang thungs so ⑩zhes de bor nas gzhan byed du 'jud / stan ⑩'di ni ha cang dog go/ /'di ni ha cang yangs so 'di ni thams cad kyi thams cad du bug rdol dang / sha zad pa dang / bcos 6—307

dka' ba ①dag nyid yin no/ /zhes de bor nas gzhan byed du 'jud pa bden nam / btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod pa che ba dang / chog mi shes pa dang / gso dka' ba dang / dgang dka' ba rnam par smad par ②mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod pa chung ba dang / chog shes pa dang / gso sla ①ba dang / dgang sla dub dang /phri ba dang / yo byad bsnyungs pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / mdzes pa dang / drod rig pa nyid kyi bsngags pa brjod nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' lastsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas/ 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la ༷sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong gis stan sar pa byed na mi 'dod bzhin du lo ༅drug tu bcang bar bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gis lo drug tshun chad du stan rnying pa de spangs kyang rung / ma spangs kyang rung stan sar pa gzhan byed na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'brog gnas na 'brog gi nags ⑧na bzhugs so/ /'brog gnas grang zhing rlung che bas dge slong lag gi bla dag lo drug tu stan gyis mi ⑨thub pa de dag grang ba dag gis las sar pa dag rgyun bcad par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das (sprernams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste/mkhyen bzhin du rmed pa/ mkhyen kyang mi rmed pa/ dus su rmed pa/ dus las yol bar yimi rmed pa/ don dang ldan par tshurmed pa/ don dang mi ldan 6—308

par ①mi rmed pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni don dang mi ldan par rgyarmed pa ③la chu lon gyis zlog pa ༷mdzad pa yin no/ /de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 0ni don dang ldan par ༷rmed pa la dus mkhyen pa yin pas / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la rmas ⑦pa / kun dga' bo ci'i phyir dge slong lag gi bla dag gis ⑧las sar pa dag rgyun bcad par gyur/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di ltar dge slong gis stan sar pa byed na mi 'dod bzhin du lo drug tu bcang bar bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gis lo drug tshun chad du stan rnying pa de spangs ①kyang rung / ma spangs kyang rung / stan sar pa gzhan byed na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /zhes 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ⑩bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba mdzad pas/ dge slong lag gi bla dag dgung lo drug gi bar du stan gyis yimi thub pa de dag grang ba dag gis las sar pa dag 8rgyun bkum par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong lag gi bla gang la lo drug tu stan gyis mi thub pa'i dge slong des dge 'dun las lo drug tshun chad du stan gyi gnang ba gsol bar 0bya'o/ /'di ltar gsol bar bya ste/ gnas mal bsham 8pa byas nas gaṇ+ḍi 8brdungs te dris pa'i tshig tshugis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo nas / dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur tshul/ dge slong lag gi bla des bla 'gos phrag pa gcig tu byas te/ rgan rims kyis ⑩phyag 'tshal nas/ rgan pa'i mtha' logs su tsog pur 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol / bdag dge slong lag gi bla ming 'di zhes bgyi ba lo drug tu stan mi 6—309

bgyid pa las/ bdag dge slong lag gi bla ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun las lo drug tshun chad du stan gnang ba gsol na thugs brtse ①ba can/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag dge slong lag gi bla ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la lo ②drug tshun chad du stan gnang ba stsal du gsol/ de bzhin du rgyalan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas te gsol bar bya'o/ /dudage slong de dag gis dge slong lag gi bla de la dad pa'am/ yid ches pas 'gro bar mi bya bar dge 'dun thams cad der 'dong bar ⑤bya ba'am/ dge 'dun gyis bskos pa'i dge slong dag btang dubar bya zhing de dag ④stan de rang gi mig sngar bab ⑧par bya ba'am/ yang na stan de dge 'dun gyi dbus su dbyung bar bya ste/gal te stan de ha cang ring ba yin na de dag gis bcad ⑨par bya'o/ / gal te ha cang thung ba yin na bal sbyin par bya'o⑩/ /gal te ha cang yangs pa yin na de dag gis bcad yipar bya'o/ /gal te ha cang dog pa yin na bal sbyin par bya'o / /gal te ral ba dang rdol ba yin na bal sbyin par bya'o/ /gal te thams cad kyis tho)thams cad du bug rdol ba 'dang / sha zad pa dang /bcos dka' ba nyid yin na de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig ④gis gsol ba bya ste ⑫las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong lag gi bla ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di lo drug tu stan mi bgyid pa las dge slong lag gi bla ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun las lo drug tshun chad du stan gnang bar ⑫gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ⑩dus la bab cing bzod tson dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong lag gi bla ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la lo drug tshun chad du stan gnang ba stsol 7to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o//6—310

las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong lag gi bla ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di lo drug tu stan mi ①bgyid pa las dge slong lag gi bla ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun las lo drug tshun chad du ②stan gnang bar gsol te/③ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong lag gi bla ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la lo drug tshun chad du stan gnang ba stsol na④/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong lag gi bla ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ⑤'di la lo drug tshun chad du stan gnang bar ⑥stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung ④shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ⑧shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong lag gi bla ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la lo drug tshun chad du stan gnang ba stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun gyis dge slong lag gi bla gang la lo drug tshun chad du stan gnang ba byin pa des 0lo drug tshun chad du stan byed du gzhug ⑩ste 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa 'dod pa dang / bslab pa la gus pa dang / bslab pa la yo byad bsnyungs pa'i bsngags pa brjod de/ dge slong rnams la yang de dang mthun pa dang / de'i shas che ba dang / de dang 'tsham pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid mdzad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na snga ma ni bcas pa yin la 'di ni gnang ba yin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong gis stan sar pa byed na mi 'dod bzhin du lo drug tu bcang bar bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gis lo drug tshun chad du stan rnying pa de spangs kyang rung / ma spangs kyang rung / stan sar pa 6—311

gzhan byed na dge 'dun gyis gnang ba ma gtogs te spang ①ba'i ltung byed do/ /dge slong gis zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pas so/ /stan zhes bya ba ni stan gnyis te / nang tshangs can dang / rlings pa stergya/ don 'dir ni rlings ⑧pa yin par dgongs so/ /sar pa zhes bya ba ni sar pa gnyis te/ gsar pas sar pa dang / rnyed pas sar pa ste/ don 'dir ni gsar pas sar pa yin par dgongs so/ /byed na zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid kyis sam/ gzhan byed du 'jud na'odu/ /mi 'dod bzhin du lo drug tu bcang bar bya'o zhes bya ba ni lo drug gi mtha' ⑤mun chad du bcang bar bya ba'oX/ /gal te dge slong gis lo drug tshun chad du zhes bya ba ni de'i mtha' 3tshun chad dol/ /stan rnying pa ⑨zhes bya ba ni stan gang yod pa ⑨ de'o/ /spangs kyang rung / ma spangs 0kyang ru( stan sar pa gzhan byed na zhes bya ba ni gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun gyis gnang ba ma gtogs so ⑩zhes bya ba ni dge 'dun gyis gnang ba bzhag ste'o8/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ④ste/ des na spang tsoba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe ⑩na/ /bar sdom la/ gnyis brtsams phyi ma zin pa dang / /gnyis brtsams snga ma zin pa dang / /gnyis 0zin nas ni tsogacig spong dang / / gnyis ka ⑥brtsams te gtong ba dang / /lo drug pa la nyes med pa/ /de ni stan gyi chabasdu ba yin/ /dge slong gis lo ⑥gang la stan rtsom par byed pa'i lo de nyid la stan phyoganyis pa rtsom par byed na gnyis pa rtsom pa de la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ byas zin na yang nyes byas su 'gyur rol/ /snga ma la ni ltung ba med do/ /lo de nyid la stan gnyis pa mi rtsom 6—312

yang lo gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lo lnga pa la stan gnyis pa rtsom par byed na gnyis pa rtsom pa de la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ byas zin na yang nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ / snga ma la ni ①lhung ba med do/ /dge slong gis lo gang la stan rtsom par ②byed pa'i lo de nyid la stan gnyis pa brtsams nas snga ma zin par byed na gnyis pa rtsom pa de la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ byas zin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /lo de nyid la stan gnyis pa brtsams ⑧nas zin par mi byed kyang lo ④gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang /lnga pa la stan gnyis pa brtsams nas snga ma zin par byed na de rtsom ⑤pa nyal nyes byas su 'gyur la/ byas zin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis lo gang la stan byas pa'i lo de nyid la stan gnyis pa yang byas nas des snga ma shos byin gyis brlabs te ⑦phyi ma shos gtong bar byed dam/ phyi ma shos bzhag ⑧ste snga ma shos gtong bar byed na gnyis pa rtsom pa de la nyes byas su 'gyur la/byas zin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /snga ma la ni ltung ba med do/ /lo de nyid la stan gnyis pa ma byas kyang lo gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang /bzhi pa dang / lnga pa la stan gnyis pa byas nas des snga ma shos bzhag ste phyi ma shos gtong bar byed dam/ phyi ma shos bzhag ste snga ma shos gtong bar byed na gnyis pa rtsom pa de la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ byas zin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /snga ma la ni ltung ba med do/ /dge slong gis lo gang la stan rtsom ⑨pa'i ⑩de nyid la stan gnyis pa yang brtsams nas de ma zin par gtong bar byed dam/ lo gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa la brtsams nas de ma zin par gtong bar byed na de rtsom par byed pa la nyes byas 6—313

lngar ①'gyur la/ snga ma la ni ltung ba med do/ /dge slong gis lo gang la stan byed pa'i lo de nyid la stan gnyis pa mi byed cing lo gnyis pa la yang mi byed/gsum pa la yang mi byed/ bzhi pa la yang mi byed/ lnga pa la yang mi byed par lo drug pa la byed na ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang /sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /lo drug tu bcang ba'i spang ba ②ste bcu bzhi pa rdzogs sto༅// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po sum bcu ④ma gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon ⑤med zas sbyin gyi rjokun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa'i mkhyen pa thugs su chud pa de'i tshe na thams cad du yul dbus su sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung zhes grag go ⑦zhes sgra grags so/ /byang lam na tshong pa dag gis yul dbus su sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ste/ gang dag de la mchod pa dag byed pa de dag gi mchod pa byas pa de dag ni shin tu 'bras bu che ba dang / phan yon che ba dang / gsal ba che ba dang / rgya chen por 'gyur ro zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag zong dag thogs te mnyan yod du 'dong zhing der bdag cag gis khe spogs kyang bsgrub ⑧par bya/ bcom ldan 'das la yang bsnyen bkur bya'o snyam du rig nas tshong pa lnga brgya byang lam nas zong dag thogs te yul dbus su 'phags so/ /de dag mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin nas de dag gis zong mkhos su phab ⑨ste/khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ga la ba der dong nas phyin pa dang / khyim 6—314

bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ①ces smras so/ /khyim bdag bdag cag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das blta bar 'dod do/ /shes ldan dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs par lasangs rgyas pa ③rnams ni blta bar ④bya ba rin po che kho na yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni 'di lta ste/ dper na u dum bā ⑤ra'i me tog ltar bltams pa yidang / 'byung ba dkon pa yin no/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis tshong pa lnga brgya po de dag khrid nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑦zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das tshong pa de dag la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jud par mdzad/yang dag par gzengs stod ⑧par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad do/ /rnam grangs du mas chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan / yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs ⑨bstod/yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas tshong pa de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen ⑩bkur byas nas/ dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyi gtsug lag khang blta bar brtsams pa (spredang /tshong pa de dag gis dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyi mal dag na gding ba dbus rdol ba dag mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag ci'i phyir dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan 'di dag gi gding ba dag dbus rdol bar gyur/ khyim 6—315

bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis smras pa/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dag ni pal cher mtshan mo skyil mo krung ①gis 'da' bar byed do/ /de dag sems mngon par dad par gyur nas dad pa skyes pa de dag gis dge slong rnams la ras yug chen lnga brgya phul lo/ /dge slong rnams kyis gding ba rnying pa de dag khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag ②khang bla gab med pa zhig tu bzhag go/ /de'i tshe 0khyim bdag cig gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim gzhan du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun ni bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni rdzas las byung ba na dubazhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par bsgrubs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ⑥ni rgyu lngas rdzas las byung ba na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par sgrub pa ⑦mdzad de/ lnga gang zhe na/nang du yang dag ⑧'jog par ⑨bzhed pa dang / lha rnams la chos ston par bzhed pa dang / nad pa la blta ⑩bar bzhed pa dang / gnas mal la 0rtog par bzhed pa dang / 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed pa'o/ /don 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das gnas mal la rtog par bzhed pa dang / 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed pas/ rdzas las byung ba ni 8bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par sgrub pa tho)mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi dge 'dun song nas ring po ma lon par thugs su chud nas lde mig bsnams te kun dga'i ra ba nas / kun dga'i ra bar(sre/ gtsug lag khang (stenas gtsug lag khang du/khang khyim nas khang khyim du/ 'chag sa nas 'chag sa tsodang / gol bar ⑩gshegs shing mthar gyis gshegs pa na khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang ga la ba 6—316

der gshegs so/ /de'i tshe na khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang de na gding ba rnying pa rdol ba dang ral ba sa rdul gyi phye ma dang 'dres pa rab tu mang po dag sa la bkram zhing 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gding ba rnying pa rdol ba dang /ral ba sa rdul gyi phye ma dang 'dres pa rab tu mang po dag sa la bkram zhing 'dug pa dag gzigs sol/ /gzigs nas kyang e ma ②zhes gsung zhing smad srinas 'di snyam ④du dgongs te/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis pags ⑤pa dang / sha dang / khrag dag btsir cing btsir cing ༅sbyin pa dag sbyin/bsod nams dag byed pa gang yin pa de la dge slong dag drod mi shes pa dang /so sor mi rtog par yongs su longs spyod par byed do snyam du dgongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gding ba rnying pa de dag legs par brtul ⑦cing sprugs nas bting zhing bskams te rtsig pa la mi reg par mdzad nas/ gtsug lag khang gi slad rol du zhabs gnyis bsil 0te nang du yang dag 'jog gi slad du gtsug lag khang du gshegs so/ /de nas dge slong bsod snyoms sgrub ⑨pas/bsod snyoms blangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos nyid kyi ⑩bsod snyoms sgrub pa'i dge slong la dge slong las 0ji ltar 8zas bsod dam/ dge slong gi dge 'dun tshim par byas sam zhes so sor kun dga' bar mdzad pa 'dis so sor kun dga' bar mdzad pa yin pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong bsod snyoms sgrub pa la/dge slong ji ltar 'azas bsod dam/ dge slong gi dge 'dun tshim par byas sam zhes so sor kun dga' bar mdzad pa dang / des gsol pa/ btsun pa te bor zas bsod cing dge slong gi dge 'dun tshim par bgyis so/ /de nas 6—317

bcom ldan 'das zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad nas/ gtsug lag khang gi slad rol du zhabs gnyis bsil ①te nang du yang dag 'jog gi slad du gtsug lag khang du gshegs ②so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyi dro nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di na ngas dge slong gi dge 'dun song nas ring po ⑧ma lon par shes nas lde mig khyer te/ kun dga'i dur ba nas kun dga'i ⑤ra b.ram/ gtsug lag khang nas gtsug lag khang du/ khang khyim nas khang khyim du/'chag sa nas 'chag ⑥sar dang / gol bar song zhing mthar gyis 'gro ba na khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang zhig ga la ⑦ba der phyin nas ngas khang pa chen po'i gtsug lag khang ⑧de na gding ba rnying pa rdol ba dang ral ba sa rdul gyi phye ma dang 'dres ⑨pa rab tu mang po dag sa la bkram zhing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ⑩e ma zhes byas te smad nas 'di snyam du bram ze dang / khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis pags yipa dang / sha dang / khrag dag 8bcir cing btsir cing tsosbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag byed pa gang yin pa de la dge slong dag drod mi shes pa dang / so sor mi ④rtog par yongs su longs spyod par byed do snyam du dgongs kyisaX/ dge slong dag khyed kyis dad pas sbyin par bya ba la/ drod ran par yongs su longs spyad pa dang / spang ⑩zhing yongs su longs spyad ⑩pa dang / dus su yongs su longs spyad pa dang / brtag cing yongs su longs spyad pa dang / khad kyis yongs su longs spyad tson legs so// //bar sdom la/ drod ran pa dang spang ba dang / /de bzhin dus dang 6—318

brtag pa dang / /khad kyis yongs su spyad pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis drod ran pa dang / spang ba dang / dus dang / brtag pa dang /khad kyis yongs su longs spyad ①pa'i bsngags pa brjod nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ②bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste/zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar chagadon par bya ste/ dge slong gis gding ba sar pa byed na ④sar pa bya ⑤kha dog mi sdug par bya ba'i phyir gding ba rnying pa bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang 'khor bas glan par bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gis ⑥sar pa kha dog mi sdug par bya ba'i phyir gding ba rnying pa ⑦bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang 'khor bas ma glan ⑧par gding ba sar pa spyod na spang ba'i ltung byed do//dge slong gis zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pas so/ /gding ba zhes bya ba ni so sor gding ba'o/ /sar pa zhes bya ba ni sar pa gnyis te/ gsar pas sar pa dang / rnyed pas sar pa ste/ don 'dir ni gsar pas sar pa yin par dgongs so/ /byed na zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid kyis sam/ gzhan byed du 'jug na'o/ /sar pa kha dog mi sdug par bya ba'i phyir zhes bya ba ni sar pa sra bar ⑨bya ba'i phyir ro/ /gding ba rnying pa bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang 'khor bas glan ⑩par bya'o zhes bya ba ni gal te de la gding ba rnying pa bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang 'khor ba gzhan yod na'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa zhes bya ba ni ston pa'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang la ni tshad dang ldan pa'i khru'i khru phyed dang do yod do/ /'khor bas zhes bya ba ni kun nas mtho re ⑩yod 6—319

pas so/ /glan ①par bya'o zhes bya ba ni sbyar bar bya ba'o②/ /ma glan ③par zhes bya ba ni ma sbyar bar ro/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar 'ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis dugading ba rnying pa bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang 'khor bas ma glan rjopar ji tsam cung zad du gding ba sar pa spyod par byed na 0thams cad du spang ba'i ltung byed du la'agyur ro/ /gding ba rnying pa thams cad kyi thams cad du sha zad ⑨pa dang / bug rdol du gyur pa ⑩dang / bcos su mi rung ba yin na ltung ba med do/ /de tsam med na ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang /smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs ⑩pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /mtho gang gi spang ba ste bcwa tsolnga pa rdzogs sgotshu// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi (smekun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/dga' bo nye dga' lhung bzed tsonag po can 'di dag ni rkang pa spre'u'i zhag ⑩gis bskus te 'gro na yang 'gro bar chas pa'i rnyed pa sgrub ⑩par byed/ 'ong na ⑫yang blo bur du cha'ongs pa'i rnyed pa sgrub par byed cing skye bo mang po dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong bar yang 'gyur ro/ /yu bu cag ni khron pa'i rus dusbal dang 'dra bar gar yang mi 'dong / gang nas kyang mi 'ong bas rnyed pa 'thob ⑥pa dang / skye bo mang po dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong bar ga la 'gyur gyis ③yu bu cag kyang 'dong ngo / /gang du 'dong / gang du don mthun 'grub par 6—320

rol/ /de dag gis bsams ①pa/ gal te thams cad dong bar 'gyur ②na bdag cag gi ①nye bar spyod pa'i khyim gang dag yin pa de dag kyang dulhung bzed nag po can dag gis rjes su 'jug par byed par 'gyur gyisaX/ bdag cag gis dugacig bzhag ste 'dong ⑦bar bya na su bzhag ⑧par bya/ btsun pa 'char ku'o⑨ / /btsun pa 'char ka ⑩khyod 'di nyid du 'dug shig /kho bo cag 'dong bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gyis shig ces 'char ka yide nyid du 'dug go/ /lnga po dag gis don mthun btsarme bar brtsams pa dang / de dag gis bal yul du 'gro ba'i don mthun mthong nas/ de'i drung du song ste smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag khyed gang du 'phags/ 'phags pa dag bal yul du'o/ /bzhin bzangs dag kho bo cag kyang khyed dang lhan cig 'dong ngo / /'phags pa dag bal yul ni rnga mo'i rgyab 'dra ba lags pas/ khyed cag der dgyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /bzhin bzangs dag gal te de lta bu yin du zin kyang / yul mthong bar 'gyur bas 'dong bar bya'o/ /'phags pa dag gal te de lta tson tshur spyon bzhud do/ /drug sde tsodag don mthun de dag 8dang lhan cig bal yul du 'phags nas mthar gyis bal yul du phyin pa dang / nyi ma gang kho na la bal yul du phyin pa'i nyi ma de nyid la mngon par mi dga' bar gyur nas de dag nang par sngar langs te lam srang du dong ba dang / tshong pa dag gis drug sde dag mthong nas de dag gi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bal yul ci 'dra/ khyed cag mngon par mi dgyes par ma gyur tam/ bzhin bzangs dag nyi ma gang kho na la 8bal yul du phyin pa'i nyi ma de nyid la mngon par mi dga' bar gyur to/ /'phags pa dag bdag cag gis khyed la ⑩dang po 6—321

kho na nas ①bal yul ni rnga mo'i rgyab 'dra ba lags pas/ khyed cag der dgyes par mi 'gyur ro zhes ma bgyis sam/ bzhin bzangs dag ci de lta ②na 'gro'am 'dong ngo / /①'phags pa dag bdag cag gis zong ma bsgyur de rjode lta lags mod kyi 'on kyang rjobadag cag dang bshes pa'i tshong pa gzhan dag mchis pa de dag gis zong bsgyur bas de rjodag la gtad par bgyis ⑦de dag dang thabs cig ⑧bzhud cig /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ de ma nongs kyis ⑨de bzhin bgyi'o / /bal yul na bal dang ldong ros gnyis mod pas don mthun de dag gis bal gyis shing rta bkang ste chas pa dang / drug sde dag kyang don mthun de rkyidang lhan cig 'phags so/ /drug sde dag gi kun du (〉spyod pa ni rdul gyis 'jigs pas yang na ni don mthun gyi tsomadun du 'gro/ yang na ni phyi bzhin 'brang zhing 'gro bas de dag don mthun gyi phyi bzhin 'gro bar brtsams pa dang /ji tsam na tshong pa de dag gi shing rta'i srog shing chag nas tshong pa de dag gis bsams 0pa/ gal te shing rta'i srog shing bcos na sgras chom rkun pa ④dag 'ong bar 'gyur zhing de dag gis dang por bdag cag bsad ④par 'gyur la de'i 'og tu nor yang phrogs ⑩par 'gyur gyis0/ bdag cag gis gces 8pa dag khyer te 'dong ngo snyam nas yid mi dga' zhing 'khod pa dang / drug sde dag lhags nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci'i phyir yid mi dga' zhing 'khod/'phags pa dag ⑩shing rta'i srog shing chag ste gal te shing rta'i srog shing bcos na sgras chom rkun pa dag mchis par 0'gyur zhing de dag gis dang por bdag cag bkum par 'gyur la/ de'i 'og tu nor yang phrogs ⑥par 'gyur bas bdag cag gis gces pa dag 'tshal de dumachi'o snyam nas yid mi dga' zhing mchis so/ /6—322

bzhin bzangs dag khyod ①kyis bal dag yongs su btang ngamal/ yongs su btang ngo ⑧/ /gal te khyed cag la mi gnod na zhwa byadang / lham sgrog gu can dang / stod kor nang tshangs can dang / rgya cang dang / lcag pod dang /shur bu phre'u la sogs pa'i don du cung zhig bskur ⑤jo/ /'phags pa dag bdag cag la 'dis ci bgyi/ thams cad snoms shig /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' phyag dar khrod pa ⑨rnyed do zhes de dag gis chalnga car ⑤gyi lhung bzed dang chos gos dag gcig 0gis bskur yinas/ mi bzhis de nyid las thag pa bkal de ⑩khur bo che ba 'bazhi drags nas/ de dag gis de khur te dong ngo / /de dag gis khur de dag khyer te 'phags pa dang / tshong pa de dag gis drug sde dag bal gyi khur blangs te tsophyi chabazhin 'ongs pa chamathong nas smras ⑩pa/'phags pa dag bdag cag gis gla mi dag khrid de mchi'o snyam du bsams nas sh+yi/khyed cag gis bal 'di thams cad bsnams de 'byon gyis ⑩'phags pa dag la gla gsol lo/ /bkren pa dag kho bo cag khyod kyi ④ gla mi dag yin nam/ 'phags pa dag mad 0kyang bzhad phyagad bgyi'o/ /don mthun de'i nang na mu stegs can dag cig 'dong ba de dag gis smras pa/ kye ma drug sde dag khyed 0cag gang du khur 'jig par 'gyur/ gang du rnyed pa 'grub par 'gyur/ khyod ④kyi ma'i lto dral te der khur 'jig par 'gyur zhing der rnyed pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' gal te don mthun dang lhan cig 'dong na tho 'tsham ④pa mang du 'byung gis 0don mthun gyi mdun du 'dong ngo zhes de dag don mthun gyi mdun du 'phags te dong ba dang / ri brags shig ⑦na chom rkun pa gcad ⑥pa'i phyir yang rgod kyi mi mang po bkod cing 'khod pa de 6—323

dag gis de dag thag ①ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang nyam nga bar gyur nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag laglang po che dang bcas pa'i dmag byung ngo zhes ri brags ⑧pa de dag thams cad skrag dunas nags khrod du byer ro/ /de dag gi nang nas kha cig gis smras pa/ 'di dag ni glang po che dang bcas pa'i dmag dum yin gyi 'di ltar rnga mo dag ༅cig 'ong ba yin no/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ 'di dag ni rnga mo ma yin gyi 'di ltar glang dag cig yin no / /kha cig gis smras pa/ 'di dag ni glang ma yin gyi 'di dag ni khur thogs pa ⑦dag cig yin no/ /de dag thag nye bar gyur pa dang / yang rgod de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed cag 'di lta bu'i khur dag thogs pas ⑧de'i phyir ri brags ⑨pa thams cad skrag ste nags khrod du byer ro/ /bkren pa dag gal te chom rkun pa dag gis khyed cag de dag bred ngas tshupar shes par gyur na 7nyin mo'i nyi ma kho na la yang bcings te nags khrod du khrid 8par 'gyur ro/ / dga' bo ④nye dga' gal te lam du 'dong na tho tso'atsham pa mang du 'byung gis khrulam gol bar 'dong ngo / /zhes de dag lam gol bar 0zhugs te dong ba dang / sho gam pa dag gis 0tshong pa sho gam 'dral ba bsgugs 8pa'i phyir 'ge gu ⑩pa'i mi mang po dag bkod cing 'khod pa de byadag gis de dag mthong nas smras pa/ e ma'o tshong pa sho gam 'dral ba dag ci'i phyir sho gam dral te 'dong / bkren pa dag kho bo cag khyed kyi tshong pa sho gam 'dral ba dag yin nam / khyed cag su yin/ 'phags pa drug sde dag ⑥yin no/ /bzhud cig de dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' gal te rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo nas zhugs na dulhung bzed nag po can dag las tho 0'tsham pa mang du 'byung gis cha6—324

sge'u chung nas 'jug par bya'o zhes de dag sge'u chung nas zhugs pa dang / rgan zhugs zhig gis ①mthong nas des smras ②pa/ e ma'o khur tsa ba chadag ci'i phyir grong ༷dral te 'jug par byed/ rgan zhugs kho bo cag khyod kyi khur tsa dub dag yin nam/ des smras pa khyed su yin/ tshe dang ldan pa drug sde dag ༷yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag byon pa legs so byon pa legs sol/ /de dag nang du zhugs nas de dag gi ⑧bal gyi khur de dag bshig pa dang / ri rab kyi rnam pa ⑨'dra ba'i phung po chen por rnam par gnas so/ /de dag la dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag khur 'di lta bu dag thogs nas ⑩khyed la tho tshu'atsham pa dag mi 'byung ngam/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed 8ci kho bo cag gis bza' ba kho na'i phyir kha mngon par bsgrubs sam/ gang kho bo cag la tho ⑫'tsham par byed pa de la kho bo cag gis kyang nyis gyur tsosbyin par bya'o/ /dge slong dag 8don nyung ba tsodag ci'i phyir/ dge slong dag yan lag gang gis ngo tsha bar bya ba'i yan lag de nyid kyis khengs par byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka ⑩gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis tsobacom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba tsomadzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang ⑥snga ma bzhin no0/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis drug sde dag la mos ⑥pa/dge slong dag khyed kyis mi mdzes pa de lta bu de byas par gyur pa bden nam/btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin 6—325

pa / rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa ①mdzad do//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad ②pa mdzad nas/dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab ③pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis du'adul ba la bslab pa'i ⑤gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong lam du zhugs pas lug bal dag rnyed la 'dod na dge slong des blang bar bya'o/ /blangs nas khyer ⑥ba med na dpag tshad gsum gyi mtha'i bar du bdag nyid kyis bkur bar bya'o/ /de las 'das par khyer na spang ba'i lhung byed do⑤/ /dge slong zhes bya ba ni drug sde dag gam/ chagazhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /lam du zhugs pas zhes ⑨bya ba ni/ ⑩dgon pa'i lam du zhugs pas so/ /lug bal dag ces bya ba ni lug gi bal dag go/ /rnyed pa ⑩zhes bya ba ni gzhan las so/ /'dod na zhes bya ba ni gal te don du gnyer na'o/ /dge slong des blang bar bya'o zhes bya ba ni mnod par bya ba'o⑩/ /blangs nas khyer 8ba med na zhes bya ba ni rung ba 8byed pa med na'o/ /dpag tshad gsum gyi mtha'i bar du zhes bya ba ni dpag tshad gsum gyi mthar thug 8pa'i bar tshun chad du'o⑩/ /bdag nyid kyis bkur bar bya'o/ /zhes bya ba ni bdag rang gis bkur bar bya ba'o⑩ / /de las 'das par khyer na zhes bya ba ni de las thal bar khyer na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na 8spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /6—326

de la ltung bar ①ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis lug bal dag rnyed la ②khyer ba med na bdag nyid kyis dpag tshad gsum gyi mtha' las 'das par khyer na rgyang grags phyed du phyin na nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rgyang grags kyi mthar phyin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /khyer ②ba yod bzhin du bdag nyid kyis khyer na rtsom pa'i dus kho na na nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rgyang grags phyed du phyin na nyes byas su ④ gzhan gcig ⑤tu 'gyur/ rgyang grags kyi mthar phyin na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /rdul phra rab drug la rdul phra mo gcig go/ /rdul phra mo drug la chu rdul gcig go/ /chu rdul drug la lcag ༅rdul gcig go/ /lcag ༅rdul drug la ri bong gi ⑧rdul gcig go/ /ri bong 0rdul drug la lug rdul gcig go/ /lug rdul drug la glang rdul gcig go/ /glang rdul drug la nyi ༅zer gyi rdul gcig go/ /nyi 0zer gyi rdul drug la sro ma gcig go/ /sro tsom drug la shig gcig go/ /shig drug la nas gcig go/ /nas drug la sor gcig go/ /sor bzhi drug la khru gang ngo / /khru phyed dang bzhi la mi'i srid do/ /khru bzhi la gzhu'o / /gzhu lnga brgya la rgyang grags gcig go/ /rgyang grags brgyad la dpag tshad gcig go/ /de la dge slong dgon pa pa lam du zhugs pas lug bal dag rnyed la/ de blangs te khyer 0ba med na rgyang grags kyis chod pa'i grong bdun po dag gi grong phyed du ni nyes byas su 'gyur la/ grong gi mthar ④ni spang ba'i ltung byed du 8'gyur ro/ /grong yinas dgon pa'i lam du 'jug na rgyang grags phyed phyed du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rgyang grags re rer spang ba'i 0ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /zhwa dang / lham sgrog 8gu can dang / stod kor nang tshangs can dang / rgya cang dang / lcag pod dang / shur bu phre'u la sogs 6—327

pa'i don du de tsam dag khyer ba la ni lhung ba med do/ /las dang po pa ①dang /smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /bal ②thogs pa'i spang ba ste bcu drug pa rdzogs stol// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/dga' bo nye dga' bal bgo bar bya'o / /cha dur bya de dag gis smras pa/bdag cag gis btsun pa 'char ka 0'di nyid na 'dug 'dug pa la ci'i phyir skal ba sbyin/ cha lngar bya'o/ /'char kus ②thos nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed kyis der rnyed pa gang grub pa ⑥de yang khyed kyis ⑦gyis shig /kho bo 'di nyid na 'dug 'dug pas rnyed pa gang grub pa de yang kho bo ⑧nyid kyir bya'o / /nye dga'as bsams pa 'di 'di ⑨na 'dug 'dug pas rnyed pa mang po grub gor ma chag snyam nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag dus thams cad du drug sde yin na da ⑩ci'i phyir lnga sder 'gyur bar bya/ cha drug kho nar bya'o su dgod du yigazhug /btsun pa 'char ka tsom dub pa yin gyis 8de 'god du gzhug go/ /'char kus cha 8drug tu byas te bdag nyid kyi skal ba rang gi gnas khang du bcug ste bzhag tsogo/ /de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka khyod ⑩kyis rnyed pa gang grub pa de khyer shog bgo'o⑩/ /'char gas ⑫smras pa/ kho bos de'i bar du ka ka ṇi yigacig tsam yang ma rnyed do/ /khyod kyis kho bo cag bslus so/ /'char gas bsams ⑥pa/ bdag gis bal nyung ⑥ngu ma zhig rnyed pa 'di su rmel dudu gzhug /gal te khyim pa chadag la bcol na ni 6—328

de dag bslab pa yang dag par ma blangs pa yin pas thams cad brkus par ①'gyur ro/ /gal te bcu gnyis ③ste dag la bcol na ni bca' rgyaba'i rin du 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /chos byin dul bcol duyang chos byin ༷ni mdo sde'i mtha' pa yin la/ 'khor yang mdo sde'i mtha' pa dang ldan pa yin pas ⑦mdo sde'i tshig dag sems ⑧pa na dus 'gyangs ⑨par 'gyur ro/ / gi ta nī 7skem mo la bcol du yang gau ta sī skem 7mo ni 'dul ba 'dzin pa yin la/ de'i 8'khor yang 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang ldan pa yin ⑩pas de 'di ni ltung ba 8yin no/ /'di ni ltung ba ma yin no zhes sems 8pa na dus 'gyangs ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /skye dgu'i ⑩bdag mo chen mo gi ta rmā ni spong ba ma 8yin la/ 'khor yang spong ba pa yidang ldan pas des ⑥sems rtse gcig tu 'jog pa la bal rmel ba ⑥mi gnod kyis dubadag gis de la bal rmel du bcol lo 0snyam nas/ de de snyam sems rdzizhing 'dug pa na skye dgu'i byabadag mo chen mo gau ta sbos bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der 'ongs pa de tsotshe dang ldan pa 'char kus thag 0ring po kho na tsonas mthong nas smras ⑥pa/ gi ta rmās ⑥bcom ldan 'das kyis tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i sems kyi smon pa 'grub 0ste/ de yang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro zhes bka' stsal pa de legs par gsungs pa yin te/ da gzod kho na bdag kye ma skye dgu'i dubadag mo chen mo gi ta sī 'ongs na ci ma rung snyam pa'i blo skyes na khyod ༷kyang 'dir 'ongs so/ /bdag gis bal nyung zhig rnyed pa de khyed ④kyis rmel du chug ste byin cig /'phags pa bdag chabacom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te slar mchis nas dge slong ma gnyis btang gis ⑥de gnyis la bskur bar ṣ+yostsol 9cig /'char kus ⑥bal de dag gzar 0thag gis bam po 6wa 329

gnyis su dam du ①rab tu bcings te sgo glegs kyi phag tu bzhag go/ /de nas skye dgu'i ②bdag mo chen ①mo gi ༷ta sī bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te / dbyar khang du son ⑤nas des de'i gan du dge slong ma gnyis btang ste/'phags pa 'char ku'i dugan du deng rgyal bal de bskur du stsol ⑧zhes gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /de gnyis dong ste smras pa/ 'phags pa gi ta sī'i ⑨mchid nas bal de bskur ⑩du gsol zhes mchi'o⑩/ /'char kus 8de gnyis la smras pa/sgo glegs kyi phag na bam po gnyis 'dug pa de tsoganyis khyer la deng ④shig /de gnyis gnas khang du zhugs te 'degs 8par brtsams pa dang / bsgul ba tsam du yang ma nus nas de gnyis kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa ci 'dir rang thag tshugi gor ma dag stsal tam/ gzhon nu ma gnyis ci khyed gnyis gzhon nu ma gta' gam pa yin nam/ zhes des the'u chung 0gis bteg 8ste gcig ni gcig gi mgor bskur/ gcig ni gcig yigi rked du bskur ro/ /de gnyis mgo chag la thug go/ /rked 0pa chag 0la thug go zhes zer zhing chadabyar khang du dong nas khur sa la bzhag ste khri 0steng du skyel ④cing 'dug go/ /dge slong ma rnams kyis de gnyis la smras pa/ khyed gnyis gzhon nu ma gta' chagam pa yin nam/ de gnyis kyis smras pa/ khyed cag las stobs dang ldan pa gang yin pa des je 'di theg chashig /de dag gis de 'degs ⑥par brtsams pa dang / bskul ba tsam du yang ma nus nas de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags ma gnyis ci 'dir rang thag 9gi rdo dag bcug gam zhes de dag gis bam po de gnyis bshig pa dang ji tsam na phung po chen por 0rnam par gnas par gyur to/ /dge slong ma rnams kyis rta gad zhukyis btab ste smras pa/ 'phags pa 'char ka nyen re bal cung zhig chazer 6—330

na gal te mang bar gyur na ①ji lta bur 'gyur/ skye dgu'i ②bdag mo chen mo gi ta rmās ②smras pa/ nu mo rjodag mgo bregs shing mchan khung ral bu can dag yin na god ⑤du ci yod/ 'phags pa 'char ku'i dumachid nas bal nyung zhig ces mchi na gal te mang bar gyur na ji lta bur 'gyur/ skye dgu'i ⑦bdag mo chen ⑧me gi nyuta sbos smras pa/ nu mo ⑩dag de dag ni gnas ngan len kun tu spyod pa dag yin pas de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑩bstan pa la 'drums pa ltung bas ltung bar byed do/ /nu mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di gnyis ni ⑫skyes bu dam pa yin te/ khur ma blangs pa mi len pa gang yin pa dang / khur blangs pa mthar phyin par 'byed pa gang yin pa'o zhes gsungs pas/ 'di ni khur blangs pa yin pas mthar phyin par bya dgos ④kyis/ khyed cag las gang gis ji tsam rmel bar spro ba 8de tsam rmel tshul de'i gan du khyer te byin cig /de dag yun ring ⑩du thogs pa dang 'char gas bsams 8pa/ de dag gis bal de ⑫bca' ba'i rin du bzhag 0gor ma chag /bdag gis ma legs pa zhig byas te ⑥bdag gis bal de ni char pas 'jigs pas gang tsol khar bzhag pa dang 'dra bar gyur to snyam mo/ /dge slong ma gnyis kyis bal khal 0cig rmel te khyer te 'ongs nas smras pa/ 'phags pa 'char ka chabal dag 'tshal te mchis na chagang du gzhag 0par bgyi/ 'char kus bsams ⑦pa/ da dung spyod yul lhag ma dang bcas pa yin no snyam nas smras pa/ gnas khang du chug ste zhog shig /de gnyis kyis bzhag ste song ba dang / gzhan dag gis kyang khyer te 'ongs so/ /ji 9tsam na thams cad kyis kyang khyer te 'ongs so/ /de nas skye dgu'i ⑥bdag mo chen mo go ta sbri bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste 0phyin nas/ bcom 6—331

ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te ①mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /de'i tshe na ②skye dgu'i ②bdag mo chen mo gi ta sbi'i lag pa gnyis 'di lta ste/ dper na btso 0blag mkhan gyi lag pa dudamar ba ltar rjodamar ba dang ༅shin tu dmar bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skye dgu'i ⑧bdag mo chen mo gi ta sī ⑨la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gi ta sī ci'i phyir khyod ⑩kyi lag pa gnyis 'di lta ste/ dper na btso 7blag mkhan gyi lag pa dmar ba ltar dmar ba dang shin tu dmar bar gyur/ bcom ldan 'das 'di na tibagyi ba gzhan lags na gzhan bgyid do/ /ji ltar gyur/ 'phags pa 'char kus 'badag bal rmel du stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong dag dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la lug bal dag rmel du ④'jud dmatso/ btsun pa rmel du stsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi tsodage 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs ⑩pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni tsomakhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin teyi/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la mas ⑥pa/ 'char ka ⑥khyod dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la lug bal dag rmel tsodu 'jud pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun ⑫pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun ④pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa byamadzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' 6—332

stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ①bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams skyes 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la lug bal 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni 'char ku'am ②gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /dge slong ma zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa'o/ /nye du ma yin pa la zhes bya ba ni phyi mo dang mes po dang / phrugs kyi bdun pa tshun chad ni nye du yin la/ de phan chad ni nye du ma yin no/ /lug bal zhes bya ba ni lug gi ①bal lo/ /'khrur 'jud dam zhes bya ba ni tha na chur snyug ④pa byed du 'jud na'o/ /'tshed du 'jud dam zhes bya ba ni tha na tshon du snyug ⑤pa byed du 'jud na'o/ /rmel du 'jud na zhes bya ba ni ༅tha na 'da' ba ⑦byed du 'jud na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par ⑧bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar ⑨ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis ⑩dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la nye du ma yin par 'du shes pas lug bal dag 'khrur 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'tshed du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /rmel yidu 'jud tson spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dmatso/6—333

rmel du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud pa dang / rmel du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la yid gnyis za bas lug bal dag 'khrur 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro / /'tshed du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /rmel du 'jud ①na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/'khrur 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam / 'tshed du 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'khrur ②'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud pa dang / rmel du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du la nye du ma yin par 'du shes pas lug bal dag 'khrur 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'tshed du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /rmel du 'jud ②na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'khrur bya'ajud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud ⑤pa dang /rmel du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong ma nye du la yid ⑥gnyis za bas lug bal dag 'khrur 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ri /'tshed du 'jud na ④nyes byas gsu 'gyur ro/ /rmel du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dam/ 'khrur 'jud pa 6—334

dang rmel du 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang 'khrur 'jud dam/ 'tshed du 'jud pa dang rmel du 'jud dam/ rmel du 'jud pa dang ①'khrur ②'jud ①dam / rmel du 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud dmaX/ 'khrur 'jud pa dang 'tshed du 'jud pa dang / rmel du 'jud na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos dupa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /bal rmel du 'jud pa'i spang ba ste bcu bdun pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal rdzika lan da ku'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /de nas grong dpon gtsug na nor bu bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig nitu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig 0tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la grong dpon gtsug na nor bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa sngon gyi gdugs rnams kyis ches ⑩snga ba zhig na rgyal po'i pho brang na rgyal po dang blon po'i 'khor mchis shing mthun par gyur pa rnams la bar skabs kyi bka' mchid kun tu brjod ⑩pa 'di lta bu 'di 'byung bar gyur te⑩/ shes ldan dag ci dge slong rnams la mngon tsomatshan can rung ngam/ shākya'i 8sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid dam/ 'on te dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong ⑩rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid ces mchi nas/ de na kha cig ni 'di skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung zhing ༷shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid do 6—335

zhes mchi/ kha cig ni 'di skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing lashākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid do zhes mchi na / btsun pa de la gang dag de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid do zhes mchis ②na/ btsun pa ji ltar gang dag de skad mchi ba de dag de ltar brda sprod par bgyid pa na/ bcom ldan 'das la skur pa 'debs par mi bgyid cing ha cang thal bar yang mi bgyid pa dang / de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i rjes su smra ba dang / chos smra ba dang / chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos brda sprod par bgyid pa dang / gsungs pa'i rjes su smra ba de dag la gzhan las chos dang mthun pas smad pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos 'ga' yang mi mchi ba lags sam / grong dpon gang dag de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir byed do zhes zer ba de dag de ltar brda sprod par byed pa na nga rgyal skur pa 'debs par byed cing ha cang thal bar byed pa dang / de dag ngas smras pa'i rjes su smra ba ma yin pa dang /chos smra ba ma yin pa dang / chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos brda sprod par byed pa ma yin pa dang / smras pa'i rjes su smra ba ma yin pa de dag la gzhan las chos dang mthun pas smad pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos shin tu 'ong ba yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ grong dpon dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi byed de/ gang la la la ④mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /grong dpon ngas khyod ⑤6—336

la don de nyid kyi phyir lan gnyis lan gsum gyi ①bar du brjod par bya ste/dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi byed de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin no/ /btsun pa gang gi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma lags shing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma lags so zhes bka' stsal te/ ji latsam du bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa ni ngo mtshar to/ /btsun pa gang gi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces grong dpon ngas khyod la don de nyid kyi phyir lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya ste/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong ②rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid de/gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma lags shing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma lags so zhes bka' stsal ④pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' de ni rgya cher bzang ba lags so/ /btsun pa bdag kyang 'di snyam bgyid deX/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de ⑥ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po dag kyang rung ba kho na lags so/ /grong dpon de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi 6—337

dge sbyong ①rnams gser bdag gir mi byed ②de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin no/ /de nas grong dpon gtsug na nor bus bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la mngon par dga' ba dang rjes su yi ②rang ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs na 'dug par gyur cing bsil yab thogs te bcom ldan 'das la g.yob cing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis grong dpon gtsug na nor bu song nas ring por dum lon par thugs su chud nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas na dge slong ji snyed nye bar rten ⑤cing gnas pa de dag thams cad dpong ⑥sa'i khang par bsdus 0shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas na dge slong ji snyed nye bar rten ⑤cing gnas pa de dag thams cad dpong sa'i khang par bsdus te⑨/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas na dge slong ji snyed nye bar rten ⑩cing gnas pa de dag thams cad dpong yisa'i khang par mchis shing mthun par gyur na ⑩bcom ldan 'das kyis da ⑫de'i dus la bab par mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 6—338

dpong sa'i khang pa ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas ①bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ci'i 0grong dpon gtsug srin nor bu nga dug la ba der 'ongs te phyin nas nga'i rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas nga la grong ⑤dpon gtsug na dunor bu 'di skad ces btsun pa sngon gyi gdugs rnams kyi ches ⑦snga ba zhig na rgyal po'i pho brang na rgyal po dang blon po'i 'khor mchis shing mthun par gyur pa rnams la bar skabs kyi bka' mchid kun tu rjod ⑧pa 'di lta bu 'di byung bar gyur te/ shes ldan dag ci ⑨dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung ngam shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid dam/'on te dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid ces mchi nas0/ de na kha cig ni 'di skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung zhing shākya'i yisras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid do zhes mchi/ kha cig ni 'di skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can 8mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid do zhes mchi na/ btsun pa de la gang dag de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi 0rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir bgyid do zhes mchi na/ btsun pa ji ltar gang dag de skad mchi ba de dag de ltar brda sprod par bgyid pa na bcom ldan 'das la skur pa 'debs par mi bgyid cing ha cang thal bar yang ④mi bgyid pa dang / de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i rjes su smra ba dang / chos smra ba dang ⑫/6—339

chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos brda ①sprod par bgyid pa dang / gsungs pa'i rjes su smra ba pa ②de dag la gzhan las chos dang ③mthun pas smad pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos 'ga' yang mi mchi ba lags sam zhes zer nas④/ ngas de la 'di skad ces grong dpon gang dag de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir byed do zhes zer ba de dag de ltar brda sprod par byed pa na nga la skur pa 'debs par byed cing ha cang thal bar byed pa dang / de dag ngas ⑤smras pa'i rjes su smra ba ma yin pa dang /chos smra ba ma yin pa dang / chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos brda sprod par byed pa ma yin pa dang / smras pa'i yirjes su smra ba ma yin pa de dag la gzhan las chos dang mthun pas smad pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos shin tu 'ong ba yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ grong dpon dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir ⑦byed de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /grong dpon ngas khyod ⑧la don de nyid kyi phyir lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya ste/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi byed de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan 0can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi 0chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin no zhes smras pa dang / de nga la 'di skad ces btsun pa gang gi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid de/ gang 6—340

la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma lags shing de ni shākya'i ①sbas kyi chos ma lags so zhes bka' 475 te/ji tsam du bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa ni ngo mtshar to/ /btsun pa gang gis ②slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces grong dpon ngas khyod la don de nyid kyi phyir lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya ste/dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing lashākya'i sras kyi dudage sbyong rnams gser bdag gir ⑤mi bgyid de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma lags shing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma lags so/ /zhes bka' stsal pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' de ni rgya cher bzang ba lags so/ /btsun pa bdag kyang 'di snyam bgyid de/dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid ⑥de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can ⑦rung zhing gser bdag gir bgyid pa de la ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po dag kyang rung ba kho na lags so zhes zer ro/ /ngas de la 'di skad ces grong dpon de de bzhin no / /de de bzhin te/ dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi ⑧dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi bgyid dol/ /gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin no zhes smras so0/ /de nas grong dpon gtsug na nor bu des ngas smras pa la mngon par dga' ba dang / 7rjes su yi tsorang ba byas nas nga'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te nga'i drung nas song ngo / /dge slong dag de ltar grong dpon gtsug na nor bu des rgyal po 6—341

dang bcas pa'i 'khor ①gyi mdun du dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi byed de/ gang la la la mngon mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de la ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po dag kyang gdon mi za bar rung ba yin no zhes cha gcig bzung ste/khyu mchog gi tshig rgya chen po smras shing 'khor gyi nang du yang dag par seng ge'i sgra bsgrags so/ /dge slong dag ngas kyang de skad ces dge slong rnams la mngon mtshan can mi rung zhing shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams gser bdag gir mi byed de / gang la la la mngon ②mtshan can rung zhing gser bdag gir byed pa de ni dge sbyong gi chos ma yin zhing de ni shākya'i sras kyi chos ma yin no zhes smras so/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na khyed kyis da deng phyin cad ②shing 'dod pa dag gis shing yongs su btsal bar bya/ rtswa 'dod pa dag gis ni rtswa/ shing rta'i las 'dod pa dag gis ni shing rta'i las/ mi blas 'dod pa dag gis ④ni mi blas yongs su btsal bar bya zhes smra ba'i ⑤'di skad ces rnam grangs gang gis kyang gser bdag gir bya ba ni mi smra'o/ /'di ni re zhig ⑥byung ba yin gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das re zhig 'dul ⑦ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' nibar ni 0mi mdzad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong drug sde dag rang gi tshulag gis gser dang dngul len par byed/ len du 'jud par byed/phung po gcig tu byed/ phung po gnyis su byed/ khri dang khri'u dang / khri'u chung ngu dag tu 'jog par byed nas/ gzhan mu stegs can dag shes ldan dag 6—342

shākya'i bu'i ①dge sbyong dag ni ma log ma spangs so sor ma spangs pa yin te/'di ltar rang gi lag gis gser dang dngul len par byed/ ②len du 'jud par byed/ phung po gcig tu byed/ phung rgyapo gnyis su byed/ khri dang khri'u dang / khri'u chung ngu dag tu 'jog par byed do/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dag kyang rang gi lag gis gser dang dngul len par byed/ len du 'jud par byed/ phung po gcig tu byed/ phung po gnyis su byed/ khri dang khri'u dang / khri'u chung ngu dag du'ajog par byed na shes ldan dag shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams dang bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyi 'di la bye brag ni ci yod/bsam pa ni ci yod/ tha dad du bya ba ni ci yod/ su zhig dge sbyong mgo reg 'di dag la bsod snyoms sbyin pa dang bya bar sems zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka rjogatong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed 0pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du med par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong drug sde dag la mos ⑦pa/ dge slong dag khyed rang gi lag gis gser dang dngul len pa dang /len du 'jud par byed pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑧dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa dang ⑨/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad par ⑩mdzad do/ /de nas bcom 6—343

ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i ②nyan thos rnams ②kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang rang gi la gis gser dang dngul len tam/ len du 'jud na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni drug ste sridag gam gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /rang gi lag gis zhes bya ba ni rang gi lag ①pas so/ /gser dang dngul zhes bya ba ni dbyig dang gser ro/ /len tam zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid kyis so/ /len du 'jug rgyan zhes bya ba ni gzhan no/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes 0bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags ⑦par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar ②ji ltar 'gyur zhe na / gzhi bcwa brgyad kyis te/ 'di long lashig /'di nas long ⑩shig /'di tsam long ⑩shig ces bya ba dang / 'di khyer shog /'di nas khyer shog /'di tsam khyer shog ces bya ba dang / 'di zhog shig /'dir zhog shig /'di tsam zhog shig ces bya ba dang / de long ⑩shig de nas long 0shig /de tsam long ④shig ces bya ba dang / de khyer shog /de nas khyer shog /de tsam khyer shog ces bya ba dang / de zhog shig /der zhog shig /de tsam zhog shig ces bya bas so/ /de la 'di long 8shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su dbyig gam/ gser 'di long ⑩shig ces bsgo 0bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo 8bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 6—344

'gyur ro/ /'di nas long ①shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po che nas sam/ zangs nas sam/ rdza bo nas sam/ sgrom ②nas sam/ko lpags nas sam/ za ma tog nas long ①shig ces bsgo ༷bar byed pa ste/de bsgo bar byed pa la ⑥nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di tsam long 0shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su brgya'am/ stong ngam 'bum long ①shig ces ⑧bsgo bar byed pa ste/de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ⑨ba'i lhung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di khyer shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su dbyig gam/ gser 'di khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa ⑩ste/ de bsgo bar ⑫byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ khyer ba tson spang ba'i ltung byed du tso'agyur ro//'di nas khyer shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po che nas sam / zangs nas sam/ rdza bo nas sam/ sgrom nas sam/ ko lpags nas sam/ za ma tog nas khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur rol/ /'di tsam khyer spre)shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su brgya'am / stong ngam/ 'bum khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas tsos 'gyur la/ khyer ba na 8spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di zhog shig ⑩ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su dbyig gam/ gser 'di zhog shig 8ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas yis 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro//'dir zhog shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po cher ram/6—345

zangs su'am/ rdza phor ①ram/ sgrom du'am/ ko lpags su'am/ za ma tog tu zhog shig ②ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /'di tsam zhog shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su brgya'am/ stong ngam/'bum zhog shig ①ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de long ④shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs ⑤su dbyig gam/ gser de long rjoshig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de nas long 0shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po che nas sam/ zangs nas sam/rdza bo nas sam/ sgrom nas sam/ ko lpags nas sam/ za ma tog nas long ⑧shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de tsam long 0shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su brgya'am/ stong ngam/ 'bum long ⑩shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de khyer shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su dbyig gam/ gser de khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa ste de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ khyer ba na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de nas khyer shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po che nas sam/ zangs nas yisam/ rdza bo nas sam/ sgrom nas sam / ko lpags nas sam/ za ma tog nas khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa 6—346

ste de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas ①su 'gyur la/ blangs pa ②na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de tsam khyer shog ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su brgya'am/ stong ngam/ 'bum khyer shog ces bsgo bar byed pa ste de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ khyer ba srin spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de zhog shig ༷ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su dbyig gam / gser de zhog shig duces bsgo bar byed pa ste de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /der zhog shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs su zangs po cher duram/zangs su'amal/ rdza phor ⑧ram/ sgrom du'am/ ko lpags su'am/ za ma tog tu zhog shig ①ces bsgo bar byed pa ste/ de bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de tsam zhog shig ces bya ba ni 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyogs 4)su brgya'am/ stong ngam/'bum zhog shig ces bsgo bar byed pa ste de bsgo bar byed pa skyel nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bzhag pa na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ / 'di long shigatso/'di nas long 0shig 'di tsam long ④shig ces bya ba dang / 'di khyer shog 'di nas khyer shog /'di tsam khyer shog ces bya ba dang / 'di zhog shig 'dir zhig shig /'di tsam zhog shig ces bya ba dang / de long shig 8de nas long ⑩shig/de tsam long ⑩shig ces bya ba dang / de khyer shog 8de nas khyer shogayi /de tsam khyer shog ces bya ba dang / de zhog shig der zhog shig /de tsam zhog shig ces bya ba de dag 'thob par 'gyur ba ma yin pa'i phyogs su bsgo bar byed na / de 0bsgo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ blangs pa dang khyer ba 6—347

dang / bzhag pa na yang nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dbyig ①la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gser la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dbyig dang gser la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ②dbyig gam/ gser brdungs pa la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dbyig dang gser mngon mtshan can la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dngul la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /nor bu la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /mu tig la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /be+e ḍūr+ya ③la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /nor bu dang mu tig dang be+e ḍūr+ya ④la reg na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis yul gyi tha snyad can gyi dbyig dang / gser la reg na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /ra gan dang zangs ma dang / lcags dang rno lcags dang ro nye dang zha nye dang / khro chu la reg pa la ltung ba med do zhes de ⑤ltar bcom ldan 'das ⑥'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba ⑦mdzad do// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po sum bcu ②rtsa gsum pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na tsam pa ⑨na khyim bdag dad pa yidang ldan pa/ yidage ba'i bsam pa can/ bzang po sbyin pa zhig 'dug pa des de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyi phyir gtsug lag khang rta babs mthon po dang / skar khung dang skar khung 'dra ba can dang /lan kun gyis brgyan pa8/ snying dang mig 'phrog pa mtho ris kyi them skas su 6—348

gyur pa zhig byed du bcug nas/ der dge slong mang po dag dbyar gnas par khas blangs te/ de dag gis ①dgag dbye byas nas smras pa/ khyim bdag bdag cag mnyan yod du ston pa dang / dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams ②kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal du 'gros chabadag cag la gos dag byin cig /khyim ④bdag des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag 'di na gos bzang po dag ma mchis te/ don mthun rjodag mchi zhes ①grag ⑦gis ⑧don mthun dag mchis kyi bar du re zhig gzhes 0shig dang / de nas gos bzang po dag 'jal 0te gsol lo / /de dag gis smras pa/ khyim bdag gal te gos yibazang po dag med na gos ngan pa chadag byin cig /'phags pa dag bdag ni bzang po sbyin pa lags na/ji ltar bdag gis tsongan pa dag gsol ④bar bgyi/ gal te khyed cag rings na gos kyi rin kār ṣā pa ṇa dag snoms la bzhud cig /khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das kyis kār ṣā pa ṇa dag bkag pas bdag cag mi 8len to/ /'phags pa dag 'di ltar bdag la ma byin pa ni mi mnga'itshu/ gos ngan pa dag sbyin du ni ⑫mi rung ngo / /dge slong de dag gis kār ṣā pa ṇa dag ma blangs par gos ngan pa dag kho nas dong ste/ mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin pa dang / de dag la dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag gis dbyaro gnas pa'i gos kyi rnyed pa ma rnyed dam/ ci nas tsogang gi phyir khyed cag gos dag ngan par gyur ma rnyed do/ /khyed cag gang du dbyar gnas par khas blangs tsam par rol/ /khyim bdag gang la brten/ che ge mo zhig la'o/ /khyim bdag de bzang po sbyin pa zhes grag go ⑩de'i phyir ma rnyed do/ /ci'i duphyir de dag gis skabs de rgyas par brjod pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 6—349

gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ kye ma bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag kyang gos kyi rin dag sbyin par byed la/ nga'i nyan thos rnams kyang gos kyi rin dag 'dod kyis ①ngas nyan thos rnams la rung bar bya bar chung ②zhig gnang bar bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blang ②bar bya zhing blangs nas kyang sbyin bdag de nyid la yid brten te bcang bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang dge slong gis zhal ta byed pa spro bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis zhal ta byed pa gang spro bar bya ba mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' ④ra ba pa'am/dge bsnyen spro ⑤bar bya ste/ kun dga' ra ba pa zhes bya ba ⑥ni rung ba ⑦byed pa'o / /dge bsnyen zhes bya ba ni gsum la skyabs su song ba bslab pa'i gzhi lnga bzung ba'o/ /dge slong dag yul gzhan du 'dong ba na de dag 'di na bdag cag la sbyin bdag 'ga' ⑤yang med do zhes 'gyod pa skyes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sbyin bdag de nyid ji srid du son ⑨pa dang /'dug pa dang / 'tsho ba dang / sdod pa'i bar du shin tu ring du song ⑩yang nyams pa med do/ /dge slong rnams kyis chos gos kyi rin dag rnyed la sbyin bdag med nas de dag 'gyod pa skyes te/ mi len pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blang bar 0bya zhing blangs nas kyang dge slong gi mdun du 'greng ste 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /8tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'di rnyed de/bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'di byin 6—350
