gyis brlab po/ /dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'dis dngos po rung ba ①bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du ②lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod par bya ste/'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis mtha' 'khob dag tu gtsug lag khang dag byed du bcug nas de na ③dus dang dus su skrag pa dag byung nas dge slong dag gis gtsug lag khang ④stong par bor te byer ro ⑤ma byin par len pa dag gis gtsug lag khang stong par rig nas gtsug lag khang bcom pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge 'dun bye'amanya/ mchod rten gyi dbyig dang gser sbas te ⑦'gro bar bya'o//bcom ldan 'das kyis sba bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang ⑧/ de dag gis gang gis sba bar bya ba 0mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun dga' ra ba pa'am/ dge bsnyen gyis sba bar bya'o/ /gang dag sbed par byed pa de dag nyid rku bar byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 4) stsal pa/dge bsnyen dad pa can gyis sba bar bya'o/ /dge bsnyen dad pa can med na dge tshul gyis sba bar bya'o/ /dge tshul med na dge slong dag gis rang gis sba bar bya'o / /de la dong brko yibar bya ba yod nas gang gis brko chubar bya ba mi shes nas bcom lda na 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' 6)ra ba pa'am/dge bsnyen 0gyis brko 8bar bya'o/ /de nyid rku ⑩bar byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge bsnyen dad pa can gyis brko bar bya'o/ /dge bsnyen dad pa can med na dge tshul gyis brko bar bya'o/ /dge tshul med na dge slong dag gis rang gis brko bar bya'o/ /'jigs pa dang bral na rnam pa de lta bu nyid kyis phyung ste dge 'dun la dbul bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag ngas 6—351

phongs pa'i dus dag tu gnang ba gang yin pa de bde ba'i gnas skabs dag tu spyad par mi bya ste/ spyod na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa ①dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /gser dngul rgyal reg pa'i spang ba ste bcwa brgyad pa rdzogs stol// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ba de'i tshe na thams cad du yul dbus su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byung ngo zhes sgra grags te/ de'i nyan thos rnams 'bar ba dang /gsal ba dang / char ④'bab pa dang / glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag byed pas gang dag de la mchod pa dag byed pa de dag ⑤ni shin tu 'bras bu che ba dang /phan yon che ba dang / gsal ba che ba dang / rgyas pa che bar 'gyur ro zhes byang lam pa'i tshong pa dag gis thos nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag yul dbus su 'dong ngo rjo/ /der khe spogs mang po yang bsgrub par bya/sangs rgyas dang / chos dang dge 'dun dag la mchod pa 0bya'o zhes byang lam pa'i tshong pa de dag zong thogs te/ yul ⑧dbus su 'phags nas mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin to/ /mnyan yod na shes pa can rtsis mkhas pa zhig 'dug pa des byang lam nas tshong pa don mthun 'ongs zhes thos nas des bsams pa/song ste je bltas ⑨na der cung zad 'thob po snyam yinas/ des cung zad dmigs pas kyang shes/ cung zad rtog ges yikyang shes nas de tsosong ste/6—352

ded dpon la ming dang rus nas brjod cing ming ①'di zhes bya ba 'ongs pa legs so 'ongs pa legs so/ /khyod kyi ma ni ming 'di zhes bya/ khyod kyi pha ni ②ming 'di zhes bya/ khyod kyi lardzas ni 'di snyed cig 'ongs so/ /nyi ma ga ge dumo zhig la ni khal 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /khe spogs ni 'di snyed cig 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang ded dpon des bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos gang dag 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bab pa dang /glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag ⑤byed ces grag dupa de dag las 'ga' zhig 'di yin gor ma chag snyam nas des de la dad pas byang lam gyi nags kyi 'bras bus slong phor bkang ste byin ⑦nas la ba srin bu'i mdog lta bu cig kyang bskon no/ /shes pa can des ⑧blangs shing gyon te tshangs pa ⑨mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi gan du song ba dang / de dag gis de mthong nas smras pa/ shes pa can khyod kyis mgo bzlog ste 0nyal ba gang zhig las thob des smras pa/ byang lam nas tshong pa don mthun 'ongs nas der kho bos ⑩ded dpon la ming dang rus nas brjod nas des kho bo la dad pas dad pa'i tsodabang du byas pa sbyin tsono/ /de dag gis smras pa/ shes pa can bdag cag la shākya'i ④bu'i dge sbyong de dag rtag tu khyed tsol thag pa dag dang phreng rgyud dag dang / 'bru mar mkhan dag las gzhan pa mi gtso bo 'ga' yang mngon par dad par mi byed do zhes tho ⑩'tsham par byed kyisabya/ khyod tsol ba 'di gyon te song la shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong de dag gi snying dag gas ⑩par gyis shig de ltar bya'o zhes smras te/ de nas shes pa can de la ba de gyon nas rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ngo / /drug sde dag gis ⑥kun tu spyod pa ni 'dir bdag cag gis bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ongs pa rnams la 6—353

yang chos bstan par bya/ rgol ba dag kyang tshar gcad ①par bya/ rang gi grags pa yang bsgrag ②par bya'o snyam pas drug sde las gang yang rung bas rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo stong par mi 'jog pas nye dga' rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na 'chag cing 'dug pa des shes pa can de thag ring po kho na nas mthong ngo de nas nye dga'as bsams pa/ gcer bu pa ngan pa 'di la ba bzang po zhig gyon te 'ongs kyis chagal te bdag gis de ma phrogs ④na nye dga' zhes bya ba'i ming mi gzung ngo snyam nas/ des de la smras pa/ shes pa can khyod ⑤gcer bu pa yin la la ba 'di lta bu gyon na phyir babs sam ci kho bo phyir ma babs te/'di ltar byang lam nas tshong pa don mthun 'ongs nas der kho bos ded dpon la ming dang rus nas ⑥brjod nas des kho bo la dad pas dad pa'i dbang du byas pa byin ⑦rna/ /ma legs so ma legs so/ /khyed ⑤kyis rgas pa'i gnas skabs su tshul khrims 'chal pa kun tu spyad 0do/ /tshur 0shog 'dug shig dang chos bstan par bya'o/ /shes pa can de nye dga'i mdun du 'dug pa dang / nye dga' yiyid dga' zhing yid dga' nas 8de la sbyin pa'i bsngags pa brjod par brtsams so/ /drug sde dag gi kun tu spyod pa ni gal te tshul khrims kyi gtam dag byed na nyan pa po dag bdag cag lha rnams su skyes so snyam du sems la/gal te sbyin pa'i gtam dag byed na nyan pa po dag tsorang gi sha gang yin pa de yang bcad cing byabacad cing sbyin par bya'o snyam du sems so/ /gal te ngan song gi gtam dag byed na nyan pa po dag bdag cag ngan song rnams su skyes so snyam du sems par 'gyur ba yin pas/ nye dga'as shes pa can de la smras pa/shes pa can khyod kyi ston pa ni ngan pa la mos pa yin te/ gal te de bzang po 6—354

'dod par gyur na des khyed cag la gos 'bum ri ba dang / zas ro brgya ①dang ldan pa dang / khang pa brtsegs pa mig lnga brgya pa yang gnang bar 'gyur ba zhig ma ②gnang ngo / /kho bo cag gi ston pa ni bzang po la mos pa yin pas/ des kho bo cag la gos 'bum ri ba dang / zas ro brgya dang ldan pa dang / khang pa brtsegs pa mig lnga brgya pa yang gnang ngo / /gal te khyod la ba 'di lta bu gyon te slong ②mo la 'gro bar gyur na bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis shes pa can 'dis tshul khrims 'chal pa kun tu spyad 0do snyam du shes pas khyed kyis slong ⑤me yang mi rnyed par gyur gyisaX/ khyod kyi ⑦la ba 'di kho bo la byin cig dang / kho bos khyod la la ba gzhan zhig sbyin no/ /kho bo la ba 'di gyon te ⑧bsod snyoms la 'jug pa na/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis kho bo mthong nas btsun pa nye dga'as la ba 'di lta bu 0ga las rnyed ces zer na/kho bos de dag la 'di skad ces shes pa can che ge mo zhig gis byin no zhes brjod par bya ste/ des na de dag gis shes pa can dad pa dang ldan par gyur to snyam du shes par 'gyur zhing / de dag gis khyod slong tsomo la zhugs pa la chang dang nur rtsi'i 7slong phor bkang ste tsosbyin par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ btsun pa nye dga' bzhes shig /nye dga'as smras pa/ shes pa can khyod kyi tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dag ni tshul khrims 'chal pa yin pas/ khyod de dag gi tshig thos nas yang phyir 'phrog tu 'ong bar gyur pa 8de lta bu'i gnas yod do/ /btsun pa nye dga' ci kho bo'i la ba 'di tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa de dag dbang ba ④yin nam/ la ba 'di ni kho bo nyid dbang ba yin gyis tsobazhes shig dang / slar tso'aphrog tu mi mchis so0/ /nye dga'as la ba de blangs nas la 6—355

ba rtsub po nyugazhan zhig de la byine nas ⑤shes pa can de la ba lartsub po de gyon nas tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi gan du phyir song ba dang / de dag gis de mthong nas smras pa/ shes pa can khyod kyis 0yang mgo bsgyur de 0nyal ba gang zhig las thob/ des smras pa/ 'di ni glo gzhan nas grub pa yin no/ /ji ltar gyur/ kho bos la ba de btsun pa nye dga' la byin nas des kyang kho bo la rjol ba 'di byin no⑦/ /de dag gis spyos te smras pa/ shes pa can shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong ⑧rnams ni yu bu cag gson pas kyang mi dga' ba yin no/ /drug sde dag ji lta bar ⑨gzhan de lta ma yin la/ nye dga' ji lta bar drug sde gzhan de lta ma yin no/ /gal te khyod kyis dge slong gnas brtan gzhan 'ga' zhig la byin ⑩par gyur na kho bo cag kyang rjes su yi khyarang bar byed na khyod kyis nye dga' la byin te/ de ni bdag cag las zong gis kyang khrag 8gi phyis bu len par 'dod pa yin gyisaX/ gal te la ba khyer te 'ong na de lta na legs/ gal te khyer te mi 'ong na kho bo cag gis khyod tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i nang nas gnas nas byadabyung bar bya zhing / tshul shing yang dbyung bar bya/ spang leb khri'u 8yang bsgyur skyabar bya/ slong phor yang khas dbub par bya/ khar ⑩ba yang dor bar bya'o/ /de skrag nas nye dga' ga la ba der song ba dang nye dga'as thag ring po kho na nas de 'ong ba mthong nas des tsobasams pa/ shes pa can 'gros 'di lta bus 'ong ba 'di ni bdag gi la ba 'phrog ⑥par byed pa yin no ⑥snyam nas de gtsug lag khang gi nang du zhugs nas sgo bcad de 'dug go/ /shes pa can des sgo ⑥brdung bar brtsams te btsun pa nye dga' phyobatsun pa nye dga' zhes bos pa dang nye dga' cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /dge slong rnams kyis de 6—356

la smras ①pa/ shes pa can khyod la btsun pa nye dga'as ci bya/ des smras pa/des kho bo'i ②la ba zhig khyer ro/ /shes pa can gal te khyod la ba 'dod na song la bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su sgrubs ②shig /de bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis shes pa can de thag ring po kho na nas 'ong ba gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag khyed shes pa can thag ring po kho na nas 'ong ba la ltos shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal/ 'di ni la ba'i phyir 'ongs te/ gal te la ba thob na de lta na legs gal te ma thob na khrag tsha ba skyugs te dus byed par 'gyur ro / /de nas shes pa can de phyin dunas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das btsun pa nye dga'as bdag gi la ba du'atshal ba de bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la slar stsal du gsol cig /gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la la ba slar stsal du ma stsal na/ 'di ltar bdag tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i dunang nas gnas nas 0phyung bar 'gyur zhing tshul shing yang phyung bar gyural/ spang leb khri'u yang bsgyur ⑨bar 'gyur/ slong phor yang khas phub par 'gyur/ khar ⑩ba yang bor bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la nye dga'i gan du song ste/ shes pa can gyi la ba phyir byin cig /gal te mi byin yin shes pa can 'di khrag tsha ba skyugs te dus byed par 'gyur ba'i gnas de lta bu yod do zhes gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas nye dga' ga la ba der song ba dang / nye dga'as tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo thag ring 6—357

po kho na nas 'ong ba mthong nas des bsams pa/ shes pa can gyi ①so nya 'di lta bu khrid de 'ongs ②pas 'dis kho bo'i la ba phrogs ②par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos nye dga' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shes pa can gyi la ba phyir byin cig /gal te 'di'i dul ba phyir myur bar ⑤ma byin na shes pa can 'di khrag tsha ba skyugs te dus byed par 'gyur ba'i gnas de lta bu yod par 'gyur ro zhes byung ngo / /nye dga'as smras pa/ btsun pa kun dga' bo ston pa'i bka' mnyan par zad kyi / gzhan du na sgre byi gcer bu 'di khrag tsha ba skyugs te dus byed par 'gyur ba bas gal te shes pa can sha stag gis 'dzam bu'i gling 'di lta ste/ dper na bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ 'dam bu'i tshal lam/ 'od ma'i tshal bzhin du gang bar gyur la de dag thams cad khrag tsha ba skyugs te kha dag 0cing dus byed par gyur kyang nye dga'i spu'i rtse mo tsam yang mi g.yo ste༅/ 'on kyang bzhud cig dang sbyin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo song ba dang nye dga'as smras pa/kwa'i ⑧gcer bu pa nyon cig khyod kyis ston pa brdzun ⑨ma des brdzun du smra bas 'jig rten bslus nas sems can dmyal ba rnams su skyes te/ de'i lce la thong gshol lnga brgyas med par byed na/ khyed 0kyang de bas kyang brdzun ⑩ma chen po ⑫yin pas khyed ⑩kyi lce la yang thong gshol ④stong gis rmo bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang kho bo'i la ba khyod kyis spyod na/ ci kho bos kyang khyod kyi la ba spyad snyam mam8/btsun pa nye dga' skyam lags so/ /nye dga'as ⑩de'i la ba des mdoms 8kyi phyogs thams cad phyis yinas bzhi ltab 0tu bltab ste/ lag pa g.yon po'i steng du bzhag nas lag pa g.yas pas thal lcag gis 0bsnun pa dang rim pa thams 6—358

cad rdol bar gyur nas smras pa/ shes pa can lag pa gnyis rkyong ①shig /des lag pa gnyis brkyang ②ba dang / nye dga'as gang gis de khas bub tu 'gyel ⑧bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i shugs kyis la ba lag tu byin ༷pa dang / de khas bub tu 'gyel ⑤nas nye dga'as rdog pas bsnun te smras pa/ gcer bu pa sgre byi gtsug lag khang sla tsas ma gtal ⑥bar song shig /btsun pa nye dga' ⑦gal te ma gum na mchi stedu/ slan chad rgyal byed kyi tshal du mi mchi'o/ /de ni re zhig ⑨byung ba yin gyi/ sangs rgyas ⑩bcom ldan 'das re zhig yi'adul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi tshubaslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' 'bar ni mi ④mdzad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra tsob na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong drug sde dag mngon mtshan can gyis 0spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed de⑩/ kun tu sbyor bar byed/ rab tu sbyor bar byed/ bun 'gyed par byed/ skyed tso'agyed par byed / byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang / byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa dang / ma byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang / ma byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed do/ /ji ltar kun du sbyor bar byed ce na/ kun du rtsom par byed/ yul tshol bar byed/ shing rta sogs ⑩par byed/ yul du ⑥ 'gro ba'i rdzas shom par byed/le'u pa dang / gro ba ⑥dang / snag tsha dang / smyu chagu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed de/ de ltar kun du sbyor bar byed do/ /ji ltar rab tu sbyor bar byed ce na/ brgyad ⑥shas dang / bcu shas dang / bcu gnyis 3shas kyi phyir dbang po dang / gro ba chadang / snag tsha dang / smyu phyagu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed de / de ltar rab tu sbyor bar byed do/ /ji ltar bun 'gyed 96—359

par byed ce na/ nas dang 'bru rnying ①pa gser phye dang nye sde'i phyir gtong ba dang / gzhal ba'i snod dang / bre'u chung sridang / phul dang gro ba ③dang /snag tsha dang / sgyu sgrogu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed deX/ de ltar bun 'gyed par byed doX/ /ji ltar skyed 'gyed par byed ce na/ dung gi tshogs kyi phyir nor bu'i tshogs gtong bar byed pa dang / nor bu'i tshogs kyi phyir mu tig gi tshogs gtong bar byed pa dang / mu tig gi ④tshogs kyi phyir bai ḍūr+ya'i ⑧tshogs gtong bar byed cing / dbang po dang / gro ba ⑨dang / snag tsha dang /sgyu 0gu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed deyi/ de ltar skyed 'gyed par byed do/ /ji ltar byas pa'i phyir byas pa gtong tsobar byed ce na/ gser mngon mtshan can gyi phyir mngon mtshan can gtong bar byed de0/ de ltar byas pa'i phyir byas pa gtong bar byed do/ /ji ltar byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed ce na/ gser mngon mtshan can gyi phyir mngon mtshan can ④med pa gtong bar byed deX/ de ltar byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong tsobar byed do/ /ji ltar ma byas pa'i phyir byas pa gtong bar byed ce na/ gser mngon mtshan can ma yin pa'i phyir mngon mtshan can gtong bar byed de⑩/ de ltar ma byas pa'i phyir byas pa gtong bar byed do/ /⑩ji ltar ma byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed ce na/ gser mngon mtshan can ma yin pa'i phyir mngon mtshan can ma yin par yigatong bar byed de/ de ltar ma byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed do/ /gzhan mu stegs can dag shes ldan dag shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams ni ma log ma spangs so sor ma spangs pa yin te/ 'di ltar mngon mtshan can gyis 0spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed de/ kun du sbyor bar byed/6—360

rab tu sbyor bar byed/ bun 'gyed par byed/ skyed 'gyed par byed①/ byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang / byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa dang ma byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang ma byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed do②/ /bram ze dang /khyim bdag rnams kyang mngon mtshan can gyis ⑧spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed de/kun du sbyor bar 0byed/ rab tu sbyor bar byed/ bun 'gyed par byed/skyed 'gyed par byed/ byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang / byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa dang ma byas pa'i phyir byas pa dang / ma byas pa'i phyir ma byas pa gtong bar byed na shes ldan dag shākya'i bu'i rjodage sbyong rnams dang bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams la bye brag ni ༅ci yod/ bsam pa ni ci yod/ tha dad du bya ba ni ⑦ci yod/ su zhig dge sbyong mgo reg 'di dag la bsod snyoms sbyin pa dang ⑧bya bar sems zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka ⑨gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 0kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di skyedang /skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa ⑩snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong drug sde dag la mas ⑩pa/ dge slong dag khyed mngon mtshan can gyis ④spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa8/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no/ /zhes rnam par smad pa ⑩mdzad do/ /6—361

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang mngon mtshan can gyis ①spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni drug sde dag gamasno/ gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o / /mngon mtshan can gyis ②spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs zhes bya ba ni rnam pa du ma'o/ /byed na zhes bya ba ni kun du sbyor bar ⑤byed pa dang / rab tu sbyor bar byed pa dang / bun 'gyed par byed pa dang / skyed 'gyed par byed pa lhag par spyod par ⑤byed na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ⑥ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar ⑦ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis rnyed pa 'dod pas yul gyi tha snyad kyi zong kun du sbyor bar byed cing /de de la shing rta dang glang dang 0gla mi dang / dpang po dang / gro ba ⑨dang /snag tsha dang / sgyu 0gu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed de/ sho gam dang la gcan yidang gru btsas sbyin par byed na ji srid du rnyed pa dag 'badag gir 0mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rnyed pa bdag gir byed pa tson spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis rnyed pa 'dod pas dbyig gam/gser rab tu sbyor bar byed cing / de de la dpang po dang / gro ba tsodang snag tsha dang / smyu 0gu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed na ji srid du rnyed pa 6—362

bdag gir ①mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rnyed pa dag ②bdag gir byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ③rnyed pa 'dod pas nas dang / 'bru'i bun 'gyed par byed cing / de de la gzhal blugs ④dang / bre'u chung dudang / phul dang / dpang po dang / gro ba dudang /snag tsha dang / smyu ⑦ku dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed na ji srid du rnyed pa bdag gir mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rnyed pa bdag gir byed pa dun spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ⑨rnyed pa 'dod pas dung gi tshogs kyi phyir nor bu'i tshogs gtong bar byed pa dang / nor bu'i tshogs kyi phyir mu tig gi tshogs gtong bar byed pa dang / mu tig gi tshogs kyi phyir be+e ḍūr+ya'i 0tshogs gtong bar byed cing / de de la dpang po dang / gro ba ⑩dang / snag tsha dang / smyu 'gu dang / yi ge pa tshol bar byed na/ ji srid du rnyed pa bdag gir mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rnyed pa bdag gir byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro zhes de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar mdzad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na 8spre'u rdzing gi 'gram na khang pa brtsegs pa'i khang bzangs na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na yangs pa can pa'i lits+tsha bī dag gis tsokhang pa dag ⑩drug rtseg ⑩dang bdun rtseg tu ⑦byed do/ /yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī 8rnams kyi khang pa ji lta ba de bzhin du gtsug lag khang dag kyang drug rtseg dang bdun rtseg tu 7byed pas de dag mtho ches pas brtsigs ⑥shing brtsigs shing rdib nas sbyin bdag dag gis bsams pa/ bdag cag gson zhing 'dug ste/ 'tsho zhing sdod pa rnams kyi gtsug lag khang dag kyang 6—363

'di ltar 'jig na shi ba rnams kyi ji ltar 'gyur/ bdag cag gis mkhar len ①gyi rgyur dge 'dun la mi zad pa dbul ②bar bya'o snyam nas de dag mi zad pa thogs te chadage slong rnams kyi gan du dong ༷nas phyin pa dang / dge slong rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa dag dumakhar len ⑥gyi slad du mi zad pa 'di rgyadag bzhes shig dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar ⑧mdzad pas bdag cag mi len to zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi phyir mkhar len 0gyi rgyu mi zad par blang bar ⑩bya'o/ /gzhan yang dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang ni sum rtseg tu ⑩bya'o dge slong ma'i dge 'dun gyi dbyar khang ni nyis rtseg tu tsobya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas mi zad pa blangs nas dge 'dun gyi mdzod du bcug ste bzhag go/ /sbyin bdag dag tso'ongs te smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ci'i 8slad du gtsug lag khang gi mkhar len tsomi bgyid kār ṣā ⑩pa ṇa dag med do/ /'o na bdag cag ⑦gis khyed la mi zad pa dag ma phul lam/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ ci kho bo cag gis mi zad pa dag zos snyam 'amatso/ dge 'dun gyi tsomadzod na 'dug go/ /'phags pa dag de lta dun mi zad par mi 'gyur gyi 'di ltar zad par 'gyur te ci bdag cag gi sdum pa na gnas ma mchis snyam 'am0 / ci'i slad du rab tu sbyor bar dumi mdzad/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba 3mdzad pas bdag cag rab tu sbyor bar mi byed chado zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 6—364

'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi phyir mkhar len ①gyi rgyu mi zad pa rab tu sbyor bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du bram ze dang / khyim bdag dad pa can dag sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /dge 'dun gyi phyir mi zad pa 'bul nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun gyi phyir mi zad pa rab tu sbyor bar ②bya zhing de las skyed gang grub pa des sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /dge 'dun la mchod par bya'o/ /de dag gis de dag nyid la byin nas de dag la 'das ②pa na rtsod par byed cing / 'phags pa dag ci'i phyir bdag nyid kyi nor las rtsod pa byung zhes zer ba'i skabs de khyodage slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag la sbyin par mi bya'o/ /de dag gis phyug po dag la byin ⑤nas/ de dag la 'das ⑥pa na mthu dang ldan pa la rten cing ⑦mi ster ba dang / bla'i grwa'i mthus mi ster nas ⑧bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag la sbyin par mi bya'o / /de dag gis dbul po rnams la byin nas de dag gis kyang 'jal mi nus nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ gta' nyi rir blangs te ⑨dpang po dang bcas pa'i dam rgya'i glegs bu bris te sbyin par bya'o/ /glegs bu de la yang lo dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan dang / dge skos dang / len pa po dang / rdzas dang / skyed rnams kyi ming bri bar bya'o/ /gang la sbyin par bya ba dge bsnyen dad pa can bslab pa'i gzhi lnga bzung ba la yang gta' nyi ri kho ⑩nas sbyin par bya'o/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang ⑩/ tshor ba dag gis 6—365

nyen pa la ltung ①ba med do/ /mngon mtshan can gyis ②spyod pa'i spang ba ste bcu dgu pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod ③na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong drug sde dag nyo 'tshong ④rnam pa sna tshogs byed de/ len ⑤par byed/ gtong bar byed/nyo bar byed/ 'tshong ⑥bar byed do/ /ji ltar len par byed ce na/ gang gi tshe ljongs su lo legs shing grong khyer du lo nyes pa de'i tshe na ljongs ⑦nas grong khyer du len par byed del/ de ltar len par byed do/ /⑨ji ltar gtong bar byed ce na/ gang gi tshe grong khyer du lo legs shing ljongs su lo nyes pa de'i tshe na grong khyer nas ljongs su gtong bar byed de/ de ltar gtong bar byed do/ /ji ⑩ltar nyo bar byed ce na/ gang gi tshe rin chung ba de'i tshe na nyo bar byed de/ de ltar nyo bar byed do/ /ji ltar 'tshong ⑩bar byed ce na/ gang gi tshe tsorin che ba de'i tshe na 'tshong 'bar byed de/ de ltar 'tshong tsobar byed do/ /gzhan mu stegs can dag shes ldan dag shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams ni ma log ma spangs so sor ma spangs pa yin te/ 'di ltar nyo 'tshong (sternam pa sna tshogs byed de/len par byed/ gtong bar byed/ nyo bar byed/ 'tshong skyabar byed cing bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyang nyo 'tshong ⑩rnam pa sna tsotshogs byed de/len par byed/ gtong bar byed/ nyo bar byed/ 'tshong ⑩bar byed na shākya'i bu'i byadage sbyong rnams dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag 'di dag ⑥la bye brag ni ci yod/ bsam pa ni ci yod/ tha dad du bya ba ni ci yod/ su 6—366

zhig dge sbyong mgo reg 'di dag la bsod snyoms sbyin pa dang ①bya bar sems zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka rgyagatong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du med par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang ③snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong drug sde dag la rmas dupa/ dge slong dag khyed nyo 'tshong ⑤rnam pa sna tshogs byed de/ len par byed/ gtong bar byed/ nyo bar byed/'tshong ⑥bar byed pa bden namakhye/ btsun pa mad ⑧do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad par ⑨mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ⑩bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa ⑩snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang ⑩nyo 'tshong tsornam pa sna tshogs byed na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni drug sde dag gam/gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /nyo 'tshong tsornam pa sna tshogs zhes bya ba ni rnam pa mang po'o/ /byed na zhes bya ba ni len par byed pa dang / gtong bar 6—367

byed pa dang / nyo bar byed pa dang / 'tshong ①bar byed pa dag lhag par spyod par byed na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de ②spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ②ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar ⑦ji ltar 'gyur ⑤zhe yin/ dge slong gis rnyed pa 'dod pas nyo bar byed/ 'tshong ⑦bar byed na 0nyo bar byed pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ 'tshong 0ba la spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis rnyed pa 'dod pas nyo bar byed cing rnyed pa mi 'dod pas 'tshong ⑩bar byed na/nyo bar byed ⑩pa rtsal nyes byas su 'gyur la/ 'tshong tshubar byed pa la ltung ba med dol/ /dge slong gis rnyed pa mi 'dod pas nyo bar byed cing rnyed pa 'dod pas 'tshong ④bar byed na nyo bar byed pa la ltung ba med la/ 'tshong ④bar byed pa la spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis rnyed pa mi 'dod pas nyo bar byed cing rnyed pa mi 'dod pas 'tshong ⑩bar byed na gnyis ka cil ltung ba med do//yul gzhan gyi sbyor bas snga ma'i rgyud sbyong bar byed pa la ltung ba med do zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba mdzad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na spre'u rdzing gi 'gram na khang pa brtsegs pa'i khang bzangs na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na byang lam pa'i tshong pa lam gyi bgrod par zhugs pa dag gis gtsug lag khang rta babs mthon po dang ldan pa/ skar khung dang ⑫/ skar khung dra yib can dang / lan kun gyis brgyan pa/ mig dang snying 'phrog pa ⑥ mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa dag mthong nas de dag dad par gyur te/ de dag gtsug lag khang du dong nas dge 6—368

slong rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa dag bdag cag gis dge 'dun la mchod ston bgyi'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ mchod ston gyi yo byad dag khyer te sheg ①shig /de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag blo ③bur du lhags ③pa dag lags te/ 'di ltar bdag cag rin 'bul gyis dukhyed kyis 'bras dag stsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba mdzad pas bdag cag 'bras dag mi 'tshong ⑤ngo zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de ltar mi bya bar 'di ltar gang dag rjodage 'dun gyi phyir mchod ston byed pa de la rin gyis 'bras sbyin par bya'o/ /dge slong dag ri ba kho na sbyin ⑦nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gtsug lag khang de nyid du mchod ston byed pa de la 'theb dang bcas pa sbyin par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rin gyis 'bras sbyin par bya'o zhes bca' ba ⑧mdzad pas mang po dag mchod ston byed nas thams cad la byin na ⑨'bras dag spyad pas spyi bungs chad par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ltar mi bya bar 'di ltar rin des 'bras gzhan dag nyo bar bya'o/ /'bras rnying ⑩pa dag kyang so sor brtags nas gal te srog chags med na dus su btsongs te 'bras sar skyepas bang ba dag dgang bar bya'o/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang /tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /nyo 'tshong 8byed pa'i spang ba ste nyi shu pa rdzogs sto// //6—369

sdom la/ lhung bzed gnyis dang tha ga gnyis/ /byin 'phrog ston zla tha chungs ①dang / /dgon pa pa dang ras chen dang / /bsngos pa dang ni gsog ②'jog go/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi ②tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na rjobazhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di dag thams cad khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bslab 0pa'i gzhi dag gis khyab par byas pas phyin cad dugang nas kyang rnyed pa bslang bar ⑦mi nus so snyam nas de de snyam sems pa na dga' 'dun drug bcu skyed ②mos tshal du dong ba de dag nye dga'as mthong ngo /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te 'di dag las rnyed pa ma grub na nye dga' zhes bya ba'i ming gzung bar mi bya'o snyam mo/ /drug sde dag gi kun du ⑨spyod pa ni gal te sbyin pa'i gtam dag byed na nyan pa po dag bdag cag gis rang gi sha dag bcad cing bcad cing sbyin par bya'o snyam du sems la/ gal te tshul khrims kyi gtam dag byed na nyan pa po dag bdag cag lha rnams kyi nang du skyes so snyam du sems so/ /gal te ngan song gi gtam dag byed na nyan pa po dag bdag cag ngan song rnams su skyes so snyam du sems pa yin pas des lhung bzed gsal ba/ zlum pa longs spyad par bzod pa mchan khung gis khyer te dga' 'dun de dag ga la ba der song ⑩ste phyin nas dga' 'dun pa gcig la ci nas kyang de'i sems mngon par dad par 'gyur ba de ltar sbyin pa'i gtam byas nas de ⑩sems dad par gyur te smras pa/ 'phags pa ci'i slad du byon⑩/ nye dga'as smras pa/ bzhin bzangs bdag la lhung bzed dgos so/ /'phags pa bdag la lhung bzed ma mchis te gal te rin gyis rnyed na bdag gis 6—370

mjal ①te gsol lo/ /nye dga'as lhung bzed mchan khung nas phyung ste de la bstan nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs lhung bzed 'di yang rin gyis rnyed pa yin no/ /'phags pa 'di'i rin ji ⑤tsam/ kār ṣā pa ṇa drug bcu'o/ /bdag gis 'di'i rin kār ṣā pa ṇa drug bcu ni'abul lo/ /bzhin bzangs a rog gya mede dag khyod kyir ༷gyur cig /sbyin pa 'dis khyod 0sems kyi rgyan dang /sems kyi yo byad dang / rnal 'byor gyi tshogs dang / don gyi ⑦mchog 'thob ⑧pa dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du snod du 'gyur bar gyur cig /de bzhin du de ⑨des dga' 'dun drug bcu tsopo dag re re yang kār ṣā pa ṇa drug bcu drug bcu 0sbyor du bcug ste sbyor du bcug tsonas song ngo / /dga' 'dun de dag thams cad gcig tu 'dus par gyur nas de na dga' 'dun gcig gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bos btsun pa nye dga' shākya'i rigs las rab tu byung ba chos sgrog pa rig 0pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pa la lhung bzed kyi rin du kār ṣā pa ṇa drug bcu phul gyis ④rjes su yi rang bar gyis shig /gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ kho bos kyang phul lo/ /yang gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ kho bos kyang phul lo/ /de bzhin du thams cad kyis kho bos kyang phul lo/ /kho bos kyang phul lo zhes smras nas de dag phan tshun blta bar brtsams te/ shes ldan dag dge slong gcig la lhung bzed du dgos zhes de dag gis dge slong zhig la dris pa/ 'phags pa dge slong gcig la lhung bzed du 'tshal/ des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag gcig kho na dgos so/ /de dag gis shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams ni rnyed pa 'dod pas zil gyis gnon 8pa dag yin no zhes smad par brtsams so/ /de ni re zhig byung ba ⑦yin gyi sangs rgyas bcom 6—371

ldan 'das re zhig ①'dul ba la ②nyan thos rnams kyi ①bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' bar ni 0mi mdzad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong drug sde dag lhung bzed rnyed do cog gsog ⑤par byed cing bdag nyid kyang spyod par mi byed/dge slong gzhan dag la yang sbyin par mi byed nas dge slong don nyung ༷ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag lhung bzed rnyed do cog gsog ⑦par byed cing bdag nyid kyang spyod par mi byed/ dge slong gzhan dag la yang sbyin par mi byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ⑧ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du med par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong drug sde dag la rmas ⑨pa/ dge slong dag khyed lhung bzed rnyed do cog sogs ⑩par byed cing bdag nyid 0kyang spyod par mi byed/ dge slong gzhan dag la yang sbyin par mi byed pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul dang mthun pa ⑩ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa skemadzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' 6—372

stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la ①sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong gis ②lhung bzed lhag pa zhag bcu'i bar du bcang bar bya'o/ /de las 'das par 'chang na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /dge slong gis zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pas so/ /lhung bzed lhag pa zhes bya ba ni byin gyis brlab par bya ba las lhag pa'o/ /zhag bcu'i bar du zhes bya ba ni nyin mtshan bcu'i mtha'i bar du'o/ /bcang bar bya'o zhes bya ba ni bdag gir bya'o/ /de las 'das par 'chang na zhes bya ba ni de las thal bar 'chang ba'o③/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs sol/ /de la ltung bar ⑤ji ltar 'gyur zhe na 'di lta ste/ dge slong gis tshes la lhung bzed rnyed na dge slong des lhung bzed de zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang ༷du byin gyis brlab ⑦par bya ba'am/ gtang bar bya ba'am/⑧ rnam par brtag ⑨par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rnam par rtog ⑫ par mi byed dam/gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshes la lhung bzed ma rnyed kyang tshes gnyis sam/tshes gsum mam/ tshes dgu'am/ tshes bcu tshun chad kyis 7lhung bzed rnyed na dge slong des lhung bzed de zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab ⑫par bya ba'am/ gtang 8bar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/6—373

gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rnam par rtog par mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar ba ①na spang ba'i lhung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis 0tshes la lhung bzed cig ③rnyed cing des tshes gnyis la yang gzhan zhig rnyed na dge slong des zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du snga ma byin gyis brlab par bya zhing phyi ma gtang dubar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /yang na phyi ma byin gyis brlab ⑤par bya zhing snga ma gtang dubar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam gtong bar mi byed dam rnam par rtog par mi byed dam/gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i nyung byed du 'gyur ro/ tshes dang / tshes gnyis la ma rnyed kyang tshes gsum dang tshes bcu tshun chad kyi ②lhung bzed cig rnyed na dge slong des zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du snga ma byin gyis brlab ⑧par bya zhing phyi ma gtang ⑨bar bya ba'am/rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /yang na phyi ma byin gyis brlab par bya zhing snga ma gtang ⑩bar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam gtong bar mi byed dam/ rnam par rtog par mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis tshes la lhung bzed gnyis rnyed na dge slong des lhung bzed de gnyis zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am/ gtang ⑩bar bya ba'am / rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin 6—374

gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rnam par rtog par mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshes la lhung bzed gnyis ma rnyed kyang tshes gnyis sam/ tshes gsum mamal/ tshes dgu'am/ tshes bcu tshun chad kyis lhung bzed gnyis rnyed na dge slong des lhung bzed de ②gnyis zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am/ gtang ②bar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis brlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rnam par rtog par mi byed dam gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /⑤dge slong gis tshes la lhung bzed gnyis shig rnyed cing des tshes gnyis la ༅lhung bzed gzhan gnyis shig ༅rnyed na dge slong des zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du snga ma gnyis byin gyis brlab par bya zhing phyi ma gnyis gtang ⑧bar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /yang na 0phyi ma gnyis byin gyis brlab par bya zhing snga ma gnyis gtang skyabar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o / /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rnam par rtog par mi byed dam/ yigazhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na 8spang ba'i ltung 'byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshes dang / tshes gnyis la ma rnyed kyang tshes gsum dang / tshes bcu tshun chad kyis lhung bzed gnyis shig rnyed na dge slong des zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du snga ma gnyis byin gyis brlab 8par bya zhing phyi ma gnyis gtang tsobar bya ba'am/ rnam par 6—375

brtag par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /yang na phyi ma gnyis byin gyis brlab ①par bya zhing snga ma gnyis gtang ②bar bya ③ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'oX/ /byin gyis rlob ⑤par mi byed dam/gtong bar mi byed dam/ rnam par rtog par mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis tshes la lhung bzed mang po rnyed na dge slong des lhung bzed 0de dag zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am/gtang rgyabar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'amadu/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/rnam par tog ⑨par mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi 0byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshes la lhung bzed mang po ma rnyed kyang tshes gnyis sam/ tshes gsum mam/ tshes dgu'am/tshes bcu tshun chad kyis lhung bzed mang po rnyed na dge slong des lhung bzed de zhag bcu po de nyid kyi yinang du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'am/ gtang chabar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/ rnam par rtog par mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis tshes la lhung bzed mang po dag cig rnyed cing des tshes gnyis la yang gzhan mang po dag cig rnyed na dge slong des zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du snga ma dag byin gyis brlab par bya zhing phyi ma dag gtang tho)bar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/6—376

gzhan ①la sbyin par bya'o/ /yang na ②phyi ma dag byin ③gyis brlab par bya zhing snga ma dag gtang dubar bya ba'amaX/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/ gtong bar mi byed dam/rnam par rtog ①par mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /tshes dang /tshes gnyis la ma rnyed kyang tshes gsum dang / tshes bcu tshun chad kyis lhung bzed mang po dag cig rnyed na dge slong des zhag bcu po de nyid kyi nang du snga ma dag byin gyis brlab par bya zhing phyi ma dag gtang ⑦bar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag par bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /yang na phyi ma dag byin gyis brlab par bya zhing snga ma dag gtang ⑧bar bya ba'am/ rnam par brtag ⑨par bya ba'am / gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /byin gyis rlob par mi byed dam/gtong bar mi 0byed dam/ rnam par rtog ⑩par mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i lhung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi lhung bzad spang bar gyur na de ma 8spangs shing bral ⑫bar ma byas la ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig rnyed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi 0lhung bzed spang bar gyur na/ de ⑫spangs shing bral bar ma ⑩byas la/ ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig ༅rnyed na/de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi ②lhung bzed spang bar gyur na 8de spangs shing bral bar byas la ltung ba ma bshags par gzhan zhig chayirnyed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi 0 lhung bzed spang bar gyur na de spangs shing bral bar byas la/ ltung ba ⑥bshags nas gzhan 6—377

zhig rnyed na de la ltung ba med do/ /de bzhin du dge slong gis ji srid du spang ba'i dngos po de ①ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags par lhung bzed dam/chos gos sam/ dra ba'am/ phor bu'am/ ska rags sam/ dge sbyong gi 'tsho ba'i yo ②byad gang yang ①rung ba gzhan nye bar 'jog par byed na de yang snga ma'i rgyud kyis spang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhung bzed chung ngu dang / lhung bzed skya ba dang / lhung bzed che ba dang / lhung bzed ma tshos pa 'chang ba la ltung ba med do/ /rab tu 'byung ba la ④nyos pa'i don du lhung bzed 'chang ba la duthams cad du ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa ⑥dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /lhung bzed 'chang ba'i spang ba ste nyi shu gcig pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na spos 'tshong ⑦gi khye'u zhig 'dug pa des lhung bzed shin du gsal ba/ dbyibs legs pa/longs spyad ⑧par bzod pa zhig rnyed do/ /bsod snyoms pa zhig kyang snga dro sham ⑨thabs bgos lhung bzed dang / chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs nas des bsod snyoms brgyus 0te sung du phyin pa dang / spos 'tshong yigi khye'u des de mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gis lhung bzed shin du gsal ba/ dbyibs legs pa/ longs spyad 8par bzod pa zhig rnyed kyis tsogal te bzhed na snoms shig bzhin bzangs ④bdag la lhung bzed yod do//'phags pa gal te dge slong gzhan 'ga' zhig lhung bzed 'tshal ba mchis na de 6—378

gtang ①du gsol/ gtang ②bar bya'o/ /de nas bsod snyoms pa des mnyan yod du ③bsod snyoms la brgyus dunas rgyal byed kyi tshal du ⑤song ste/ des zan zos nas lhung bzed 'khru ba na dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag srang ga ge ༷mo zhig na spos 'tshong ⑦gi khye'u zhig 'dug pa des lhung bzed shin du gsal ba/ dbyibs legs pa/ longs spyad ⑧par bzod pa zhig rnyed kyis ⑨khyed cag las gang lhung bzed 'dod pa de song shig /de dang ha cang thag mi ring ba na nye dga' 'dug pa des thos nas des bsams pa/ de 0lhung bzed nag po can 'ga' zhig gis thos nas rab tu rgyug par gyur na mi rung gis 0smad par bya'o snyam nas des de la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod dad pas byin pa zos nas lhung bzed kyi gtam dang / chos gos kyi tsogatam las gzhan pa'i gtam 'ga' yang med mod/ des bsams 8pa/ 'jig rten na 'dod pa'i bdag nyid can gang ji snyed pa de dag dang nye dga' mtshungs pa yin na 'dis kyang re zhig ④bdag smad par gyur na gal te dge slong gnas brtan gzhan 'ga' zhig gis thos par gyur na des rgya cher smad par 'gyur ro ④snyam nas de cang mi smra bar 'dug ⑩go/ /nye dga'as de bkar te smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyi mkhan po dang kho bo bshes pas de'i phyir kho bos khyod smad ⑩kyis ma gshe shigatso /gnas brtan gal te bdag yang smra bar gyur na khyod kyis bdag la yang smad par mdzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa kho bo ⑩yang nye bar ma zhuzhi ba tsam du zad kyi ci lhung bzed de lhung bzed ⑥ma yin nam/ gnas brtan snga ma nyid 0kyang 0smra bar mi bgyi ba lags kyis ci'atshal to/ /tshe dang ldan pa de lta mod kyi 'on kyang re zhig duspros shig /gnas brtan chasrang che ge mo zhig na spos 'tshong ⑦gi khye'u 6—379

zhig mchis pa des lhung bzed shin tu gsal ba/ dbyibs legs pa/longs spyad ①par bzod pa zhig rnyed nas de'i mchid nas gal te dge slong lhung bzed 'tshal ba 'ga' —zhig ②mchis na de gtang ①du gsol zhes mchi'o/ /de ni de tsam du zad de/ de yang nye bar ma zhi ba tsam kho nar zad do/ /de nas nye dga' snam sbyar gyon te 'gros bskyed nas phya rar ④song ba dang / spos 'tshong ⑤gi khye'u des de 'gros bskyed de 'ong ba thag ring po kho na nas mthong nas des bsams pa/ dge sbyong hral po ⑥'gros 'di lta bus 'ong ba 'dis bdag gi lhung bzed 'di 'phrogs ⑧par 'gyur du 0'ong ngo snyam nas des lhung bzed de blangs te 'jong ⑩tshe'i 'og tu bcug ste bzhag ⑩pa dang nye dga'as de sbed pa'i tshe mthong nas des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs ci lhung bzed 'di nal gyi bu yin nam ci na de phyir sbed par byed ces des lag pa brkyang ste lhung bzed blangs nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs a rog gya tho)sbyin pa 'dis khyod sems kyi rgyan dang / sems kyi yo byad dang / rnal 'byor gyi tshogs dang / don gyi mchog thob pa dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang na snod du 'gyur bar gyur cig /'phags pa bdag cag tshong pa dag ni (sprekhe spogs 'tshal bas 'tsho ba lags pas 'di rin ma mchis par mi dbul yite 'di ltar rin gyi phyir 'bul lo/ /bzhin bzangs ci khyod drang srong gi snod 'tshong 8bar byed dam/ tshigs su bcad pa yang smras pa/ gal te skyes bu skyas snod kyis/ /gser gyi snod ni thob gyur na/ /de yis mya ngan ci phyir bya/ /bslus pa med par kho bos mthong / /'phags pa khyod mang du gsung tshumod kyi 'on kyang rin ma mchis par mi 'bul 8lo//nye dga'as smras pa/ khyod kyi lhung bzed la lhag par chags pa 'dis yi 6—380

dgas lkog ①sba can dag gi nang du skye bar bya dgos so zhes de de skad ②spyo bar byed pa na khyim bdag cig phyogs der 'ongs nas des smras pa/ 'phags pa nuphyag 'tshal lo/ /btsun pa nye dga' ⑤phyag 'tshal lo/ /nye dga'as smras pa/bzhin bzangs khyod kyi phyag skam po 'dis ci bya/ 'phags pa bdag la btsun pa nye dga'as bka' stsal pa gang zhig bdag gis ma bsgrubs/ lhung bzed ⑤'di nyos te byin cig /khyim bdag des spos 'tshong ༅gi khye'u de la smras pa/bzhin bzangs lhung bzed 'di rin ci ༷tsam/ 'di dang 'di tsam mo/ /kho bos khyod la sbyin no/ /spos 'tshong ⑤gi khye'u des lhung bzed de khyim bdag de la byin nas khyim bdag des kyang nye dga' la phul lo/ /nye dga'as smras pa/ a rog gya 0sbyin pa 'dis khyod ⑩sems kyi rgyan (spredang / sems kyi yo byad dang /rnal 'byor gyi tshogs dang / don gyi mchog thob pa dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang na snod du 'gyur bar gyur cig /khyim bdag de song ba dang / nye dga'as spos 'tshong 8gi khye'u de la smras pa/ bkren pa khyod kyis nye dga'as lhung bzed kyi rin spyod du 'jud 4)mi nus snyam du shes sam/ khyod kyi lhung bzed la lhag ④par chags pa 'dis yi dgas lba ba can dag gi nang du skye bar bya dgos so/ /'phags pa ci zhig sbyor mchis/ khyod kyis kyang lhung bzed thob la / bdag gis kyang rin thob kyis byabazhud cig /nye dga' yang lhung bzed khyer te gtsug lag khang du song nas des lhung bzed de dge slong rnams la bstan te smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ltos shig /kho bo'i lhung bzed ci 'dra/gzhon nu zhig gis smras pa/ gnas brtan ⑩ci khyod la lhung bzed gzhan ma mchis sam/ yod do/ /bya'o na gnas brtan gyis lhung bzed yod cing 6—381

bdog bzhin du lhung bzed gzhan btsal du rung ngam/ dgra bo rnams kyi gre bar rkang pas mnan nas so/ /gnas brtan la dgra bo dag kyang mchis sam/gang gi phyir khyod kho bo'i lhung bzed gnyis pa yang mi bzod pas je ①khyod kho bo'i dgra bo thu ②bo yin no/ /dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag lhung bzed yod cing bdog bzhin du lhung bzed gzhan tshol bar byed ces ⑤smod par byed/ phyar ④ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du med par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis nye dga' la rmas rjopa/ nye dga' khyod lhung bzed yod cing bdog bzhin du lhung bzed gzhan tshol ba bden namayi/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge ༅sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa lamadzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong gis lhung bzed yod cing bdog bzhin du lhung bzed gzhan btsal bar mi bya'o// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po sum bcu rtsa ⑨bzhi pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis lhung bzed yod cing bdog bzhin du lhung bzed 6—382

gzhan btsal bar mi bya'o zhes bka' 475 nas bsod snyoms pa zhig gi lhung bzed cung zhig rdol nas des ①de thogs te mnyan yod du ②bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang des phye dag rnyed nas des de dag lhung bzed kyi snosnod kyis mnos so / /'bras can gsher ba rnyed nas des de dag lhung bzed kyis mnos pa dang de nas zags pas phye dag gsher bar gyur te ④de dag gis lhung bzed kyi snod ma ⑤rung bar gyur nas de sbrang bu dag gis yongs su bskor bar gyur pa dang /de la khye'u dang / bu mo dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pas ༅nor can dang /tshong dpon dang / ded dpon dag bzhin du 'khor mang por ⑦'gyur ba'i las byas pas sbrang bu dag gis yongs su bskor cing bzhud do/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis de mthong nas smras pa/ byis pa dag ci'i phyir 'phags pa la mtho ③'tsham par byed/ khyim bdag 'phags pa la tho btsam 0du ci mchis/'phags pas 0nor can dang / tshong dpon dang / ded dpon dag bzhin du 'khor mang por ⑩'gyur ba'i las bgyis pas sbrang bu dag gis yongs su bskor cing bzhud do/ /khyim bdag mgon med 8zas sbyin gyis dge slong de la smras pa/'phags pa bcom ldan 'das kyis 0bstan pa kun du mdzes pa la khyod ci cal col byed/ khyim bdag 'di la cal col du gyur pa ci yod/ khyod kyis kho bo rol mo mkhan gyi khyim dang / 'jud mthun ma'i khyim dang / chang pa'i 'khyim dang / rgyal po'i pho brang dang / gdol pa'i khyim du zhugs par mthong ngam/'phags pa 'o na ci'i phyir khyod byis pa dag gis bskor te 'phya bar tunyebyed/khyim bdag kho bo'i lhung bzed 'di 8zag go/ /'o na ci'i phyir lhung bzed gzhan mi tshol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis lhung bzed yod cing 6—383

bdog bzhin du lhung bzed gzhan btsal bar mi bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /'phags pa khyod kyi lhung bzed 'di 'dra ba yod cing bdog pa yin nam zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gi lhung bzed rdol ba des glan ①par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi lhung bzed rdol ba des glan ②par bya'o / /zhes bca' ba lamadzad nas/ dge slong dag lhan pa snyi ba lnga po bu ram dang / rgya skyegs kyi tshigs ma dang / spra tshil dang / ro nye dang /tshon mo steng dag gis glon ④par byed nas/ de dag tsha ba dang phrad nas yang zags ⑤par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lhan pa snyi ba lnga po de dag spangs te lhan pa sra ba lnga po gzhan dag gis glan par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis lhan pa sra ba lnga po dag ci 'dra ba mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lhan rings ⑥dang / tham phran dang / lhan pa dang / chu srin gyi ⑦so lta bu dang / phye mas so/ /dge slong rnams kyis phye ma du yod mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phye ma laganyis te/ lcags kyi phye ma dang / rdo'i phye ma'o⑨/ /lcags kyi lhung bzed la ni 0lcags kyi phye mas glan ⑩par bya'o / /sa'i lhung bzed la ni rdo'i phye mas glan 8par bya'o/ /de dag chur phye ma bdar te glon par byed nas de de bzhin du 'gogs tsonas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'bru mar du bdar bas glan 8par bya'o/ /de dag ha cang drag tu sreg pas de 'gogs 8pa dang / ha cang chung ngur sros ⑫pas mi 'chags nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ci ran tsam du 6—384

bsro bar bya'o/ /ha cang rtsub por gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / bdar bar bya'o/ /de dag chus blugs te bdar ①bar byed pas de yang 'gogs ②nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'bru mar blugs te bdar bar bya'o/ /sa las byas pa'i lhung bzed dag rdol nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu ram dang / 'jim ②pas glan ④nas de dag bsro bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de ltar lhan pa lnga po dag gis glan ⑤par bya'o/ /zhes bca' bar ⑥mdzad nas/ dge slong bsod snyoms pa zhig gis sa las byas pa'i lhung bzed lag pa nas shor te gyo dum lngar gyur nas/des de dag bu ⑦ku phug ste gyo dum dag skud pas brgyus lanas bsod snyoms la rgyu bar byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lhung bzed la zas med par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas des de rung bar byed pa na bshig cing rgyud ⑨par byed pas snga dro thams cad zad par gyur nas dge slong rnams kyis de la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa ci khyod kyi dge ba'i phyogs 'di lta ste/ bcings pa 'grol ⑩ba 'di kho na yin nam / des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis lhung bzed chag ⑩pa la lhan pa sra chub lnga po dag gis glan 8par bya'o/ / zhes bca' bar mdzad do ④zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas bslab pa 'dod pa dang / bslab pa la gus pa dang / bslab pa la yo byad bsnyungs pa'i bsngags tunyepa brjod nas/ dge slong rnams la de dang rjes su mthun pa dang /de'i shas che ba dang / de dang 'tsham ⑩pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid mdzad nas ⑩dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na 6—385

phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis ①'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/yang dge slong gang lhung bzed lhan pa lnga med pa/ spyad bzod pa yod bzhin du bzang po 'dod pa'i phyir lhung bzed sar ②pa gzhan tshol zhing lhung bzed grub na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /dge slong des lhung bzed de dge slong gi 'khor la dbul bar bya'o/ /dge slong gi 'khor de'i lhung bzed tha mar gyur pa gang yin pa de dge slong de la dge slong khyod kyis lhung bzed 'di byin gyis brlab par mi bya/gtang ①bar mi bya/ gzhan la sbyin par mi bya bar chag pa'i mthar thug pa'i bar du khad kyis dal bu dal bus spyad par bya'o zhes sbyin par bya ste/ de la de ni cho ga yin no/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ④ni chos 'di pa'o/ /lhung bzed lhan pa lnga med pa zhes bya ba ni lhung bzed lhan pa lngar ma tshang ba'o/ /spyad bzod pa yod bzhin du zhes bya ba ni yongs su longs spyad ⑤par bzod pa yod bzhin du'o/ /bzang po 'dod pa'i phyir zhes bya ba ni mchog 'dod pa'i phyir ram/ yang dang yang 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /lhung bzed sar ༷pa zhes bya ba ni sar ⑦pa gnyis te gsar pas sar ⑧pa dang / rnyed pas sar ⑨pa ste/don 'dir ni gnyis ka ⑦yin par dgongs so/ /gzhan zhes bya ba ni gnyis pa'o⑩ / /tshol zhing zhes bya ba ni tshol bar byed cing ngo / /lhung bzed grub na zhes bya ba ni lhung bzed thob na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /dge slong des zhes bya ba ni dge slong gang 6—386

yin pa des so/ /lhung bzed de zhes bya ba ni lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa de'o / /dge slong gi 'khor la dbul bar bya'o zhes bya ba ni de na dge slong gang dag 'khod pa la'o/ /dge slong gi 'khor de'i lhung bzed tha mar gyur pa gang yin pa de dge slong de la dge slong khyod kyis lhung bzed 'di byin gyis brlab par ①mi bya/ gtang ②bar mi bya/ gzhan la sbyin par mi bya bar chag ②pa'i mthar thug gi bar du khad kyis dal bu dal bus spyad par bya'o zhes sbyin par bya ste zhes bya ba la / dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis kyang lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ④pa'i dge slong bsko ⑤bar bya ste/ lhung bzed 'brel gyipa med pa 'brim ⑦pa'i dge slong chos lnga dang ldan pa ni ma bskos pa yang bsko bar mi bya la/ bskos pa yang dbyung bar bya ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'dun ⑧pas 'gro ba dang / zhe sdang gis 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis ⑨'gro ba dang / 'jigs pas 'gro ba dang /lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa brims pa dang ma brims pa mi shes pa'o/ /lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ⑩pa'i dge slong chos lnga dang ldan pa ni ma bskos pa yang bsko bar bya la/ bskos pa yang dbyung bar mi bya ste/ lnga gang zhe na/'dun 0pas mi 'gro ba dang / zhe sdang gis mi 'gro ba dang /tso gti mug gis mi 'gro ba dang / 'jigs pas mi 'gro ba dang / lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa brims pa dang ma 'brims pa shes pa'o/ /'di ltar bsko bar bya ste/ je ⑫dang por spro bar bya ste/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dge 'dun la lhung bzed 'brel pa 8med pa 'brim ⑩par spro'am/ gal te spro na des spro'o zhes brjod par bya'o / /de'i 'og tu des gnas mal bsham ⑩pa byas te/ gaṇ+ḍi brdungs nas dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yiyang dag par bsgo ste/ dge 6—387

'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la/ dge slong gcig ①gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ /dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ②par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di chadage 'dun la lhung ④bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ⑤par bsko'o / /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ⑥par spro ste/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ⑦par bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ⑤par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung 0shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ⑩shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun la lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim 0par skos tsolags te/'di ltar cang mi gsung bas tsode de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /ngas lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ④pa'i dge slong gi kun du spyod pa'i chos dag bca' bar bya ste/ lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ④pa'i dge slong gis tshogs pa'i dus su dge 'dun la tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag sang dge ⑩'dun la lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ⑩par 'gyur gyis8/ khyed cag nang par gaṇ+ḍi brdungs pa na rang charang gi lhung bzed dag thogs la dge 'dun gyi nang du gshegs par 6—388

mdzod cig ces bsgo bar bya'o/ /de nas lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ①pa'i dge slong gis phyi de nyin par gnas mal bsham ②pa byas te/ gaṇ+ḍi brdungs nas dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis kyang charang rang gi lhung bzed dag byin gyis brlabs ①pa phyung zhing thogs te dge 'dun gyi nang du 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'brim ⑤pa'i dge slong gis dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa thogs te rgan pa'i mtha' logs su phyag 'tshal nas dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi mdun du 'dug ste/gnas brtan lhung bzed 'di ni shin tu gsal ba/ dbyibs legs pa/longs spyad ⑥par bzod pa lags kyis ⑦gal te bzhed na snoms shig ces yon tan ji lta ba bzhin du lhung ⑧bzed 'brel pa med pa'i bsngags ⑨pa brjod de dbul bar bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis kyang gal te 'dod na blang bar bya'o/ /gal te dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis lhung bzed de blangs na dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi lhung bzed gang yin pa de gnas brtan gnyis pa la dbul bar bya'o/ /gnas brtan gnyis pa'i lhung bzed gang yin pa de gnas brtan gsum pa la dbul bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du dge 'dun gyi gsar bu gnyis pa'i lhung bzed gang yin pa de dge 'dun gyi sar 0bu la dbul ba'i bar du bya'o⑩/ /gal te dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis ma blangs na gnas brtan gnyis pa la dbul bar bya'o/ /gal te gnas brtan gnyis pas ma blangs na gnas brtan gsum pa la dbul bar bya'o/ /gal te gnas brtan gsum pas ma blangs na tsodage 'dun gyi gnas brtan slong bar byed na brjod pa 6—389

dang po la sbyin par mi bya zhing brjod pa gnyis pa la yang sbyin par mi bya'o/ /brjod pa gsum pa la sbyin par bya ste/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi ①'dul ba dang 'gal ba'i nyes byas kyi ltung ba bshags par bya'o/ /de bzhin du dge 'dun gyi gsar bu gsum pas ma blangs na gsar bu gnyis pa la dbul bar bya'o//gal te gsar bu gnyis pas ma blangs na gsar bu la dbul bar bya'o/ /gal te dge 'dun gyi gsar bus blangs pa na gsar bu gsum pa slong bar ②byed na brjod pa dang po la sbyin par mi bya zhing / brjod pa gnyis pa la yang sbyin par mi bya'o/ /brjod pa gsum pa la sbyin par bya ste/ dge 'dun gyi gsar bu gsum pas 'dul ba dang 'gal ba'i nyes byas kyi ltung ba bshags pa'i bar du bya'o / /dge slong gi 'khor de'i lhung bzed tha mar gyur pa gang yin pa de dge slong de la dge slong khyod kyis lhung bzed 'di byin gyis brlab par mi bya/ gtang bar mi ②bya/ gzhan la sbyin par mi bya bar chag pa'i mthar thug gi bar du khad kyis dal bu dal bus spyad par bya'o zhes sbyin par bya'o/ /lhung bzed 'brel ④pa med pa 'brim ⑤pa'i dge slong gis ⑥kun tu spyad par bya ba'i chos ji ltar bcas pa dag yang dag par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /ngas lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'chang ba'i dge slong gi ⑦kun tu spyad par ⑧bya ba'i chos dag bca' bar bya ste lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'chang ba'i dge slong gis lhung bzed kyi snod gnyis nye bar gzhag ⑨par bya zhing de la bzang po gang yin pa der lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa gzhug par bya zhing / cig shos su lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs pa cigazhug ⑩par bya'o//des lhung bzed gnyi ga thogs te bsod snyoms la 'jug par bya zhing gal te 6—390

'bras chan ①skam po rnyed na lhung bzed 'brel pa med pas blang bar bya'o/ /gal te 'bras chan ②gsher ba rnyed na lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs ①pas blang bar bya'o/ /gtsug lag khang du 'ongs nas dkyil 'khor byas te lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa mdun du dubazhag nas lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs 0par bza' bar bya'o/ /zos zin nas byi dor dang / kha zas 'bags 0pa'i dril phyi bya ⑦ba yang dang por lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa la bya zhing / de'i 'og tu lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs pa la bya'o/ /bkru ba dang / bskam pa dang /lci bas brud ⑧pa la yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /gal te lhung bzed kyi ngos khung gnyis yod na bzang po gang yin pa der lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa gzhug par bya zhing / cig 0shos su lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs pa gzhug par bya'o/ /gal te ngos khung gcig ⑨ yod la gal te shod bzang na shod du 0lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa gzhag par bya zhing / ngos khung du lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs pa gzhug par bya'o/ /gal te ngos khung bzang na ngos khung du lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa gzhug par bya zhing / shod du lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs pa gzhag par bya'o/ /lhung bzed kyi 8las byed pa na gal te rdza bo gnyis yod na 'ardza bo bzang po gang yin pa der lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa bsreg par bya zhing / cig 8shos su lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs pa bsreg ⑫par bya'o/ /gal te rdza bo gcig yod tshun gal te 'og ma legs par tshos par 'gyur na 'og tu lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa gzhag ⑩par bya zhing / steng du lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs pa gzhag par bya'o/ /gal te steng du bzhag 8pa legs par tshos par 'gyur ⑩ na steng du lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa gzhag par 6—391

bya zhing / 'og tu lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs pa gzhag ①par bya'o/ /lam du 'gro ba na lhung bzed kyi snod gnyis bskur ②bar bya ste/ de la bzang po gang yin pa der lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa gzhug par bya zhing / cig gshos su lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs ④pa gzhug par bya'o/ /gal te khur tsha ba 'ga' zhig yod na de la lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa bskur ⑤bar bya zhing / bdag nyid kyis lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs pa bskur par ⑥bya'o/ /gal te khur tsha ba 'ga' yang med na phrag pa g.yon pas lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa bskur ⑦bar bya zhing / phrag pa g.yas pas lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs pa bskur ⑧bar bya'o/ /'di ni re zhig ⑨chad pa'i las yin te tshul khrims yang dag par rjes su srung bas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du spyad par bya'o/ /lhung bzed 'brel pa med pa 'chang ba'i dge slong gis kun du spyad ⑩pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa dag yang dag par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /de la de ni cho ga yin no zhes bya ba ni de la de ni rjes su mthun pa'i chos 7yin pa'o//de la ltung bar 'ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gi lhung bzed chag kyang lhan pa ⑫gcig gis glan ④par 'os shing ma glan tsol spyad bzod ⑩pa yin na/ de lhung bzed spyad bzod pa de yod bzhin du lhung bzed sar ⑩pa gzhan tshol bar byed na de tsotshol ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ thob na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur rol/ /dge slong gi lhung bzed chag kyang lhan pa gnyis kyis glan ⑩par 'os shing ma glan la spyad bzod pa yin na/ de lhung bzed spyad bzod pa ⑩de yod bzhin du lhung bzed sar 0pa gzhan tshol bar byed na de tshol ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ thob na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi lhung 6—392

bzed chag kyang lhan pa gsum gyis glan ①par 'os shing ma glan ②la spyad bzod pa ②yin na/ de la lhung bzed spyad bzod pa de duyod bzhin du lhung bzed sar rjopa gzhan tshol bar byed na de tshol ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ thob yin spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi lhung bzed chag kyang lhan pa bzhis glan ⑦par 'os shing ma glan ⑧la spyad bzod pa yin na⑨/ de lhung bzod spyad bzod pa de yod bzhin du lhung bzed sar ⑩pa gzhan tshol bar byed na de tshol ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ thob na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi lhung bzed chag kyang lhan pa gcig gis glan ⑩par 'os shing glan ⑫la spyad bzod pa yin na/ de lhung bzed spyad bzod pa de yod bzhin du lhung bzed sar 8pa gzhan tshol bar byed na de tshol ba la nyes byas su 'gyur 0la/thob na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi lhung bzed chag kyang lhan pa gnyis kyis glan par 'os shing glan la spyad bzod pa yin na/ de lhung bzed spyad bzod pa de yod 8bzhin du lhung bzed sar ⑩pa gzhan tshol bar byed na de tshol ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ thob na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro//dge slong gi lhung bzed chag kyang lhan pa gsum gyis glan par 'os shing glan la spyad bzod pa yin na/ de lhung bzed spyad bzod pa de ⑩yod bzhin du lhung bzed sar tho)pa gzhan tshol bar byed na de tshol ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/thob na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gi 0lhung bzed chag kyang lhan pa bzhis glan par 'os shing glan la spyad bzod pa yin na/ de dulhung bzed spyad bzod pa de 0yod bzhin du lhung bzed sar ⑤pa gzhan tshol bar byed na de tshol ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ thob na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /6—393

dge slong gi ①lhung bzed chag cing lhan pa lngas glan par 'os pa yin na de des glan kyang ②zung / ma glan kyang ①rung / spyad bzod kyang rung / spyad mi bzod kyang rung / lhung bzed sar ④pa gzhan tshol bar byed na de tshol ba la yang ltung ba med la/ thob na yang ⑧ltung ba med do/ /rin gyis len pa dang /brje bas len pa la ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang /sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /lhung bzed tshol ba'i spang ba ste nyi shu gnyis pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi ༅kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /nye dga'as bsams pa/'di dag thams cad khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bslab pa'i gzhi dag gis bsdams pas phyin chad ras yug phran sbom po gcig ⑦gi rin yang gangadulas kyang bslang bar mi nus kyis0/ song ste bltas la ⑩gal te la la las bslang bar nus 47kyang srid do snyam nas de snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang /chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du shar sgo nas bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang /skyed tsomos tshal zhig na yugs sa mo lnga brgya 8tsam dog pa 'khal zhing 'khod pa de dag des mthong nas bsams ④pa/ 'di dag ni las bdag gir bya ba dang ldan pa dag gcig ste/ nyin mtshan du thong gshol 'dakar po spyod 8kyang ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la sgyur ⑩dpya 'jal bar mi byed pa dag yin no snyam nas des de dag la smras pa/ sring mo dag a rog gya/ a rog gya'/de dag cang mi smra bar ⑩'khod pa dang des de dag la smras pa/ sring mo dag skye 6—394

bo mang po mi 'dod pa dang / skye bo mang po mi dga' ba dang / skye bo mang po la mi sdug pa dang / skye bo mang po'i yid du mi 'ong ba 'jig rten thams cad dang thun mong ba 'di lta ste/ 'chi ba zhes bya ba'i chos de 'ong bar 'gyur bas khyed cag de'i tshe tshig smrar ni dang po nyid nas mi nus par 'gyur ro/ /de na gzhon nu ma bsod nams 'dod pa cig ①'dug pa des stan las langs te nye dga'i stan ②bting ba dang / nye dga' de la 'dug nas des nye dga'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te mdun du 'dug go/ /nye dga'as de dag la smras pa/ sring mo dag khyed cag la dge ba'i chos yang dag par blangs te 'jug par bya ba cung zad yod dam/ 'phags pa ci yang ma mchis so/ /sring mo dag ma legs so/ /bu mo 'dis ni re zhig dge ba'i chos gnyis byas shing bsags te/ 'dis kho bo la sems mngon par dad par byas pa gang yin pa des ③ni 'dis phyug por ④'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa yin no/ /'dis kho bo la mngon ⑤du ldang ba ⑥byas shing stan bting ba dang / phyag byas pa gang yin pa des ⑦ni 'dis rigs mthon por 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa yin no/ /gal te cung zad sbyin par byed na de ni 'di'i longs spyod chen por 'gyur ba yin no/ /sring mo dag khyed cag gi 'tsho tshis dag ga las 'byung / 'phags pa sgyur nib 'di nyid las so/ /gos dag ga las 'byung / sgyur ⑨ba 'di nyid las so/ /khyed cag gis 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba'i lam rgyags 0cung zad khyer ba yod dam/'phags pa de ni thams cad kyi thams cad du ma mchis so sring mo dag ma legs so ma legs so/ /'phags pa su la thugs ngan mdzad/ khyed cag la ste0/khyed cag 'jig rten pha rol nas kyang bcom zhing 'dir 'ongs la/ 'di nas ⑫6—395

bcom bzhin du 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro bar byed do/ /'phags pa gang gis bdag cag gis 'jig rten pha rol tu mchi ba'i shul rgyags cung zad bskur ①ba'i thabs ci mchis/ sring mo dag gal te khyed kyis dge sbyong shākya'i rigs las rab tu byung ba sde snod gsum dang ldan pa/ chos sgrogs pa/ rigs ②pa dang / grol ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pa gang yin pa de la ras yug chen bskon ②na des khyed cag gis 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba'i lam rgyags ④mang po khyer bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa bdag cag ⑤gis dge slong de lta bu ⑥ga las rnyed/ sring mo dag khyed kyis kho bo shākya'i rigs las rab tu byung ba sde snod gsum dang ldan pa/ chos sgrogs pa/ rigs ⑦pa dang grol ba'i spobs ②pa dang ldan pa yin par mi shes sam/ 'phags pa bdag cag la ras yug chen gyi 'byor pa ga las mchis/ sring mo dag khyed kyis/ bsod nams chung yang brnyas mi bya/ /de ༅ni bdag la mi 'ong min/ /chu yi thigs pa 'dzag pa yis ⑩ /snod chen ⑩gang bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /brtan pa rnams kyis bsod nams ni/ /cung zad cung zad bsags na rdzogs/ /zhes bya ba de 8mi shes sam/ khyed kyis re zhig dog pa srang gcig 6sbyin nus sam/ rngo thog go④/ /gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ bdag gis kyang srang byed dbul tsolo/ /gzhan zhig gis kyang smras pa/ bdag gis kyang srang gi bzhi cha cig ⑩dbul lo/ /de bzhin du thams cad kyis kyang shas shas kyis ⑩dbul bar khas blangs so/ /nye dga'as smras pa/ sring mo dag dog pa phra mo dag byin cig /'phags pa bdag cag thams cad ni sbom po 'khal ba dag lags so/ /bdag cag gi nang na bde gnas ma zhig ni phra mor 'khal lo/ /sring mo dag de je bos shig /de dag 6—396

gis de bos pa dang / nye dga'as de la smras pa/ bu mo je ①dog pa phrar khol cig /des por bkal ba dang / nye dga'as smras pa/ bu mo de bas kyang phrar khol cig /des de bas kyang phrar bkal ba dang / nye dga'as yang dang yang du bu mo de bas lakyang phrar khol cig ces smras pa dang / des smras pa/'phags pa 'di las phra bar ni rngo mi thog godu/ /nye dga'as de dag la smras pa/sring mo dag khyed cag thams cad kyis dog pa 'di 'dra ba sha stag byin cig /'phags pa bdag cag gis dog pa 'di 'dra ba ④'khal du rgyarngo mi thog go༅/ /bu mo 'dis kyang mi nus sam ci/ khyed cag gis 'di'i don du 'khol chul 'di khyed ducag gi don du 'khal du chug shigashe /'phags pa gal te btub na'o/ /nye dga'as de la smras pa/ bu mo gyis shig dang khyod la bsod nams su 'gyur ro / /'phags pa dog pa 'di ni phra bdar che ba lags pas yun ring mos bkal 'tshal gyis caha cang ngos drag tu ma mdzad par dus 'di tsam na spyon cig/nye dga'as de la a rog gya 4)zhes smras nas stan las langs te song ngo bde gnas 4)ma des dus de srid kyis mdog pa bkal nas de gzhan dag gi gan du song ste thams cad 'dus nas dog pa de nye dga' la phul lo/ /nye dga'as de dag la a rog gya casbyin pa 'dis khyed 8sems kyi rgyan dang / sems kyi yo byad dang / rnal 'byor gyi tshogs dang / don gyi mchog thob pa yidang / lha dang mi rnams kyi gos dag thob par gyur cig ces smras te song ngo / /de nas nye dga'as dog pa de khyer te gtsug lag khang du song nas/ des dge slong rnams la dog pa de bstan te smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag kho bo'i dog pa ci 'dra ltos/ gnas brtan dog pa bzang ngo / /gnas brtan gyis gang ras 6—397

yug chen 'thag par 'gyur ba'i tha ga pa 'ga' btsal ba mchis sam/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ci khyed ①kyis nye dga' zil gyis gnon tam/ gal te nye dga' rab tu ma byung du zin na nye dga' rang nyid 'thag par 'gyur ro/ /gnas brtan bdag cag gis gnas brtan ga la zil gyis gnon/ 'di ltar ra ba ga ge mo'i drung na tha ga pa spyi cer khyo shug mchis te/ gal te des dog pa 'di rnyed ②du lags na chen po la 'os pa'i ras yug chen 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bu dag a rog gya ②don gyis na khyed kyis kho bo'i ras yug chen 'thag tu bcug go zhes des dog pa de khyer te tha ga pa de'i khyim du song ba dang / des tha ga pa de thag ring po kho na nas mthong nas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ mkhas pa ring nas rab snang ba/ /gangs dang ldan pa'i ri bo bzhin/ /mi mkhas rab tu mi snang ba / /mun pa'i nang du mda' 'phangs bzhin/ /bzhin bzangs khyod kyi grags pas mnyan yod thams cad gang bar gyur pa ni khyod kyis rnyed pa lags par rnyed ④pa yin no/ /dog pa 'di ci 'dra je ltos shig /'phags pa dog pa bzang ngo / /dog pa ni 'di lags la tha ga pa ni bdag lags na chen po la 'os pa'i ras yug chen du 'gyur ro/ /bzhin bzangs thogs shig /'phags pa bdag la thags gla sus stsol bar 'gyur⑤/ bzhin bzangs khyod rtag pa nyid du thags glas mi ngoms sam/ 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba'i lam rgyags kyang bskur ⑥bar gyis shig /de la chung mas smras pa/ rje'i sras 'dis thag ring po kho na nas bdag cag gnyis kyi bsngags pa brjod kyis ⑦'di'i ras yug chen thogs shig /'phags pa dog pa 'di phra bdar che ba lags kyis ②yun 'di tsam na spyon cig /nye dga'as a rog gya ⑨zhes smras te song ngo / /tha ga pa des 6—398

ras yug chen de dus de tsam gyis btags so/ /nye dga'as ①yang dus de tsam gyis der song ba dang tha ga pa des de la ras yug chen de phul lo/ /nye dga'as de khyer te gtsug lag khang du song nas des dge slong rnams la ras yug chen de bstan te smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag kho bo'i ras yug chen ci 'dra ②stos/gnas brtan ras yug chen bzang ngo / /'di ltar gang la 'di lta bu gnyis pa yang mchis pa de ni sar ②pa las snam sbyar nyi rim du bgyis te dge ba'i phyogs la snying las chung ngus tron ④bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag ci khyod kyi ⑤snying lam na nye dga'as ras yug chen 'di 'dra ba gnyis ༅sbyor du 'jud mi nus snyam mamal/ ji ltar sbyor du 'jud pa ltos shig /de nas nye dga' snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du nub sgo nas bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / skyed ⑤mos tshal zhig na yugs las mo lnga brgya tsam dog pa 'khal tho'e zhing 'khod pa de skyedag des mthong nas bsams pa/'di dag ni las bdag gir bya ba dang ldan pa dag cig ste/ nyin mtshan du thong gshol tsodakar po spyod kyang ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la sgyur dpya ⑫'jal bar mi byed pa dag yin no snyam nas des de dag la smras ④pa/ sring mo dag a rog gya a rog gya'/ de dag cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang des ⑩de dag la smras pa/ sring mo dag skye bo mang po mi 'dod pa dang skye bo mang po ⑩mi dga' 8ba dang / skye bo mang po la mi sdug pa dang / skye bo mang po'i yid du mi 'ong ba ⑩'jig rten thams cad dang thun mong pa 'di lta ste/ 'chi ba zhes bya ba'i chos de 'ong bar 'gyur bas khyed cag de'i tshe tshig smrar ni dang po nyid nas mi nus par 'gyur ro/ /de na gzhon nu ma bsod nams 'dod pa cig cha'adug 6—399

pa des stan las langs te nye dga'i stan bting ba dang nye dga' de la 'dug nas des nye dga'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te mdun du 'dug go/ /nye dga'as de dag la smras pa/ sring mo dag khyed cag la dge ba'i chos yang dag par blangs te 'jug par bya ba cung zad yod dam/ 'phags pa ci yang ma mchis sol/ /sring mo dag ma legs ②so/ /bu mo 'dis ni re zhig chadage ba'i chos gnyis byas shing bsags te/ 'dis kho bo la sems mngon par dad par byas pa gang yin pa des ④ni 'dis phyug por 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa yin no/ /'dis kho bo la mngon du ldang ba byas shing stan bting ba dang phyag byas pa gang yin pa des ⑤ni 'dis rigs mthon por 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa yin no/ /gal te cung zad sbyin par byed na de ni 'di'i longs spyod chen por 'gyur ba yin no/ /sring mo dag khyed cag gi 'tsho tshis dag ga las 'byung 'phags pa sgyur ⑥ba 'di nyid las so/ /gos dag ga las 'byung / sgyur ⑦ba 'di nyid las so/ /khyed cag gis 'jig rten pha rol du 'gro ba'i dulam rgyags cung ⑨zad khyer ba yod dam/ 'phags pa de ni thams cad kyi thams cad du ma ⑩mchis so/ /sring mo dag ma legs so ma legs so/ /'phags pa su la thugs ngan mdzad/ khyed cag la ste(spre/ khyed cag 'jig rten pha rol nas kyang bcom zhing 'dir 'ongs la/ 'di nas kyang bcom bzhin du 'jig rten pha rol du 'gro bar byed do/ /'phags pa gang gis bdag cag gis 'jig rten pha rol du mchi tsoba'i shul rgyags 0cung zad bskur tsoba'i thabs ci mchis/ sring mo dag gal te khyed kyis dge slong shākya'i rigs las rab tu byung ba sde snod gsum dang ldan pa chos sgrogs pa/ rigs 8pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pa 6—400
