gang yin pa de la ①ras yug chen bskon na des khyed cag gis 'jig rten pha rol du 'gro ba'i lam rgyags mang po 0khyer bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa bdag cag gis dge slong de lta bu ga las rnyed/ sring mo dag khyed kyis kho bo shākya'i rigs las rab tu byung ba sde snod gsum dang ldan pa/ chos sgrogs pa/ rigs ③pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pa yin par mi shes sam/ 'phags pa bdag cag la ras yug chen gyi 'byor pa ga las mchis/ sring mo dag khyed kyis/bsod nams chung yang brnyas mi bya/ /de ni bdag la mi 'ong min/ /chu yi thigs ④pa 'dzag pa yis/ /snod chen gang bar 'gyur ⑤ba bzhin/ /brtan pa rnams kyis bsod nams ni/ /cung zad cung zad bsags na rdzogs/ /zhes bya ba de ⑥mi shes sam/ khyed kyis re zhig dog pa srang gcig sbyin nus sam/ rngo thog go⑦/ /gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ bdag gis kyang srang phyed dbul lo//gzhan zhig gis kyang smras pa/ bdag gis kyang srang gi bzhi cha cig phyedabul lo//de bzhin du thams cad kyis kyang shas shas kyis dbul bar khas blangs so/ /nye dga'as smras pa/ sring mo dag dog pa phra mo dag byin cig /'phags pa bdag cag thams cad ni sbom po 'khal ba dag lags so/ /bdag cag gi nang na bde gnas ma zhig ni 0phra mor 'khal lo/ /sring mo dag de je ⑩bos shig /de dag gis de bos pa dang nye dga'as de la smras pa/ bu mo je dog pa phrar 'khol ⑩cig /8des phrar bkal ba dang nye dga'as smras pa/ bu mo de bas kyang phrar 'khol 8cig /des de bas kyang phrar bkal ba dang / ④nye dga'as yang dang yang tsodu bu mo de bas kyang phrar 'khol ⑩cig ces smras pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa 'di las phra bar ⑩ni rngo mi thog gotso/ /nye dga'as de 6—401

dag la smras pa/ sring mo dag khyed cag thams cad kyis dog pa 'di 'dra ba sha stag byin cig /'phags pa bdag cag gis dog pa 'di 'dra ba 'khal du ①rngo mi thog go②/ /bu mo 'dis kyang mi nus sam ci khyed cag gis 'di'i don du 'khol ②la/ 'di khyed cag gi don du 'khal du chug shig /mephags pa gal te btub na'o/ /nye dga'as de la smras pa/ bu mo gyis shig dang khyod ④la bsod nams su 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa dog pa 'di ni phra bdar che ba lags pas yun ⑤ring mos bkal 'tshal gyis ⑤ha cang ngos drag par ma mdzad par dus 'di tsam na spyon cig /nye dga'as de la a rog gya ⑦zhes smras nas stan las langs te song ngo / /bde gnas ma des dus de srid kyis ⑧dog pa bkal nas de gzhan dag gi ⑨gan du song ste thams cad 'dus nas dog pa de nye dga' la phul lo/ /nye dga'as de dag la a rog gya4) / sbyin pa 'dis khyed ⑩sems kyi rgyan dang / sems kyi yo byad dang / rnal 'byor gyi tshogs dang / don gyi mchog thob pa dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi gos dag thob par gyur cig ces smras te song ngo / /8de nas nye dga'as dog pa de khyer te gtsug lag khang du song nas des dge slong rnams la dog pa de bstan te smras btso/ tshe dang ldan pa dag kho bo'i dog pa 'di ④ci 'dra ltos/ gnas brtan dog 8pa bzang ngo / /gnas brtan gyis gang ras yug chen 'thag par 'gyur ba'i tha ga pa 'ga' btsal ba mchis sam/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ci khyed kyis nye dga' 0zil gyis gnon tam/ gal te nye dga' rab tu ma byung du 0zin na nye dga' rang nyid 'thag par 'gyur ro/ /gnas brtan bdag cag gis gnas brtan ga la tsozil gyis gnon/ 'di ltar ra ba ga ge mo'i drung na tha ga pa spyi cer khyo shug mchis te/6—402

gal te des dog pa 'di rnyed ①du lags na chen po la 'os pa'i ras yug chen 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bu dag a rog gya de ②don gyis na khyed kyis kho bo'i ras yug chen 'thag tu bcug go zhes des dog pa de khyer te tha ga pa de'i khyim du song ba dang / des tha ga pa de thag ②ring po kho na nas mthong nas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ mkhas pa ring nas rab snang ba/ /gangs dang ldan pa'i ri bo bzhin/ /mi mkhas rab tu mi snang ba/ /mun pa'i nang du mda' 'phangs bzhin / /bzhin bzangs ④khyod kyi grags pas mnyan yod thams cad gang bar gyur pa ni khyed ⑤kyis rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa yin no/ /dog pa 'di ci 'dra je ltos shig /'phags pa dog pa bzang ngo / /dog pa ni 'di lags la tha ga ⑥pa ni bdag lags ⑦na chen po la 'os pa'i ras yug chen du 'gyur ro/ /bzhin bzangs 'di yang thogs shig /'phags pa bdag la thags gla sus stsal ⑧bar 'gyur/ bzhin bzangs khyod rtag pa nyid du thags glas mi ngoms sam / 'jig rten pha rol du 'gro ba'i lam rgyags kyang bskur ⑨bar gyis shig /'phags pa ras yug 0 chen snga ma de 'thag pa na bdag gis bu lon gang dag ⑩blangs pa de dag kyang da dung ma tso'akhor tso'o/ /des chung ma'i gdong du blta rdzibar brtsams pa dang / chung mas smras pa/ 'phags pa gal te 'di 'tshal yang bdag ni ④mi 'tshal lo/ /nye dga'as spyos te smras pa/ kwa'i tha ga pa spyi cer nyon cig /kho bos gal te khyod ras yug chen 'di 'thag tu ma bcug ⑩na spyi cer gyi mgo 'dis mna' 'dor ro/ /tha ga pa des kyang spyos te smras pa/kwa'i dge sbyong mgo reg nyon cig /kho bo gal te khyod kyi tshuras yug chen 'thag na mgo reg gi mgo rdzi'adis mna' 'dor ro/ /nye yidaga'as spyos te song nas 6—403

ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi lapho brang gi yid brten pa che ba zhes bya ba nye dga'i mdza' bo zhig yod de②/ nye dga' de'i sdum par song ste/g.yog 'khor dag la smras pa/ kye nang rje dag che ba gar song / de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa srang du mchis so/ /nye dga' ②de 'ong ba'i sung du song ba dang / che ba chang 'tshong ④ba'i tshong rdal ⑤zhig tu zhugs so/ /nye dga' ⑥tshong rdal de'i sgor bsdad de che ba la nye dga' sgo na sdod kyis ⑦phyir byung shig ces phrin duspring ba dang / che ba phyir byung ⑨nas smras pa0/ btsun pa nye dga' phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal lo/ /nye dga'as smras pa/ che ba kho bos ko ⑫khyod rgyal po'i bya ba dang / rgyal po'i byed pa dag la brtson 8par gyur snyam du bsams kyis / kho tsobos khyod 'di ltar chang 'tshong ④ba'i khyim nas chang 'tshong ⑫ba'i khyim du 'phyan ⑩par ni ma bsams so0/ /'phags pa bdag rgyal po'i dgos pas 'dir zhugs so/ /btsun pa nye dga' byon pa'i dgos pa ci mchis/che ba dog pa cung zhig rnyed pa 'dis re zhig tsoras yug chen ⑩'thag tu chug shig/bdag gis btsun pa nye dga' la ras yug chen nyid dbul lo/ /de yang bskur ⑥na ci dad pas sbyin par bya ba 'di dor bar bya'am 0/ che bas mi zhig la bsgo bske/ kye nang rje tha ga pa'i sna bo'i gan du song la 'phags pa nye dga'i ras yug chen 'di tsothogs la phul cig ces gyis shig /nye dga'as smras pa/ 'di tha ga pa'i sna bo 'thag tu ma gzhug ⑥par 'di ltar ra ba ga ge mo zhig gi drung na tha ga pa spyi cer 0khyo shug 'dug pa des 'di btag par bya'o/ /che bas mi de la smras pa / kye nang rje tha ga pa spyi cer de'i gan du song la 'di skad ces che ba na re ⑥'di thogs la byin cig ⑩ces zer ro zhes gyis shig /mi des dog pa de khyer te 6—404

tha ga pa spyi cer ①gyi gan du song ste ②smras pa/ kye spyi cer lache ba'i zhal nas 'di thogs la byin cig ④ces gsung ngo / /spyi cer gyis dog pa de ngo shes nas des smras pa/ bdag gis res 'khor ⑤ngo/ /mi de song ste che ba la smras pa/tha ga pa spyi cer gyi mchid nas bdag gi res 'khor ⑥ro zhes mchi'o/ /che bas smras pa/ kye nang rje spyi cer gyi gan du song la 'di skad ces res gzhan byed du mi gzhug go zhes gyis shig /mi de song ste smras pa/ kye spyi cer che ba'i zhal nas res gzhan ⑦byed du mi gzhug go zhes gsung ngo / /spyi cer gyis smras pa/kye nang rje che ba mnyan yod du dbang byed na kho bo mnyan yod du ⑧mi gnas par zad mod/ kho bo skal ⑨ba ma yin pa'i las mi byed do/ /mi de che ba'i gan du song ste smras pa/ spyi cer gyi mchid nas che ba mnyan yod du dbang byed na kho bo mnyan yod du mi gnas par zad mod/ kho bo 0skal ba ma yin pa'i las mi byed do zhes mchi'o/ /che bas smras pa/ kye nang rje tha ga pa'i sna bo'i gan du song la dog pa 'di las ras yug chen thogs shig ces bgyi ⑩shig /nye dga'as smras pa / 'di tha ga pa'i sna bos btag par mi bya bar 'di ltar tha ga pa spyi cer gyis btag par tsobya'o/ /che bas mi de la smras pa/ kye nang rje tha ga pa spyi cer ⑫gyi gan du song la/ che ba na re skom zong sbyin gyis tsoras yug chen thogs shig ces zer ro zhes gyis shig /de 'phags pa ④nye dga'as de la smras pa/ bkren pa khyod su zhig gis rgyal po'i mir bzhag /khyod lcag rgod mang pos brdabs te sa dang shing dag skyed du gzhug par bya ba yin no/ /tha ga pa spyi cer 0gyi gan du song ste 'di skad ces che ba'i zhal nas ras yug chen thogs shig ces byung ngo / /zhes zer mi nus samacha/ gal te mi 'thag go zhes zer na tsothor to 6—405

dag nas ①bzung ste khug la khu tshur gyis gtogs shig gal te ngu na thags mi mthun par dril cig② /gal te de'i chung ma ngu na lan bu nas bzung ste drang bar bya zhing / khyed gnyis kyis ③che ba'i mchid dubacag pas khyed gnyis ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya gzhal dgos pa'i gyod la bsgrin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de lta dun kho bo'i ras yug chen yang 'grub par 'gyur la khyod kyis kyang gsug mang po 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de song ste smras pa/ che ba'i zhal nas skom zong sbyin gyis duras yug chen thogs shig ces byung ngo / /spyi cer ⑦gyis smras pa/ kho bo skal ba ma yin ⑧pa 'thag mi nus so//des de'i thor to ⑨dag nas bzung ste bkug nas khu tshur gyis btags so/ /des ngu bar brtsams pa dang / des de'i thags mi mthun tho)par dril bar brtsams so/ /de'i chung mas ngu bar brtsams pa dang / des de'i lan bu nas bzung ste drang bar brtsams shing khyed gnyis yikyis che ba'i mchid 8bcag pas khyed tsoganyis ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya gzhal dgos pa'i gyod ④la bsgrin ④par byas 'tshur shog /rgyal po'i pho brang du 'dong ngo zhes des de gnyis khrid de 'phags pa dang / chung ⑩mas spyi cer la smras pa/rje'i sras tsogal te bdag cag gnyis btson rar bcug par gyur na bdag cag gnyis la thar bar byed pa 'ga' yang med pas ⑩btson rar gnod pa dag gis 'chi bar bya dgos kyis ras yug chen 'di thogs shig /spyi ⑩cer gyis smras pa/kye nang po bdag cag rgyal po'i pho 0brang du ma bkri bar dog pa zhog dul bzhud cig dang bdag ༷gis ras yug chen yang btag cing khyod la yang gsug byamang po dbul lo/ /des dog pa bzhag ste song ba dang spyi cer dugyis chung ma la smras pa/6—406

bzang mo ras yug chen 'di gang gis dog par yang mi ①rung la ras yug chen du'ang mi rung bar 'gyur ba de ltar btag par bya'o/ /chung mas smras pa/rje'i sras de dge sbyong hral po de lta bu yin pas bdag cag gis ras yug chen de lta bur byas na des btang re skan/ des ras yug chen de btags nas de ②ras yug chen de thags las 'grol zhing 'dug pa na ①nye dga' yang 'ongs nas nye dga'as ras yug chen de blangs pa dang / spyi cer ④gyis smras pa/'phags pa bdag la skom zong stsol ⑤cig /bkren pa kho bo khyod kyi skom zong dbul ⑥ba yin namanya/ dug ci'i phyir mi brgyud nur rtsi ⑤ci'i phyir mi brgyud⑨/de shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams kyi dge sbyong gi tshul ni tshig go/ /bram ze'i tshul ni tshig ste/ 'di ltar kha'i chos cung 0zad kyis kyang 'thag 0tu bcug go/ /rgyal po'i pho brang gi mthu cung zad kyis kyang 'thag tu bcug go zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka chagatong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te0/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis nye dga' la rmas 0pa/nye dga' khyod kyis mi mdzes pa de lta bu de byas par gyur pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad 8do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa tsomadzad do/ /de 6—407

nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang rang gis bslangs ①pa'i dog pas tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa las ②gos 'thag tu 'jud na gos grub na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni shākya'i bu nye dga' 'am/ gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /rang gis bslangs ②pa'i dog pas zhes bya ba ni 'dun pas la ④la las sung gcig⑤ /la la las srang phyed/ la la las zho gnyis/ la la las zho gcig bslangs 0pa'i dog pas so/ /tha ga pa zhes bya ba ni thags mkhan no/ /nye du ma yin pa la ⑦zhes bya ba ni phyi mo dang / mes po dang / phrugs las brten pa'i bdun pa tshun chad ni nye du yin la/ de phan chad ni nye du ma yin no/ /gos 'thag tu 'jud na zhes bya ba ni bdun ④po bal gos dang / sha na'i gos dang / zar ma'i gos dang / du gu la'i gos dang / ras bal gyi 0gos dang / ko tam pa'i gos dang / nyi 'og gi gos la ba ⑩gang yang rung ba'o/ /gos grub na zhes bya ba ni gos thob na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags pa yibya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i 7ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar 'ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis ④nye du ma yin pa las dog pa bslangs te tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa la gos 'thag tu 'jud na de slong ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa la 'thag tu 'jud 6—408

pa la spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis nye du ma yin pa las dog pa bslangs ①te tha ga pa nye du la gos 'thag ②tu 'jud na de slong ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ tha ga pa nye du la 'thag tu 'jud pa la ①lhung ba med do/ /dge slong gis nye du ma yin pa las dog pa bslangs ༷te bdag nyid kyis 'thag par byed na/ de slong ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la bdag nyid kyis 'thag pa la yang nyes byas nyid du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis nye du ma yin pa las dog pa bslangs ⑤te tha ga pa nye du dang nye du ma yin pa la gos 'thag tu 'jud na de duslong ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ tha ga pa nye du la 'thag tu 'jud pa la ltung ba med do/ /tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa la 'thag tu 'jud pa la spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis nye du ma yin pa las dog pa bslangs ⑦te bdag nyid dang tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa la dugos 'thag tu 'jud na de slong ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bdag nyid kyis 'thag pa la yang nyes byas nyid du ⑨'gyur ro/ /tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa la 'thag tu 'jud pa la spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis nye du ma yin pa las dog pa bslangs 0te bdag nyid dang tha ga pa nye du la gos 'thag tu 'jud na de slong ba la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ bdag nyid kyis 'thag pa la yang nyes byas nyid du 'gyur ro/ /tha ga pa nye du la 'thag tu 'jud pa la ltung ba med do/ /dge slong gis nye du las dog pa bslangs te tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa la gos 'thag tu 'jud na de slong ba la ltung ba med la/tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa la gos 'thag tu 'jud pa la spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur rol/ /dge slong gis nye du las dog pa bslangs te tha ga pa nye du la gos 'thag tu 'jud na de slong ba la ltung ba med la/ tha ga pa nye du la gos 'thag tu 'jud 6wa 409

pa la yang ltung ba med do/ /dge slong gis ①nye du las ②dog pa bslangs te bdag nyid kyis 'thag par byed na de slong ba la ltung ba med la bdag nyid kyis 'thag pa la nyes byas nyid du 'gyur ro/ /③dge slong gis nye du las dog pa bslangs ④te tha ga pa ①nye du ma yin pa la gos 'thag tu 'jud na de slong ba la ltung ba med la/ tha ga pa nye du la gos 'thag tu 'jud pa la yang lhung ba med do//tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa la gos 'thag tu 'jud pa la spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro / /dge slong gis nye du las dog pa bslangs te bdag nyid dang tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa la gos ⑥'thag tu 'jud na de slong ba la ltung ba med la/ bdag nyid kyis 'thag pa la nyes byas nyid du 'gyur ro/ /tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa la 'thag tu 'jud pa la spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis nye du las dog pa bslangs ⑦te bdag nyid dang tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa la gos 'thag tu 'jud na de slong ba la ltung ba med la/ bdag nyid kyis 'thag pa la nyes byas nyid du 'gyur ro/ /tha ga pa nye du la gos 'thag tu 'jud pa la ltung ba med do/ /gla rngan gyis 'thag tu 'jud pa la ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang /smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /'thag tu 'jud pa'i spang ba ste nyi shu gsum pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na khyim bdag cig 'dug pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed dga' mgur ⑧spyod par byed do/ /khyim bdag 6wa 410

de dus gzhan zhig na gzhan gyi chung ma la chags par gyur nas de la chung mas rje'i sras de lta ①ma mdzad cig ces phyir zlog ②na/ ji tsam du de ②phyir bzlog kyang ma log pa de tsam du de'i ༷chung ma de yang skyes pa gzhan dag dang lhan cig 'khrul pa rtsom par byed do/ /khyim bdag de yang bud med gzhan dag la sbyin par byed la/ chung ⑤ma de yang skyes pa gzhan dag la sbyin par byed pas de ltar khyim de gnyis ka ⑥rgyad par gyur nas ⑦de gnyis la bu mo mngag gzhug ma zhig yod nas khyim bdag des bu mo de la 'dis khyim rgud par byas so zhes khu nitshur dang / thal lcag dag gis rdeg par byed do/ /bu mo des smras pa/ bdag gis khyim rgyad par gyur pa ⑨'di ci las gyur pa 'tshal mod kyi 'on kyang bdag gis ji ltar rje dag la bsngags pa ma lags pa brjod ⑩ par bgyir rung / nye dga'as de yitshor nas 'khyim bdag de dang khyim bdag gi 'chung ma de'i gan du song ste ci nas kyang de gnyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi dag la gnas par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar tshul khrims kyi bsngags pa brjod cing / tshul khrims 'chal pa'i bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod nas des de gnyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi tsodag la gnas par byas so/ /khyim bdag de gtum pa/ brtun klungs pa/ drag shul che ba yin pas yang bu mo de la brdeg ⑫par brtsams pa dang / chung mas de la smras pa/ rje'i sras gang gi 0tshe bdag cag las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa mi mkhyen pa de'i tshe go brdeg par mdzad modayi / da bdag cag dge ba'i bshes 0gnyen 'phags pa nye dga' la ⑥brten nas las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa mkhyen pas 'di ltar 'jig rten ni rang gi las kyi 'bras bu la spyod pa lags pas su zhig su'i bran lags/ bu mo 6—411

'di la rdeg par ma mdzad cig /bzang mo khyod zer ba ma nyes so/ /bu mo tshur shog /khrus gyis la shog shig /bu mo de ༅khrus byas te 'ongs pa dang /des de la gos phrugs gcig ②bskon nas smras pa/ bu mo dga' zhing las byos shig /bu mo des bsams pa/ khyim bdag khyo shug 'di sngon gtum pa/brtun ngas pa/ drag shul che ba yin te/ yang dang yang du bdag la khu tshur dang thal lcag dag ②gis rdeg par byed cing zas dang gos ngan pa dag sbyin par byed na/ da 'di bdag gi ④pa ma dang 'dra bar gyur to snyam nas/ yang bsams pa/ gang tshun cad nas 'phags pa nye dga' khyim 'dir 'jug par brtsams pa de tshun chad nas khyim bdag 'di pha ma dang 'dra bar gyur pas bdag gis 'phags pa nye dga' la ci zhig gis dga' bar bya snyam nas des bsams pa/gal te bdag gis 'di las chung zhig brkus ⑤te dbul du ni khyim bdag 'dis bdag brdeg btsog ⑥mang po byas te sngon gyi gnas su bzhag ⑦par 'gyur ro snyam nas de sdod cing 'dug go/ /khyim bdag gi chung ma des khyim bdag de la smras pa/rje'i sras mkhyen par mdzod cig /'phags pa ②nye dga' ni bdag cag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags te/ 'phags pa nye dga'as bdag cag las ⑨dri ma can dang phral nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi dag la bkod ⑩de/yang dang yang du bdag cag la chos kyis sdud par byed pas bdag cag gis kyang de la zang zing cung zad kyis bsdu bar bgyi'o/ /bzang mo de bzhin bya'o/ /rje'i sras bdag gis dog pa 'jam po bkal te/ dog pa de las tha ga pa che ge mo zhig la ⑩ras yug chen 'thag tu stsal 0cing slad kyis ras yug chen bskon ⑫par bgyi'o/ /khyim bdag des dog pa de tha ga pa la byin nas smras pa/6—412

bzhin bzangs khyod kyis dog pa 'di las ras yug chen thogs shig dang 'phags pa nye dga' la dbul bar ba'o①/ /de ltar bya'o/ /bu mo des de thos nas bsams pa/ bdag gis 'phags pa nye dga' la dga' ba de sbran par bya'o snyam mo/ /nye dga' yang snga dro sham thabs bgos ②lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs nas mthar gyis bsod ⑧snyoms la rgyu ba na khyim der zhugs pa dang / bu mo des khyim legs par byugs shing phyag dar bor nas/ des nye dga' mthong ba dang rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ bdag gis 'phags pa nye dga' la dgyes pa sbran ④par bgyi'ol/ /nye dga'as smras pa/ bu mo khyod kyis kho bo la dga' ba ci zhig sbran par bya/ khyim bdag 'di khyod la ras yug chen 'bul bar 'gyur ro/ /nye dga'as bsams pa/ sa'i steng na 'dod pa'i bdag nyid can gang ji snyed yod pa de dag dang bdag mnyam par deng bu mo ⑤'dis kyang 'phrigs so snyam du rig nas bu mo de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu mo ༅ci kho bo la tho 'tsham ⑦par byed dam/ bu mos ⑤smras pa/ bdag ci'i slad du 'phags pa la tho 0'tsham par bgyid/ nye dga'as smras pa/ bu mo gal te bden par gyur na ni ngas khyod la gshe ba dag la chugs ma bya'o/ / ji ste brdzun ⑩par gyur na ni brdeg btsog ⑩mang po byed du bcug ste sngon gyi gnas ji lta tsobar gzhag par bya'o/ /'phags pa gal te bdag la thugs mi ches na phyogs ga ge mo zhig na tha ga pa mchis pa der bzhud cig dang khyod nyid kyis mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ /de der song ste 8tha ga pa la smras 0pa/ bzhin bzangs ras yug chen 8'thag pa 'di su'i yin/ 'phags pa btsun pa nye dga'i lags so/ /khyod kyis nye dga' 6—413

shes ①sam/ ma 'tshal to②/ /de ni kho bo yin no/ /bzhin bzangs srid du 'di tsam gyis srings ②shig /'phags pa dog pa sus stsol dubar 'gyur/khyim bdag de nyid kyis sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /kho bos kyang khyod la cung zhig nye bar bsgrub par bya'o/ /nye dga' phyi de nyin par snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed ⑤dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs nas de mthar gyis bsod ①snyoms la rgyu ba na/ btsun mo phreng ldan ma'i khyim du zhugs ⑦nas / des de'i stan bting ba dang / de de la 'dug nas btsun mo phreng ⑧ldan mas nye dga'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te chos mnyan pa'i phyir mdun du ⑨'dug go/ /des de la chos bstan nas des smras pa/ 'phags pa ci lags/deng spyan drangs sam/ bsod snyoms mdzad/ bsod snyoms bgyid do/ /des bsams pa su zhig bdag pas ⑨ bsod 0snyoms ches bzang ba 'bul bar 'gyur snyam nas des de la hwags kyi la thu 8dag gis lhung bzed 0bkang ste phul lo / /nye dga'as de dag blangs te tha ga pa de'i gan du song nas des de la smras pa/ bzhin bzangs je lag pa gnyis zed ④cig /des lag pa gnyis bzed 4)pa dang / des de la la thu gcig (9byin nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs je tu)zo shig /des de tu)zos pa dang / des de la smras pa/bzhin bzangs la thu'i ⑥ro ci 'dra/ 'phags pa bda'o/ /khyod kyis sngon lan 'ga' la thu ( tre 'di 'dra ba zos sam/ 'phags pa lan 'ga' yang ma 'tshal to/ /thu ba zed cig /des thu ba bzed pa dang / des de'i thu bar la thu 0thams cad blugs te smras pa/ bzhin bzangs kho bo'i ras yug chen 'di legs par thogs 3shig /kho bos ⑫khyod la phyis kyang la thu chung chazad nye 6—414

bar bsgrub par byas zheng ①du 'di tsam gyis skyed ②cig /'phags pa dog pa bas par gyur na ②sus ④stsol bar 'gyur/ khyim bdag de nyid kyis sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /des ras yug chen de 'thag pa na dog pa ⑧zad nas de khyim bdag de'i gan du song ba dang / ji tsam na khyim bdag gi chung ma ni med/ khyim bdag ni 'dug nas tha ga pa des khyim bdag de la smras pa/ khyim bdag ras yug chen de btag pa'i dog pa zad kyis khyedog pa byin cig khyim bdag des byin te btang ngo / /yang 'thag pa na dog pa zad pa ⑦nas de yang khyim bdag de'i gan du song ba dang / ji tsam na khyim bdag ni med khyim bdag gi chung ma ni 'dug nas tha ga pa des khyim bdag gi chung ma de la smras pa/ sru ras yug chen de btag ⑧pa'i dog pa zad kyis 0dog pa byin cig /des byin te btang ngo / /yang 'thag pa na dog pa 4) zad nas de khyim bdag de'i khyim du song ba dang /ci 7tsam na khyim bdag dang khyim bdag gi chung ma gnyi ga 'dug nas tha ga pa des khyim bdag de la smras pa/ khyim bdag yang ras yug chen de btag pa'i dog pa zad kyis spre)yang dog pa byin cig /khyim bdag gi chung mas smras pa/ kye tha ga pa ci ras yug chen de bskyed dam/ khyim bdag gis chung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo ci khyod kyis kyang 'di la dog pa byin nam/ stsal to/ /khyim bdag gis smras pa/ kye tha ga pa ci ras yug chen de bskyed dam/ tha ga pas smras pa/khyim bdag ci deng bskyed par brtsams snyam mamatso/ nyi ma gang kho na la btsun pa nye dga' mchis nas 'di skad ces srid du 'di tsam gyis srings ④shig /zheng du 'di tsam gyis skyed 8cig ces mchi ba'i nyi ma de kho na la bskyed ⑩par brtsams so/ /khyim bdag gi chung mas bsams pa/ ras yug chen ⑩de ci 6—415

'dra ji ltar ①'gro'o snyam nas de der song ba dang / ji tsam na chen po la ②'os pa'i ras yug chen mthong ngo / /de mthong nas de'i mig khrag gis gang ste smras pa/ kho mos ras yug chen 'di 'phags pa nye dga' la mi byin ②rna/ /kho mos de'i don du ras yug chen gzhan zhig 'thag tu gzhug go zhes zer te song ngo / /nye dga' dus dang dus su der 'ongs nas smras pa/ kye tha ga ④pa rung ngam/'phags pa bdag gi ⑤ni rung na khyod kyi ni mi rung ngo / /kye tha ga pa ji ltar gyur/des smras pa/ khyim bdag gi chung ma mchis par gyur te des ras yug chen mthong nas de'i mig khrag gis gang ste/ kho mos 'phags pa nye dga' la ras yug chen 'di mi sbyin no/ /kho mos de'i don du ras yug chen gzhan 'thag tu gzhug go zhes mchi ste mchis so/ /kye tha ga pa khyod la kho bos cung 0zhig byas pa yod pa shes sam/ des smras pa ci'i slad du ma 'tshal/ bdag da dung yang khyod kyi la thu ⑦dag 'tshal zhing mchis so/ /kye tha ga pa gang gi tshe 'kho bo khyim der 'ongs par gyur pa de'i tshe na khyod kyis ras lug chen 'di khyer 0shog shig /'phags pa je bzhud cig dang bdag gis kyang kha tshar bkal te mchi'o/ /nye dga' de'i khyim du song ste tshusgo'i thad kur 'dug pa dang / khyim bdag gi chung ma des rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te kha sgor lta zhing mdun du 'dug go/ /tha ga pa des kyang ras yug chen de'i kha tshar dril nas de khyer te der tho〉song ba dang /khyim bdag gi 'chung ma des de thag ring po kho na nas mthong nas des lag brdas ma 'ong ④shig ces byas pa dang / tha ga pa des phyogs bzhir rnam par bltas nas ltos bzung bas mgo smad de nang du zhugs nas des ras yug chen de khyim bdag gi chung ma de'i pang du bzhag pa dang / nye dga'as tsham tshom med par 6—416

blangs te smras pa/ a rog gya ①sbyin pa 'dis khyod sems kyi rgyan dang /sems kyi yo byad dang / rnal 'byor gyi tshogs dang / don gyi mchog 'thob ②pa dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi gos thob par gyur cig /khyim bdag gi chung mas smras pa/ 'phags pa khyim bdag gis rang gi sug pa nas dbul gyis ③slar stsol cig /nye dga'as smras pa/ kho bos 'di je ⑦rung bar byas/de'i 'og tu khyim bdag drang srong gi rgyal mtshan skon ⑤du gzhug go/ /khyim bdag gi 0chung mas smras pa/ 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das kyis kha dog dkar po ⑦bsngags so/ /nye dga'as smras pa/ drang srong gi rgyal mtshan skon ⑤du chug shig ces smras nas langs te song ngo// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po sum bcu rtsa ⑨lnga pa/ tha ga pas smras pa/ khyim bdag gi tshubatsun mo bdag la gla byin cig /des smras yipa/kho mo'i ras yug chen gcig kyang 'phrog tu bcug nas gla gzhan yang ded dam/song la khyod kyis gang la ras yug chen byin pa de nyid la gla dos shig /de nye dga'i gan du song ste smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag la gla stsol cig /song la khyim bdag gi chung ma de nyid la dos shig /'phags pa khyim bdag gi mchis brang de mchid 'bo 8zhing 'di skad ces khyod kyis gang la ras yug chen byin pa de nyid la gla dos shig ces mchi'o/ /nye dga'as smras pa/ song shig dang byin par 'gyur ro/ /tha ga pa de yang de'i tsogan du song ste smras pa/ khyim bdag gi btsun mo bdag la gla byin cig /des smras pa/ kwa'i khyo chag khyod 'dug mi phod dam/ gal te 'dug na ni 'dug shig /mi 'dug na kho mos khyod kyi mgrin 8par chol zangs btags te mnyan yod thams cad du bskor bar bya'o/ /6—417

tha ga pa de yang nye dga'i thad du song ste smras pa/ 'phags pa khyim bdag gi mchis brang des ①bdag spyos te/ kwa'i 0khyo ga khyod 'dug mi phod dam/ gal te 'dug na ni ③'dug shig /mi 'dug na kho mos khyod kyi mgrin 0par chol zangs ⑤btags te mnyan yod thams cad du bskor ⑥bar bya'o zhes mchi yis 'phags pas ⑦bdag la gla stsol cig /nye dga'as smras pa/ kye nang rje ⑧gal te gang gis 0kho bo'i ras yug chen 'thag tu bcug pa de'i gla kho bo 'jal bar gyur na kho bo'i lhung bzed dang chos gos kyang med par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang tshur shog rtsis byas ⑩khyod kyis kho bo las bag phye'i rin dang / zhun ⑩mar dang / hwags la sogs pa ji tsam khyer ba dag khod cig ⑩ces rtsis byas pa dang /ji tsam na ches lhag par khyer bar gyur nas/ nye dga'as tha ga pa de yud tsam zhig nyi tshan la btags te btang ngo / /tha ga pa de shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams kyi dge sbyong gi tshul ni tshig go/ /bram ze'i tshul ni tshig ste/ de ④ltar lhag pa kho na bya'o zhes zer la 'bri ba kho nar byed do zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka tsogatong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang /gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do ⑫zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni ⑩mkhyen bzhin du rmed 0par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin cate'u / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis nye dga' la mas yipa/ nye dga' khyod kyis mi mdzes pa de lta bu de byas par gyur pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad ⑦do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun 6—418

pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa ①mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong gi phyir khyim bdag gam khyim bdag gi chung ma nye du ma yin pas tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa ②la gos 'thag tu bcug pa las de na gal te dge slong de la sngar ma bstabs ③par rnam par rtog pa 'ga' zhig byung nas tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa tha ga pa shes par gyis shig /gos 'di kho bo'i phyir 'thag gis thutshe dang ldan pa tha ga pa gos 'di zheng ①che ba dang / khrun ring ba dang / thar gyis zhag pa dang / thags duran bzang bar legs par ⑦gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa tha ga pa 'di ltar kho bos gla rngan 'di lta ste/ bza' ba'am bca' ⑧ba tsam mam ⑨bza' rgyu cung 0zad sbyin no zhes smras nas/ de la gal te dge slong des gos bsgrub pa'i phyir gla rngan 'di lta ste/ bza' ba'am bca' yib tsam mamaX/ bza' rgyu cung 8zad cig sbyin zhing gos grub na spang ba'i ltung byed do / /dge slong gi phyir zhes bya ba ni shākya'i bu nye dga' 'am gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /khyim bdag ces bya ba ni skyes pa'o/ /khyim bdag gi chung ma zhes bya ba ni bud med do/ /nye du ma yin pa 4)zhes bya ba ni phyi mo dang /mes po dang / phrugs kyi bdun pa tshun chad ni nye du yin la/ de phan chad 6—419

ni nye du ma yin no/ /tha ga pa zhes bya ba ni thags mkhan no/ /nye du ma yin pa la zhes bya ba ni phyi mo dang / mes po dang / phrugs kyi bdun pa ①tsan chad ni nye du yin la/ de phan chad ni nye du ma yin no/ /gos 'thag tu bcug pa las zhes bya ba ni bdun po bal gos dang / sha na'i gos dang / zar ma'i gos dang / du gu la'i gos dang / ras bal gyi gos dang / ko tam pa'i gos dang / nyi ⑤'og gi gos dag las gang yang rung ba'o/ /de na gal te dge slong de la zhes bya ba ni shākya'i bu nye dga' la'o/ /sngar ma bstabs par zhes bya ba ni sngar mgon ①du ma bos par ro/ /rnam par rtog ④pa 'ga' zhig byung nas zhes bya ba ni bsnyen bkur byed pa 'ga' zhig ⑥byung nas so/ /tha ga pa nye du ma yin pa'i gan du song ste zhes bya ba ni drung du song ste'o/ /'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa tha ga pa shes par gyis shig /gos 'di kho bo'i phyir 'thag gis ⑥zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid nye bar ston par byed pa'o/ /zheng che ba zhes bya ba ni rgyar che ba'o⑦/ /khrun ring ba zhes bya ba ni chur ring ba'o/ /thar gyis zhag pa zhes bya ba ②ni 'jur ⑨mdud med pa'o/ /thags tshuran bzang bar zhes bya ba ni byer zug snyoms pa dang / shas bzang ba dang / sad sed med par ro⑩ /bza' ba'am zhes bya ba ni bza' ba lnga po tsodag go/ / bca' ba tsam mam ⑫zhes bya ba ni bca' ba lnga po dag go/ /bza' rgyu zhes bya ba ni bza' ba'i ④rgyu'o//de la gal te dge slong des zhes bya ba ni shākya'i bu nye dga'as so/ /gos bsgrub pa'i phyir zhes bya ba ni gos thob par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /gos grub na zhes bya ba ni gos thob na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs byanas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i 6—420

ltung byed do zhes gsungs so/ /de la ltung bar ①ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dge slong gis ji ①tsam du gos bsgrub pa'i phyir khri las ldang bar byed/ gos dag dang / sham thabs gon par byed/ lag pa dang / lhung bzed ②'khru bar byed/ bsod snyoms la 'jug par byed/ bca' ba lnga dang bza' ba lnga dag slong bar byed/ tha ga pa la sbyin par byed cing ji srid du gos thob par mi byed kyi bar du nyes ④byas su 'gyur ro/ /gos thob na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gal te phyogs ga ge mo zhig tu gos 'thag tu bcug gis ⑤de khyod kyis blta bar bya'o zhes sngar bstabs par gyur na ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /'thag pa skyed ⑥pa'i spang ba ste nyi shu bzhi pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /dga' bo la lhan cig ⑦gnas pa chos zhes bya ba ngo tsha shes pa 'gyod pa dang ldan pa dubasdams pa/ bslab pa 'dod pa zhig yod pa des ji srid du de gnas ngan len kun tu spyod par mi shes pa de srid du de dang lhan cig gnas so/ /gang gi tshe des de gnas ngan len kun tu spyod par shes pa de'i tshe na de ⑨rang bzhin ⑩du gnas pa'i dge slong rnams dang lhan cig gnas par brtsams te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑩bka' lung gis dus gsum du rkang pa la phyag 'tshal du 'gro ba 'ba' zhig 'byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun 6—421

dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa ko sa la dag tu ljongs ①rgyur gshegs kyis ②khyed cag las gang de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig ②ko sa la dag tu ljongs rgyur 'gro bar 0spro ba des chos gos kyi las gyis shig ces bsgo ⑤sheg /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das ko sa la dag tu ljongs rgyur gshegs kyis ⑥khyed cag las gang bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ⑦ko sa la dag tu ljongs rgyur ⑧'gro bar spro ba ⑨des chos gos kyi las gyis shig /dga' bos thos te/ thos nas kyang nye dga' la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' shes par gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos dge slong rnams la tshe dang ldan pa dag shes par gyis shig/bcom ldan 'das ko sa la dag tu ljongs rgyur gshegs kyis7/ khyed cag las gang bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig 7rka sa la dag tu ljongs rgyur 'gro bar spro ba des chos gos kyi las gyis shig ces bsgo na/ gal te bdag cag 'di nyid du 'dug na ni sgo tso'aphar brgya dag 'das te ci nas kyang lto dgang ba bsgrub par bya dgos so/ /ji 0ste bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ci'agro na ni bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas gshegs pa la phan yon bcwa chubargyad yod par gsungs pas srog chags brgya stong phrag du ma dag kyang bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ⑫'gro bar 'gyur bas/ gal te bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ⑩'gro na re zhig chu yang rnyog pa 8can dag btung dgos par 'gyur la/ shing sngon pa'i drung du yang go ⑩thob par mi 'gyur gyis chabadag cag dge slong rab tu bshes ⑥pa 'ga' zhig khrid de/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun gyi 6—422

bsngags ①pa brjod cing mdun du dong na de lta na bdag cag bde bar rgyu bar 'gyur zhing rnyed pa mang po yang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /nye dgalas smras pa/slob dpon re zhig gser gyi snod spangs te sa'i snod kyis bsod snyoms rgyu bar ②byed dam/ khyod kyi ②lhan cig gnas pa chos lta bu ngo tsha shes pa/ 'gyod pa dang ldan pa/ bsdams pa/ bslab pa ④'dod pa su la yod/ des kho bo mthong bar yang ⑤mi 'dod do/ /slob dpon bcom ldan 'das kyis bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi po sbyin pa dang / snyan par smra ba dang / don spyod pa dang /⑥don mthun pa gang dag bka' ⑦stsal ⑧pa de dag las slob dpon gyis 'ga' zhig yang dag par 0blangs te 'jud par byas pa yod dam/ de ni thams cad kyi ⑩thams cad du med do/ /de'i phyir khyod kyi yiganas skabs de lta bu der gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa chos kyi snam sbyar rnyings tsonas des ras yug chen zhig 0rnyed nas bsams pa/ bdag song la mkhan po la zhus te snam sbyar btsem par bya'o snyam nas/ des de khyer te dga' bo'i gan du 'phags pa dang / de 'gro ba na bsod snyoms pa zhig gis mthong nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa chos 8gar 'gro/ des smras pa/ kho bo'i snam sbyar rnyings te kho bo'i tsoras yug chen 'di rnyed pas bdag song ste mkhan po la zhus la tsosnam sbyar btsem par bya'o/ /bsod snyoms pas smras pa/ gal te khyod snam sbyar sar ⑩pa gzhan 'tshem na snam sbyar rnying pa 'di kho bo la byin cig /de bzhin bya'o/ /de dga' bo'i gan du song ste smras pa/ mkhan po bdag gi snam sbyar rnyings te 8bdag gis ras yug chen 'di rnyed ⑩pas snam sbyar btsem par duzhu'o/ /nye dga'as smras pa ⑥slob dpon 'di ni de'i dus lags so/ /dga' bos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 6—423

chos ②kho bo nyid la snam sbyar zhig yod pa de kho bos khyod la sbyin no/ /mkhan po mi 'tshal te bdag gis ras yug chen 'di ②las snam sbyar drubs te bcang bar bgyi'o / /nye dga'as smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa chos ②kho bos ko gzhan thos la gzhan mthong ste/ kho bos khyod ngo tsha shes pa/ 'gyod pa dang ldan pa/ bsdams pa/ bslab pa 'dod pa yin par shes kyi/ kho bos khyod 'di ltar mkhan po'i chos dang ldan pa'i tshig gcog par mi shes so/ /ci khyod mkhan po dang mi mthun pa'i don yang dag par len par byed dam/ de dge slong dbang chen pos smad pas cang mi smra bar 'dug pa dang / dga' bos kyang de la snam sbyar byin no/ /des de blangs nas smras pa/ mkhan po khyod ras yug chen 'di bzhes shig /tshe dang ldan pa chos ④ci kho bos khyod la brje ba'i ⑤phyir snam sbyar byin nas ⑥ras yug chen yang lakhyod nyid khyer cig /des bsams pa/ bdag la yo byad don med pa 'dis ci bya/ bdag gis ras yug chen 'di dge 'dun la dbul ⑧bar bya zhing snam sbyar rnying pa 'di yang bsod snyoms pa de la sbyin pa mkhan po la 7zhu'o snyam nas smras pa/ mkhan po bdag gis ras yug chen 'di dge 'dun la dbul bar bgyi zhing snam sbyar rnying ⑩pa 'di yang ⑩bsod snyoms pa zhig gis bslangs pas de la stsal bar bgyi ba mkhan po la zhu'o/ /de bzhin gyis shig /des ras yug chen de dge 'dun la phul ⑩zhing snam sbyar rnying tshupa de yang bsod snyoms pa de ④la byin no/ /phyi de ⑫nyin par de snam sbyar de gyon te mkhan po'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal du 'ongs pa dang / dga' bos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa chos ⑩shes par gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos dge slong rnams la tshe dang ldan pa dag shes par gyis 6—424

shig /bcom ldan 'das ko sa la dag tu ljongs rgyur gshegs kyisal/ khyed cag las gang bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ②ko sa la dag tu ljongs rgyur 'gro bar spro ba des chos gos kyi las gyis ②shig ces bsgo na/ gal te bdag cag 'di nyid du 'dug na ni sgo 'phar brgya rjodag 'das te ci nas kyang lto gang rjob bsgrub dupar bya dgos so/ /ji ④ste bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ⑧'gro na ni bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas gshegs pa la phan yon bcwa brgyad yod par gsungs pas srog chags ⑨brgya stong phrag du ma dag kyang bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ⑩'gro bar 'gyur bas gal te bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ⑩'gro ba tson re zhig chu yang rnyog pa 8can dag btung dgos par 'gyur la/shing ljon pa'i drung du yang go thob par mi 'gyur gyis8/ bdag cag sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 8'dun gyi bsngags pa brjod ⑩cing mdun du dong na de lta na bdag cag bde bar rgyu bar 'gyur zhing / rnyed pa mang po yang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /mkhan po bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas gshegs pa la phan yon bcwa brgyad mchis par bka' stsal pa gang dag tshulags pa de dag tsomakhan po la nyes dmigs kho nar gyur te bdag ni re zhig bcom ldan 'das nyid dang thabs cig mchi'o⑩/ /dga' bos smras pa/ kho bo dang lhan cig 'dong 0ngo / /des smras 0pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyid phyedang lhan cig mchi'o/ /dga' bos spyos te smras pa/ ngan pa ci kho bos khyod la chos la 'chos nyid bzang pos snam sbyar byin snyam mamardzi/ khyod kho bo dang lhan cig 'gro ba'i phyir byin pa yin na gal te kho bo dang lhan cig mi 'gro na tsosnam sbyar 'on cig khyod dul mi sbyin no ⑦/ /tshe dang ldan pa chos ⑥kyis bsams pa/ bdag la chos gos 6—425

phrogs ①pa ni bla'i bdag gnas ngan len kun tu spyod pa dag dang lhan ②cig ljongs rgyur 'gro ba ni mi rung ngo snyam nas des de la snam sbyar phyir byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba dang ldan pa/ zhi ba 'khor zhi ba dang ldan pa/ grol ba 'khor grol ba dang ldan pa/ dbugs phyin pa 'khor dbugs phyin pa dang ldan pa/ thul ba 'khor thul ba dang ldan pa/ dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa dang ldan pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba dang ldan pa/ mdzes pa 'khor mdzes pa dang ldan pa/khyu mchog ltar ba lang gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ glang po che ltar glang po che'i phru gu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ seng ge ltar mche ba can gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar ngang pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nam mkha' lding ltar bya'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/bram ze ltar slob ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ sman pa mkhas ②pa ltar nad pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ dpa' bo ltar ru pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ④ba/ sa mkhan ltar lam du zhugs pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ded dpon ltar tshong pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su ⑤bskor ba/ tshong dpon ⑥ltar 'khor gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ⑦ba/ mkhar gyi rgyal po ltar blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ 'khor los sgyur ②ba ltar 0bu stong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ zla ba ltar rgyu skar gyi ⑨ tshogs kyis yongs su yibaskor 8ba/ nyi ma ltar 'od zer stong gi 'tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ yul 'khor srung ltar dri za'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/'phags skyes po ltar grul bum gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mig mi 6—426

bzang ltar klu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ①ba/ nor ②sbyin ltar gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis yongs ②bskor ba/ thags zangs ④ris ltar lha ma yin gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ⑤ba/ brgya byin ltar sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i 0tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ tshangs pa ltar tshangs ris kyi tshogs ⑦kyis yongs su bskor ba/ dbang po rnams kyis ⑧shin tu dul ba/ spyod lam dang /spyod pa ma 'khrugs pa/ chu gter ltar ting nge ba/ sprin ltar chu dang bcas pa/glang po che'i rgyal po ltar dregs pa dang bral bal/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus 0sku rnam par mdzes pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis gzugs can brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun tu bzang ba/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen lhonyepo dang tsoldan pa/ 'jig rten la phan par zhugs pa/ srung ba gcig 0pu pa/ nyag gcig yidapa' ba/gnyis pa med pa/ gnyis su mi gsung ba/ zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong gis bzhugs 8pa rig pa gsum gsal bar mdzad pa/ bslab pa gsum la legs par bslabs ⑩pa/ dul ba'i gnas gsum gyi gzhi la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi las rgal ⑩ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis spyod pa'i gzhi la legs par gnas pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas yongs su sbyang ba mdzad pa / mi 'jigs pa bzhis bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba/ yan lag lnga spangs pa/'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtag tu gnas pa drug gis gnas pa/6—427

byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis phyug pa/ lam gyi yan lag brgyad ston pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i ①snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcur snyan pas yang dag par rgyas pa/brgya phrag bcur dbang sgyur ②ba las khyad par du 'phags pa/ 'khor nyan thos chen po tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung dang / ga ya 'od srung sridang / chu klung 'od srung ④la sogs pa sngon gyi ral pa can stong dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i ⑤du dang / mod gal ⑥gyi bu chen po la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun mang pos mdun du bdar te ko sa la dag tu ljongs rgyur gshegs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ljongs rgyur gshegs pa rnams ni chos nyid kyis na sku thams cad kyis g.yas phyogs su glang po che'i lta stangs ⑦kyis la las legs par ma bgos pa ⑧dang / legs par ma bcangs ⑨par ma gyur tam snyam du rnam par gzigs par mdzad pas bcom ldan 'das kyis sku thams cad kyis ⑩g.yas phyogs su glang po che'i lta stangs kyis rnam par gzigs pa na tshe dang ldan pa chos ⑫chos gos stod g.yogs ()smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs rgyur 'gro ba (spregazigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo dge slong dbyar gnas pa rnams kyi 8chos gos kyi rnyed pa ma grub bams / bcom ldan 'das grub po/ /'o na ci'i phyir dge slong chos chos ⑩gos stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pas ljongs rgyur 'gro/ /des skabs de ⑩bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong dag dge slong la gos byin nas 'phrog par byed dam/ btsun pa 'phrog par bgyid do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 6—428

kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi ①'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la ②sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' bo la rmas ②pa/ dga' bo khyod kyis dge slong la gos byin nas yang phyir phrogs dupa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun ⑤pa ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa ⑥de ni rab tu byung bas ④bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa ⑧mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas/ 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la 0sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/yang dge slong gang dge slong la gos byin nas de'i 'og tu khros 'khrugs rngam par gyur te yi ⑩ma rangs nas 'phrog yigam 'phrog tu 'jud cing / de la 'di skad ces dge slong khyod la gos mi sbyin gyis 8phyir byin cig ④ces zer na dge slong des lhag ma yod pa phyir sbyin par bya zhing btang na spang ba'i ltung byed do/ /yang ④dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni shākya'i bu dga' bo'am/ gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /dge slong la zhes bya ba ni chos 'di pa'o/ /gos zhes bya ba ni bdun po bal gos dang / sha na'i gos dang / zar ma'i gos dang / du gu la'i gos dang / ras tsobal gyi gos dang / ko tam pa'i gos dang / nyi 6—429

'og gi gos las gang yang rung ba'o/ /byin nas ①zhes bya ba ni phyir sbyin mi dgos par ro de'i 'og tu zhes bya ba ni ②dus gzhan na'o②/ /khros 'khrugs rngam par gyur te yi ④ma rangs nas zhes bya ba ni khro ba ma sangs par ro/ /'phrog gam zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid kyis so/ /'phrog tu 'jud cing zhes bya ba ni gzhan no/ /dge slong des zhes bya ba ni dge slong gang yin pa des so/ /lhag ma yod pa zhes bya ba ni de'i lhag ma gang yod pa'o/ /phyir sbyin par bya zhing zhes bya ba ni gtang ⑤bar bya zhing ngo / /btang na zhes bya ba ni lus dang bral bar byas na'o/ /spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni dngos po de spangs nas ltung byed kyi ltung ba bshags par bya ba ste/ des na spang ba'i ltung byed do zhes gsungs 0so/ /de la ltung bar ⑦ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ lus g.yo bar byed pa dang / tshig rjod ⑧par byed pa dang / de gnyis ka ⑨dang ldan pa dang /gzhan dag gis so/ /de la ji ltar lus g.yo bar byed pas zhe ⑩na/ dge slong gis dge slong la gos byin nas de'i 'og tu khros 'khrugs yirngam par gyur te yi ⑫ma rangs nas lus 0kyis rtul ④bar byed cing 'dren par byed khrid par byed la/tshig gis dge slong khyod tsol gos mi sbyin gyis yiphyir byin cig ⑩ces ni mi zer na ji srid du gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/gos kyi grwa tsolus la 7bral bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur te/ de ltar lus g.yo bar byed pas so/ /ji ltar tshig rjod du par byed pas zhe na/ dge slong gis dge slong la gos byin 0nas de'i 'og tu khros 'khrugs durngam par gyur te yi 'am rangs nas dge slong khyod la gos mi sbyin gyis ④phyir byin cig ces tshig rjod par byed la lus kyis rtul khyabar 0mi byed na ji srid du gos kyi grwa lus las 6—430

bral bar mi byed pa de srid du nyes ①byas su 'gyur la/ gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur te/ de ltar tshig rjod par byed ②pas so/ /ji ltar de gnyis ka rgyadang ldan pas zhe na dge slong gis dge slong la gos byin nas de'i 'og tu khros 'khrugs rngam par gyur te yi dum rangs nas lus kyis kyang rtul ⑤bar byed cing tshig gis kyang dge slong khyod la gos mi sbyin gyis ༅phyir byin cig ces zer na ji srid du gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar mi byed pa de srid du nyes byas su 'gyur la/ gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar byed na spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur te/ de ltar gnyis ka ⑦dang ldan pas so/ /ji ltar gzhan dag gis zhe na dge slong gis dge slong la gos byin nas de'i 'og tu khros 'khrugs durngam par gyur te yi ⑨ma rangs nas dge slong 'phrog tu 'jud na ji srid du gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar mi byed pa de srid du gnyis ka tshul nyes byas re rer 'gyur la/ gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar byed na gnyi ga la spang ba'i ltung byed re rer 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong la gos byin nas ⑩de'i 'og tu khros 'khrugs tsorngam par gyur te yi tsom rangs nas dge slong ma 'phrog btu 'jud na ji srid du skegos kyi grwa lus las bral bar mi byed pa de srid du gnyis ka ⑫la nyes byas re rer 'gyur la/ gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar byed na dge slong ma la nyes byas nyid du 'gyur la/ dge slong la spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong la gos byin nas de'i 'og tu khros 'khrugs 0rngam par gyur te yi tsom rangs nas dge slob ⑩ma 'phrog tu 'jud na ji srid du gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar mi byed pa de srid du gnyis ka dul nyes byas re rer 'gyur la gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar byed na dge slob ⑥ma la nyes byas nyid du 'gyur la/6—431

dge slong la laspang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong la gos byin nas de'i 'og tu khros 'khrugs rngam par gyur te yi ②ma rangs nas dge tshul 'phrog tu 'jud na ji srid du gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar mi byed pa de srid du gnyis ka ③la nyes byas re rer 'gyur ro/ /④gis kyi grwa lus las bral bar byed na dge tshul la nyes byas nyid du 'gyur la/ dge slong la spang ba'i ltung byed du ⑤'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong la gos byin nas de'i 'og tu khros 'khrugs rngam par gyur te yi ⑥ma rangs nas dge tshul ma 'phrog tu 'jud na ji srid du gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar mi byed pa de srid du gnyis ka ⑦la nyes byas re rer 'gyur la/ gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar byed na dge tshul ma la nyes byas nyid du 'gyur la/ dge slong la spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong la gos byin nas de'i 'og tu khros 'khrugs rngam par gyur te yi ⑧ma rangs nas khyim pa 'phrog tu 'jud na ji srid du gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar mi byed pa de srid du khyim pa la bsod nams ma yin pa mang po skye bar 'gyur zhing /dge slong la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ gos kyi grwa 0lus las bral bar byed na khyim pa la bsod nams ma yin pa ches mang du skye bar 'gyur zhing / dge slong la spang ba'i ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis dge slong la gos byin nas ⑩de'i 'og tu khros 'khrugs rngam par gyur te yi skem rangs nas khyim pa mo 'phrog tu 'jud na ji srid du 'gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar mi byed pa de srid du khyim pa mo la bsod nams ma yin pa mang du skye bar 'gyur zhing / dge slong la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ gos kyi grwa lus las bral bar byed na khyim pa mo la bsod nams ma yin pa ches mang du skye bar 'gyur zhing / dge slong la spang ba'i ltung 6—432

byed du 'gyur te/ de ltar gzhan dag gis so/ /don gzhan dang 'dul ba'i yo byad ①kyis ni ltung ba med do/ /ji ltar don gzhan gyis zhe na/ 'di lta ste/slob dpon dang / mkhan po'i lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dag ②'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i phyogs su dus ma yin pa dang / chu klung gi kha'am/yur po che'i khar 'gro ba de dag la slob dpon dang / mkhan pos chom rkun pa sridang / g.yon can dag gis gos dag phrogs 0par gyur na mi rung ngo snyam pas 'phrog gam/ 'phrog tu 'jud pa ste/ de ltar don gzhan gyis so/ /ji ltar 'dul ba'i yo byad kyis zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong rnams kyi lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dag sdig pa'i grogs po dang / sdig pa'i zla bo dang / sdig pa'i sten ④grogs dag dang lhan cig sdig pa sten ༅cing lam du 'gro bar gyur na de dag la mkhan po dang / slob dpon gyis 'di dag sdig pa'i grogs po dang / sdig pa'i zla bo dang /④ sdig pa'i sten ⑧grogs la sten ⑨par gyur na mi rung ngo snyam pas gos dag 'phrog gam ⑨ 'phrog tu 'jud pa ste/de ltar 'dul ba'i yo byad kyis so/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang /sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /'phrog 7pa'i spang ba ste nyi shu lnga pa rdzogs sgo// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' tsor ba na bzhugs so/ /ri brag zhig tson khyim bdag dad pa dang ldan pa bzang ba dge ba'i bsam pa can zhig (sme'adug pa des ⑫dgon par dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang rta babs mthon po dang ldan pa 6—433

mthongs ②khung dang / skar khung dra ba can dang / lan kun gyis brgyan pa②/snying dang mig 'phrog par byed pa/ mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa/ khri dang /khri'u dang / yo byad phun sum tshogs pa zhig byed du bcug ste/ de na dge slong drug bcu ③gnas pa de dag la khyim bdag des chos gos dang / bsod snyoms la sogs pa dumakho ba stobs ①par byed do/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag de dus kyi chos dang ldan par gyur nas khyim bdag de la bu zhig yod pa de'i gan du dge slong de dag dong ste smras pa⑥/ bzhin bzangs ⑦khyod kyi pas dge slong drug bcu dul chos gos dang / bsod snyoms la sogs pas mkho ⑨ ba bstabs pa ⑩byas par gyur na khyod kyis kyang kho bo cag dge slong drug bcu tshul chos gos dang / bsod snyoms la sogs pas mkho ba stobs 8par byed nus sam/des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag la la ni brgya la bsnyen bkur byed/ la la ni stong la/ la la ni 'bum la bsnyen 8bkur byed pa yang yod/ la las ni bdag nyid kyang gso bar dka' bas bdag gis tsorngo mi thog gos/ /de nas dge slong de dag gtsug lag khang de nas dong ngo / /rgan zhugs ri brag ⑩de nyid nas rab tu byung ba gnyis zhig bsod snyoms brgyus ⑩nas gtsug lag khang de nyid na 'khod do/ /byang lam nas don mthun dag lhags nas de dag gis gtsug lag khang de thag ring po kho na nas mthong nas de dag der dong ste tshigs su bcad pa'i skad kyis mchod rten la phyag 'tshal nas gtsug lag khang du zhugs pa dang / ji tsam na gtsug lag khang stong par (spre'adug nas de dag gis bsams pa/ dge slong dag nang du yang dag 'jog la zhugs sam/ yang na nyin mo spyod du dong gor ma chag snyam nas de dag de na yongs su bskor ba na rgan 6—434

zhugs de gnyis mthong nas de dag gis de gnyis la smras pa/ 'phags pa gnyis dge slong dag gar dong / de ①gnyis kyis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs ②dag 'di na dge slong dag mi 'khod do ji'i ③slad du/ khyim bdag gang gis gtsug lag khang 'di byed du bcug pa des dge slong drug bcu dul chos gos dang /bsod snyoms la sogs pas mkho ba bstabs par ⑤byas par gyur te ⑥nus kyi ⑦chos dang ldan par gyur nas dge slong rnams kyis de la bu zhig yod pa de'i gan du song ste bzhin bzangs khyod kyi ⑧pas dge slong drug bcu ⑨la chos gos dang /bsod snyoms la sogs pa ⑩ mkho ba yibastabs par ⑫ byas par 'gyur na khyod kyis kyang kho bo cag dge slong drug bcu 8la chos gos dang / bsod snyoms la ⑫sogs pas mkho ba stobs tho9par byed nus sam zhes smras na(spre/ de na re 'phags pa dag la la ni brgya la bsnyen bkur byed/ la la ni stong la/ la la ni 'bum la bsnyen bkur byed pa yang yod/ la las ni bdag nyid tsogaso bar dka' bas bdag gis rngo mi thog go yizhes zer nas dge slong de dag dong ngo / /kho bo cag gnyis ni bsod snyoms brgyus du nas gtsug lag khang 'di nyid na 'khod do / /ded dpon gyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag yun ring po nas smon pa/ kye ma bdag cag 0gis dge 'dun gyi 3gtsug lag khang byed du gzhug cing gtsug lag khang byed du bcug nas dge slong rnams la mkho ba bstabs 3par bya'o snyam na/ gtsug lag khang 'di ni byas zin pa yin pas gtsug lag lang 'di nyid du dge slong rnams la mkho ba bstabs ④par bya'o zhes des ras yug chen bting ste/ shes ldan dag khyed ④cag las cigang gis ji ⑦yongs su btang chab de 'dir phul cig ces smras pa dang / de dag gis kyang ji ⑥'byor pa der ⑥6—435

phul nas der rnyed pa mang po 'dus par gyur pa dang ded dpon gyis rgan zhugs de gnyis la smras pa/ 'phags pa gnyis 'di ni dge slong drug bcu'i lazla ba gsum gyi bsod snyoms lags so/ /'di ni brgyad ston dang / bcu bzhi ston dang / nya ston gyi bsod snyoms lags so/ /'di ni na ba'i rkyen dang /sman gyi yo byad lags so/ /'di ni rnyed pa lags so/ /'di ni chos gos kyi zong lags kyis ②dge slong bzang po dag spyan rgyadrongs shig /bdag cag dbyar 'das nas 'dir mchis ④te dge slong brgya la ⑤mkho ba bstabs dupar bgyi'o zhes smras te dong ngo / /rgan zhugs gcig ⑦gis ⑤smras pa/ rgan zhugs dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa sus sba bar bya/ cig 0shos kyis smras pa0/ gang gzhon pas so/ /de gnyis las gang gzhon pas rnyed pa de sbas nas des smras pa/ rgan zhugs mnyan yod nas dge slong dag bod skyon der gang 'gro bar bya/ rgan pas smras pa/ gang gzhon pa 'gro bar bya'o/ /gzhon pas smras pa8/ kho bos rnyed pa sbas kyis ⑫khyod der song shigaci /rgan pa shos mnyan yod du dge slong sgron 'du song ngo / /drug sde dag gi kun tu spyod pa ni 'dir bdag cag gis bram ze ⑩dang khyim bdag 'ongs shing lhags pa rnams la yang chos bstan par bya / rgol ba dag kyang tshar gcad par bya/ rang gi grags pa yang bsgrag ⑩par bya'o snyam pas drug sde las gang yang rung bas rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo stong par mi 'jog 8pas tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na 'chag cing 'dug pa des thag ring po kho na nas rgan zhugs mgo spra ba'i me tog ltar skya ba smin ma 'phyang ba zhig 'ong ba de mthong nas des bsams pa/ dge slong gnas brtan zhig 'ong yipa 'di gang yin pa su'o snyam 0nas des de la gnas 6—436

brtan byon pa legs so/ /byon pa legs so/ /phyag 'tshal lo zhes smras pa dang / de na re slob dpon phyag 'tshal lo zhes zer nas nye dga'as bsams pa / kye ma 'di ni rgan zhugs zhig ste ①slob dpon yang mi shes/ mkhan po yang mi shes so snyam nas des de la smras pa/ rgan zhugs ga las 'ongs/ ri brag gi ②gtsug lag khang ga ge mo zhig nas mchis so/ /rgan zhugs ci de gtsug lag khang yin nam/ 'on te phongs pa yin gtsug lag khang ni ci 'dra/phongs pa ni ci 'dra/ gang na yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa ni gtsug lag khang yin la/ gang na yo byad thams cad dang bral ba ni phongs pa yin no/ /de sngon ni phongs par gyur la/ da ni gtsug lag khang du gyur to/ /ji ltar gyur byang lam nas don mthun dag lhags nas de dag gis der dge slong drug bcu'i ②zla ba gsum gyi bsod snyoms dang / brgyad ston dang / bcu bzhi ston dang /nya ston dang / na ba'i rkyen ⑤sman gyi yo byad dang / rnyed pa dang / chos gos kyi zong dag phul nas 'di skad ces 'phags pa dge slong bzang po dag bos shig /bdag cag kyang dbyar 'das nas 'dir mchis te dge slong brgya la mkho ba bstabs ⑤par bgyi'o zhes mchi'o/ /nye dga'as smras pa/ 'on ⑥tang khyod dge slong rkur 'ongs mod/ lags so/ /rgan zhugs ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal dang / btsun mo phreng ldan ma dang / rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang / bla mkhyen drang srong byin dang / rnying pa dang / khyim bdag gi chung ma ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga dang / legs skyes dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag dad pa can mang po gzhan dag gis kyang dge slong rnams la yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur 6—437

byas shing / dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan nyi ma re re zhing yon bshad pa byed pa na yang gnas 'dir dge slong gang dag ma 'ongs pa de dag kyang 'ong bar 'gyur zhing 'ongs pa dag kyang mngon par dga' bar gyur cig ces zer la/ de dag kyang 'di lta ste/ chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gnas mal dang /na ba'i rkyen dang ①/ sman gyi ②yo byad dag gis brel ba med cing bcom ldan 'das kyang mngon sum du chos ston par mdzad pas 'di na chos kyi longs spyod dang / zang zing gi longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa yin pas gal te dge slong rnams kyis khyod dge slong rkur 'dir 'ongs par shes par gyur na khyod gnas nas dbyung ba'i las byed par 'gyur ba gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod par 'gyur gyis / dge slong gzhan la de skad ma zer cig /'di ltar kho bo cag mi drug re re la yang 'khor bcu bcu yod pas khyod la snying brtse ba'i phyir 'ong ngo //slob dpon bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal du mchis te slad kyis mchi'o/ /nye dga'as bsams ༷pa/ lhung bzed nag po can ⑤'ga' zhig gis 'di mthong zhing de thos nas dang po kho nar 'gro bar gyur na mi rung ngo snyam nas smras pa/ rgan zhugs khyod kyis lha ni yid kyis bskor ba yin gyi lus kyis bskor ⑥ba ma yin no zhes bya ba ma thos sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang /chos rnams yid kyis 'dren byed cing / /yid gtso yid kyi 'gros can yin/ /zhes gsungs kyisame/ 'di nyid nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshol ⑧cig ces des de'i gnya' ba nas bzung ste rgan zhugs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo / /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo zhes gyis shig ces 'dud du bcug go/ /slob dpon skom gyis ⑨ji skom 'thung du mchi'o/ /6—438

'di nyid du sdod cig dang kho bos skom gyis phor bu bkang ste lakhyer te 'ong ngo zhes des skom gyis phor ②du bkang ste blud nas smras pa/ rgan zhugs da song shig ③ces des de thag ring por bskyal nas da ④phyir ma ldog cig ces bsgo ste 0bdag nyid phyir log go/ /drug sde dag gi ⑥kun tu spyod pa ni gang chung ༅zad ci thos pa de phye ma red lakyi dus kyi tshe gcig tu 'dus nas phan tshun rjod par byed pa yin pas nye dga' gtsug lag khang du song ste drug sde rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag gis yun ji srid kyis brel ba spang bar bya/ khyod kyis thos pa chung ①zhig yod dam/ yod de/ ri brag gi ⑩gtsug lag khang ga ge mo zhig tu byang lam nas don mthun dag lhags nas de dag gis der dge slong drug bcu'i yidabyar zla ba gsum gyi bsod snyoms dang / brgyad ston dang / bcu bzhi ston dang / nya ston dang / na ba'i rkyen dang / sman gyi yo byad dag ⑫rnyed pa dang chos gos kyi zong dag phul gyis 8der dong ngo / /ci 8de nyid du dbyar gnas par bya'amatshu/ mi bya ste/ 'di ltar dbyar gyi nang nyid du de dag zos te 'di nyid du 'ongs la dbyar phyi ma nye bar sgrub ⑩pa'i dus su gnas par khas blang bar bya'o/ /de dag der 'ong ba ⑩dang rgan zhugs gnyis 8kyis de dag thag ring po kho na nas 'ong ba mthong nas/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'ongs pa legs so/ /'ongs pa legs so zhes de gnyis kyis de dag gi gnas khang dag bskos ⑩shing gnas mal dang / khri dang / khri'u dang / chu ra dang / phor bu dang / chu tshags dang / lde mig kyog ⑥ po dag phog go/ /de dag gis bsams pa/ bdag cag don gang gi phyir lhags pa de je brtag par bya'o snyam nas de dag gis smras pa/ rgan zhugs gnyis 'dir 0rnyed pa ci grub pa 6wa 439

dag ji bltas la'on cig /rgan zhugs de gnyis ②drang po'i rang bzhin can yin pas de gnyis kyis 'di ni dge slong drug bcu'i ③zla ba gsum gyi bsod snyoms so/ /'di ni brgyad ston no/ /'di ni bcu bzhi ston no/ /'di ni nya ston no/ /'di ni na ba'i rkyen to/ /'di ni sman gyi yo byad doX/ /'di ni 'di'i brnyed pa'o/ /'di ni chos gos kyi zong ngo zhes rnyed pa de dag thams cad bstan no0/ /de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag rgan zhugs ser sna can yin pas zas bsod pa sbyin par mi nus la 'di ltar rgan zhugs 'di gnyis kyis dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byas pas yongs su spang ba ⑦phyin no zhes de dag gis de gnyis la yongs su spang ba sbyin lanas de gnyis 0kyang bdag cag gnyis kyis yongs su spang ba ⑩thob bo zhes dga' bar gyur to7/ /de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag dge slong lto mdun 8can 'ga' zhig la bcol na des 'dage 'dun la nyi ma re re zhing bca' ba rnam pa bcwa ④brgyad dang / tshod ma snum bag can mang po sna tshogs dag dang / legs par sbyar ba'i btung ba yang 'brim 8par 'gyur ro zhes de dag gis dge slong lto mdun 8can zhig la bcol ba dang / des de dag la nyi ma re re zhing bca' ba rnam pa bcwa skyabargyad dang / tshod ma snum bag can mang po sna tshogs dag dang / legs par sbyar ⑫ba'i btung ba yang 'brim ⑩par byed pas dus cung zad cig gis bsod snyoms thams cad spyad pa dang / dge bskos ⑩kyis rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'dug ste smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag dudage 'dun gyi gdugs gcig kho na'i spyi bungs zhig mchis so/ /de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag gang dag bslab pa yang dag par ma blangs pa de dag ni brgyad ston dang / bcu bzhi ston ③6—440

dang / nya ston byed la①/ bdag cag bslab pa yang dag par blangs pa dag de mi byed kyis ②de yang bza'o zhes de dag gis de yang zos pa dang / dge bskos ①kyis yang rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'dug ste smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag da ni dge 'dun gyi na ba'i rkyen dang yo byad dag gcig ④mchis so/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ji srid du nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga 'tsho ba de srid du bdag cag rtag tu nad pa yin pas na ba'i sman de yang bza'o zhes de dag gis de yang zos nas de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khur ya gcig na ⑤'dug par dka' ba yin gyis ༅gos kyi rnyed pa 'di yang bgos la/ khur do mnyam pas bde bar 'dong bar bya'o zhes de dag gis de yang bgos pa dang / dge bskos ⑦kyis yang rgan pa'i mtha' logs ②su 'dug ste smras pa/ da ni dge 'dun gyi gdugs ⑨gcig kho na'i spyi bungs las ma mchis so/ /de dag gis smras pa/ rgan zhugs gnyis khyed ⑩gnyis na re dge slong drug bcu'i 7zla ba gsum gyi bsod snyoms yod do zhes zer na dbyar gyi nang du zad par gyur to/ /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ ci de dag gis bca' ba rnam pa bcwa brgyad dang / tshod ma snum bag can mang po sna tshogs dag 8dang /legs par sbyar ba'i btung ba sha stag rims shig ces smras sam/ de dag gis smras pa/ rgan zhugs gnyis gnya' ba smad de spyod spyod la da smod par byed kyis ⑫tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di gnyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i las gyis shig /kha cig gis smras pa/ rgan zhugs gnyis myur du bzod pa gsol cig /phyis ④bzod pa gsol na ltag pa'i spu ⑩byi bar 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis kyis bzod pa gsol bar brtsams pa dang / kha cig gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag rgan zhugs 'di 6—441

gnyis drang po'i rang bzhin can yin gyis ①'di gnyis la bzod pa gyis shig /de dag gis smras pa/ rgan zhugs gnyis bzod par bya'o/ /ri brag ②'di ni ma dad pa mang bas ③'dir bsod snyoms kyang mi rnyed kyis ④gal te lhag rol cung ⑧zad yod na de yang byin cig /'on te med na ni kho bo cag 'dong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa dag ci yang med kyis deng ⑥shig /de dag de nas dong ste mnyan yod du song nas de dag der phyin pa dang dbyar phyi mar gnas par khas blangs so//dbyar 'das pa dang don mthun de dag yang lhags ⑦nas de dag gis de bzhin du tshigs su bcad pa'i skad kyis mchod rten la phyag 'tshal te/ gtsug lag khang du zhugs pa dang / ji tsam na gtsug lag khang stong par mthong nas de dag gis bsams pa/ dge slong dag nang du yang dag 'jog la zhugs sam/nyin mo spyod du dong gor ma chag snyam nas/ de dag de na yongs su bskor ba na rgan zhugs de gnyis mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa gnyis dge slong dag gar dong / bzhin bzangs dag 'di na dge slong dag mi 'khod do/ /'phags pa gnyis bdag cag gis dge slong drug bcu'i ⑤zla ba gsum gyi bsod snyoms ma phul lam/ de gnyis kyis smras pa/ dge slong dag lhags par gyur nas de dag gis dbyar gyi nang nyid du thams cad zos te dong ngo / /khyed gnyis kyis dge slong gang dag khrid de 0'ongs/ drug sde dag go/ /'phags pa gnyis khyed ⑨ gnyis rgya mtsho chen por dong nas nor bu mching bu dag khyer te 'ongs so/ /de na dge slong gzhan dag med dam ci na ⑩drug sde dag khrid de 'ongs / de dag shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong tsornams kyi dge sbyong gi tshul ni tshig go/ /bram ze'i tshul ni tshig ste/ 'di ltar bdag cag gi dad pa'i myu gu skyes ma thag 6—442

tu bcom mo zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka ①gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi ②'di dang /skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong drug sde dag la rmas ③pa/ dge slong dag khyed ④kyis dbyar gyi rnyed pa dbyar gyi nang du bgos pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa ⑤mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa zlu ma bzhin no/ /'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyis bslab ⑥pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par ⑨bya ste/ de lta bas na dge slong rnams kyis dbyar gyi rnyed pa dbyar gyi nang du bgo bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis dbyar gyi nirnyed pa dbyar gyi nang du bgo bar ⑨byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi de ltar bca' bar mdzad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na ⑩rgyal byed kyi yitshal mgon 6wa 443

med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong ma skye dgu'i ①bdag mo chen mo gi ta sbo ②dang / chos byin ②gnyis las skye dgu'i rjobadag mo chen mo gi ta sī ⑤ni spong ba ma 'khor yang spong ba ma dang ldan pa yin la/chos byin ⑥ni mdo sde'i mtha' pa 'khor yang mdo sde'i mtha' pa dang ldan pa yin te / de gnyis dbyar khang cig tu ⑦gnas par khas blangs nas gang gi tshe/skye dgu'i nibadag mo chen mo gi ta sī ⑨'khor rnam par langs par gyur pa de'i tshe na chos byin gyis rang gi 'khor la nu mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑩dge slong ma ⑩rnams la rab tu 'byung ba dang rdzogs par bsnyen pa dge slong ma'i dngos po rjes su gnang ba gang yin pa de thams cad skye dgu'i tsobadag mo chen mo gi ta nī las 0brten pa yin la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gzhan gyi sems srung ba'i gang zag ni bsod nams mang du skyed 8par byed do/ /zhes gsungs kyis8/khyed cag kyang re zhig mi rtag pa nyid yid la bya ba sgoms ⑩shig ces 'doms par byed cing / de dag kyang mi rtag pa nyid yid la bya ba sgom par rtsom mo/ /gang gi tshe chos byin gyi 'khor rnam par langs par gyur pa de'i tshe na skye dgu'i ⑩bdag mo chen mo gau ta sbo tsoyang rang gi 'khor la nu mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis dka' ba 7spyod pa brgya stong phrag du ma dag gis pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par mdzad de bla na med pa'i mkhyen pa thugs su chud pa gang yin pa de ⑥ thams cad sems can chal phan pa'i rgyu yin la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gzhan gyi sems srung ba'i gang zag ni bsod nams mang po skyed par byed dudo zhes gsungs kyis3/ khyed cag kyang re zhig mi rtag pa nyid dang ldan pa'i mdo 0sde'i mtha' dag kha ton gyis shig ces 6wa 444

'doms par byed cing / de dag kyang mi rtag pa nyid dang ldan pa'i mdo ①sde'i mtha' dag kha ton du ②byed par rtsom mo/ /dge slong ma dag de ltar phan tshun sems rjes su srung bas dge ba'i chos rnams kyis mi 'phel te/ chu med pa nas ut+pa ③la bzhin no/ /chos byin la dge bsnyen sa ga zhes bya ba mngon par dad pas des yo byad thams cad kyis de mgron ④du bos so/ /dus gzhan zhig na dge bsnyen ⑤sa ga chos byin gyi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal du 'ongs pa dang / chos byin gyis de la smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dge slong ma rab tu mang po dag dbyar khang gcig tu rjoganas par khas blangs pas ⑦de dag phan tshun sems rjes su srung bsatshoṭake ba'i chos rnams kyis mi 'phel te chu med pa nas ut+pa ⑧la bzhin du gyur na khyod kyis dge slong ma'i dge 'dun gyi phyir dbyar khang byed du 'jud nus sam/ des smras pa/ 'phags ma bdag la kār ṣā pa ṇa ⑨dag ni mchis na sa ⑩gzhi rgyal po dbang bas sa gzhi'i slad du rgyal po la gsol ba mdzod cig dang der bdag gis dbyar khang bgyid du stsal to/ /dge slong ma chos byin btsun mo phreng ldan ma'i gan du song ba dang / btsun mo phreng ldan mas smras pa/'phags ma 0byon pa legs so/ /byon pa legs so/ /'phags ma 8sku don ci zhig gi slad du byon/ bdag dge slong ma'i dbyar khang zhig bgyid du stsol bar 'tshal na/ sa tsogazhi rgyal po dbang ④bas sa gzhi'i slad du rgyal po la gsol ba bgyi bar bya'atshal lo/ /'phags ma khyod bzhud cig dang / bdag gis 'phags ma'i slad du lha la gsol bar tsobagyi'o/ /chos byin song ba dang btsun mo phreng ldan ma ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi gan du song ste des smras pa/ lha khyod kyi pho brang du 'phags ma chos byin byon par gyur pa ⑩ni khyod ⑫6wa 445

kyis rnyed ①pa legs par rnyed do/ /de ②ci'i slad du byon/ de dge slong ma'i dbyar khang zhig bgyid du stsol bar bzhed nas / dog sa rgyal po mnga' bas dog sa'i slad du rgyal po la gsol ba ④bgyid ces mchi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/gal te 'phags ma chos byin re zhig gnas 'di nyid du ⑤bzhed na yang de 'di nyid du bzhugs la rag ste/ nga'i pho brang gzhan du byed du gzhug go/ /gal te mi bzhed na gang du dgyes pa de ⑥dbyar khang bgyid du stsol la rag go/ /btsun mo phreng ldan mas chos byin la lhas 'phags ma la dam pa gsol te/gal te 'phags ma chos byin gnas 'di nyid du ⑦bzhed na yang de 'di nyid du ⑧bzhugs la rag ste nga'i pho brang gzhan du byed du gzhug go/ /gal te mi bzhed na gang du dgyes pa der dbyar khang bgyid du stsol ⑨la rag ces byung ngo zhes spring ngo / /chos sbyin 0gyis dge bsnyen sa ga la ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bdag la dam pa byin te/ gal te 'phags ma chos byin re zhig gnas 'di nyid 7du bzhugs la tsorag ste nga'i pho brang gzhan du byed du gzhug go/ /gal te mi bzhed na gang du dgyes pa der dbyar khang bgyid du stsol tsol rag ces byung ngo zhes spring ngo / /ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la ral gri'i mthu can dang / rgyal rigs bzang po pa zhes bya ba'i khrom gnyis yod pa las/ral gri'i ④mthu can gyi khrom dmag gi gnas su song ba dang / de dag gi chung ma rnams 8skyes pa gzhan dag dang lhan cig dga' mgur ④spyod par byed pas phyogs de go skabs dben par gyur nas chos byin gyis smras pa/ phyogs 'dir dbyar khang byed du chug shig /dge bsnyen chas gas phyogs der dbyar khang byed du bcug nas dge slong ma rnams kyis tsoder gnas par brtsams so ral 6—446

gri'i mthu can gyi khrom de dmag gi gnas nas phyir 'ongs te/ de dag gis chung ma de dag bkug cing bkug cing brdeg par brtsams pa dang / srang dag na de dag ngu ba'i sgra rta'i ①skad dang / glang po che'i skad lta bu'i skad mthon po dang /skad chen po dag byung ngo / /dge slong ma rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags ma bdag cag dgung char gyis 'jigs pas dang la kha'i 'og tu zhugs so/ /chos byin gyis bsams pa/ 'di dag las kha cig la dge ba'i rtsa ba yod dam snyam du bsams na/ yod par mthong ngo / /su la rag lus snyam du bsams na bdag nyid la rag lus par mthong nas des smras pa/ nu mo dag gdul ba la ltos ②pas thams cad bzod par bya'o/ /chos byin gyis phyogs gcig tu gyo mo sar ②pa bzhag ste dge slong ma rnams la smras pa/ nu mo dag khyed cag gang la sder lhag yod pa de thams cad gyo mo 'dir chug shig④ /de dag la ⑤ster lhag ci yod pa de thams cad gyo mo der 'jud par byed do/ /de na ༅byis pa dag der 'ong bar ④gyur nas chos byin gyis de ni khye'u gang dag yin pa de dag la ni 'bru mar byin nas gcig gis gcig dugi mgo skud du bcug ste rang gi lag gis bca' ba dag sbyin par byed do/ /bu mo gang dag yin pa de dag la ni bdag nyid kyis ⑨'bru mar gyis mgo bskus nas rang gi lag gis bca' ba dag sbyin par byed do/ /byis pa de dag gis de dag khyer te rang rang gi khyim dag tu dong ba dang de ⑩dag gi ma dag gis dris pa/ khyed cag la 'di dag sus byin/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags ma chos byin gyis so/ /chung ma de dag gis bsams pa/ don gyis na 'phags ma chos byin ni bdag cag la ma ma'i bya ba mdzad do snyam du rig nas de la yimangon par dad par gyur te/ de dag gis 6—447

bsams pa/ gang gi tshe bdag cag gi ཿkhyim thab ②dag dmag gi gnas su 'dong ba de'i tshe na bdag cag gis khyim thab dag bskyal nas 'phags ma chos byin la bsnyen bkur bya'o snyam mo/ /dus gzhan zhig na de dag gi khyim thab ②dag dmag gi gnas su 'phags pa dang / chos byin gyis de dag 'dul 0ba'i dus shes nas gtsug lag khang chag 0chag btab/ legs par byugs/ lci ba sar pa'i byug 0pas bskus te 'dag rdzas dang / chu dang / dri dang /bdug ⑦pa dang / me tog dang / pog por ⑧bzhag nas dge slong ma skad snyan pa dag bskos te bsdad pa dang / chung ma de dag kyang khyim thab dag bskyal te chos byin gyi drung du lhags nas chos byin gyis de dag la 'dag rdzas dang /lag pa bsnyal ba'i chu dang / dri dang / bdug ⑨pa dang / me tog dang /pog por yidag byin nas tshigs su bcad pa'i skad kyis mchod rten la phyag 'tshal te dge slong ma'i yidage 'dun gyi gong du stan bshams ⑩pa nyid la 'dug go//de dag kyang de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te chos mnyan pa'i phyir mdun du 'khod do//chos byin gyis de dag gi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang /rang bzhin khong du chud nas ji 0nas kyang de dag gis 'jig ④tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi 8rdo rjes bcom ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa de ltar chos bstan pa byas so/ /de dag gis bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags ma bdag cag gis dge ba'i bshes ⑩gnyen 'phags ma la brten ⑩nas 'phags mas bdag cag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag cag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis ⑫6—448

kyang ma bgyis①/ dge sbyong dang / bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang / mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis te/khrag dang ②mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgral/ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang yi dgas dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag /'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig ①tshogs la lta rjoba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/'phags ma bdag cag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/ / 'phags ma bdag cag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/⑤ 'phags ma bdag cag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchis0/bdag cag dge bsnyen mar gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du glo ba thag pa nas skyabs su mchi'o/ /de dag mngon par dad par gyur nas khyim khyim du dong ste khyim ⑦chag chag btab/ legs par byugs/ lci ba sar pa'i byug ⑧pas bskus te spyod lam zhi bas 'khod do de dag gi khyim thab dag dmag gi gnas nas phyir 'ong ba na bsams ⑨pa/ bdag cag gi chung ma glang po che 'tsho ba'am/ ba lang rdzi'am/ su zhig dang lhan cig dga' mgur 0spyod par byed cing 'dug snyam mo/ /de dag gis bdag cag gi khyim thab dag 'ongs zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang bshes pa dang bcas ⑩pa'i tshig gis rje'i sras dag byon pa legs so/ / byon pa ⑩legs so zhes bsu rkyenas de dag rang tsorang gi khyim du dong ba dang / de dag rang rang gi chung ma dag gis bsku mnye dang 6—449

dril phyi byas te khrus byas nas legs par ①bskus te zas byin no/ /de dag gis bsams pa/ 'di dag gi spyod lam 'di lta bu ni sngon ②ma byung ngo snyam nas de dag la dris pa/ bzang mo dag khyed kyi spyod lam 'di lta bu 'di sngon ma byung ba yin na ji ②las gyur/ de dag gis smras pa/ rje'i sras dag 'phags ma chos byin gyis bdag cag la ji ④nas kyang bdag cag 'khor ba na 'khor ba ⑤rnams la ⑥slan chad nyon mongs pa de lta bu kun tu ⑦'byung bar mi 'gyur ba de ltar chos bstan pa lamadzad do/ /de dag gis bsams pa/ 'phags ma chos byin ni ma dul ba 'dul bar mdzad pa yin te/ des 'di dag btul ba lta ste/ gang gi phyir bdag cag gis 'di dag bsad ⑨pa dang / bcing ba dang / brdeg pa dang / spyo bas gdul bar ma nus pa dag 'phags ma chos 0 byin gyis chos bstan pas btul bas 'phags ma chos byin gyis bdag cag la phan btags kyis(spre / bdag cag gis kyang rgyal po bltas te 8'phags ma chos byin la bsnyen bkur bya'o snyam mo/ /chos byin gyis kyang de dag gdul ba'i dus shes nas gtsug lag khang chag chag btab/ legs par byugs/ lci ba sar 8pa'i byug pas bskus 8te 'dag rdzas dang / chu dang / dri dang / bdug pa ⑫dang / me tog dang / pog por ⑩bzhag nas dge slong ma skad snyan pa dag bskos te bsdad pa dang / de dag kyang rgyal po bltas nas chos byin gyi drung du lhags pa dang / chos byin gyis de dag la 'dag rdzas dang / lag pa bsnyal ⑩ba'i chu dang / dri dang / bdug pa dang / me tog dang / pog por ⑫dag byin nas tshigs su bcad pa'i skad kyis mchod rten la phyag 'tshal te dge slong ma'i dge 'dun gyi gong du stan bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de dag kyang 6—450
