kyang rung dge slong la ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong ①gis mi'i skyon nas smra ba'i bsam pas 'breg ②mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/tshe dang ldan pa ni 'breg ②mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis④/ tshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste/ spu gri dang / chan pa dang / bdar ⑤dang / smang tser ⑥dang / sen gris rang gi las bya'o zhes smras na dge slong spa gong ba nyid du gyur kyang rung ma gyur kyang rung dge slong la ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ⑦mi'i skyon nas smra ba'i thubasam pas shing mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces 0tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni shing mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis0/tshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste ste'u dang / sta re dang gzong dang / sog yile dang / tho bas rang gi las bya'o zhes smras na dge slong spa gong ba nyid du gyur kyang rung ma gyur kyang rung dge slong la ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis mi'i skyon nas smra ba'i bsam pas phyig phyem mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rtsig ma tsomakhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyisagatshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste/ phyig tho)ma dang / gri dang / tshon dang /sgyug tho dang / lhang tsher gyis tshurang gi las bya'o zhes smras na dge slong spa gong ba nyid du gyur kyang rung ma gyur kyang rung dge slong la ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis mi'i skyon nas smra ba'i bsam pas bran las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i 6wa 560

tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni bran las rab tu byung ba yin gyis①/ tshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste/ bsku mnye ②dang dril phyi dang / khrus dang / pho nyar 'gro ba chadang / mngag dupas rang gi las bya'o zhes smras na dge slong spa gong ba nyid du gyur kyang rung ma gyur kyang rung dge slong la ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis mi'i skyon nas smra ba'i bsam pas dge slong gi gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i 0tshul ga la yod / tshe dang ldan pa ni theng 0po dang / smad 'chal dang / zhar ba dang /lag sor rdum po ⑦dang / sgur po dang / mi'u thung dang / lba ba can dang /glen pa dang / lkugs ②pa dang / grum po dang / 'on pa dang / rten 'phye ⑨dang / rkang 'bam tshulas rab tu byung ba yin no zhes smras na dge slong spa gong ba nyid du gyur kyang rung ma gyur kyang yirung dge slong la ltung byed du 'gyur ro//dge slong gis mi'i skyon nas smra ba'i bsam pas dge slong gi gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod / tshe dang ldan pa ni mdze can dang / 'brum bu phra mo can tho)dang /ngal skyen pa tsodang / shu ba can dang / g.yan pa can dang / khyi rngo can dang / glog pa can dang / rkang shu can dang / skyigs 4)bu can dang /skyug bro ba tsodang / khong skem 8can dang / rims can dang / rims drag po can dang / lud pa can dang / dbugs mi bde ba can dang / skem nad can ⑩dang / brjed byed can dang / bkres ngab 8can dang / skya rbab yican dang / tshil po che dang / skran can dang / khrag nad can dang /mkhris dund can dang / mtshan bar rdol ba las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes 6—561

smras na dge slong spa gong ba nyid du ①gyur kyang rung ma gyur kyang rung dge slong la ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis mi'i skyon nas smra ba'i bsam pas dge slong gi gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni pham par 'gyur ba dang / dge 'dun lhag ma dang / ltung byed dang / so sor bshags par bya ba dang /nyes byas kyi ⑧ltung ba byung ba yin no zhes smras na dge slong spa gong ba nyid du gyur kyang rung ma gyur kyang rung dge slong la ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis mi'i skyon nas smra ba'i ②bsam pas dge slong gi ④gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni khro ba dang / khon ⑤du 'dzin pa dang / 'chab pa dang /dngan ༅dus can dang / phrag dog can dang / ser sna can dang / g.yon can dang / sgyu can dang / ngo tsha med pa dang / khrel med pa dang ⑦/sdig pa 'dod pa dang / log par lta ba yin no zhes smras na dge slong spa gong ba nyid du gyur kyang rung ma gyur kyang rung dge slong la ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis mi'i skyon nas smra ba'i bsam pas dge slong gi gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod / tshe dang ldan pa ni ro lta bu yin no zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i spyo ba ⑧dag gis spyo bar byed na dge slong spa gong ba nyid du gyur kyang rung ma gyur kyang rung dge slong la ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gal te ming de lta bu mang po dag yod par gyur na de la lan gdab par ⑨smra ba sangs rgyas skyong gang yin zhes zer ba la bram 0ze las rab tu byung ba gang yin pa de'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma lta bu 6—562

dag brjod ①pa la ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang /sems 'khrugs ②pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /mi'i skyon nas smra ba'i ltung byed de gnyis pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong drug sde dag dge slong rnams la phra mas kun du spyod par byed de/ phra mas kun tu spyod pa na dge slong dag spa gong ba dang / gzengs ②dmas pa dang / zhum par gyur nas lung mnod pa dang / bklag ④pa dang / kha ton ⑤dang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba dang / nang gi sems kyi zhi gnas kyang gtong bar byed/'di ltar dus yun ring po nas nye bar bsags pa chos dang ldan pa'i gcugs ⑥pa'i rgyun yang gcod par byed nas dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag ⑦dge slong rnams la phra mas kun du spyod par byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka dugatong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong drug sde dag la rmas ⑨pa/ dge slong dag khyed dge slong rnams la phra mas kun du spyod pa bden namal/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi 6—663

tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam ①par smad pa ②mdzad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na nags tshal zhig na seng ge mo sbrum ma zhig 'dug ste/ de la ①seng ge mo rnams kyi kun du spyod pa ni gang gi tshe 'brang ba'i dus la bab pa de'i tshe na sha'i tshogs byas te 'brang bar byed pas seng ge mo de ba lang gi tshogs chen po zhig gi phyi bzhin du rjes su song ba dang / ba 'brangs nas ring ④po ma lon pa be'u rjes su skyong ⑤bar byed pa zhig khyu'i phyi bzhin 'brang zhing 'gro ba de seng ge mo des ⑥bsad nas sha khyer ⑦te/ rang gi tshang du song ngo / /be'u de yang ma'i nu ma 'thung 'dod pas de'i phyi bzhin phyi bzhin du ⑧song ba dang seng ge mos bsam ⑨pa/be'u 'di yang gsad par bya'o snyam nas ⑩yang bsam ༅pa/ gal te bdag gi bu 'brangs 8par gyur na 'di de'i chung po 'grogs su 'gyur gyis ④mi gsad do snyam mo/ /seng ge mo de 'brangs (smenas de las phrug yigu pho zhig byung ba dang /seng ge mo des rang gi phrug tho)gu dang / be'u de gnyis ka nu ma bsnun par brtsams (smenas ji tsam dus gzhan 6)zhig na de gnyis ka zhu rtechen por gyur te( tre/dus gzhan zhig na seng ge mo tsode na bar gyur nas de 'chi ba'i dus phyokyi tshe smras pa/bu gnyis khyed gnyis (sten ma gcig la nu nu ba'i spun yin la/ phra ma can snod 'byed pa dag gis 'jig rten gang bar tso'akhod kyis 'kho mo 'das pa'i 'og tu khyed gnyis kyis 'ga' yang mnyan par mi bya'o zhes smras nas/ bsags pa kun gyi mtha' zad 0cing / /mthon po rnams kyi tsomatha' ltung 'gyur/ /phrad ⑥pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ⑥ ba ste/ /gson pa'i mtha' ni 'chi ba yin/ /zhes bya ba yin 6wa 564

pas dus kyi chos dang ldan par gyur to/ /seng ge de ri dgas dam pa dam pa dag bsad nas sha dam pa ①dam pa dag za zhing khrag mang po dag 'thung bas chen por gyur to/ /khyu mchog de yang seng ges bsrung ba'i rtswa ②bzang po dag ②za zhing chu gtsang ma dag 'thung bas chen por gyur to/ /ri dgas kyi rgyal po seng ge de la wa rgan po rab tu brkam pa lhag ma za ba zhig 'khor zhing phyi bzhin phyi bzhin rjes su 'brang nas seng ge des ri dgas dam pa dam pa ④dag bsad nas sha dam pa dag zos shing khrag dam pa dag 'thungs ⑤bag tsha ba med par de na 'dug pas ༅phyogs der gcan gzan phra mo gzhan dag gis nye mi phod pas wa rgan po de seng ge des ri dgas dam pa ⑦dam pa dag bsad nas sha dam pa dag zos ⑧shing khrag dam pa 'thungs pa'i sha'i lhag ⑨ma dang khrag gi ⑩lhag ma dag za zhing 'thung bas pags ⑩pa dang / sha dang / khrag rgyas par gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na seng ge de ri dgas dam pa tsodam pa dag bsad nas sha dam pa dag zos shing khrag dam pa dag 'thungs nas myur ba myur ba tsokho nar tshang du song ste khyu mchog de dang lhan cig rtse zhing 'dug par byed nas sha'i lhag ma de dag kyang gcan gzan phra mo gzhan dag gis zos nas wa rgan po des bsams pal/ seng ge 'di gang du 'gro ba je ④blta bar bya'o snyam nas/ de de'i phyi bzhin skephyi bzhin du song ba dang / ji tsam na khyu mchog dang lhan cig rtse zhing 'dug pa mthong nas des bsams pa/ khyu mchog 'di bdag gi lto'i dgrar gyur pa yin gyis bdag gis ⑩'di gnyis dbye ⑩bar bya'o snyam nas wa rgan po de tsokhyu mchog de'i mdun du rna ba phab ste 'dug pa dang / khyu mchog gis smras pa/zhang po rlung tsha ba dag mi ldang ngam/ was smras pa/ tsha bo rlung rab tu 'bar 6wa 565

ba dag ldang ngo / /ci nyes①/ seng ge 'di na re kho bo'i sha tshogs rgyu ②khu mchog de gar song / gang gi tshe kho bos sha gzhan ma ③rnyed pa de'i tshe na 0kho bos khyu mchog 'di bza' bar bya'o zhes zer ro/ /khyu mchog gis smras pa/zhang po kho bo cag gnyis la mas 'chi kur ⑤du gnyis khyed gnyis ⑥nu ma gcig la nu nu ba'i spun ⑦yin la phra ma can snod 'byed pa dag gis ⑧'jig rten gang bar 'khod kyi ②kho mo 'das pa'i 'og tu khyed gnyis kyis ⑩'ga' yang mnyan 0par mi bya'o zhes kha chems bzhag gis ⑫khyod de skad ma zer cig /was smras pa/ tsha bo khyod da 'kho bo phan ④par 'dod pa'i tshig mi nyan na chud zos par 'ong ngo / /khyu mchog gis smras pa/ zhang po go rims 'ji ltar 'ong bar 'gyur/ was smras pa/ tsha bo seng ge 'di tshang nas byung nas bya smyang 0byed par 'gyur la/bya smyang ⑩byas tsonas glal bar 'gyur zhing glal nas 7phyogs bzhir rnam par lta ⑥bar 'gyur/ phyogs bzhir rnam par bltas nas seng ge'i skad thang gsum 0phyung ste/ khyod kyi tsomadun du 'ong bar 'gyur ba na khyod kyis bdag 'dis bsad do snyam 6)du shes par gyis shig /wa de de'i 'og tu seng ge'i mdun dzu )du rna ba phab ste 'dug pa dang / seng ges smras pa/ zhang po rlung tsha ba dag mi ldang ngam / was smras pabla/ tsha bo rlung rab tu 'bar ba dag ldang ngo / /ci nyes/khyu mchog 'di na re kho bo'i rtsa'i ciseng ge de tshugar song / 'di'i mas kho bo'i ma bsad kyis tso'adi'i lto nges par dral bar bya'o zhes zer ro/ /seng ges smras pa / zhang po kho bo cag gnyis la mas 'chi kur 0bu gnyis khyed chaganyis nu ma gcig 0la nu nu ba'i spun yin la/ phra ma can snod 'byed pa dag gis 'jig rten gang bar 'khod kyisam/ kho mo 'das pa'i 'og tu khyod bluganyis kyis 'ga' 6wa 566

yang mnyan par mi bya'o zhes kha chems bzhag gis ①khyod de skad ma zer cig /was smras pa/ tsha bo khyod da kho bo phan par 'dod pa'i tshig mi nyan na chud zos par 'ong ngo / /seng ges smras pa/ zhang po go rims ji ltar 'ong bar 'gyur/was smras pa/ tsha bo khyu mchog 'di lhas nas byung nas bya smyung ②byed par 'gyur la / bya smyang ②byas nas 'bu sgra ④'byin par 'gyur zhing 'bu sgra phyung nas phug thig byed par 'gyur/ phug thig byas nas rngam pa byas te khyod kyi mdun du 'ong bar 'gyur ⑤na/ khyod kyis bdag 'dis bsad ༅do snyam du shes par gyis shig/de gnyis rang bzhin gyis rtag tu de lta ⑦byed mod kyi lan ⑤'ga' yang phan tshun mtshan mar ma bzung ngo / /de nas dus gzhan zhig na ri dgas kyi rgyal po seng ge de tshang nas byung nas bya smyung ⑨byas te glal nas phyogs bzhir rnam 0 par bltas te seng ge'i skad thang gsum phyung nas khyu mchog gi mdun du song ngo /khyu mchog de yang lhas yinas byung nas bya smyang 8byas te 'bu sgra phyung nas phug thig byas te rngam pa byas nas tsoseng ge'i mdun du song ngo / /de gnyis rang ④bzhin gyis rtag tu de lta 'byed mod kyi lan 'ga' yang mtshan mar ma bzung ⑩ste gang gi tshe rgyud la dbyen gyi sa bon btab pa de'i tshe na mtshan mar bzung bas/ khyu mchog gis 0kyang bdag 'dis bsad tsodo snyam du bsams la/ seng ges kyang bdag 'dis bsad do 7snyam du bsams nas/ seng gis khyu mchog gi brang la sder mos dubatab pa dang / khyu mchog gis kyang ras ⑥seng ge'i lto dral nas de gnyis ka dus la bab pa dang / lhas 'tshigs su bcad pa ⑤smras pa/ bzang po dag la lta ba'i mis/ /skye bo ngan pa bsten chami bya/ /seng ge khyu mchog mdza' ba la/ /wa yis tha dad phye la ltos/ /dge slong dag re zhig dud 6—567

'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa'i srog chags de dag kyang phra mas kun tu spyod ①pa na gsod ②par sems na mi rnams lta smos ①kyang ci dgos/ dge slong dag de lta bas na du dge slong gis ⑤dge slong la phra mas kun du spyod ⑥par mi bya'o/ /dge slong gis dge slong la phra mas kun du spyod par byed na 'gal tshabs can du ⑦'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ⑧'das pa'i dus na nags tshal zhig na seng ge mo phrug 0gu dang bcas pa zhig dang / stag mo phrug 0gu dang bcas pa zhig 'dug ste/ seng ge mo spyod yul du song ba dang / de'i phrug 7gu de 'khyam ⑫pa na stag mo'i gan du song nas stag tsomos de mthong nas bsams pa 'di gsad ⑫par bya'o snyam nas/ yang bsams pa/ 'di bdag gi bu'i chung po grogs su 'gyur gyis mi bsad 'do snyam nas des de yin ma snun ⑩par brtsams so/ /seng ge mo des kyang spyod yul brgyus 8te phyir 'ongs pa dang / ji 7tsam na phrug ⑥gu mi snang nas des de btsal bar brtsams pa dang / des phrug 0gu stag mos bsnun par 'amathong ngo / /stag mo des kyang seng ge mo de mthong nas skrag ste 'bros par brtsams pa dang / seng ge mo des stag mo la smras pa/ nu mo ma 'bros shig dang / lhan cig 'khod par bya ste/ 'di ltar kho mo spyod yul du song ba 3na khyod kyis kho mo'i phrug 'gu la mkho ba chabastabs pas gal te khyod 0spyod yul du 'gro bar gyur na/ kho mos kyang khyod kyi phrug 0gu la mkho ba phyobastabs ⑥par bya'o/ /de gnyis lhan cig 'khod par brtsams nas de gnyis kyis seng ge'i phrug 0gu'i ming ni mche bzang 0zhes bya bar btags0/ stag phrug gi ⑫ming ni dpung bzang ④zhes bya bar btags nas de gnyis dus cigazhan zhig na chen por gyur to/ /dus gzhan zhig na seng ge mo dang / stag mo gnyis na 6—568

bar gyur nas de gnyis 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe bu gnyis la smras pa/ bu gnyis khyed gnyis nu ma gcig la nu nu ba'i spun yin la phra ma can snod 'byed pa dag gis 'jig rten gang bar 'khod kyis①/ kho mo cag gnyis 'das pa'i 'og tu khyod ②gnyis kyis 'ga' yang mnyan par mi bya'o zhes smras nas/ bsags pa kun gyi mtha' zad ②cing / /mthon po rnams kyi mtha' ltung 'gyur/ /phrad ④pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba ste/ /gson pa'i ⑤mtha' ni 'chi ⑥ba yin/ /zhes bya ba yin pas dus kyi chos dang ldan par gyur to/ /seng ges ⑦ni ri dgas dam pa dam pa dag bsad nas sha dam pa dag za bar byed/ khrag dam pa dag ⑧'thung bar byed cing / de sha dam pa dag zos shing khrag dam pa dag 'thungs nas myur ba myur ba kho nar tshang du 'gro bar byed do/ /stag gis 0spyod yul du song nas tshegs yichen pos ri dgas dag bsad de sha dang khrag zos shing 'thungs nas yun ring pos phyir 'ong ngo / /dus gzhan zhig na stag gis 7lhag rol dag sbas nas des de zos te myur du phyir 'ongs pa dang / seng ges stag la smras pa/ khyod sngon chad ni yun ring zhig gis phyir 'ongs tson deng myur du phyir 'ongs pa 'di la rgyu ci 0yod/ stag gis smras pa/ kho bos ④lhag rol ④spas par gyur pa de ⑩zos te phyir 'ongs so/ /seng shes smras pa/ khyod lhag rol sbed dam/ stag gis smras pa sbed do/ /seng ges smras pa/ kho bo ni ri dgas dam pa dam pa ⑩dag bsad nas sha dam pa dag 'azos shing khrag dam pa dag yi'athungs nas ltos pa med par 'gro'o/ /stag gis smras pa/ khyod ni stobs dang ldan pa yin gyisag kho bos ni de ltar byed mi nus so/ /seng ges smras pa/ bdag cag lhan cig dong 0ngo / /de gnyis lhan cig 'dong bar brtsams so/ /ri dgas kyi rgyal po 6wa 569

seng ge de la wa rgan po rab tu gdu ba lhag ma za ba zhig 'khor zhing ①phyi bzhin du 'brang ba des bsams pa/ stag 'di bdag gi lto'i dgrar gyur pa yin gyis ②'di gnyis dbye bar bya'o snyam nas/ de nas wa rgan po de seng ge'i ②mdun du rna ba phab ste 'dug pa dang / seng shes smras pa/ zhang po ①rlung tsha ba dag mi ldang ngam/ was smras pa/ tsha bo rlung rab tu 'bar ba dag ldang ngo / /ci nyes / stag 'di na re kho bo'i rtsa'i ⑤song ge de gar song / des kho bo lhag ma zar bcug gis ༅kho bos de nges par gsad ⑦par bya'o zhes zer ro seng ges smras pa/ zhang po kho bo cag gnyis la ma gnyis kyis 'chi kur ③bu gnyis khyed gnyis 0nu ma gcig tshul nu nu ba'i spun yin la/ phra ma can snod 'byed pa dag gis 'jig rten gang bar 'khod kyis0/ kho mo cag gnyis 'das pa'i 'og tu khyed tsoganyis kyis 'ga' yang mnyan 0par mi bya'o zhes kha chems bzhag gis ④khyod de skad ma zer cig /was smras pa/ tsha bo khyod da kho bo phan par 'dod pa'i tshig mi nyan na chud zos par 'ong ngo / /seng ges smras pa/ zhang po go rims tho)ji ltar 'ong bar 'gyur/ was smras pa/ tsha bo stag 'di tshang nas byung nas ⑩bya smyung 7byed par 'gyur la/ bya smyang tsobyas nas glal bar 'gyur zhing / glal nas phyogs bzhir rnam par blta yibar 'gyur/ phyogs bzhir rnam par bltas du nas stag gi skad thang gsum phyung ste khyod kyi 0mdun du 'ong dubar 'gyur ba na khyod kyis bdag 'dis bsad 0do snyam du shes par gyis shig /de'i 'og tu stag gi mdun du rna ba phab ste 'dug pa dang / stag gis smras pa/zhang po rlung tsha ba dag mi ldang ngam/ was smras pa/ tsha bo rlung rab tu ④'bar ba dag ldang ngo / /ci nyes/ seng ge 'di na re kho bo'i rtsa'i stag de gar song /6wa 570

de nges par gsad ①par bya'o zhes zer rol/ /stag gis ②smras pa/ zhang po kho bo cag gnyis la ma gnyis kyis 'chi kur ④bu gnyis khyed gnyis nu ⑤ma gcig la nu nu ba'i spun yin la/ phra ma can snod 'byed pa dag gis 'jig rten gang bar 'khod kyis⑥/ khyed gnyis kyis 'ga' yang mnyan par mi bya'o zhes kha chems bzhag gis khyod ⑦de skad ma zer cig /was ⑤smras pa/ tsha bo khyod da kho bo phan par 'dod pa'i tshig mi nyan na chud zos ⑨par 'ong ngo / /zhang po go rims ⑩ji ltar 'ong bar 'gyur/ was smras pa/ tsha yibo seng ge 'di tshang nas byung nas bya smyung 'byed par 'gyur la/ bya smyang tsobyas nas glal bar 'gyur zhing /glal nas phyogs bzhir rnam par lta bar 'gyur/ phyogs bzhir rnam par bltas nas seng ge'i skad thang gsum phyung ste khyod kyi ④mdun du 'ong tsobar 'gyur ba na khyod kyis bdag 'dis bsad 4)par 'gyur ro snyam du shes par bya'o/ /de gnyis rang bzhin gyis rtag tu de ltar byed mod kyi/ lan 'ga' yang mtshan mar ma bzung ngo / /dus gzhan zhig na ri dgas kyi rgyal po seng ge de 0tshang nas byung nas tsobya smyang ⑥byas te glal nas phyogs bzhir rnam par bltas te seng ge'i skad thang gsum phyung rju nas stag gi mdun du song ngo / /stag gis 0kyang tshang nas byung nas bya smyang tsobyas te glal nas phyogs bzhir rnam par bltas te stag skad thang gsum phyung nas seng ge'i mdun du song ngo / / phye de gnyis rtag tu de lta 0byed mod kyi/ lan 'ga' yang mtshan mar ma bzung ste/ gang gi tshe rgyud la dbyen gyi sa bon btab pa de'i tshe mtshan mar bzung ⑤bas d+ku seng ges kyang bdag 'dis bsad 0do snyam du bsams la/ stag gis kyang bdag 'dis bsad rdzido snyam du bsams so ⑦/ /yang seng ges bsams pa/ bdag ni 6—571

stobs dang ldan ①pa yin la stag ni de lta ②ma yin pas 'dis bdag la rgol mi nus kyis je brtag ③par bya'o snyam nas des tshigs su bcad pas ⑤smras pa/chu zhing ⑤phun sum tshogs pa dang / /rtsal dang shugs dang ldan pa yiX/ /mche ba bzang la rgol byed pa/ /dpung bzang de ni rigs pa min/ /stag gis kyang tshigs su bcad pa ⑦smras pa/ chu zhing phun sum tshogs pa dang / /rtsal dang shugs dang ldan pa yidu/ /dpung bzang la ni rgol byed pa/ /mche bzang ⑨de ni rigs pa min/ /seng ges smras pa/ khyod la sus smras/ stag gis smras pa / wa 'dis so/ /stag gis smras pa/ khyos ⑩la sus ⑩smras/ seng ges smras pa/ wa 'dis so/ /seng shes bsams pa/ 'dis bdag cag gnyis 'byed par byed do snyam nas des wa de thal lcag 8gis bsnun te bsad pa dang /lhas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ gzhan gyi tshig gis mdza' bshes mi spang zhing //gzhan gyis smras pa dag la brtag 0par bya/ /'byed par 'dod pa skabs tshol byed pas na/ /skye bo phra ma can la yid ma ④rton/ /wa skyes grong pa brdzun 8du smra byed pa/ /mdza' bshes 'byed par byed pas skyes to tshure/ /phra ma smra ba de ni bsad gyur nas/ /bde bas mdza' bshes dga' bar byed la 0ltos/ /dge slong dag re zhig dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa'i srog chags de dag kyang phra mas kun du spyod pa na gsod 8par sems na mi rnams la yismos kyang ci dgos/dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong gis dge slong la phra mas kun du spyad ⑥par mi bya'o/ /dge slong gis dge slong la phra mas spyod par byed na 'gal tshabs can du ⑥'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam ⑤par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan 6—572

yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ①bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ dge slong la phra ma byed na ltung byed do/ /dge slong la phra ma byed na zhes bya ba ni dge slong la phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas ngag dang / tshig dang tha snyad dang / skad dang /brjod ②pa dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / tshig gi lam dang / tshig gi sgra dang / ngag gi las dang /cha ngag gi rnam par rig byed smras pa'o④/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang / log par ltung ba dag tu sreg par byed/'tshod par byed/ ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ltung ba ⑤de ma bshags ⑥shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/ des ⑦na ltung byed do zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar 'a ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ /bar sdom la/ rigs dang bzo dang las dang ni/ /rtags nad ltung ba sde lnga dang / /nye ba'i nyon mongs rnams dang ni/ /spyo bar byed pa tha ma yin/ /dge slong gis ༅phra ma bya ba'i bsam 0pas bram ze las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni bram ze 7las rab tu byung ba yin no ④zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas phra mor 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma ⑫6—573

bya ba'i bsam pas rgyal rigs las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rgyal rigs las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas phra mor 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas rje'u rigs las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la ①dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rje'u rigs las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras ②na/ming ①brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur ④la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ⑤phya ma bya ba'i bsam pas dmangs rigs las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod / tshe dang ldan pa ni dmangs ⑥rigs las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas tha ga pa las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/6—574

bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni tha ga pa las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na/ ming brjod pa la ༅ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas khab ris mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni khab ris mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni ②'di zhes bya/ rigs ni cha'adi zhes bya/ rus ni ④'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas bzang mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong ⑤gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga phyol yod/tshe dang ldan pa ni bzang mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas lcags mgar tshulas rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni lcags mgar ⑧las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te / dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/6—575

rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ༅phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas rdungs mgar ②las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rdungs mgar ②las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ༅ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ⑤phya ma bya ba'i bsam pas ko alpags mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni ko lpags mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin no ⑦zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas rdza mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rdza mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod ⑤pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas 6—576

'breg ①mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ②ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan ①pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni 'breg ④mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni du'adi zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas shing mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni shing mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming ⑥brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/⑦ jigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas snyig ⑧ma mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi 0tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni phyig ⑩ma mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis 'phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas bran las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul 6—577

ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni bran las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te/dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di ①zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ②phya ma bya ba'i bsam pas bram ze las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni bram ze las rab tu byung ba yin gyis③/tshe dang ldan pas rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ bram ze'i spyod 0tshul dang / spyod pa dang / gtsang sbra ⑤dang / kun du spyod pa dang / thal ba blang ba dang /bya ma bum pa yiblang ba dang / sa blang ba dang / lag stangs dang / thor tshugs dang / rab bsngags ④bya ba dang / kye zhes bya ba dang / nges brjod kyi rig ②byed dang / mchod sbyin gyi rig ⑨byed dang / snyan tshig gi rig ⑩byed dang / srid srung gi rig (1byed dang / mchod sbyin byed pa dang /mchod sbyin byed du 'jud ④pa dang / klog pa dang / klog tu 'jud 0pa dang /sbyin pa dang / len pa dag ④bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na / ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di ④zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rigs tsodang rus brjod pa la nyes byas phra mor 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ⑩phya ma bya ba'i bsam pas rgyal rigs las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rgyal rigs las rab tu byung ba yin gyisatso/ tshe 6—578

dang ldan pas rang gi bzo 'di lta ste glang po che'i gnyar bzhon ①pa dang / rta bzhon ②pa dang / shing ①rta'i thabs dang / ral gri'i thabs dang / 'phong dang phyir bsnur ba dang / mdun du bsnur ba khyodang / lcags kyus sgyur ⑤thabs dang / zhags pa gdab ⑥pa dang / mda' bo che 'phen thabs dang /'dzin stangs dang / gom stabs ⑦dang / thor tshugs dang / bcad ⑧pa dang / dral ba dang / dbug pa dang / rgyang nas phog pa dang / sgra grag par phog pa dang / gnad du phog pa dang / mi 'chor ⑨bar rdzog pa dang /tshabs che ba dag bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas phra mor 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas rje'u rigs las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rje'u rigs las rab tu byung ba yin gyis༅/ tshe dang ldan pas rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ zhing rmo 7ba dang / ba lang bsrung ⑫ ba dang / tshong bya ba bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas dmangs rigs las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni 6—579

dmangs rigs las rab tu byung ba yin gyis①/ tshe dang ldan pas ②rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ zor ba dang / phrag gdang ①bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas tha ga pa las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa ④la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni tha ga pa las rab tu byung ba yin gyis⑤/tshe dang ༅ldan pas rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ dar dag dang / ras yug chen dag dang / be'u ras dag dang / dar la dag dang / du gu la dag dang /ko tam pa dag bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas khab ris mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa ⑦la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga ⑧la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni khab ris mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis0/ tshe dang ldan pas rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ be'u ras yug chen ⑨ dang / bar thang dang /khab ris dang / khre'u tho〉tshe dang / gong bu bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang 6—580

rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ①ba'i bsam pas bzang mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni bzang mkhan ②las rab tu byung ba yin gyis③ / tshe dang ldan pas rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ zhwa dang zhwa sgre bo dang /byis pa'i gos dag dang / shi nga dpung bcad ④dag dang / dor mang dag dang / dor thung dag dang / bzang mkhan gyi ⑤bzo gzhan gang yin pa dag bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes ⑨smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la2/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas lcags mgar ⑧las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod ⑨la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni lcags mgar tshulas rab tu byung ba yin gyis0/ tshe dang ldan pas dang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ lhung bzed dang / lhung bzed chung ngu dang / khab dang / gri ⑫dag dang / sen 'gri dag dang / lcags mgar ④gyi bzo gzhan gang yin pa dag bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis 'phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas rdungs mgar tshulas rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge 6—581

sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rdungs mgar ①las rab tu byung ba yin gyis②/ tshe dang ldan pas rang gi bzo 'di lta ste / khar gzhong chadag dang / gzhong bu dag ④dang / cha lang dag dang /skom ⑤mor dag dang / ril rjob dag dang / rdungs mgar gyi bzo ⑦gzhan gang yin pa dag bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ⑧za ma bya ba'i bsam pas ko lpags mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni ko lpags mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyisal/ tshe dang ldan pas ⑨ rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ lham sgrog gu can dag dang / lham yu chad dag dang / mchil lham dag dang / sga dag yidang / dong pa dag dang /ko lpags mkhan gyi bzo gzhan gang yin pa dag bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes tsoms na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro④/ /dge slong gis 8phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas rdza mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rdza mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis8/tshe dang ldan pas rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ rdza ma dag dang / bum pa dag dang /6—582

ril ①ba dag dang / rdze'u dag dang / kham phor dag dang / rdza mkhan gyi bzo gzhan gang yin pa dag bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas 'breg ②mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ①ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/tshe dang ldan pa ni 'breg ④mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis⑤/ tshe dang ldan pas ⑥rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ skra breg ⑦pa dang / sen ④mo breg ⑨pa dang / kha spu breg tshupa dang / byin pa bcos pa dang / 'breg yimakhan gyi bzo gzhan gang yin pa dag bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas shing mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni 8shing mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis8/ tshe dang ldan pas rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ khri dag dang / khri'u dag dang / an dag dang /an khri'u dag dang / sgo glegs dag ④dang / shing mkhan gyi bzo gzhan gang yin pa dag bslab 8par bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming 6—683

brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas phyig ①ma mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/tshe dang ldan pa ni spyig ②ma mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis / tshe dang ldan pas rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ skon bu dag dang / sprog ma dag dang /gdugs dag ④dang / bsil yab dag dang / dung gzeb ⑤dag dang /phyig ⑥ma mkhan gyi bzo gzhan ⑦gang yin pa dag bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas bran ⑧las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan ⑨pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni bran las rab tu byung ba yin gyis0/ tshe dang ldan pas rang gi bzo 'di lta ste/ bsku mnye dang / dril phyi dang /khrus yidang / pho nyar 'gro ba dang / mngag pa dang / bran gyi bzo gzhan gang yin pa dag bslab par bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bzhi bcu pa/ dge slong gis phra 6—684

ma bya ba'i bsam pas bram ze las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa ①khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod / bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni bram ze las rab tu byung ba yin gyisal/ tshe dang ldan pas charang gi las 'di lta ste/ bram ze'i spyod tshul dang / spyod pa dang / gtsang sbra dang / kun du spyod pa dang / thal ba blang ④ba dang / bya ma bum blang ba dang / lag stangs ⑤dang / thor tshugs dang / rab bsngags bya ba dang / kye zhes bya ⑥dang / nges brjod kyi rig ⑦byed dang / mchod sbyin gyi rig byed dang / snyan tshig gi rig byed dang /⑧srid sung gi rig ⑨byed dang / mchod sbyin byed pa dang /⑩ mchod sbyin byed du 'jud ⑩pa dang / klog pa dang / klog tu 'jug pa dang /tso sbyin pa dang / len pa dang / bram ze'i las gzhan gang yin pa dag kyang bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas phra mor 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma tsobya ba'i bsam pas rgyal rigs las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rgyal rigs las tsorab tu byung ba yin gyisatso/ tshe dang ldan pas rang gi las 'di lta ste/ glang po che'i tsoganyar bzhon ⑩pa dang / rta la bzhon 8pa dang / shing rta'i thabs dang / ral gri'i thabs dang / 'phong dang / phyir bsnur ba dag yidang / mdun du bsnur chab dang / lcags kyus 0sgyur thabs dang / zhags pa gdab pa 'dang /6—585

mda' bo che 'phen thabs dang / 'dzin stangs dang / gom stangs dang ①/thor tshugs dang / gcad ②pa dang / dral ba dang / dbug pa dang /rgyang nas phog pa dang / sgra grag par phog pa dang / gnad ②du phog pa dang /mi 'chor bar phog ④pa dang / tshabs che bar ༅phog pa dang / rgyal rigs kyi las gzhan gang yin pa dag kyang bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas phra mor 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas rje'u ⑥rigs las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa ⑦khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rje'u rigs las rab tu byung ba yin gyisadu/ tshe dang ldan pas rang gi las 'di lta ste/ zhing rmo ba dang/ ba lang bsrung ⑨ba dang / tshong bya ba dang / rje'u rigs kyi las gzhan gang yin pa dag kyang bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas dmangs rigs las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste/'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni dmangs rigs las rab tu byung ba yin gyis() / tshe dang ldan pas rang gi las 'di lta ste/zor ba dang / phrag gdang yidang / dmangs rigs kyi las gzhan gang yin 6—586

pa de dag kyang bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas tha ga pa las ①rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste/'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni tha ga pa las rab tu byung ba yin gyis②/ tshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste/ thags bzangs ①dang / son pa dang / dru bu ④dang / snas ma ⑤la sogs pas rang gi las bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas khab ris mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste/'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni khab ris mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis⑥/ tshe dang ldan pas ⑦'di lta ste/ rgyang shing dang / skud pa dang / tshon dang / phur pa dang / so mangs kyis ⑧rang gi las bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming ⑨brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ⑩ phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas bzang mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la 6—687

dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni bzang mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis①/ tshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste/khab dang / skud pa dang / gri dang / chan pa dang / lcub ②mos rang gi las bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhuzhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas lcags mgar ④las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni lcags mgar ⑤las rab tu byung ba yin gyisayi/ tshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste/ sbud pa dang /spud ru dang / ti tsa dang / skam pa dang / tho tho bas rang gi las bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis duphra ma bya ba'i bsam pas rdungs mgar ⑨las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rdungs mgar tshulas rab tu byung ba yin gyis(che/ tshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste/ sbud pa dang / sbud ru dang /ti tsa dang / skam pa dang / tho bas rang gi las bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus 6—588

brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas ko lpags mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni ko lpags mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyisashitshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste/ rgyus pa dang / gyi'u dang / 'breng ②gu dang /dra gri dang / smyung dang / smyung bus rang gi las bya'o zhes zer ③te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas rdza mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni rdza mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis④/ tshe dang ldan pas ⑤'di lta ste/ 'khor lo dang / dbyig yig dang / tha gu dang /'khor lo'i rten ma dang / gsal gyis rang gi las bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas 'breg ⑦mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni 'breg ⑧mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyisashitshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste/ spu gri dang / chan pa dang / bdar ⑩dang /6wa 589

smang tser ①dang / sen gris rang gi ②las bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas shing mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod / tshe dang ldan pa ni shing mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis②/ tshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste/ ste'u dang / sta re dang / gzong dang / sog le khyodang / tho bas rang gi las bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes ⑤bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ༅phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas phyig ⑦ma mkhan las rab tu byung ba'i gan du stong ⑤ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yodal/ tshe dang ldan pa ni phyig ⑨ma mkhan las rab tu byung ba yin gyis0/ tshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste/ snyig skem dang / gri dang / tshon dang / smyug tho dang / lhang tsher gyis rang gi las bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra tsom bya ba'i bsam pas bran las rab tu byung ba'i gan du song ste/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re 6—590

tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni bran las rab tu byung ba yin gyis①/ tshe dang ldan pas 'di lta ste bsku mnye dang / dril phyi dang / khrus dang / pho nyar 'gro ba dang /mngag pas rang gi las bya'o zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di ②zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ༅phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas dge slong gi gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni theng ④po dang / smad 'chal dang / zhar ba dang / lag sor rdum po dang / sgur po dang / mi'u thung dang / lba ba can dang / glen pa dang / lkugs phyepa dang / grum ༅po dang / 'on pa dang / rten 'phye dang / rkang 'bam ⑦las rab tu byung ba yin gyis ④zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la lhung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas dge slong gi gan du song ⑨ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni mdze can dang / 'brum bu phra mo can dang / ngal skyen pa ⑩dang / shu ba can dang /g.yan pa can dang / khyi rngo can dang / glog pa can dang / rkang shu can dang / skyigs bu can dang / skyug bro ba dang / khong skam (7can dang /6—591

rims can dang / rims drag po can dang / lud pa can dang / dbugs ①mi bde ba can dang / skem nad can dang / brjed ②byed can chadang /bkres ngab ④can dang / skya rbab ⑤can dang / tshil po che dang / skran can dang / khrag nad can dang / mkhris nad ⑥dang / mtshan bar rdol ba las rab tu byung ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya① / rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro//dge slong gis laphra ma bya ba'i bsam pas dge slong gi gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni pham par 'gyur ba dang / dge 'dun lhag ma dang / ltung byed dang / so sor bshags par bya ba dang /nyes byas kyi ltung ba byung ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas dge slong gi gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/ bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni khro ba dang /khon 0du 'dzin pa dang / 'chab pa dang / dngan dus 0can dang / phrag dog can dang / ser sna can dang / g.yon can dang / sgyu yican dang /ngo tsha med pa dang / khrel med pa dang / sdig pa tso'adod pa dang / log par lta ba yin no zhes zer te/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya/6—592

rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya zhes smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du 'gyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis phra ma bya ba'i bsam bas dge slong gi gan du song ste 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod la dge slong na re tshe dang ldan pa ①la dge sbyong gi tshul ga la yod/bram ze'i tshul ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa ni ro lta bu yin no zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i spyo ba dag gis spyo bar byed de/ dge slong gang zhe na/ ming ni 'di zhes bya / rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ②ni 'di zhes bya zhes ⑤smras na ming brjod pa la ltung byed du du'agyur la/ rigs dang rus brjod pa la nyes byas su 'gyur ro⑤ / /de bzhin du dge slong gis ji tsam du phra ma bya ba'i bsam pas dge slong dag dbye ⑥ba'i tshig smra ⑦na bden yang rung / brdzun ⑧yang rung thams cad du ⑨ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /dge slong la phra ma byed pa'i ltung byed de gsum pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal 0byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na dge slong drug sde dag dge 'dun mthun pas chos bzhin du rtsod pa sbyangs par ⑩shes bzhin du rtsod pa ⑫'di ni shad kyis ma byang ba dang / legs par shad 0kyis ma byang ba yin gyis yang shad ④kyis byang bar tsobya'o/ /rtsod pa 'di ni nges par ma brtags pa dang /legs par nges par ma brtags pa yin gyis ⑩yang nges par brtag ⑩par bya'o/ /rtsod pa 'di ni nye bar ma zhi ba dang / legs par nye bar ma zhi ba yin gyis ⑫6—693

yang nye bar ①zhi bar bya'o zhes yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed de/ dge slong dag yang dang yang ②du rtsod pa nye bar zhi bar byed pa na bya ba mang ba dang / byed pa mang bar ⑤gyur nas lung mnod pa dang / bklag ④pa dang / kha ton dang /rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba dang / nang gi sems kyi zhi gnas gtong ⑤bar byed do/ /dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag dge 'dun mthun pas chos bzhin du rtsod pa sbyangs ⑥par shes bzhin du rtsod pa 'di ni shad kyis ma tsobyang ba dang / legs par shad kyis ma byang ba yin gyis ⑤yang shad kyis sbyang bar ⑨bya'o/ /rtsod pa 'di ni nges par ma brtags pa dang / legs par nges par ma brtags pa ༅yin gyis yang nges par brtag ⑩par bya'o/ /rtsod 8pa 'di ni nye bar ma zhi chub dang / legs par nye bar ma zhi ba yin gyis ⑫yang nye bar zhi bar bya'o zhes yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka 8gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyagasol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du med par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong drug sde dag la rmas ⑩pa/ dge slong dag khyed tsodage 'dun mthun pas chos bzhin du rtsod pa sbyangs par shes bzhin du yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de 6—594

ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa ①mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi ②bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang dge 'dun mthun pas chos bzhin du rtsod pa sbyangs par shes bzhin du yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni drug sde'am /gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /dge 'dun zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun no/ /mthun pas zhes ④bya ba ni blo mthun pas so/ /chos bzhin du zhes ⑤bya ba ni chos ji lta ba dang / 'dul ba ji lta ba dang /ston pa'i bstan pa ༅ji lta ba bzhin du'o/ /rtsod ⑦pa zhes bya ba ni rtsod pa bzhi po ⑤'thab pa'i phyir rtsod pa dang / mi gdams pa'i phyir rtsod pa dang / ltung ba'i phyir rtsod pa dang / bya ba'i phyir rtsod ⑨pa'o/ /sbyangs pa ⑩zhes bya ba ni nye bar zhi bar byas pa'o/ /shes bzhin du zhes bya ba ni rang nyid kyis de ⑩yongs su rig pa'am/ gzhan dag gis brjod pas so/ /yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na zhes bya ba ni yang byed na'o/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang ⑫/log par ltung ba dag tu sreg 8par byed/ 'tshod par byed/ lhung bar byed pa'ol/ /gzhan yang ltung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/ des na ltung byed do zhes gsungs so// 6—595

de la ltung bar ①ji ltar 'gyur ②zhe na/ dge slong gis 'thab pa'i phyir rtsod pa la 'thab pa'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ③ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ④ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ⑤ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis 'thab pa'i phyir rtsod pa la mi gdams pa'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sdogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs ⑨byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro//shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis ④spyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis 'thab pa'i phyir rtsod pa la ltung ba'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba la shad kyis ⑧byang bar 'du shes shing ⑨yang las kyis skyo sdogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sdogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo rdzogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis 'thab pa'i phyir rtsod pa la bya ba'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba la shad kyis ⑩byang 6—596

bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis ①skya sdogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur rol/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs ②byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis mi gdams pa'i phyir ⑤rtsod pa ⑤la mi gdams pa'i phyir ༅rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sdogs ⑦byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba ⑤la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes ⑨byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis mi gdams pa'i phyir rtsod pa la 'thab ⑩pa'i phyir rtsod ⑩par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba ⑩la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na lhung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis mi gdams pa'i phyir rtsod pa la ltung ba'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba tshul shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la ④yid gnyis za ⑩zhing yang las 6—597

kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ / shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo ①sdogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis mi gdams pa'i phyir rtsod pa la bya ba'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis ②byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su la'agyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo ④stogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ / dge slong gis ⑧ltung ba'i phyir rtsod pa la ltung ⑥ba'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sdogs byed na rgyasang byed du 'gyur rol/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung ⑤byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ⑨ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing ⑩yang las kyis skyo sdogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis ⑩skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis 'altung ba'i phyir rtsod 8pa la 'thab pa'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 8'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo rdzogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sdogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro//6—598

shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ltung ba'i phyir rtsod pa la mi ①gdams pa'i phyir rtsod par ②'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis sriskyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo ④rdzogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ltung ba'i phyir ⑤rtsod pa la bya ba'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sdogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sdogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bya ba'i phyir rtsod pa la bya ⑥ba'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba ⑦la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis bskyo sdogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bya ba'i phyir rtsod pa la 'thab pa'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad 6—599

kyis byang ba la shad kyis ①byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bya ba'i phyir rtsod pa la mi gdams pa'i phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ②byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sdogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bya ba'i phyir rtsod pa la ltung ba'i ②phyir rtsod par 'du shes nas shad kyis byang ba ④la shad kyis byang ⑤bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sdogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la shad kyis byang bar 'du shes shing yang las kyis skyo sdogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /shad kyis ma byang ba la yid gnyis za zhing yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni gang zag lnga ste/gnyug mar gnas pa dang / las byed pa dang / 'dun pa 'bul ba dang /lta ba smra ba dang / blo ⑦bur du 'ongs pa dag go/ /de la gang zag gnyug mar gnas pa gang zhe na/ gang gis rtsod ⑦pa de'i thog ma dang / dbus dang /6—600

tha ma dag shes pa'o/ /gang zag las byed pa gang zhe na/ gang gis rtsod pa de nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir las byas pa'o/ /gang zag 'dun pa 'bul ba gang zhe na/ gang gis las de bya ba'i phyir 'dun pa phul bar gyur pa'o/ /gang zag lta ba smra ba gang zhe na/ gang gis rtsod pa de la rang gi lta ba smras par gyur pa'o / /gang zag blo ①bur du 'ongs pa gang zhe na/ gang gis rtsod pa de'i thog ma dang / dbus dang / tha ma dag mi shes pa'o/ /de la gang zag dang po gsum po gnyug mar gnas pa dang / las byed pa dang / 'dun pa ②'bul ba'i gang zag de gsum gyis dge 'dun mthun pas chos bzhin du rtsod pa sbyangs par shes bzhin du yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /gang zag tha ma gnyis po lta ba smra ba dang / blo ①bur du 'ongs pa'i gang zag de gnyis ④dge 'dun mthun pas chos bzhin du rtsod pa sbyangs par shes bzhin du yang las kyis skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /las dang po pa dang /smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ⑧ltung ba med do/ /skyo sngogs byed pa'i ltung byed de bzhi ⑥pa rdzogs sto// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka sha mtshan gyi rig pa shes te/ de snga dro sham thabs bgos/ lhung bzed ⑦dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la 'jug go/ /de bram ze dang /khyim bdag gi khyim dag tu song ste chos ston par byed cing chos bstan nas mna' ma la dris pa/ sru mo khyod kyi sgyug mo ci 'dra/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa ri 6—601

bong ma mdas phog pa ci 'dra ba de 'dra'o/ /'char kus ②smras pa/ sru mo ci de de'i nyes pa yin snyam mamal/ 'di ltar de la gtum pa'i mtshan nu chama'i bar dang / mdoms ④kyi bar dang / rked pa'i bar dag na sha rman dang /mdzer ⑤du dang / sme ba dang / sme ba dmar po dang / spu 'khyil 0ba dag yod pas de ni de'i nyes pa yin no/ /de'i 'og tu sgyug mo'i gan du song ste dris pa / sru mo khyod kyi mna' ma ci 'dra/ 'phags pa de'i skyon ni seg dar gyis bdar ⑦'tshal te/ le lo can sgrub mi phod pa/ gtum pa/ gshe ba/ spyo bar bgyid pa lags ⑧so/ /sru mo ci de de'i nyes pa yin snyam mamal/ 'di ltar de la gtum pa'i mtshan nu ma'i bar dang / mdoms tho )kyi bar dang /rked pa'i bar dag na sha rman dang / mdzer 0bu dang / sme ba dang ⑫/ sme ba dmar po dang / spu 'khyil ba dag yod pas de ni de'i nyes pa yin no/ /de dus gzhan zhig na yang sham thabs bgos/ lhung bzed dang / chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la 'jug go/ /de bram ze dang / khyim bdag gi 'khyim dag tu song ste chos ston par byed cing / chos ston pa na ④sgyug mo la dris pa/ sru mo khyod kyi mna' ma ④ci 'dra/ 'phags pa 0bu mo'am/ nu mo ci 'dra ba de 'dra'o/ /sru mo de ni 'di'i yon tan ma yin te/ 'di ltar de la nges pa'i mtshan nu ma'i bar dang / mdoms ⑩kyi bar dang / rked pa'o bar dag na 'di lta ste'u/ dpal be'u dang / bum pa gang ba dang ⑩/ bkra shis dang / g.yung drung dag yod pas de ni de'i yon tan yin no/ /de'i 'og tu de'i mna' ma'i gan du song ste dris pa/ sru mo khyod kyi sgyug mo ci 'dra/'phags pa ma'am/ bu ⑦ mo ci 'dra ba de 'dra'o/ /sru mo de ni de'i nyeyon tan 6—602

ma yin te/ 'di ltar de la nges pa'i mtshan nu ma'i bar dang / mdoms ①kyi bar dang / rked pa'i bar dag na 'di lta ste/ dpal be'u dang / bum pa gang ba dang / bkra shis dang / g.yung drung dag yod pas de ni de'i yon tan yin no/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na bud med de dag bsku mnye dang /dril phyi dang / khrus bdag gir byed pa'i tshe gcig la gcig ②gsang ba'i gnas kyi mtshan ma rtog par byed pa na/ ji 0tsam na tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas ④ji skad ⑤bstan pa de kho na lta bu'i mtshan bzang po dang / mtshan ngan pa dag mthong ngo / /de dag gang gi tshe thab ⑥me byung ba de'i tshe na gcig la gcig ⑦gleng bar byed de/ khyod kyang kho mo dang lhan cig ⑤smra bar byed dam/ khyod ⑨skyes pa gzhan dag dang lhan cig 'di dang 'di ltar byed do/ /sdig pa zhi'o/ /'o na khyod kyi mdoms ⑩kyi bar dag na mtshan dang / mtshan ngan pa dag yod pa skyes pa gzhan gyis ji ltar shes/ gal te de lta na kho 0mo yang ci'i phyir mi smra/khyod kyang kho mo dang lhan cig smra bar byed dam/ khyod skyes pa tsogazhan dag dang lhan cig 'di dang 'di ltar 'byed do/ /sdig pa zhi'o/ /'o na khyod kyi mdoms ④kyi bar dag na mtshan skedang / mtshan tsongan pa dag yod pa skyes pa gzhan gyis ji ltar shes/ gang gi tshe de dag gcig la gcig tshubazod pa gsol ba de'i tshe na gcig gis gcig tsol dris pa/ tār+shani la sus smras/ 'phags pa 'char nas ⑪sol/ /khyod la yang sus smras/ 'phags pa 'char gas du so/ /de dag 'phags pa 'char kus bsams 0bzhin du bdag cag 'thab tu bcug go zhes smod par byed/ phyar trika gtong bar byed 3/ kha zer bar byed do/ /de dag the tshom skyes nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan dag bsod snyoms ④la 6—603

zhugs pa na de dag gis de dag la dris pa/ 'phags pa dag 'phags pa 'char ka ①dge stong ②ji lta bu lags/ sring mo dag de ni mdun na 'don gyi bu las rab tu byung ba dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin no/ /'phags pa dag gal te ③dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa lags na des ji ltar bud med kyi yul gyi gsang ba'i phyogs dag na sha rman ④mchis pa dag 'tshal/ de dag gis smras pa/sring mo dag des sha mtshan brtags ⑤pa'i rig pa shes pas de'i mthus shes so/ /'phags pa dag ci ji tsam 'tshal ba de dag thams cad bstan par bgyi'am zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong ⑥bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ⑦'di snyam du dgongs te/ gang gi phyir nyes dmigs cung zad ci labyung ba de dag thams cad dge slong dag 0bud med kyi yul la chos ston ⑩pa las gyur pa yin gyisayi/ de'i phyir dge slong gis bud med kyi yul la chos bstan par mi bya'o snyam du dgongs nas de lta bas na dge slong gis bud med kyi yul la chos bstan par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis bud med kyi yul la chos bstan par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas tsodage slong dag bsod snyoms la zhugs pa na bud med kyi yul dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag chos bstan du gsol/ sring mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /de dag gis smras pa/ gal te khyod chos mi ston na bdag cag kyang bsod snyoms mi 'bul lo zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshig lngas chos bstan par bya ste/ sring mo dag 'di ltar gzugs ni mi rtag 0pa'o/ /tshor ba 6wa 604

dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni mi rtag pa'o zhes bya bas so/ /dge slong dag bsod snyoms la zhugs pa na bud med kyi yul dag gis smras pa①/ 'phags pa dag chos bstan du gsol/ dge slong rnams kyis sring mo dag 'di ltar gzugs ni mi rtag pa'o/ /tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni mi rtag ②pa'o zhes tshig lngas chos bstan pa dang / de dag gis smras ②pa/ 'phags pa dag yang chos bstan du gsol/ sring mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis re zhig de tsam zhig rjes su gnang ngo / /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag legs kyis bdag cag ④kyang bsod snyoms cung zhig 'bul lo zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshig drug gis chos bstan par bya ste/ sring mo dag 'di ltar mig ni mi rtag pa'o/ /rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid ni mi rtag pa'o zhes bya bas so/ /dge ⑤slong dag bsod snyoms la zhugs pa na bud med kyi yul dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag chos bstan du gsol/dge slong rnams kyis sring mo dag 'di ltar mig ni ⑥mi rtag pa'o/ /rna ba dang /sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid ni mi rtag pa'o zhes tshig drug gis chos bstan pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag yang chos bstan du gsol/ sring mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis re zhig de tsam zhig rjes su gnang ngo / /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag legs kyis ⑦bdag cag kyang bsod ②snyoms chung 0zhig 'bul ⑨ lo zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/6—605

skyes pa bzhag ste ji tsam ①'dod par chos bstan par bya'o/ /dge slong dag bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dag ②na bud med kyi yul dag gis smras pa/'phags pa chos bstan du gsol/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ sring mo dag skyes pa 'ga' zhig khrid de shog /'phags pa dag skyes pas ci bgyi/sring mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis skyes pa bzhag ste/ ci tsam 'dod par ②chos bstan par bya'o zhes bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar mdzad do/ /'phags pa dag legs te bdag cag kyang shin tu sbas pa dang / shin tu bsrungs par 'gyur la/ 'phags pa dag kyang mi bsnyengs ④par chos ston par 'gyur ro zhes de dag gis skyes pa khrid de 'ongs nas dge slong dag gis kyang ci 'dod pas ⑤chos bstan te dong ngo / /drug sde dag bsod snyoms la zhugs nas de dag gis bud med kyi yul dag la smras pa/ sring mo dag 'khod cig dang chos bstan par bya'o / /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag skyes pa 'ga' zhig khrid de mchi'i ⑥bar du re zhig yud tsam zhig gzhes lasu gsol drug sde dag gis smras pa/khyi dang / spre'u dang / be'u dang / phyi rgan ⑧du nyal ba dang / gog pa dang / khye'u ⑨'dug pa 'di las gzhan pa'i skyes pa ci dgos zhes de dag la chos bstan nas dong 0ngo / /dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan dag bsod snyoms la zhugs pa na bud med kyi yul dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag chos bstan du gsol/ sring mo dag skyes pa 'ga' zhig khrid de shog /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag ci yilags khyi dang / spre'u dang / be'u dang /phyi rgan du nyal 8ba dang / gog pa dang / khye'u 'di phyedag ma mchis sam/sring mo dag kho bo cag skyes pa 'di lta bu dang chos mi ston te/ khyed cag la skyes 6—606

pa 'di lta bu dang chos ston par byed pa de su yin/ de dag gis smras ①pa/'phags pa drug sde dag go/ /de kho rgyana'i phyir de dag gi ③gnas skabs de 'dra'o zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rig pa'i skyes pa bzhag ④ste ci 'dod par chos bstan par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bud med kyi yul la tshig lnga'am drug gis chos bstan par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ drug sde dag tshig lngas chos ston pa na bsams bzhin du tshig drug pa la 'jug par byed cing / tshig drug gis chos ston pa na yang bsams bzhin du tshig bdun pa la 'jug par byed nas dge slong rnams kyis de dag la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis tshig lnga'am drug gis chos bstan par bya'o zhes bka' stsal na/ khyed cag tshig lngas chos ston ⑤pa na bsams bzhin du tshig drug pa la 'jug par byed cing / tshig drug gis chos ston pa na yang bsams bzhin du tshig bdun pa la 'jug par byed dam/ de dag gis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag gang la tshig lnga pa rung ba de la tshig drug pa yang rung la/ gang la ༅tshig drug pa rung ba de la ⑦tshig bdun pa yang rung steni/ tshig drug pa dang / bdun pas kun dong 0zos sam/ chang 'thungs sam/ ji ⑨ na dmigs kyis dgag par ⑩bya/ dge slong don nyung ngu dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bud med kyi yul che tshig lnga'am/ drug gis chos bstan par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas8/ ci'i phyir dge slong dag tshig lngas chos ston pa na tsobasams bzhin du tshig drug pa la 'jug par byed cing / tshig drug gis chos ston pa na yang bsams bzhin du tshig bdun pa la tso'ajug par byed ces smod par byed/6—607

phyar ka ①gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi dang / skabs ②'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed ①par mdzad pa ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang snga ma bzhin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong drug sde dag la rmas ④pa/dge slong dag ngas ⑤dud med kyi yul la tshig lnga'am/ drug gis chos bstan par bya'o zhes bstan na/ khyed tshig lngas chos ston pa na bsams bzhin du tshig drug pa la 'jug par byed cing / tshig drug gis chos ston pa na yang bsams ⑥bzhin du tshig bdun pa la 'jug pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas ༅bya ba ma yin no zhes rnam ⑤par smad pa ⑨mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la 0nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon ⑩par bya ste/ yang dge slong gang bud med kyi yul la tshig lnga'am drug las lhag pa'i 8chos ston na/ rig 8pa'i skyes pa ma gtogs te ltung byed do/ /yang dge slong gang zhes bya ba ni drug sde'am/ gzhan yang de lta bu gang yin pa'o/ /bud med kyi yul la zhes bya ba ni bud med dam/6—608
